Swipe.description: A melee attack that hits all enemies in an area in front of you. Unaffected by weapon range.
Swipe.altText: Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

SummonWolf.description:
Summons a primal wolf that follows you into combat. When its health drops to 0 it is downed, and you can stand near it to revive it.

While you have your maximum number of wolves, the ability is replaced with {Howl}.

The wolf counts as a companion. You can have a maximum of two companions at once by default.
SummonWolf.altText: The Wolf has 220 base health and is resistant to powerful area attacks.

BasicPlayerAttack.description: A basic attack with your weapon that costs no mana

Primalist Evade.description:
Rapidly move a short distance forwards.

Evading does not grant damage immunity or prevent abilities from hitting you.

Evade gains 0.5% Increased Cooldown Recovery Speed per Character level.

GatheringStormMelee.description: Strike at your enemy with a mighty lightning powered storm. When you use Gathering Storm and hit at least one enemy, you gain a {Storm Stack}. Every second you expend a Storm Stack to cause a {Storm Bolt} to strike a nearby enemy. This interval is reduced by 2% for every stack you currently have.
GatheringStormMelee.altText:
The attack deals melee lightning damage with added damage applying at 100% effectiveness, and the {Storm Bolt} deals spell lightning damage with added damage applying at 100% effectiveness.

Increased area for area skills stats apply to the melee attack and to the damage area of the {Storm Bolt}, but not to the area in which enemies are targeted by {Storm Bolts}.

FuryLeap.description: Leap to the target location, dealing damage to nearby enemies when you hit the ground.
FuryLeap.altText:
Added damage is applied at 250% effectiveness.

Using a Traversal skill puts all other traversal skills on cooldown and traversal skills' cooldowns do not recover while you are using a traversal skill.

SummonThornTotem.description: Summons a totem that fires thorns at nearby enemies. You can have a maximum of two thorn totems by default.
SummonThornTotem.altText:
Totems scale with your minion or totem stats, not your stats.
Added minion spell damage applies at 100% effectiveness for the Thorns fired by the Thorn Totem.

Thorn totems have 120 base health and last 6 seconds by default.

TempestStrike.description:
A melee combo attack that cycles through a cold strike, a physical strike, and a lightning strike that trigger elemental {Tempest} spells of the same damage type if the strikes hit at least one enemy.

Cold strike: Triggers a {Frigid Tempest}, which is a cold projectile that pierces through enemies.
Physical strike: Triggers a {Wind Tempest}, which is a small twister that lasts a short duration dealing physical damage per over time.
Lightning strike: Triggers a {Thunder Tempest}, which is an expanding storm of lightning bolts.
TempestStrike.altText:
Added damage for the melee strikes apply at 100% effectiveness.

{Frigid Tempest}: Added damage applies at 150% effectiveness.
{Wind Tempest}: Added damage applies at 150% effectiveness per second.
{Thunder Tempest}: Added damage applies at 100% effectiveness.

Maelstrom.description:
Surrounds you with a freezing Maelstrom that deals cold damage over time to nearby enemies.

Can be cast repeatedly to create multiple maelstroms at once. Each Maelstrom lasts 7 seconds.
Maelstrom.altText:
Each Maelstrom has a base freeze rate per second of 24.

Added spell damage applies to each Maelstrom at 100% effectiveness per second.

Upheaval.description: Sunders the ground in a line in front of you, dealing damage to enemies along the path.
Upheaval.altText: Added damage is applied at 200% effectiveness.

Eterras Blessing.description: The nearest allied target is healed for 100 health. If the target is one of your minions then the healing is tripled and the minion is energised for 4 seconds, increasing its size by 20% and its damage by 100%.

Warcry.description:
Unleash a mighty roar that knocks back nearby enemies and stuns them for 1.5 seconds. Rares and bosses are stunned for half as long.

20% of remaining cooldown recovered whenever you stun (or freeze if Warcry is converted to cold) an enemy, including with Warcry itself. This effect can occur a maximum of two times each second.

SummonStormCrow.description:
Summons Storm Crows up to your companion limit. The Storm Crow casts spells from a distance. When its health drops to 0 it is downed, and you can stand near it to revive it.

The Storm Crow counts as a companion. You can have a maximum of two companions at once by default.
SummonStormCrow.altText: The crow has 200 base health and is resistant to powerful area attacks.

SerpentStrike.description:
Requires a spear.

A melee attack with 140% poison chance.

Poisons inflicted by serpent strike last 40% longer.
SerpentStrike.altText:
Poison chance above 100% gives a chance to apply additional stacks of poison (this mechanic applies to all hits, not just Serpent Strike).

Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

SummonRaptor.description:
Summons a primal raptor that ferociously attacks your enemies. When its health drops to 0 it is downed, and you can stand near it to revive it.

The raptor counts as a companion. You can have a maximum of two companions at once by default.
SummonRaptor.altText: The raptor has 240 base health and is resistant to powerful area attacks.

SummonBear.description:
Summons a primal bear that follows you into combat. When its health drops to 0 it is downed, and you can stand near it to revive it.

The bear counts as a companion. You can have a maximum of two companions at once by default.
SummonBear.altText: Primals bears have 300 base health and is resistant to powerful area attacks.

SummonScorpion.description:
Summons a scorpion that follows you into combat. Its attacks with its tails inflict a long lasting poison. When its health drops to 0 it is downed, and you can stand near it to revive it.

The scorpion counts as a companion. You can have a maximum of two companions at once by default.
SummonScorpion.altText: The scorpion has 400 base health and is resistant to powerful area attacks.

SummonFrenzyTotem.description: Summons a totem that grants Frenzy to all nearby allies. Frenzy increases attack and cast speed by 20%.
SummonFrenzyTotem.altText: Frenzy totems have 120 base health and last 6 seconds.

SummonSabertooth.description:
Summons a primal sabertooth cat that leaps into combat. When its health drops to 0 it is downed, and you can stand near it to revive it.

The sabertooth cat counts as a companion. You can have a maximum of two companions at once by default.
SummonSabertooth.altText: The sabertooth has 240 base health and is resistant to powerful area attacks.

SummonStormTotem.description:
Summons a totem that casts lightning storms around nearby enemies.

Storm totems last 8 seconds, and you cannot control more than 1 at once.

Tornado.description: Conjures a tornado that moves at random, pulling in nearby enemies and dealing physical damage to them.
Tornado.altText: Added damage applies to the damage over time at 150% effectiveness per second.

EarthquakeSlam.description: Slam the ground with your weapon damaging enemies in a large area and creating 2 to 4 aftershocks nearby.
EarthquakeSlam.altText: Added melee damage applies at 700% effectiveness.

Earthquake.description: A melee attack that hits all enemies in an area around you sending out tremors to nearby enemies.

EarthquakeAftershock.description: Seeks out targets and erupts, damaging all nearby enemies.
EarthquakeAftershock.altText: Added damage is applied at 200% effectiveness

Avalanche.description: Summon the might of winter and pummel your foes in ice and snow, unleashing a large boulder at the target followed by 10 smaller boulders around the area over 2 seconds.
Avalanche.altText:
Added damage is applied at 400% effectiveness. Each hit has a freeze rate of 80.
The large boulder deals 100% more damage and has 100% more area of effect (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

Increased Area for Area Skills stats apply to the area of the individual boulders, but not to the area in which they fall.

AvalancheSnowball.description: Call a meteor from the sky that deals a large amount of damage upon landing. Added damage is applied at three times its normal value.
AvalancheSnowball.altText: Added damage is applied at 300% effectiveness.

AvalancheSnowballAoE.description: Launches an icy boulder from the sky.
AvalancheSnowballAoE.altText: Added damage is applied at 300% effectiveness.

WerebearForm.description:
Transform into a ferocious werebear, increasing your physical capabilities and gaining 4 new abilities. 

Your mana is replaced with Rage while in werebear form. When your Rage reaches 0 you automatically transform back into your human form. Your starting Rage is equal to your maximum mana. Rage slowly decays over time at a constant rate.
WerebearForm.altText:
The four new abilities are: Rampage, Swipe, Maul and Roar. Swipe and Roar inherit all bonuses from your Swipe and Warcry skill trees.

While in bear form you have 50% increased melee damage and 15% increased health.

When returning to human form, your mana will return to the amount you had before shapeshifting, but you will have gained the mana you regenerated while shapeshifted. Other forms of mana recovery do not apply.

SprigganForm.description:
Transform into a forest spriggan, increasing your spell casting capabilities, and gaining 4 new abilities.

Your mana is replaced with Rage while in spriggan form. When your Rage reaches 0 you automatically transform back into your human form. Your starting Rage is equal to your maximum mana. Rage slowly decays over time at a constant rate.
SprigganForm.altText:
The four new abilities are: Spirit Thorns, Thorn Shield, Summon Vine and Summon Healing Totem.

While in spriggan form you have 50% increased spell damage and +300 armor.

When returning to human form, your mana will return to the amount you had before shapeshifting, but you will have gained the mana you regenerated while shapeshifted. Other forms of mana recovery do not apply.

ThornShield.description: Form a protective barrier of thorns around yourself or an ally that grants 30 armor and reflects 40 damage to attackers. When the shield expires, a burst of thorns shoots out and damages all nearby enemies.

Thorn Shield Nova.description: Releases a burst of thorns, damaging all nearby enemies.
Thorn Shield Nova.altText: Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

SummonSpriggan.description:
Summon a spriggan that casts spells to attack your enemies and has a passive Healing Aura that restores 10 health per second. When its health drops to 0 it is downed, and you can stand near it to revive it.

The spriggan counts as a companion. You can have a maximum of two companions at once by default.
SummonSpriggan.altText: The spriggan has 160 base health and is resistant to powerful area attacks.

Swarmblade Form.description:
Transform into an agile Swarmblade, increasing your melee capabilities, and gaining 4 new abilities.

Your mana is replaced with Rage while in swarmblade form. When your Rage reaches 0 you automatically transform back into your human form. Your starting Rage is equal to your maximum mana. Rage slowly decays over time at a constant rate.
Swarmblade Form.altText:
The four new abilities are: Armblade Slashes, Swarm Strike, Dash and Summon Hive.

While in Swarmblade Form you have 10% increased melee attack speed and movement speed.

When returning to human form, your mana will return to the amount you had before shapeshifting, but you will have gained the mana you regenerated while shapeshifted. Other forms of mana recovery do not apply.

SwarmbladeSpinAttack.description: A circular attack which deals damage to all nearby enemies, then gathers nearby locusts to create a Swarm around you which deals damage over time to nearby enemies.
SwarmbladeSpinAttack.altText:
For each Locust consumed the Swarm gains +15 melee physical, +15 melee poison damage, 15% increased duration, and 15% increased area.

Added melee damage applies at 350% effectiveness to the initial hit and at 300% per second to the Swarm.

Locust Swarm.description:
Surrounds you with a swarm of locusts that deals melee damage over time.

Has a base duration of 4 seconds. Only one Locust Swarm can exist at once.
Locust Swarm.altText: Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

EntanglingRoots.description:
Call forth a wave of roots that grows outwards in a wide cone in front of you. The wave deals physical damage and roots enemies it hits for 1.5 seconds. Rooted enemies take physical damage over time until they are freed.

Added spell damage applies at 100% to the initial hit and 200% per second to the damage over time.

ManaStrike.description: A melee attack that hits all enemies in an area in front of you. If it hits at least one enemy, it creates a mana orb that returns to you and restores 15 mana.
ManaStrike.altText: Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

LightningBlast.description: Hurl a bolt of lightning at the target. It chains to an additional enemy for each time it has been directly cast in the last 4 seconds, up to 2 times.
LightningBlast.altText: Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

Mage Evade.description:
Rapidly move a short distance forwards.

Evading does not grant damage immunity or prevent abilities from hitting you.

Evade gains 0.5% Increased Cooldown Recovery Speed per Character level.

Fireball.description: Cast a ball of fire towards the target. Has 40% chance to ignite on hit. Added spell damage applies at 125% effectiveness.

SnapFreeze.description:
Freezes enemies in a cone in front of you. Freeze lasts for 2 seconds.

20% of remaining cooldown recovered whenever you freeze an enemy, including with Snap Freeze itself. This effect can occur a maximum of two times each second.

ElementalNova.description:
Casts a nova around you that deals fire, cold and lightning damage.

All types of Elemental Nova that you have enabled have an equal chance to be cast.
ElementalNova.altText: Added damage is applied at 120% effectiveness.

FlameWard.description: Grants a burst of 400 ward. Then for 3 seconds, hits deal 30% less damage to you and cause a retaliatory burst of flames.
FlameWard.altText:
Added spell damage applies ot the burst of flames at 200% effectiveness.

The area of effect of the burst of flames scales with increased Area of Area Skills stats.

Teleport.altText: Using a Traversal skill puts all other traversal skills on cooldown and traversal skills' cooldowns do not recover while you are using a traversal skill.

Frost Claw.description: Three projectiles arc to the target location to create a burst of frost. Added spell damage applies to the burst at 100% effectiveness and it has a freeze rate of 40.

Frost Claw Left Projectile.description: Three projectiles arc to the target location to create a burst of frost. Added spell damage applies to the burst at 100% effectiveness and it has a freeze rate of 40.

Frost Claw Main Projectile.description: Three projectiles arc to the target location to create a burst of frost. Added spell damage applies to the burst at 100% effectiveness and it has a freeze rate of 40.

Frost Claw Explosion.description: Three projectiles arc to the target location to create a burst of frost. Added spell damage applies to the burst at 100% effectiveness and it has a freeze rate of 40.

Frost Claw Right Projectile.description: Three projectiles arc to the target location to create a burst of frost. Added spell damage applies to the burst at 100% effectiveness and it has a freeze rate of 40.

Static.description:
Static charges up as you move or when you get hit. Activate Static to discharge what you have built up, striking up to 5 nearby enemies with lightning.

100 charges maximum. Deals 4% more damage per charge.
Static.altText:
By default static gains 5 charges per second while moving, and also gains 5 charges whenever you take a hit.

Added spell damage applies at 250% effectiveness.

Glacier.description: Creates three successively larger ice explosions in the target direction. Each explosion deals more damage than the last.
Glacier.altText:
Added damage is applied at double effectiveness to the middle explosion, and at quadruple effectiveness to the largest explosion.

The smallest explosion has a freeze rate of 40, the middle explosion has a freeze rate of 70, and the largest explosion has a freeze rate of 140.

Added spell damage applies at 100% effectiveness to the smallest explosion, 175% effectiveness to the middle explosion, and 350% effectiveness to the largest explosion.

Disintegrate.description: Channel to create a beam of pure energy in the target direction. The beam deals fire and lightning damage to all enemies caught in it.
Disintegrate.altText: Added damage applies at 480% effectiveness each second. Damage reduces while rotating.

VolcanicOrb.description: Casts a fiery orb that spews burning shrapnel in all directions.
VolcanicOrb.altText: Added damage applies to the orb at 200% effectiveness, and to the shrapnel at 100% effectiveness.

Shrapnel.description: Fires a piece of burning shrapnel in a random direction.
Shrapnel.altText: Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

Focus.description: Hold ability key to channel. While channelling you have 100% increased mana regen and gain 10 ward per second. After channelling for exactly one second you recover 10% of missing mana and gain a burst of 40 mana and ward.

Meteor.description: Call a meteor from the sky that deals a large amount of damage upon landing.
Meteor.skillLore: A cunning mage can use the power of gravity in more ways than one
Meteor.altText: Added damage is applied at 1200% effectiveness

MeteorAoe.description: Call a meteor from the sky that deals a large amount of damage upon landing.
MeteorAoe.skillLore: A cunning mage can use the power of gravity in more ways than one
MeteorAoe.altText: Added damage is applied at 1200% effectiveness

StaticOrb.description: Casts an orb in a target direction that deals lightning damage and pulls enemies that it hits towards it as it travels. At the target location it explodes, dealing lightning damage to enemies surrounding it and also striking up to 5 enemies further out. The further it travels the higher the damage and area of effect of the explosion, up to 100%.
StaticOrb.altText:
As the area of effect of the explosion increases so does the maximum range at which it can strike additional enemies. Increased Area for Area Skills stats also affect both and are additive with this increase.

Static Orb's added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness and the explosion added damages is applied at 200% effectiveness.

IceBarrage.description: Opens a rift that repeatedly shoots a barrage of ice shards in a target direction for 5 seconds.
IceBarrage.altText:
Ice Shards are cold projectiles that will curve to nearby targets.

The shards have a freeze rate of 40.

Added damage is applied at 120% effectiveness.

Frostbolt.description: Cast a homing bolt of ice towards the target.

ArcaneAscendance.description: Toggle to prevent movement and drain 25 mana each second. Mana drain increases by 1 mana per second. All spells cost +5 mana to cast. 100% increased spell damage and 50% increased cast speed. Also deals lightning damage over time to surrounding enemies.
ArcaneAscendance.altText: Added damage is applied at 45% effectiveness.

BlackHole.description: Summon a powerful black hole at target location that aggressively pulls enemies and deals cold damage over time to enemies within its reach.
BlackHole.altText: Added spell damage is applied at 800% effectiveness per second. The Black Hole persists for 2.75s by default.

ShatterStrike.description:
A sweeping melee attack of 2 arcs that strikes enemies in a circle around you dealing cold damage and instantly kills frozen enemies below 10% health.

Enemies in the middle of the attack are hit twice, where the arcs overlap.
ShatterStrike.altText:
Has a freeze rate of 50.

Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

FlameReave.description: A melee attack that releases a wave of flames from your weapon, cleaving through enemies in a cone in front of you. Deals less damage as it expands, up to 50% less at maximum distance.

EnchantWeapon.description:
Active: Enchant your weapon with elemental power. Your melee attacks deal 50% more elemental damage for 5 seconds.

Passive: Your melee attacks deal 15% more elemental damage.

Firebrand.description: A melee attack which grants you a stack of Firebrand buff if it hits an enemy. Each stack of the Firebrand buff increases the size of subsequent Firebrand attacks and adds melee fire damage.
Firebrand.altText:
Firebrand can stack up to 4 times. Each stack grants +5 melee fire damage, increases the size of Firebrand attacks by 25% and lasts for 4 seconds.

Added damage is applied at 125% effectiveness.

Surge.description: Quick fixed distance dash which hits all enemies in the path with a lightning melee attack.
Surge.altText:
Added melee damage applies at 200% effectiveness.

Using a Traversal skill puts all other traversal skills on cooldown and traversal skills' cooldowns do not recover while you are using a traversal skill.

Runemaster 04 Runic Invocation.description:
{Passive:} Whenever you directly use an elemental skill, gain 1 {Rune} of the corresponding element. For channelled skills you gain 1 rune per second instead.

{Active:} Consume all of your active {Runes} to cast a unique {Invocation} based on the combination and order of runes consumed.

The last {Rune} in the sequence determines the damage type.

Casting a fire skill grants a {Rah Rune}.
Casting a lightning skill grants a {Gon Rune}.
Casting a cold skill grants a {Heo Rune}.
Runemaster 04 Runic Invocation.altText: Added damage applies at varying effectiveness and for {Invocations}, but the more {Runes} you have before casting an {Invocation} the more powerful they become and the more mana they cost.

Runemaster 10 Ward Burst.description:
Grants you a burst of ward.

Ward gained: 80 + 1 per intelligence

Cast elemental skills to gain runes and invoke more powerful invocations than this one.

Runemaster 06 Flame Rush.description: You turn into a ball of flame and launch yourself in the target direction. The longer you hold down the key, the slower you move, but the larger and more damaging the explosion is when you stop channeling. You take 40% less damage during Flame Rush.
Runemaster 06 Flame Rush.altText:
Added damage applies to the hit from passing through enemies at 100% effectiveness, and to the explosion at 200% effectiveness.
The explosion gains up to 150% more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and 150% increased area based on time spent channeling.

Runemaster 06.1 Explosion.description: Create a burst of fire damage around a minion. Has 400% added damage effectiveness.

Runemaster 01 Frost Wall.description:
Creates a wall of frost which persists for 6 seconds. Enemies inside the wall take cold damage over time and receive a stack of chill every 0.25 seconds. You can have up to 1 active Frost Wall at a time.

Enemies that reach the wall at least 0.2 seconds after it's been created are frozen for twice as long as the wall has existed, up to a 2 second freeze duration. Bosses cannot be frozen in this way.
Runemaster 01 Frost Wall.altText: Added spell damage applies at 400% effectiveness per second and the damage over time has a freeze rate of 80 per second.

Runemaster 05c1 Runebolt Fire.description: A combo spell that fires piercing projectiles. The first part of the combo is fire, the second is lightning, and the third is cold.
Runemaster 05c1 Runebolt Fire.altText: Added damage applies at 100% effectiveness. The cold rune bolt has a freeze rate of 40.

Runemaster 02 Glyph of Dominion.description: Places a lightning glyph on the ground that grows over time. Deals lightning damage over time and slows in its area. At full size it detonates, dealing large amounts of lightning damage to enemies within its area. You can have a maximum of one Glyph at a time by default.
Runemaster 02 Glyph of Dominion.altText:
Added damage applies to the damage over time at 150% effectiveness each second, and to the explosion at 200% effectiveness.
The glyph and its explosion gain up to 150% more radius (multiplicative with other modifiers) over the course of its growth. Modifiers to duration do not affect the total growth.

Runemaster 02.1 Glyph of Dominion Damage.description: Create a wall that chills enemies who walk through it.

Rive1.description: A combo of three melee attacks. Every third consecutive attack with Rive slashes in a full circle around the character, dealing double damage.
Rive1.altText:
The consecutive attack counter resets if you go 3 seconds without using Rive.

Added melee damage applies to the first two hits at 125% effectiveness and to the third hit at 250% effectiveness.

Vengeance.description:
A melee attack that also prepares you to riposte incoming hits.

If vengeance successfully hits an enemy and you take a hit in the next 2 seconds you will riposte, taking 25% less damage and striking at a nearby enemy.
Vengeance.altText: Added damage is applied at 125% effectiveness to the initial hit and 150% effectiveness to the riposte.

Sentinel Evade.description:
Rapidly move a short distance forwards.

Evading does not grant damage immunity or prevent abilities from hitting you.

Evade gains 0.5% Increased Cooldown Recovery Speed per Character level.

Warpath.description: Spin towards the mouse while you hold down the ability key, striking nearby enemies as you move.
Warpath.altText:
You have 20% less movement speed while spinning (multiplicative with other modifiers). Hits at twice your attack rate, but added damage applies at 60% effectiveness and there is a 40% less chance to apply ailments on hit. 

You cannot be stunned while spinning.

Not affected by weapon range.

HammerThrow.description:
Throws a hammer that returns to you after a short delay.

Added Throwing Damage is applied to each hit at 110% effectiveness.
HammerThrow.altText: This is a throwing attack that scales with throwing attack damage and throwing attack speed. It is not a melee attack or spell.

Lunge.description: Dash to a nearby enemy and strike it with your weapon. Cannot be used without a target. Costs more mana the further away the target is.
Lunge.altText:
Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

Using a Traversal skill puts all other traversal skills on cooldown and traversal skills' cooldowns do not recover while you are using a traversal skill.

ShieldBash.description:
Requires a shield.

A melee directional attack that stuns enemies for 1 second. 100% increased stun duration against non-boss enemies.

1.5% more damage per 1% block chance (up to 150%, multiplicative with other modifiers).

20% of remaining cooldown recovered whenever you stun an enemy, including with Shield Bash itself. This effect can occur a maximum of two times each second.
ShieldBash.altText:
Increased attack speed has no effect for Shield Bash.

Added damage is applied at 150% effectiveness.

Javelin.description:
Hurl a javelin that pierces through every enemy in its path.

If you have a spear equipped added melee damage from the spear applies to Javelin as added throwing damage at 50% of its normal value. Added melee damage from other sources has no effect.

Added throwing damage applies at 250% effectiveness.
Javelin.altText:
This is a throwing attack that scales with throwing attack damage and throwing attack speed.

The 250% added throwing damage effectiveness applies to all added throwing damage, including added throwing damage that was converted from your spear's added melee damage. So, equipping a spear with +100 Melee Damage causes Javelin to deal 125 additional damage.

VoidCleave.description:
Requires a 2-handed sword or axe.

A melee attack that hits all enemies in an area in front of you. Can be echoed by Void Knights. Unaffected by weapon range.

Rebuke.description:
Hold ability key to channel for up to 2 seconds. You take 80% less damage while channelling.

When you stop channelling the barrier breaks dealing physical damage to all nearby enemies. This deals 20 additional physical damage for each hit you received while channelling.
Rebuke.altText:
You cannot be stunned while channelling.

Added spell damage is applied at 200% effectiveness.

ShieldRush.description:
Requires a shield.

Charge through enemies in the target direction until you release the ability key. You hit enemies in your path and in a wider area at the end of the movement. You do not regenerate mana while rushing.
ShieldRush.altText:
Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

Using a Traversal skill puts all other traversal skills on cooldown and traversal skills' cooldowns do not recover while you are using a traversal skill.

Multistrike.description:
A melee attack that grants a stack of {Armament} if you hit at least one enemy.

Armament stacks up to 2 times and each stack lasts 3 seconds.

Each stack of {Armament} causes an additional sword to strike a nearby enemy when you use Multistrike.
Multistrike.altText:
Additional swords cannot target the enemy you initially hit or enemies targeted by other swords.

Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

Smite.description:
Smites a target enemy with a bolt of holy fire that descends from the sky, healing allies around the target for 60 health. If you are in the area you are also healed.

Cannot be used without a target.
Smite.altText: Added spell damage applies at 150% effectiveness

ErasingStrike.description: A melee attack that hits all enemies in a large area in front of you. Enemies killed by the hit are erased from existence, replaced by void rifts.
ErasingStrike.altText: Added melee damage has 600% effectiveness on the initial hit, but none on the void rifts, which are void spells.

VolatileReversal.description: A combo ability that jumps forwards in time to a target location and performs a melee attack on arrival. Recast within 3 seconds to jump backwards in time to your original location and perform a melee attack on arrival.
VolatileReversal.altText:
Added damage applies to the melee attacks at 200% effectiveness.

Volatile Reversal's cooldown continues recovering while the recast is available.

VolatileReversalAttack.description: A combo ability that jumps forwards in time to a target location and performs a melee attack on arrival. Recast within 3 seconds to jump backwards in time to your original location and perform a melee attack on arrival.
VolatileReversalAttack.altText: Added damage applies to the melee attacks at 200% effectiveness.

AbyssalEchoes.description: A nova that echoes from up to 8 enemies it reaches and applies abyssal decay. Enemies with abyssal decay take void damage over time for 5 seconds, if they take a hit all the damage from abyssal decay is dealt to them immediately.
AbyssalEchoes.altText:
Abyssal decay deals a total of 100 void damage over its duration, with added spell damage applied at 100% effectiveness each second.

Abyssal Echoes cannot apply other on hit effects on hit.

DevouringOrb.description:
Creates a devouring orb at the target location for 10 seconds that deals void damage over time to nearby enemies, and casts a void rift whenever something dies nearby, hitting nearby enemies to deal void damage.

Each successive rift has 12% more damage and area of effect, capped at an increase of 120%.
DevouringOrb.altText:
Added damage is applied to the damage over time area at 100% effectiveness per second, and to the Void Rifts at 75% effectiveness.

Devouring orb cannot cast more than one void rift every 0.1 seconds.

Anomaly.description: Combo skill that first sends enemies forward in time by 5 seconds. Reactivate the skill to bring those enemies back to your timeline early.
Anomaly.altText: Bosses are only sent forward by a millisecond, causing return effects to occur immediately without them visually disappearing.

ForgeStrike.description:
A melee attack that hits all enemies in an area in front of you.

25% chance on hit to summon a Forged Weapon which lasts for 20 seconds and is affected by the stats and attack rate of your weapon. You can control up to 6 Forged Weapons at once.
ForgeStrike.altText: Added melee damage applies at 600% effectiveness.

ShieldThrow.description:
Throws a shield at a target enemy. The shield ricochets to up to 2 additional targets before returning to you.

You cannot throw a new shield until the current shield has returned to you.
ShieldThrow.altText:
The shield hits all enemies in its path, even those it does not ricochet from.

Added throwing attack damage is applied at 225% effectiveness.

ManifestArmor.description:
Manifests an animated set of heavy armor, which attacks slowly.

Stats granted by your body armor, helmet, gloves and boots also apply to your Manifest Armor.
ManifestArmor.altText:
Manifested Armors have 400 base health.

Manifest Armor has a 30% chance to retaliate with {Forge Nova} when hit. This effect deals 40 spell fire damage with added damage applying at 200% effectiveness, applies fire resistance shred to enemies hit and has a 2 second cooldown.

Ring Of Shields.description:
Manifests a ring of shields around you.

Each shield has 75 base health and lasts up to 10 seconds. Shields draw enemy aggression and block projectiles.

Stats on your equipped shield also apply to the shields created by Ring of Shields

SmeltersWrath.description:
Channel to charge a powerful frontal cone attack, dealing fire and physical damage to all enemies hit. Charging for longer increases its range and power. 2 second maximum charge time.

Your armor is doubled while channelling Smelter's Wrath.
SmeltersWrath.altText:
Deals up to 100% more damage at maximum charge.

Added damage is applied at 600% effectiveness.

Increased Area for Area Skills stats increase Smelter's Wrath's charge speed instead of its area.

HolyAura.description: You and nearby allies passively gain 30% increased damage and +15% additional elemental resistance. Activating Holy Aura doubles the stat bonuses for 4 seconds.

HealingHands.description: Heals all allies in a target area for 50 health and applies a lingering warmth which heals 80 health over the next 3 seconds. The lingering warmth cannot stack on the same target.

SigilsOfHope.description:
Every 2 seconds, summons a symbol that orbits you, causing you and your allies' attacks and spells to deal 3 additional fire damage and increasing health regeneration by 20%.

Activate to consume the symbols, granting 100 ward and 5% less damage taken per symbol for 3 seconds.

You can have up to 3 symbols at a time.

Judgement.description:
A powerful melee attack that leaves an area of {Consecrated Ground} for 4 seconds.

Allies on the {Consecrated Ground} are healed for 50 health each second.

Enemies on Consecrate Ground take fire damage over time that scales with spell damage. Consecrate Ground gains 1 spell damage per 5% increased healing effectiveness.
Judgement.altText:
Added melee damage applies to the attack at 350% effectiveness.

Added spell damage applies to Consecrated Ground at 375% effectiveness per second.

The melee attack's damage does not scale with spell damage and Consecrated Ground's damage does not scale with melee damage.

ConsecratedGround.description:
Allies on the consecrated ground are healed for 50 health each second.

Enemies on Consecrate Ground take fire damage over time that scales with spell damage. Consecrate Ground gains 1 Spell Damage per 5% increased healing effectiveness.

Added spell damage applies at 375% effectiveness per second.

Harvest.description: A melee attack that hits all enemies in an area in front of you, dealing double damage to those that are Cursed.
Harvest.altText: Unaffected by weapon range. Added damage applies at 70% effectiveness. Common curses include Marked for Death, Bone Curse and Spirit Plague.

RipBlood.description: Rips blood out of a target enemy dealing physical damage to it. An orb of the blood is drawn back to you, restoring 5 health when it reaches you.
RipBlood.altText:
Affected by increases to Healing Effectiveness.

Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

Acolyte Evade.description:
Rapidly move a short distance forwards.

Evading does not grant damage immunity or prevent abilities from hitting you.

Evade gains 0.5% Increased Cooldown Recovery Speed per Character level.

SummonSkeleton.description: Summons a skeleton warrior or skeleton archer to guard you. You are limited to 3 skeletons at a time.
SummonSkeleton.altText:
Skeletons have 100 base health.

You will always summon the skeleton type you have the fewest of.

Increased Area for Minion Area Skills stats affect summoned skeletons' melee attacks.

MarrowShards.description: Fires sharpened bones from your body. The bones pierce through enemies inflicting physical damage. Instead of mana, this spell costs 9% of your current health.
MarrowShards.altText: Added damage is applied at 125% effectiveness.

WanderingSpirits.description:
Reveals wandering spirits around you for 6 seconds. The spirits wander at random dealing necrotic damage over time to enemies they pass through.

4 spirits are revealed immediately after casting the skill and 17 more are revealed over the next 6 seconds.

The spirits individually last up to 4 seconds, but all remaining spirits fade once the reveal duration ends.
WanderingSpirits.altText:
Added spell damage applies to each spirit's damage at 200% effectiveness per second.

Increased Area stats affect the area of effect of each individual spirit, but not the area in which spirits are revealed.

WanderingSpirit.description: Summon a primal wolf to guard you and attack your enemies

BoneCurse.description: Apply a curse to enemies in an area for 8 seconds that causes physical damage when hit. The damage is tripled if you inflicted the hit yourself.
BoneCurse.altText:
Added spell damage applies at 20% effectiveness to each hit.

When the curse deals damage it counts as an additional hit, but cannot apply ailments from effects such as "chance to ignite on hit".

Transplant.description:
Creates a new body for you at the target location, then detonates your old body to deal physical damage to enemies around it.

Instead of mana, this spell costs 13% of your current health.
Transplant.altText:
Added damage is applied at 250% effectiveness.

Using a Traversal skill puts all other traversal skills on cooldown and traversal skills' cooldowns do not recover while you are using a traversal skill.

DetonateBody.description: Rips apart an allied minion, dealing physical damage to enemies around it. Added damage applies at double effectiveness.

SummonVolatileZombie.description: Summons a Volatile Zombie which trudges towards the nearest enemy. When it reaches an enemy or dies, it explodes dealing physical and fire damage to surrounding enemies.
SummonVolatileZombie.altText:
You are limited to 6 active zombies. Summoning more will cause older ones to explode.

Volatile Zombies have 200 base health and their health decays at an accelerating rate. Their explosion has 600% effectiveness of added spell damage.

HungeringSouls.description:
Calls forth five hungering souls that seeks out enemies, on hit they deal necrotic damage and then possesses the target.

Possessed enemies take necrotic damage over time for 1.5 seconds. Enemies cannot be possessed by multiple souls at once.
HungeringSouls.altText:
Possess's damage counts as spell damage and it is affected by modifiers to base spell damage.

Added spell damage applies to the initial hit at 45% effectiveness and to possess at 75% effectiveness over its full duration.

SummonBoneGolem.description: Summons a bone golem, which attacks slowly, but has a 15% chance to retaliate with Bone Shatter when hit.

SpiritPlague.description: Curses a target with a powerful necrotic damage over time effect which lasts 3 seconds. Spreads to a single nearby target on target death.
SpiritPlague.altText: Added spell damage applies at 150% effectiveness per second.

InfernalShade.description: Target enemy and all nearby enemies take fire damage per second. Each enemy can only have one Infernal Shade attached at a time. Expires after 5 seconds. Max 4 active shades.
InfernalShade.altText:
Added spell damage applies at 250% effectiveness each second.

Your maximum number of shades is shared with Dread Shade.

SummonWraith.description: Summons a wraith that rapidly fades from this world, but will seek and attack your foes while it remains.
SummonWraith.altText:
You are limited to 6 active wraiths.

Wraiths have 60 base health.

SummonMage.description:
Summons a Skeletal Mage to assist you. You are limited to 2 Skeletal Mages at a time.
Skeletal Mages cast Dread Bolt, which has 150% added damage effectiveness and has a 50% chance to apply Damned on hit.
SummonMage.altText:
Skeletal Mages have 100 base health.

You will always summon the Skeletal Mage type you have the fewest of.

Sacrifice.description: Rips apart an allied minion, dealing physical damage to enemies around it.
Sacrifice.altText: Added damage is applied at 400% effectiveness.

DreadShade.description: Your minion's health is drained for 3% of its max health per second for each second the shade has been active, but it and your minions around it deal +10 necrotic damage with spells and attacks and have 50% increased necrotic damage.
DreadShade.altText:
Each minion only benefits from one Dread Shade aura. Max 4 active shades.

Your maximum number of shades is shared with Infernal Shade.

AssembleAbomination.description:
Hold ability key to channel to absorb your Wraiths, Summoned Skeletons, Skeletal Mages, Golems, and Volatile Zombies in an area. When you release, summon a single hulking abomination with added health and more damage per minion absorbed.

The abomination remembers the minions absorbed to create it and will rapidly devour those minions to restore 10% of its maximum health.
AssembleAbomination.altText:
Abomination gains health equal to the max health of minions consumed and 5% more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per minion consumed (up to 20 minions).
All minions of the same type are devoured if any one of them are absorbed. For example, Skeleton Warriors, Skeleton Rogues, and Skeleton Archers are the same type of Summoned Skeleton.

ReaperForm.description:
Take on the mantle of death itself and transform into a Reaper, temporarily gaining the Reap ability. 

While in Reaper Form, your health regen does not apply and your health decays over time. When your health reaches 0 instead of dying you transform back to human form and are healed to full health.
ReaperForm.altText:
Reap is a short ranged dash. It deals melee damage to enemies you pass through and heals you for each enemy hit. This healing scales with your increased healing effectiveness.

The rate at which your health decays in reaper form is not based on your current or maximum health.

The health decay accelerates while you remain in reaper form.

If you take more damage than your remaining health in Reaper Form, the excess damage will be dealt to your human form health.

Reap.description: Dash a short distance in the target direction using your scythes to strike all enemies in your path. Restores 15 health for each enemy hit.
Reap.altText:
Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

Using a Traversal skill puts all other traversal skills on cooldown and traversal skills' cooldowns do not recover while you are using a traversal skill.

DrainLife.description: Channelled spell that targets up to 3 enemies around the target location, dealing necrotic damage over time and leeching 30% of that damage back as health.
DrainLife.altText: Added spell damage applies at 360% effectiveness per second.

AuraOfDecay.description:
Toggles Aura of Decay, which poisons you every second, and leaves a trail of decay. Enemies near you or in the trail are poisoned four times a second, and your chance to poison on hit applies to each of these instances at 100% effectiveness.

While Aura of Decay is active you take 30% less poison damage. Additionally, you take 50% less damage from your own Aura of Decay.
AuraOfDecay.altText: Your chance to poison on hit does not increase the rate at which poison is applied to you.

Flay 1.description:
Spirit Step up to 3 meters towards an enemy if not within range, then perform a narrow rending slash.
Each enemy killed by the melee attack will release a Blood Eruption, a spell dealing physical damage in an area.
Enemies can be hit by both Flay and all Blood Eruptions that occur.
Flay 1.altText:
The melee attack has 200% effectiveness of added melee damage.
The Blood Eruption has 200% effectiveness of added spell damage.

DeathSeal.description:
Toggle to seal your health, preventing it from going above its current value for 3 seconds. While sealed you take less damage equal to half your percent missing health, and 90% of hit damage taken is dealt over 4 seconds. 

Reactivate to unleash a Wave of Death dealing damage based on how long Death Seal has been active and your current percent missing health.
DeathSeal.altText:
The Wave of Death deals up to 20% more damage per second Death Seal has been active and deal 1% more damage per 1% missing health. Both effects are multiplicative with other modifiers.

Added spell damage applies at 500% effectiveness to Wave of Death.

Hit damage that is dealt over 4 seconds cannot be altered after the hit and is unaffected by temporary immunity effects. It does not count as damage over time.

DeathSealWave.description: Releases a Wave of Death dealing damage based on how long Death Seal has been actve and your current percent missing health.

Warlock 04 Chthonic Fissure.description:
Opens an infernal fissure in the ground, dealing fire damage over time to enemies on top of it, as well as releasing {Spirits} from the fissure that seek nearby enemies. These spirits inflict enemies with {Torment}, a {Curse} that slows and deals necrotic damage over time.

Max 1 active fissure.
Warlock 04 Chthonic Fissure.altText:
Added damage for the {Fissure} applies at 120% effectiveness each second.

Added damage for the {Spirits} applies at 30% effectiveness.

{Torment} applies 18% less movement speed (multiplicative with other modifiers), deals 120 damage over 3 seconds and added damage applies at 200% effectiveness per second.

Warlock 04.1 Arcing Soul.description: Tormenting Spirits hits enemies and inflicts them with {Torment}, dealing necrotic damage over time.
Warlock 04.1 Arcing Soul.altText:
Added damage for the {Spirits} applies at 30% effectiveness.

{Torment} applies 18% less movement speed (multiplicative with other modifiers), deals 120 damage over 3 seconds and added damage applies at 200% effectiveness per second.

Warlock 04.2 Arcing Soul Explosion.description: Create a burst of necrotic damage in an area around the target.
Warlock 04.2 Arcing Soul Explosion.altText: Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

Warlock 01 Chaos Bolts.description: A barrage of chaotic projectiles which land in an area around the target. The explosions deal necrotic and fire damage in a small area.
Warlock 01 Chaos Bolts.altText:
Added damage applies at 100% effectiveness for each bolt.

Increased Area for Area Skills stats increase the size of the individual explosions, but not the spread of the projectiles.

Warlock 01.2 Chaos Bolts Secondary Missi.description: Call a meteor from the sky that deals a large amount of damage upon landing. Added damage is applied at five times its normal value.

Warlock 02 Ghostflame.description: Channel to releases a continuous jet of horrid flames in front of you dealing fire and necrotic damage over time.
Warlock 02 Ghostflame.altText: Added damage applies at 600% effectiveness each second. Damage reduces while rotating.

Warlock 03 SoulFeast.description:
Feasts on the souls of {Cursed} enemies, dealing necrotic damage to them, and drawing fragments of their souls back to you. The soul fragments each grant 3 ward when they reach you.

Feasts on up to 13 enemies, prioritising those closest to you.
Warlock 03 SoulFeast.altText: Added spell damage is applied at 250% effectiveness.

Warlock 05 Profane Veil.description:
Channel to conceal yourself within a Profane Veil that deals necrotic damage over time to enemies around you. While concealed you dodge every Hit, but you can still take damage from damage over time effects, such as ailments, and you move more slowly.

Last for up to 2 seconds (also ends when you release the key). Cooldown does not recover during use.
Warlock 05 Profane Veil.altText:
You have 40% less movement speed while channeling (multiplicative with other modifiers).

Added spell damage applies at 200% effectiveness per second.

Puncture.description: An extended melee stab or piercing bow attack that has a 30% chance to inflict bleed on hit. Bleeds inflicted by puncture have 30% increased duration.
Puncture.altText:
When using a bow, Puncture deals 5% less damage to each subsequent enemy hit up to 20% less damage.

Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

Flurry.description: A bow or melee attack that performs 3 rapid strikes. The last strike can be cancelled by moving.
Flurry.altText:
Added damage applies at 80% effectiveness to each strike and each strike has a 40% reduced chance to apply ailments on hit.

Increased Area for Area skills stats only affect the melee version of Flurry.

Rogue Evade.description:
Rapidly move a short distance forwards.

Evading does not grant damage immunity or prevent abilities from hitting you.

Evade gains 0.5% Increased Cooldown Recovery Speed per Character level.

Shurikens.altText:
Added damage applies at 125% effectiveness.
Your shadows can imitate this ability when you directly use it.

ShadowRend.description:
Perform a short dash attack and manifest a shadow at your previous position, which will perform a sweeping melee attack or piercing bow attack for you after a short delay.

The shadow will persist afterwards for up to 5 seconds. Shadows will imitate your next direct use of Shadow Cascade, Shurikens, Umbral Blades, Explosive Trap, or Acid Flask. Shadows can also imitate indirect uses of Shadow Cascade. Up to 3 shadows can be active at once.
ShadowRend.altText:
The initial attack has 100% damage effectiveness, and the shadow's attack has 500% damage effectiveness.

Modifiers to skills used by shadows affect the shadow's attack.

CreateShadow.description:
Create a Shadow of yourself that persists for up to 5 seconds and will imitate your next direct use of Shadow Cascade, Shurikens, Umbral Blades, or Acid Flask. Shadows can also imitate indirect uses of Shadow Cascade.
Up to 3 Shadows can be active at once.

AcidFlask.description: Throw a flask of acid that explodes dealing physical damage on impact, poisoning enemies and reducing their armor.
AcidFlask.altText:
Added damage applies at 125% effectiveness.
Your shadows can imitate this ability when you directly use it.

Shift.description: Dash a short fixed distance in the target direction.
Shift.altText: Using a Traversal skill puts all other traversal skills on cooldown and traversal skills' cooldowns do not recover while you are using a traversal skill.

CinderStrike.description:
A combo ability with three attacks. The first attack also creates a fiery explosion, damaging nearby enemies.

Can be used with a bow or melee weapon.
CinderStrike.altText:
The consecutive attack counter resets if you go 2 seconds without using Cinder Strike.

Added damage applies to the first attack at 200% effectiveness, and to the other attacks at 100% effectiveness.

Decoy.description: Throw a device to create a Decoy that taunts enemies around it for 2.5 seconds before exploding.
Decoy.altText:
Added throwing attack damage is applied at 600% effectiveness to the explosion.

The Decoy cannot be destroyed before it expires.

Summon Decoy.description: Throw a device to create a decoy that taunts enemies around it for 3 seconds before exploding.
Summon Decoy.altText: Added throwing attack damage is applied at 600% effectiveness to the explosion.

Smoke Bomb.description: Drop a Smoke Bomb at your feet that blinds enemies and grants you haste while you remain inside it. The Smoke Bomb grows in size over its duration. Lasts 4 seconds.
Smoke Bomb.altText: You can have a maximum of 2 smoke bombs active at once.

Bladestorm Throw.description:
Throw spinning blades towards the target location where they will hit nearby enemies 3 times per second. 

Bladestorms last 4 seconds. You can have a maximum of 3 Bladestorms active at once, but each enemy can only take damage from one at a time.
Bladestorm Throw.altText:
Bladestorms hit 3 times per second, and added damage applies at 150% effectiveness to each hit.
Bladestorms have 40% less chance to apply ailments on hit.

Bladestorm Damage.description:
Throw spinning blades towards the target location where they will hit nearby enemies 3 times per second. 

Bladestorms last 4 seconds. You can have a maximum of 3 Bladestorms active at once, but each enemy can only take damage from one at a time.
Bladestorm Damage.altText:
Bladestorms hit 3 times per second, and added damage applies at 150% effectiveness to each hit.
Bladestorms have 40% less chance to apply ailments on hit.

SummonBallista.description: Summons a ballista that fires bolts at nearby enemies.
SummonBallista.altText: Ballistae have 1000 base health and last 10 seconds by default. Enemies rarely target ballistas.

Umbral Blades 1.description:
A combo ability that throws 2 blades, then 4 blades, then recalls all blades in the ground back to you, hitting enemies along the way.

An enemy can be hit by multiple blades from the same throw and by multiple blades from the recall.

Only the first part of the combo costs mana.
Umbral Blades 1.altText:
Added damage applies at 60% effectiveness. 40% less chance to apply ailments on hit.
Your shadows can imitate this ability when you directly use it. Shadows using Umbral Blades always throw a single blade that deals 300% more damage and has 100% increased radius.

Umbral Blades can persist in the ground for up to 6 seconds.

DancingStrike1.description:
Requires dual wielding.

A combo ability that is a series of fast dash attacks. Dancing Strikes gains increased movement speed and more damage equal to 50% of your total increased melee attack speed.
DancingStrike1.altText:
Added damage is applied to each attack at 150% effectiveness.

Your total increased melee attack speed includes the modifier from attack rate and generic increased attack speed stats. If your {Melee Attack Speed} is 1.5, then Dancing Strikes gains 25% increased movement speed and 25% more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

Dancing Strikes cannot gain more than 100% increased movement speed.

ShadowCascade.description:
Requires dual wielding.

A circular attack that's also used by your shadows.
ShadowCascade.altText: Added damages is applied at 250% effectiveness. Base critical strike chance is 10%, instead of the normal 5%.

SynchronizedStrike.description:
Requires a melee weapon.

Jump forward and strike in an area in front of you while shadows appear and simultaneously strike on either side of you.

The shadows will persist afterwards for up to 5 seconds. Shadows will imitate your next direct use of Shadow Cascade, Shurikens, Umbral Blades, Explosive Trap, or Acid Flask. Shadows can also imitate indirect uses of Shadow Cascade. Up to 3 shadows can be active at once.
SynchronizedStrike.altText: Added damage applies to each hit at 300% effectiveness.

SynchronizedStrikeEnd.description: A series of fast dash attacks.

Synchronized Strike Shadow Delayer.description: Freezes enemies in a cone in front of you. Freeze lasts for 2 seconds.

Lethal Mirage.description: Become immune for a duration and rapidly strike nearby targets with 6 mirages.
Lethal Mirage.altText:
Mirages' added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

Increased Area for Area Skills stats apply to the attacks of individual mirages, but not to the maximum range at which mirages can be created.

Lethal Mirage Damage Delayer.description: Freezes enemies in a cone in front of you. Freeze lasts for 2 seconds.

Lethal Mirage Teleporter.description: Freezes enemies in a cone in front of you. Freeze lasts for 2 seconds.

DetonatingArrow.description:
Requires a bow.

Fires an arrow that embeds itself in a target then explodes after 0.6 seconds.
DetonatingArrow.altText: Added bow damage applies to the arrow at 125% effectiveness and to the explosion at 200% effectiveness.

RogueMultishot.description:
Requires a bow.

A bow attack that fires a cone of 5 arrows in the target direction. Aiming the cursor further from your character reduces the spread.
RogueMultishot.altText: Added damage is applied at 120% effectiveness

DarkQuiver.description:
Requires a bow.

Summons 7 Black Arrows that rain from the sky over 4 seconds, granting 100% increased damage to your next bow attack when retrieved.
DarkQuiver.altText: You can hold up to 3 Black Arrows at once, but can only expend one at a time.

Dark Quiver Create Arrow.description: A basic attack with your weapon that costs no mana

Heartseeker.description:
Requires a bow.

Shoot an arrow that seeks the heart of a nearby target, passing harmlessly through other enemies. Whenever it hits its target it has a chance to continue through it and {Recurve} to strike it again. 

Subsequent {Recurve} chance is multiplied by 0.8 each time the arrow {Recurves}. If the target dies, it will choose a new target.
Heartseeker.altText:
Base recurve chance is 100%.

Added damage applies at 100% effectiveness.

HailOfArrows.description:
Requires a bow.

Launch a hail of arrows into the sky that rain down on the target location over 3.5 seconds.
HailOfArrows.altText: Added bow damage is applied at 325% effectiveness per second.

Falconer 00 Falconry.description:
Passive:
Summons a {Falcon} that fights with you.

Active:
{Falcon Strikes}: The {Falcon} rapidly hits many enemies in the target area.
Falconer 00 Falconry.skillLore: The Dune Falcon is one of the most deadly hunters in all of Eterra. What it lacks in size it makes up in speed, precision, and intelligence. Fierce and independent, the Dune Falcon is known to maim those who attempt to train it. Only those it recognizes as an equal can hope to gain its trust and be accepted as a hunting partner.
Falconer 00 Falconry.altText: The Falcon cannot take damage and is untargetable by enemies. Press {A} to give your minions an attack command.

Falconer 04 Explosive Trap.description:
Throws a trap that explodes when triggered, dealing throwing fire damage. Traps take 0.4 seconds to arm and explode when enemies walk over them or after 30s. 

You can have a maximum of 6 active traps at a time.
Falconer 04 Explosive Trap.altText: Added damage applies at 150% effectiveness to the explosion.

Falconer 04.1 Explosive Trap On Ground.description: Cast a ball of fire towards the target

Falconer 05 Net.description: Leaps backwards and throws a net which snares enemies and deals physical damage. Netted bosses and rare enemies have 35% less movement speed, and other enemies are immobilized.
Falconer 05 Net.altText:
Added damage applies at 100% effectiveness.
Nets last 3-5 seconds at random on each enemy.

Falconer 02 Aerial Assault.description: You leap towards the target and your {Falcon} dives to catch you and momentarily carry you further, before it flies up and unleashes a {Wing Burst} at the target location.
Falconer 02 Aerial Assault.altText: The Wing Burst deals physical throwing damage and scales with your Falcon's stats.

Falconer 02.1 Aerial Assault Feather Bur.description: After Aerial Assault your {Falcon} releases a quick burst of sharp feathers from its wings at nearby enemies dealing physical damage that scales with the Falcon's throwing damage.
Falconer 02.1 Aerial Assault Feather Bur.altText: Added throwing damage applies at 200% effectiveness.

Falconer 03 Dive Bomb.description: Your {Falcon} ascends high into the sky then dive bombs the target location at high speed, dealing a high amount of physical damage to enemies in the area.
Falconer 03 Dive Bomb.altText:
Your falcon's added damage applies at 500% effectiveness.
If Dive Bomb is interrupted before impact, 70% of the cooldown and mana cost are recovered.

IceNova.description: Casts a nova around you that deals cold damage.
IceNova.altText: Added damage is applied at 120% effectiveness.

HolySmite.description: Smite your enemies from a distance. Has a 10 meter radius.

GuardianOrb.description: Gain a large amount of armor and elemental protection

SoulSpear.description: Cast a piercing projectile at your enemies. Soul Lance has a higher than average critical strike chance.

IceBolt.description: Cast a slow moving ice bolt to a location, where it creates an ice vortex that lasts for 4 seconds.

IceVortex.description: Cast a swirling vortex of cold damage over time that lasts for 4 seconds.
IceVortex.altText: Added damage is applied at 40% effectiveness per second.

FireballAoe.description: A burst of flame that deals high damage in an area around the target.
FireballAoe.altText: Added damage is applied at 500% effectiveness.

LightningNova.description: Casts a nova around you that deals lightning damage.
LightningNova.altText: Added damage is applied at 120% effectiveness.

FireNova.description: Casts a nova around you that deals fire damage.
FireNova.altText: Added damage is applied at 130% effectiveness.

ChainingIceNova.description: Creates a cascade of freezing novas. Whenever an enemy is hit by a nova another one is created around them. Each ice nova has a freeze rate of 40.
ChainingIceNova.altText:
Added damage applies at 120% effectiveness.
Each enemy can only be hit by a maximum of one freezing nova.

Pyre Golem InfernalAura.description: Deals a burst of fire damage, then fire damage over time around the caster for 10 seconds. Ignites enemies within its area every second.
Pyre Golem InfernalAura.altText: Added damage applies to the burst at 300% effectiveness, and to the damage over time at 100% effectiveness per second.

Pyre Golem InfernalAura Nova.description: Deals a burst of fire damage, then fire damage over time around the caster for 10 seconds.
Pyre Golem InfernalAura Nova.altText: Added damage applies to the burst at 250% effectiveness, and to the damage over time at 20% effectiveness per second.

IceThorns.description: Releases a burst of homing ice thorns that deal physical and cold damage on hit and have a freeze rate of 18
IceThorns.altText:
Multiple thorns cannot hit the same target.

Freeze rate grants a chance to freeze on hit that is higher against enemies with lower health.

Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

PrimalLightning.description: Call forth a bolt of lightning to strike the area.

LesserLightning.description: Strikes the target area with a bolt of lightning.
LesserLightning.altText: Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

FuryLeapLightning.description: Strikes the area with a bolt of lightning.

SummonVines.description:
Summon 3 poisonous vines for 8 seconds.

Each vine has 50 base health.

SummonVineAtTarget.description:
Summons 1 poisonous vine.

Vines are melee minions that inflict poison on hit. You can have up to 12 vines.

FrenzySelf.description: Increases attack and cast speed of the caster

MeteorShrapnel.description: Fires a piece of burning shrapnel in a random direction.
MeteorShrapnel.altText: Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

IceWard.description: Toggles a protective shield that chills nearby enemies and grants 4 ward per second, but drains 3 mana per second. Can be cast instantly.

SuperIceVortex.description: Cast a greater swirling vortex of cold damage over time that lasts for 4 seconds.
SuperIceVortex.altText: Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness per second.

SummonVenomHound.description: Summon a primal wolf to guard you and attack your enemies

FrostNova.description: A circle of biting frost that deals cold damage and has a chance to freeze on hit.
FrostNova.altText:
Frost Nova has a freeze rate of 40.

Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

SummonClawTotem.description:
Summons a totem that attacks with Swipe. It only scales with totem and minion stats, but it is affected by your Swipe Tree.

Claw Totems have 120 base health and last for 12 seconds.

SummonSerpent.description:
Summon a Primal Serpent, a melee minion that poisons on hit. They have an unlimited duration, but do not regenerate health.

You are limited to one primal serpent at a time, but Primal Serpents do not count towards your companion limit.

Primal Serpents have 500 base health.

PoisonBoltWS.description: Launch a projectile that inflicts poison.
PoisonBoltWS.altText: Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

SummonIllusoryTree.description: Summons an illusory tree that distracts your opponents and lasts 8 seconds.

SwarmOfBees.description: Summon a swarm of bees to attack your enemies.

FamiliarRage.description: Surrounds you with a protective shield for 14 seconds that grants 100 armor and elemental protection and retaliates with a fireball when you take 35 damage.

SparkCharge.description: Spark charges explode after 1 second dealing lightning damage to nearby enemies. Spark charges automatically detonate when the enemy they are attached to dies.
SparkCharge.altText: Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

SmallLightningExplosion.description: Spark charges explode after 1 second dealing lightning damage to nearby enemies. Spark charges automatically detonate when the enemy they are attached to dies.
SmallLightningExplosion.altText: Added damage is applied at 50% effectiveness.

LightningAegis.description: Lightning Aegis is a buff which grants 50% increased lightning damage and 25% less damage taken. Lightning Aegis causes an explosion of lightning damage when you lose 25% of your health or after 10 seconds.

ChargedGround.description:
Charges an area of ground, causing repeated bursts of lightning in smaller areas within it.

Static Orb's damage and area bonuses based on distance travelled also apply to the Charged Ground.
ChargedGround.altText: 150% of added damage applied per second.

SmallLightningNova.description: Deals lightning damage around the target area.
SmallLightningNova.altText: Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

HealingNova.description: Cast a nova around your character that heals allies.

ExplosiveGround.description: Creates a patch of explosive ground that detonates after 3 seconds.
ExplosiveGround.altText:
Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

Increased Area for Area Skills stats apply to the individual explosions, but not the size of the patch.

SmallFireCircle.description: Creates a patch of explosive ground that detonates after 3 seconds.

FireGlyphExplosion.description: Create a glyph that explodes after a moment, dealing damage in an area.
FireGlyphExplosion.altText: Added damage is applied at 200% effectiveness.

ShatteringGround.description: Creates a patch of explosive ground

DelayedFireGlyph.description: Create a glyph that explodes after a moment, dealing damage in an area.

RavagingAura.description: Ravaging Aura deals spell void damage over time in an area around you, but you lose 5% of your current health per second. Added spell damage is applied at 350% effectiveness per second.
RavagingAura.altText: Added damage is applied at 105% effectiveness.

ValeOrb.description: Cast an orb of physical damage that travels in a line.

AbyssalOrb.description:
An orb of pure void energy that seeks out your enemies, dealing a large amount of void damage to the target and a smaller amount in an area around them.

Added spell damage applies to the primary hit at 200% effectiveness and at 100% to the area of effect.

VoidRift.description:
Creates a dark rift in an area, dealing void damage to enemies it hits.

Added spell damage applies at 100% effectiveness.

ThornTrail.description: Cast a trail of thorns along the ground, dealing physical spell damage.
ThornTrail.altText: Added damage is applied at 40% effectiveness.

SunderingThorns.description: Launch a barrage of thorns in a line.
SunderingThorns.altText: Added damage is applied at 60% effectiveness.

WaterOrb.description:
Cast a frigid orb of water to blast your enemy.
Added spell damage is applied at 400% effectiveness.

VoidAegis.description: If you take a hit that deals at least 25% of your max health as damage, sacrifice a void essence to gain Void Aegis for 4 seconds, which grants a portion of your maximum health gained as endurance threshold.

SpiritWolves.description:
Your summoned wolves release spirit wolves that travel through enemies in a line, dealing melee physical damage.

Each spirit wolf scales with the stats of the wolf that released it.

ParabolicVoidOrb.description: A cascading arc of void damage.

DelayedShieldRushEnd.description: Cast a nova around your character that does moderate damage

ForwardVoidBeam.description: A void beam that deals spell damage over time.
ForwardVoidBeam.altText: Added damage is applied at 300% effectiveness each second.

BackwardVoidBeam.description: A void beam that deals spell damage over time.
BackwardVoidBeam.altText: Added damage is applied at 300% effectiveness each second.

DarkBlade.description: Launches a blade towards an enemy, dealing melee physical damage.
DarkBlade.altText: Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

RiposteRetaliationHit.description:
A retaliatory melee attack performed automatically upon being hit.
You take less damage from the hit that triggers the riposte.
RiposteRetaliationHit.altText: Added damage is applied at 150% effectiveness.

PlayerVoidBeams.description: Casts 4 powerful void sky beams that travel at random.
PlayerVoidBeams.altText: Added damage is applied at 300% effectiveness each second.

StationaryVoidBeam.description: A void beam that deals spell damage over time.
StationaryVoidBeam.altText: Added damage is applied at 300% effectiveness each second.

VoidEruption.description: An orb of pure void energy, seeking out your enemies and destroying them.

FireShardNova.description: Shards of magma splinter off, hitting enemies around you. Added spell damage applies at 300% effectiveness.

DelayedStormOrb.description: Cast a nova around your character that does moderate damage

StormOrb.description: Create an orb that explodes after one second, dealing physical damage to nearby enemies.
StormOrb.altText: Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

PontifexCremate.description:
Burns a corpse, dealing fire damage to surrounding enemies.

Has a 10% chance to raise a burning skeleton from the remains.

SummonBurningSkeleton.description: Summon a perpetually burning skeleton that will cast fireballs at your enemies.

SummonSkeletonHarvester.description: Summon an ancient skeleton to harvest your foes.

ChannelledFireball.description: Cast a ball of fire dealing moderate damage

SummonSKeletonWarrior.description: Summon a primal wolf to guard you and attack your enemies

OldSummonSKeletonMage.description: Summon a Skeleton Mage to fight your enemies. It casts Hungering Souls every second.

SummonSKeletonArcher.description: Summon a primal wolf to guard you and attack your enemies

SummonSKeletonWarlord.description: Summon a primal wolf to guard you and attack your enemies

SummonSKeletonBrawler.description: Summon a primal wolf to guard you and attack your enemies

DeathSlash.description: A melee attack that hits all enemies in an area in front of you. Unaffected by weapon range.

NecroticMortar.description: Launches a necrotic orb in an arc. It explodes when it reaches the target.

PoisonArrow.description: Fires an arrow in a target direction

MultiShot.description:
Requires a bow.

Fires a cone of 5 arrows in the target direction. Aiming the cursor further from your character reduces the spread.

Inspire.description: Increases nectoric damage, physical damage, and attack and cast speed by 20% for 4 seconds.

SummonPutridWraith.description: Summon a wraith with decaying health that deals ranged poison attacks.

BloodSplatter.description:
Blood Splatter is a physical spell dealing damage to other enemies around the target, but not the original target. 

Added damage applies at 50% effectiveness.

BoneNova.description: Bones fly out in all directions, impaling enemies.
BoneNova.altText: Added damage is applied at 125% effectiveness.

SummonBloodWraith.description: Summons a Blood Wraith that rapidly fades from this world, but will seek and attack your foes while it remains.
SummonBloodWraith.altText: You are limited to 13 active Blood Wraiths. This is separate from your limit for the Summon Wraith skill.

BoneSplintersProjectile.description:
Unleashes multiple splinters of bone in a cone behind Marrow Shards.
An enemy can only be hit by Marrow Shards or one projectile from Bone Splinters.
BoneSplintersProjectile.altText: Added damage is applied at 125% effectiveness.

SummonRevenant.description: Summons a revenant that rapidly fades from this world, but will seek and attack your foes while it remains.

SummonFlameWraith.description: Summon a primal wolf to guard you and attack your enemies

WaveOfBlood.description: Cast a wave of physical damage that hits nearby enemies.

BlackHoleEnd.description: A wave of cold energy that erupts from Black Hole. Has a freeze rate of 240.
BlackHoleEnd.altText: Added spell damage is applied at 300% effectiveness.

SummonPyreGolem.description: Summons a bone golem, which attacks slowly, but retaliates with a bone nova when it takes 70 damage.

SummonSpectralGolem.description: Summons a bone golem, which attacks slowly, but retaliates with a bone nova when it takes 70 damage.

SummonBloodGolem.description: Summons a bone golem, which attacks slowly, but retaliates with a bone nova when it takes 70 damage.

FireAura.description: Deals fire damage in an area around you. Each stack lasts for 4 seconds. Can be converted to cold or lightning.
FireAura.altText: Added spell damage is applied at 140% effectiveness per second.

FlankingStrike.description: Your nearest summoned beast dashes to the target and taunts it. You perform a large melee attack while your foe is distracted.

FrozenGround.description: Freeze enemies in a cone in front of you. Freeze lasts for 1.2 seconds.

ArcaneLightning.description: Hurl a bolt of lightning at the target.
ArcaneLightning.altText: Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

Retribution.description: A melee physical attack that hits nearby enemies.
Retribution.altText: Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

AxeThrow.description: Throws an axe at a nearby enemy.
AxeThrow.altText:
This is a throwing attack that scales with throwing attack damage and throwing attack speed. It is not a melee attack or spell.

Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

MarkForDeath.description: Curses the enemy, reducing all resistances by 25% for 8 seconds. This effect does not stack.

SummonBonePrison.description:
Summons a bone prison around a target area.

The {Bone Prison} is considered a minion and is made up of several small sections, each with 300 base health.

SummonMirrorImage.description: Summon a mirror image to distract your foes.

ManifestWeapon.description: Manifests a melee weapon to attack in the target direction, without interrupting your other actions.

SkyBolt.description: A bolt of holy fire descends from the sky directly on to a targeted enemy.

Consecration.description: An ancient holy power that paladins one day hope to master.

HolyNova.description: Cast a nova around your character that does moderate damage

HolyFlameBurst.description: Creates a burst of holy fire around you.
HolyFlameBurst.altText: Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

SkullenRockThrow.description: Cast a ball of fire towards the target

LightningStorm.description: Repeatedly strikes around a target area with bolts of lightning.
LightningStorm.altText:
Added damage is applied at 55% effectiveness.

Increased Area for Area Skills stats apply to the area of the individual lightning strikes, but not to the area of the storm.

StormLightning.description: Strikes a nearby enemy with a bolt of lightning.
StormLightning.altText: Added damage is applied at 55% effectiveness.

LightningWave.description: Release a wave of lightning in an area around you.
LightningWave.altText: Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

Blizzard.description: Repeatedly strikes around a target area with hail, wind and frozen objects.
Blizzard.altText: Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

WerebearRoar.description:
Unleash a thunderous roar which knocks enemies back and stuns them for 1.5 seconds. Rares and bosses are stunned for half as long.. All effects from your Warcry Skill Tree are applied to Roar.

20% of remaining cooldown recovered whenever you stun (or freeze if Warcry is converted to cold) an enemy, including with Roar itself. This effect can occur a maximum of two times each second.

WerebearSwipe1.description: A melee attack that hits all enemies in an area in front of you. Unaffected by weapon range. Your Swipe Skill Tree applies to this ability.

WerebearCharge.description: Charge towards a target location dealing damage and knocking back enemies in your path.
WerebearCharge.altText: Rampage's cooldown does not recover while you are using it.

WerebearRavage.description: A powerful bite attack that applies Stagger.
WerebearRavage.altText:
Stagger is a non-stacking ailment that reduces armor by 100 and increases damage taken by 10%. Stagger lasts 6 seconds.

Added melee damage has 200% effectiveness.

Mana cost cannot be reduced below 2.

HolySymbol.description: A triggered self heal that also grants ward every second over 3 seconds. It has a 3 second cooldown.

DivineBolt.description: Cast a bolt of divine fire towards the target.
DivineBolt.altText: Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

SummonWeapon.description:
Summons a Forged Weapon which lasts for 20 seconds and is affected by the stats and attack rate of your weapon. You can control up to 6 Forged Weapons at once.

Forged Weapons have 220 based health.
SummonWeapon.altText: Press A to give your minions an attack command.

HumanForm.description: Return back to human form, returning your original stats and abilities.

MoltenBlade.description: A slashing attack that sweeps a wide area with a blade of molten steel. 25% physical and fire penetration.

SprigganValeBolt.description: Strike the target with a beam of Eterra's power.
SprigganValeBolt.altText: Mana cost cannot be reduced below 2.

SprigganRejuvenate.description: The nearest allied target is healed for 50 health and has 50% increased health regeneration for 4 seconds.

SprigganSummonVines.description:
Summons 3 poisonous vines around the target location.

Vines are melee minions that inflict poison on hit. You can have up to 12 vines.

SprigganHarden.description: Gain 50 armor and 50 tenacity for 20 seconds.

Tremor.description: A physical spell that deals damage over time in an area for 3 seconds. Applies added spell damage at 100% effectiveness per second.

Overgrowth.description: Grow larger increasing your physical prowess. Gain 15% increased critical strike multiplier, 20% increased vitality, 20% increased strength and 100 increased stun avoidance. This effect lasts 15 seconds.
