SoulEruption.description: Creates 5 souls that target enemies and apply Marked for Death. Also applies Marked for Death to you.

SummonSprigganHealingTotem.description: Summons a totem that heals nearby allies. Healing totems have 100 base health and last 6 seconds.

ButterflyHeal.description: Heals nearest ally in a target area

CreepingVines.description: Summon the power of the forest to reach out and grasp enemies in a wide area around you for 10 seconds rooting and damaging them for 3 seconds each.

SummonRootWall.description: Summons a wall of roots at target location that slow and taunt nearby enemies.

Bear Ability.description:
The companion ability of your Primal Bear.

Releases a mighty roar, taunting enemies around it and healing it for 25% of its maximum health.
Bear Ability.altText: The healing scales with your bear's increased healing effectiveness. The area scales your bear's increased area for area skills stats.

Sabertooth Ability.description:
The companion ability of your Primal Sabertooth.

Releases three swipes in rapid succession
Sabertooth Ability.altText: Scales with your sabertooth's stats rather than yours

DoubleSwipe.description: A melee attack that hits all enemies in an area in front of you. Unaffected by weapon range. Double damage scaling.

SingleSwipe.description: A melee attack that hits all enemies in an area in front of you.
SingleSwipe.altText: Has 1.5x damage scaling and is unaffected by weapon range.

ScorpionAbility.description:
The companion ability of your Primal Scorpion.

Releases a burst of venom that inflicts all enemies around the scorpion with 3 stacks of poison, and releases a spiral of projectiles that also inflict poison on hit.
ScorpionAbility.altText: Scales with your scorpion's stats rather than yours.

PoisonBoltAoD.description: Launch a projectile that inflicts poison.
PoisonBoltAoD.altText: Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

Spriggan Ability.description:
The companion ability of your Spriggan.

Restores 150 health and 15 mana to the spriggan and all nearby allies over 2 seconds.
Spriggan Ability.altText: Scales with your spriggan's stats and your minion stats. The amount healed scales with your spriggan's increased healing effectiveness.

Wolf Ability.description:
The companion ability of your Primal Wolves.

Your wolves howl to embolden themselves and allies around them, granting them frenzy and 25% more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for 3 seconds.

The howl also heals allies around you for 50 health.
Wolf Ability.altText:
"Allies" includes you and your other minions.

Frenzy grants 20% increased attack and cast speed.

This buff does not stack, even if you have multiple wolves.

Scales with your wolves' Increased Area for Area Skills stat.

EnchantWeaponPassive.description: Passive: Your melee attacks deal 15% more elemental damage.

FireExplosion.description: An explosion that deals fire damage in an area.

Descend.description: Teleport to the target location, dealing physical damage to enemies in the area.

Fissure.description: Open a fissure underneath your enemies, dealing fire damage over time for 4 seconds.
Fissure.altText: Added spell damage is applied at 200% effectiveness per second.

Rive2.description: A combo of three melee attacks. Every third consecutive attack with Rive slashes in a full circle around the character, dealing double damage.
Rive2.altText:
The consecutive attack counter resets if you go 3 seconds without using Rive.

Added melee damage applies to the first two hits at 125% effectiveness and to the third hit at 250% effectiveness.

Rive3.description: A combo of three melee attacks. Every third consecutive attack with Rive slashes in a full circle around the character, dealing double damage.
Rive3.altText:
The consecutive attack counter resets if you go 3 seconds without using Rive.

Added melee damage applies to the first two hits at 125% effectiveness and to the third hit at 250% effectiveness.

EnergyWave.description: Release a small wave of spell physical energy that has a set distance and travels through enemies.
EnergyWave.altText: Added damage is applied at 150% effectiveness.

BloodPool.description: Leave a pool for blood for 3 seconds that slows enemies.

NorthernWinds.description: Cast a burst of frozen wind that deals cold damage to enemies it hits.
NorthernWinds.altText: Added damage is applied at 70% effectiveness.

PoisonNova.description: Unleash a nova that poisons enemies, and has 25% increased effect of poison.

PutridBomb.description:
Create a globule of poison that bursts after 1 second.

Your poison chance applies at 250% of its normal value to hits from this ability.

PutridBombExplosion.description:
Create a globule of poison that bursts after 1 second.

Your poison chance applies at 250% of its normal value to hits from this ability.

Heal Over Time.description: Heals the nearest ally to the target location for 100 health per second for 5 seconds.

SummonFrostElemental.description: Summon a frost elemental to guard you and attack your enemies

SummonRockElemental.description: Summon a coldstone elemental with decaying health to attack your enemies.

LavaBurst.description: Cast a burst of molten lava, hitting the target and nearby enemies dealing spell fire damage.
LavaBurst.altText: Added damage is applied at 200% effectiveness.

ShieldThrowOut.description:
Throws a shield at a target enemy. The shield ricochets to up to 2 additional targets before returning to you.

The cooldown starts when the shield returns to you.
ShieldThrowOut.altText:
The shield hits all enemies in its path, even those it does not ricochet from.

Added throwing attack damage is applied at 200% effectiveness.

LightningBolt.description: Strikes target area with a bolt of lightning that varies in damage greatly
LightningBolt.altText: Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

EarthSpikes.description: A spell that shoots earthen spikes up from the ground which impale your enemies.
EarthSpikes.altText: Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

EarthSpikesAoe.description: A spell that shoots earthen spikes up from the ground which impale your enemies.
EarthSpikesAoe.altText: Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

SummonStormSprite.description: Summons a storm sprite to defend your totem. Storm Sprites use lightning spells to damage nearby enemies and last for 6 seconds.

ShatterStrikeLeft.description:
A sweeping melee attack that strikes enemies in a circle around you dealing cold damage and culling frozen enemies at low health.

Has a freeze rate of 50.

ShatterStrikeRight.description:
A sweeping melee attack that strikes enemies in a circle around you dealing cold damage and culling frozen enemies at low health.

Has a freeze rate of 50.

DetonateGround.description: After a short delay the ground erupts in a firey explosion.
DetonateGround.altText: Added damage is applied at 200% effectiveness.

PiercingThorn.description: Fires a piercing thorn, dealing physical damage to enemies it passes through.

SummonValeSpirit.description: Creates a Vale Spirit which orbits you for a short time. During this time you automatically shoot nearby enemies with Spirit Thorns from the Vale Spirit.
SummonValeSpirit.altText: The Spirit Thorns cast through Vale Spirit use your stats.

BoneArmor.description: A protective coating of bone armor which grants 8% less damage taken for 4 seconds.

SummonBoneMinion.description: Summon a Bone Minion to attack your enemies for 20 seconds.

SummonSkeletonRogue.description: Summon a primal wolf to guard you and attack your enemies

SummonDeathKnight.description: Summons a Skeleton Death Knight to assist you.
SummonDeathKnight.altText: Skeleton Death Knights have 200 base health and 15% base critical strike chance. Press A to give your minions an attack command.

SummonCryomancer.description: Summons a skeleton mage to assist you. You are limited to 2 mages at a time.
SummonCryomancer.altText:
Skeleton mages have 100 base health. Press A to give your minions an attack command.

You will always summon the skeleton type you have the fewest of.

SummonPyromancer.description: Summons a skeleton mage to assist you. You are limited to 2 mages at a time.
SummonPyromancer.altText:
Skeleton mages have 100 base health. Press A to give your minions an attack command.

You will always summon the skeleton type you have the fewest of.

DeathKnightHarvest.description: A melee attack that hits all enemies in an area in front of you. Unaffected by weapon range.

Charged Stone.description: Create a charged stone that orbits you for 6 seconds, dealing physical and lightning spell damage to nearby enemies each second.

Hailstorm.description: Surrounds you in a hailstorm that deals physical and cold damage over time to nearby enemies.

Tempestuous.description: Surrounds you in a swirling tempest of cold and lightning damage over time for 3 seconds.

ElementalExplosion.description: Cast an explosion of physical, cold and lightning damage around you.

OldDischarge.description: Zaps up to five nearby enemies, dealing lightning damage.
OldDischarge.altText: Added damage is applied at 250% effectiveness.

LightningTendril.description: Blast the target with a quick bolt of lightning.
LightningTendril.altText: Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

FrenzyAura.description: Increases attack and cast speed of nearby allies

FrenzyTether.description: Tethers an enemy, gives tethered actors +100% increased damage

BloodTether.description:
Tethers an enemy, drawing blood from them to deal physical damage over time. Deals 1% more damage per bleed on the target.

3% of damage dealt is leeched as health.
BloodTether.altText:
An enemy cannot have more than one tether at a time. Tethers last 3 seconds.

Added damage is applied at 200% effectiveness per second.

SummonNecroticWisp.description: Summons a wisp which lasts 10 seconds.

PhysicalNova.description: Destroy your enemies so forcefully that they generate a burst of physical damage around them as they die.
PhysicalNova.altText: Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

PoisonPool.description: Leave a pool of poison the ground for several seconds that poisons enemies within it each second.

SummonBabyScorpion.description: Summons baby scorpions which will follow your scorpion around and attack enemies. Baby scorpions receive the same stats as your scorpion.
SummonBabyScorpion.altText: The scorpion has 400 base health and is resistant to powerful area attacks. Press A to give your minions an attack command.

PullSingle.description: pulls a single target to the creator of this skill

IceShard.description: Cast a razor sharp shard of ice at the target direction.
IceShard.altText: Added damage is applied at 200% effectiveness.

SummonAxe.description: Summons a copy of your currently equipped weapon that rapidly fades from this world, but will seek and attack your foes while it remains.
SummonAxe.altText: Press A to give your minions an attack command.

TundraNova.description: Cast a burst of frigid sleet to pelt enemies around the target.
TundraNova.altText: Tundra Nova has a freeze rate of 80.

HolyEruption.description: An eruption of holy power that deals spell fire damage to enemies and heals 80 health to nearby allies.

Manifest Armor 02 ForgeBreath.description: Deals fire damage in a cone. Added spell damage applies a 350% effectiveness.

Tsunami.description: Creates a frigid cascading Tsunami around you that deals cold damage in an area.
Tsunami.altText:
If cast by Maelstrom, the total damage is multiplied by the number of Maelstrom stacks you reached.

Added damage is applied at 300% effectiveness.

Twister.description: Conjures a {Twister} that moves at random, pulling in nearby enemies and dealing physical damage to them.
Twister.altText: Added damage applies to the damage over time at 50% effectiveness per second.

Fire Fissure.description: Open a fissure underneath your enemies, dealing spell fire damage over time for 3 seconds.
Fire Fissure.altText: Added damage is applied at 200% effectiveness each second.

Twisters.description: Conjures 2 to 4 twisters that move at random, dealing physical damage to enemies they pass through each second.
Twisters.altText: Added damage applies to the damage over time at 75% effectiveness per second.

RaptorScreech.description: Your raptor emits a vicious screech, dealing damage to and shredding the armor of nearby enemies.

Rampage.description:
The companion ability of your Primal Raptor.

Sends your Raptor into a rampage. Your raptor gains 40% more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and 40% increased attack speed, cast speed, movement speed, and size for 4 seconds
Rampage.altText: Scales with your Raptor's stats rather than yours

Manifest Armor 04 Charge.description: Charge at a nearby enemy, knocking back and dealing physical damage to enemies hit along the path.

Manifest Armor 03 Whirlwind Strike.description: The Manifest Armor quickly spins, hitting all enemies around it. Added damage applies at 300% effectiveness.

HealthOrb.description: Heals the first friendly actor that comes into contact with it.

SigilAura.description: Increases allies' health regen and adds additional fire damage to attacks per active Sigil.

DivineFlare.description: A holy blast which deals spell fire damage to nearby enemies.

BurstOfFlame.description: A burst of flame that deals high damage in an area around the target.
BurstOfFlame.altText: Added damage is applied at 200% effectiveness.

LoadedDice.description: Guarantee a critical strike on your next hit.

ArcaneAscendanceExit.description: Toggle to prevent movement and drain 25 mana each second. Mana drain increases by 1 mana per second. All spells cost +5 mana to cast. 100% increased spell damage and 50% increased cast speed.

ThicketBlades.description: Summon a mystical thicket around you that repeatedly damages nearby enemies.
ThicketBlades.altText: Recasting refreshes the duration. Added damage applies at 70% of its value. Can be cast instantly.

SummonBee.description: Summon a bee to destroy your enemies for 10 seconds.

ChannelledLightningBlast.description: Cast a lightning blast dealing moderate damage

Dash.description: Moves a short distance towards the mouse cursor.

Furnace.description:
Spews sweltering heat in a cone in front of you, dealing fire damage over time.

Added damage applies at 240% effectiveness per second.

GlyphOfFire.description: Create a glyph that detonates after 1.3 seconds.

SummonRunicElemental.description: Summons a bone golem, which attacks slowly, but has a 15% chance to retaliate with bone nova when hit.
SummonRunicElemental.altText: Bone golems have 400 base health. Press A to give your minions an attack command.

RuneWall.description: Summons a wall of roots at target location that slow and taunt nearby enemies.

IceRune.skillLore: This is used by the thorn burst tree

Squirrel Ability.description:
The companion ability of your Primal Squirrels.

Your squirrels are worked up into a Sciurine Rage and gain 40% increased movement and attack speed for 4 seconds.

SummonAreksFlesh.description: Summon the remains of Arek to fight for you. Arek uses physical melee attacks.
SummonAreksFlesh.altText: Press A to give your minions an attack command.

TimeWave.description: Release a torrent of time distortion around you, damaging nearby enemies.

EphemeralStance.description: Toggles ephemeral stance. While in ephemeral stance you deal 70% increased physical and void damage, but lose 7% of your current health when you use a skill and lose 37% more mana from mana drain effects. You can only have one stance active at once.

JuggernautStance.description: Toggles juggernaut stance. While in juggernaut stance you have 50% more armour and take 15% less damage, but have 15% less crit chance, movement speed, attack speed and cast speed. You can only have one stance active at once.
JuggernautStance.altText: All stats granted by juggernaut stance are multiplicative with other modifiers

ClusterBomb.description:
Create secondary explosions from your Acid Flask. These can potentially hit the same target hit by the primary explosion.
Added damage applies at 50% effectiveness.

FireTrail.description: Leaves a wake of fire behind you that ignites enemies and lasts for 3 seconds.

BallistaBolt.description: Fires an arrow in a target direction

Harpoon.description: Fires an arrow in a target direction

PerfectStorm.description: A melee attack that can trigger three different spells - Earth Spikes, Northern Winds, and Lightning Bolt - at a 20% chance each.
PerfectStorm.altText:
Each spell is rolled independantly, so you can trigger multiple spells with a single attack.

Earth spikes deals physical damage, northern winds deals cold damage, and lightning bolt deals lightning damage.

Northern winds has a freeze rate of 20.

NecroticExplosion.description: Create a burst of necrotic damage in an area around the target.
NecroticExplosion.altText: Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

SummonPoisonWisp.description: Summons a Necrotic Wisp which lasts 10 seconds.

PoisonExplosion.description: Poison Explosion poisons all nearby enemies.

LightningBlastBeam.description:
Channel to create a beam of pure energy in the target direction. The beam deals fire and lightning damage to all enemies caught in it.

Drains 20 mana per second.
LightningBlastBeam.altText: Added damage applies at 250% effectiveness each second. Damage reduces while rotating.

AnomalyEnd.description: Brings enemies that were sent forward back to your time.

TimeBubble.description: Creates a bubble where time moves slower than the space around it. Slows enemies caught in the time bubble and shreds their void resistance.

TimeLock.description: Time Locks all nearby enemies for 2 seconds.

SmallIceNova.description: Casts a smaller nova around you that deals cold damage.

SparkChargeExplosion.description: Spark charges explode after 1 second dealing lightning damage to nearby enemies. Spark charges automatically detonate when the enemy they are attached to dies.

BurningGround.description: A Burning patch on the ground which ignites all enemies twice per second.

DeathSealExit.description: Releases a Wave of Death dealing damage based on how long Death Seal has been actve and your current percent missing health.

SummonHealingTotem.description:
Summons a totem that repeatedly heals nearby allies for 100 health. 

Healing totems have 100 base health and last 6 seconds.

IceShield.description: Creates a shield in a target direction that repeatedly casts frostbolt in that direction.
IceShield.altText:
Frostbolts are cold projectiles that create an ice explosion on hit.

The shards and explosions have a freeze rate of 12.

FrostboltSplinters.description: Cast a homing bolt of ice towards the target.

ShadowStep.description: Exchange locations with a shadow clone.

ShadowAssault.description: Three shadow clones appear around a target location and dash through it.

AssassinArrow.description: Fires an arrow that seeks out a specific enemy target. Ignoring other enemies in its path.

SpreadSpiritPlague.description: Spread the most recently applied Spirit Plague to nearby enemies.

VolatileZombieExplosion.description: Explodes caster dealing physical damage to nearby enemies.

SummonSkeletonVanguard.description: Summon a Skeleton Vanguard wielding a spear which fights for you.

DoubleStrike.description: A melee attack that hits all enemies in an area in front of you. Unaffected by weapon range. Double damage scaling.

TailSlam.description:
A melee physical hit followed by a powerful cascading explosion. The explosion counts as a fire spell and applies ignite on hit.

Added damage applies at 100% effectiveness to the melee hit and 200% effectiveness to the explosion.

Increased Area for Minion Area Skills applies to the melee hit, but not the cascading explosion.

SummonMercenary.description: Recruit a crossbow mercenary to guard you.
SummonMercenary.altText: Press A to give your minions an attack command.

DevouringSouls.description:
Calls forth five hungering souls that seeks out enemies, on hit they deal necrotic damage and then possesses the target.

Possessed enemies take necrotic damage over time for 1.5 seconds. Enemies cannot be possessed by multiple souls at once.
DevouringSouls.altText:
Possess's damage counts as spell damage and it is affected by modifiers to base spell damage.

Added spell damage applies to the initial hit at 200% and to possess at 100% per second for 1.5 seconds.

soulReave.description: A necrotic melee attack that hits all enemies in a wide area. This attack has 15% more radius compared to the abomination's basic melee attack.

Abomination Boss Tail Slam.description: Slam the ground with your weapon damaging enemies in a large area and creating 2 to 4 aftershocks nearby.
Abomination Boss Tail Slam.altText: Added melee damage applies at 300% effectiveness.

Abomination Boss Tail Slam Projectile.description: Cast a homing bolt of ice towards the target.

Abomination Melee.description: Attacks enemies in an area in front of the abomination.

Abomination Double Strike.description: Two rapid melee attacks which strike all enemies in front of the abomination.
Abomination Double Strike.altText: Added damage applies at 200% effectiveness for each hit of Double Strike.

SoulVomit.description: Vomits to death over 3 seconds applying Damned to all enemies in range.

BoneEruption.description: Bones erupt from the ground, dealing physical damage to enemies in the area.

AlluvionWave.description: A wave of crashing water dealing spell cold damage in a wide area. Added spell damage is applied at 400% effectiveness.

DragonfireNova.description: Create a burst of fire damage around a minion. This ability is cast by your minion, not by you.

SmokeTrail.description: Leaves a wake of fire behind you that ignites enemies. Duration 3 seconds.

FlameWave.description: Launch a wave of flame toward the target, hitting all enemies in its path.
FlameWave.altText: Added damage is applied at 300% effectiveness.

ShieldShatter.description: Launch shield fragments in a cone in front of you.

DelayedInfernalShade.description: Target enemy and all nearby enemies take fire damage per second . Each enemy can only have one Infernal Shade attached at a time. Expires after 5 seconds. Max 4 active shades.
DelayedInfernalShade.altText: Your maximum number of shades is shared with Dread Shade.

Fire Burst.description:
A burst of fire damage around you.
If triggered by Warden's Echo, the damage will match the element of the melee attack used.
Fire Burst.altText: Added damage is applied at 150% effectiveness.

FlurryWave.description:
Strike with such force that your blows extend further, granting additional range. Does not hit targets already hit by the attack that generated the Force Wave.
This still counts as a melee attack.
FlurryWave.altText: Added damage is applied at 50% effectiveness.

Bow Flurry.description: A bow or melee attack that performs 3 rapid strikes. The last strike can be cancelled by moving.
Bow Flurry.altText: Added damage applies at 80% effectiveness to each strike and each strike has a 40% reduced chance to apply ailments on hit.

Decoy Small Explosion.description: Trigger small hidden explosives hidden in your Decoy, damaging enemies near it.
Decoy Small Explosion.altText: Added damage is applied at 200% effectiveness.

Decoy Sonic Wave.description: Your Decoy emits a piercing sound that afflicts enemies around it with armor shred and frailty.

DancingStrike2.description:
Requires dual wielding.

A series of fast dash attacks. Dancing Strikes' movement does not scale with attack speed, but it gains increased cooldown recovery speed and more damage equal to 50% of your total increased melee attack speed.
DancingStrike2.altText:
Added damage is applied to each attack at 150% effectiveness.

Your total increased melee attack speed includes the modifier from attack rate and generic increased attack speed stats. If your {Melee Attack Speed} is 1.5, then Dancing Strikes gains 25% increased cooldown recovery speed and 25% more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

DancingStrike3.description:
Requires dual wielding.

A series of fast dash attacks. Dancing Strikes' movement does not scale with attack speed, but it gains increased cooldown recovery speed and more damage equal to 50% of your total increased melee attack speed.
DancingStrike3.altText:
Added damage is applied to each attack at 150% effectiveness.

Your total increased melee attack speed includes the modifier from attack rate and generic increased attack speed stats. If your {Melee Attack Speed} is 1.5, then Dancing Strikes gains 25% increased cooldown recovery speed and 25% more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

DancingStrike4.description:

Chakram.description: Throw a single Chakram that pierces through all enemies, rebounds off terrain, and returns to you. Enemies can be hit a second time when the Chakram is returning.
Chakram.altText: Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

BowPuncture.description: An extended melee stab or piercing bow attack that has a 30% chance to inflict bleed on hit. Bleed inflicted by puncture has 30% increased duration.
BowPuncture.altText:
When using a bow, Puncture deals 5% less damage to each subsequent enemy hit up to 20% less damage.

Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

PunctureCharging.description: An extended melee stab or piercing bow attack that causes bleeding with 40% increased duration.

BowPunctureCharging.description: An extended melee stab or piercing bow attack that causes bleeding with 40% increased duration.

smallFireball.description: Cast a ball of fire towards the target. Added spell damage applies at 125% effectiveness.

TotemPoisonBurst.description: Deals a small amount of physical damage and has 100% chance to poison on hit.
TotemPoisonBurst.altText: Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

DetonationChainLightning.description: A bolt of lightning created by the detonation, jumping to nearby enemies.

SmokeBombBowShot.description: Uses Smoke Bomb at the target spot.

DetonatingArrowCharging.description:
Fires an arrow that embeds itself in a target then explodes after 0.6 seconds.

All added bow damage is converted to lightning. Added bow damage applies to the explosion at 150% effectiveness.

SummonPrimalSquirrel.description:
Summons a primal wolf that follows you into combat. When its health drops to 0 it is downed, and you can stand near it to revive it.

The wolf counts as a companion. You can have a maximum of two companions at once by default.
SummonPrimalSquirrel.altText: The Wolf has 160 base health and is resistant to powerful area attacks. Press A to give your minions an attack command.

CinderStrikeCombo2.description: Melee or bow combo with three attacks. The first attack also creates a fiery explosion, damaging nearby enemies.
CinderStrikeCombo2.altText:
The consecutive attack counter resets if you go 2 seconds without using Cinder Strike.

Added damage applies to the first attack at 200% effectiveness, and to the other attacks at 100% effectiveness.

CinderStrikeCombo3.description: Melee or bow combo with three attacks. The first attack also creates a fiery explosion, damaging nearby enemies.
CinderStrikeCombo3.altText:
The consecutive attack counter resets if you go 2 seconds without using Cinder Strike.

Added damage applies to the first attack at 200% effectiveness, and to the other attacks at 100% effectiveness.

Cinder Strike Bow.altText:
The consecutive attack counter resets if you go 2 seconds without using Cinder Strike.

Added damage applies to the first attack at 200% effectiveness, and to the other attacks at 100% effectiveness.

CinderStrikeBigHit.altText: The consecutive attack counter resets if you go 2 seconds without using Cinder Strike.

Burning Dagger.altText: Added damage is applied at 150% effectiveness.

Burning Dagger Throw.description: Launch a burning dagger at a nearby enemy.
Burning Dagger Throw.altText: Added damage is applied at 150% effectiveness.

Burning Dagger Throw 5 of them.description: Launch a cone of burning daggers at nearby enemies.
Burning Dagger Throw 5 of them.altText: Added damage is applied at 150% effectiveness.

Rain of Arrows.description: Launch a hail of arrows into the sky that hits all enemies in an area around the target.
Rain of Arrows.altText: Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

ExplosiveFlask.description: Throw a flask of acid that explodes on impact, poisoning enemies and reducing their armor.
ExplosiveFlask.altText: Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

ExplosiveFlaskExplosion.description: Throw a highly explosive flask at a target.
ExplosiveFlaskExplosion.altText: Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

Suicide.description: Explodes caster dealing physical damage to nearby enemies.

SummonZombieTorso.description: Summons a Volatile Zombie which trudges towards the nearest enemy. When it is nearby an enemy or when it dies, it explodes dealing fire damage to all nearby enemies. Volatile Zombies' health decays at a moderate rate.
SummonZombieTorso.altText: Press A to give your minions an attack command.

ShadowDaggersFinisher.description: Upon reaching 4 stacks of Shadow Daggers, the Daggers plunge into the target, dealing physical damage. This damage always critically strikes.
ShadowDaggersFinisher.altText: Added damage is applied at 340% effectiveness.

SummonWarcryTotem.description: Summons a totem that repeatedly grants casts Warcry.
SummonWarcryTotem.altText: Warcry totems have 100 base health and last 3 seconds.

MageLightning.description: An arc of lightning from your mana blade that strikes each enemy hit by Mana Strike.
MageLightning.altText: Added damage is applied at 150% effectiveness.

SummonBallistaShield.description: Summons a shield in front of the ballista to block incoming projectiles.

TidalWave.description: A wave of crashing water dealing spell cold damage and chilling enemies in a wide area.
TidalWave.altText: Added damage is applied at 400% effectiveness.

SummonCorpseParasite.description: Summon a corpse parasite that will attack nearby enemies for 4 seconds, dealing melee physical damage.
SummonCorpseParasite.altText: Press A to give your minions an attack command.

Anchor of Oblivion Wave.description:
A devastating wave of void centred on the caster.

Added spell damage is applied at 500% effectiveness.

Applies three stacks of slow to the caster.

GasparSetSwipe.description: Slashes the area in front of you with void. Added spell damage is applied at 800% effectiveness.

HeorotUniqueBowIcicle.description: Cast a shard of ice in the direction of your bow attack.

Icicle.description: Cast an arc of ice spikes towards your enemy.
Icicle.altText: Added spell damage is applied at 300% effectiveness.

ZombieVomit.description: Vomits to death over 3 seconds, dealing a mixture of physical and poison damage over time to nearby enemies.

Storm Crow Ability.description:
The companion ability of your Storm Crows.

Your crows call down a single massive lightning strike on the targeted area after a brief delay, hitting all enemies in the area. Deals 30% more damage per contributing crow.
Storm Crow Ability.altText:
Your crows' added spell damage applies at 400% effectiveness by default.

Not affected by increased cast speed.

Storm Crow Ability Damage.description:
The companion ability of your Storm Crows.

Your crows call down a single massive lightning strike on a target enemy, hitting all enemies in the area. The damage is multiplied by the number of crows contributing to it.

StormCrowLightningBlast.description: Hurl a bolt of lightning at the target

Wisdom Of The Storm.description:
Grants an ally Aspect of the Crow.
Aspect of the Crow grants +3 melee lightning damage and +3 spell lightning damage for a base duration of 8 seconds and can stack.

GiveBerry.description: Gives a berry to the target, healing them.

Coagulated Blood.description:
Combine the excess coagulated blood into an orb that seeks out the nearest enemy and explodes, hitting all nearby enemies.
Has 150% added damage effectiveness.

Coagulated Blood Explosion.description:
Combine the excess coagulated blood into an orb that seeks out the nearest enemy and explodes, hitting all nearby enemies.
Added damage applies at 150% effectiveness.

ArcaneFlames.description: When you use a fire ability, enemies nearby that area are also ignited.

JadeDust.description: Your nearby minions are granted +50% chance to poison on hit, tripled for throwing attacks. Lasts 4 seconds.

FallingJavelin.description: Call a meteor from the sky that deals a large amount of damage upon landing. Added damage is applied at 750% effectiveness.

JavelinLightningSpear.description: A spear of lightning that emerges from the Javelin and seeks out a nearby enemy, piercing all in its path.

JavelinCharging.description:
Fires an arrow that embeds itself in a target then explodes after 0.6 seconds.

All added bow damage is converted to lightning. Added bow damage applies to the explosion at 150% effectiveness.

JavelinSpearBurst.description: Hurl a javelin that pierces through every enemy in its path.
JavelinSpearBurst.altText: This is a throwing attack that scales with throwing attack damage and throwing attack speed. It is not a melee attack or spell.

BannerRush.description: Dash to your Banner. Cannot be used without a target.
BannerRush.altText: Shares a cooldown with Lunge and Shield Rush.

FlameTrail.description:
Creates a trail of holy fire and lightning which damages enemies standing on it.

Added spell damage applies at 250% effectiveness per second.

WarSlash.description: A melee attack that hits all enemies in an area in front of you. Unaffected by weapon range.

WarpathFireTrail.description: Leaves a trail of fire behind you, igniting enemies each second.

Majasa Boss 07p3 Orbs and Nova Starter.description: Throughs a ball of void in an arc. It explodes when it reaches the target, and summons an effigy of decay.

Majasa Boss 07p2.2 Blood AoE Pool.description: Leave a pool of poison the ground for several seconds that poisons enemies within it each second.

Majasa Boss 07p3.1 Returning Blood Orb.description: Cast a ball of fire towards the target. Added spell damage applies at 125% effectiveness.

Freezing Concoction.description: A splash of freezing potion that deals no damage, but has 400 Freeze Rate.

Werebear Maul Starter.description: Jump forward a short distance and slam into the ground dealing damage to nearby enemies.
Werebear Maul Starter.altText: Added melee damage applies at 250% effectiveness.

Werebear Maul AoE.description: Slam the ground with your weapon damaging enemies in a large area and creating 2 to 4 aftershocks nearby.
Werebear Maul AoE.altText: Added melee damage applies at 250% effectiveness.

SwarmbladeShift.description: Dash a short fixed distance in the target direction dealing damage to all enemies in your path.
SwarmbladeShift.altText:
Dive's cooldown does not recover while you are using it.

Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness

SwarmbladeShiftSlash.description: Every third consecutive attack with Rive slashes in a full circle around the character, lacerating enemies it hits.
SwarmbladeShiftSlash.altText:
Lacerated enemies take melee damage over time for 3 seconds, equal to 100% of your added melee damage. Laceration does not stack.

The consecutive attack counter resets if you go 3 seconds without using Rive.

The third hit has 200% added damage effectiveness.

SwarmbladeArmbladeSlash1.description: Slash enemies in front of you with a fast combo ability.
SwarmbladeArmbladeSlash1.altText: Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness

SwarmbladeArmbladeSlash2.description: Slash enemies in front of you with a fast combo ability.
SwarmbladeArmbladeSlash2.altText: Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness

SwarmbladeArmbladeSlash3.description: Slash enemies in front of you with a fast combo ability.

SwarmbladeSummonHive.description:
Summons a Hive that releases Locusts while enemies are nearby. You can have a maximum of three Hives by default and each Hive contains 12 Locusts.

You are limited to 12 active Locusts and each Locust lasts up to 12 seconds.
SwarmbladeSummonHive.altText: The rate at which it summons Locusts scales with minion cast speed. Locusts scale with your minion stats.

SpiritThorns.description: Releases a burst of thorns towards enemies in the target direction. Thorns deal physical damage on hit and multiple thorns can hit the same target.

Umbral Blades 2.altText: Added damage applies at 60% effectiveness. 40% less chance to apply ailments on hit.

Umbral Blades Recall.description: Recall all Umbral Blades to you, hitting enemies along the way.
Umbral Blades Recall.altText: Added damage applies at 60% effectiveness. 40% less chance to apply ailments on hit.

PrismShardRelease.description:
Create a prismatic shard that explodes on a nearby enemy, dealing elemental damage.
Has 75% added damage effectiveness.

ArborealProtection [BearToSpriggan].description: Creates a thorn shield around yourself and up to 5 nearby allies then trasforms you into Spriggan Form.
ArborealProtection [BearToSpriggan].altText: Thorn Shield grants 30 armor and shoots out thorns at nearby enemies which deal physical spell damage when it ends.

CallSwarm [WerebearToSwarmblade].description: Summons a Locust for each nearby stunned enemy up to a maximum of 6 and then transforms you into Swarmblade Form.

BarkSkin [SprigganToBear].description: Adds 4 seconds to the duration of every Thorn Shield on you and then transforms you into Werebear Form.
BarkSkin [SprigganToBear].altText: Thorn Shield grants 30 armor and shoots out thorns at nearby enemies which deal physical spell damage when it ends.

Infest [SprigganToSwarmblade].description: Converts your 2 nearest vines into hives and then transforms you into Swarmblade Form.

CleanseHives [SwarmbladeToSpriggan].description: Creates a thorn shield around yourself and up to 5 nearby allies then trasforms you into Spriggan Form.
CleanseHives [SwarmbladeToSpriggan].altText: Thorn Shield grants 40 armor and shoots out thorns at nearby enemies which deal physical spell damage when it ends.

AngerSwarm [SwarmbladeToBear].altText: Thorn Shield grants 40 armor and shoots out thorns at nearby enemies which deal physical spell damage when it ends.

SummonUpheavalTotem.description: Summons a totem that repeatedly attacks with Upheaval.
SummonUpheavalTotem.altText: Upheaval totems have 100 base health and lasts 8 seconds.

UpheavalShockwave.description: Unleashes a shockwave around the enemy or totem, dealing damage to nearby enemies. Cannot hit enemies that were already hit by the Upheaval.
UpheavalShockwave.altText:
Upheaval and its Shockwaves deal the same amount of damage.

Added damage is applied at 200% effectiveness.

UpheavalShatter.description: Shatters the frozen enemy, dealing cold damage to enemies around it.

TotemShatter.description:
Shatters the totem, destroying it to deal physical damage to all nearby enemies and restore 2 health per attunement to you.
Has 400% added damage effectiveness.

WerebearSwipe2.description: A melee attack that hits all enemies in an area in front of you. Unaffected by weapon range.

Umbral Blades 3.altText: Added damage applies at 60% effectiveness. 40% less chance to apply ailments on hit.

UmbralBladeExplosion.description: Umbral Blades left in the ground explode after a short delay or upon contact with an enemy.
UmbralBladeExplosion.altText: Added damage applies at 60% effectiveness. 40% less chance to apply ailments on hit.

HiveLocustSpawn.altText: Locusts scale with your minion stats, not your stats.

Entangling Roots Wrap.description:
Smites a target enemy with a bolt of holy fire that descends from the sky, healing allies around the target for 60 health. If you are in the area you are also healed.

Cannot be used without a target.
Entangling Roots Wrap.altText: Added spell damage applies at 150% effectiveness

ThornVolley.description: Releases a burst of thorns towards enemies in the target direction. Thorns deal physical damage on hit and multiple thorns can hit the same target.

ValeSpirit.description: Creates a Vale Spirit which orbits you. When you cast Spirit Thorns, an additional Spirit Thorn is released from each Vale Spirit.
ValeSpirit.altText: The Spirit Thorns cast through Vale Spirit use your stats.

HakarsPhoenixFlameBurst.description: Create a burst of fire damage emanating from the revived companion. Scales with the companion's stats. Added spell damage applies at 400% effectiveness.

EnsnaringRoots.description:
Call forth a wave of roots that grows outwards in a wide cone in front of you. The wave deals physical damage and roots enemies it hits for 1.5 seconds. Rooted enemies take physical damage over time until they are freed.


Added spell damage applies at 100% to the initial hit and 200% per second to the damage over time.
EnsnaringRoots.altText: Added spell damage applies to the damage over time at 200% effectiveness per second.

WerebearToHumanForm.description: Return back to human form, returning your original stats and abilities.

SprigganToHumanForm.description: Return back to human form, returning your original stats and abilities.

SwarmbladeToHumanForm.description: Return back to human form, returning your original stats and abilities.

TimeTravelTeleport.description: Travel between the Divine and Ruined eras without moving
TimeTravelTeleport.skillLore: <#C686FF>Temporal Shift</color> ability gained while inside Julra's Sanctum.
TimeTravelTeleport.altText: Dodge the timeline collapse using <#C686FF>Temporal Shift.

ThornBarrier.description: Form a protective barrier of thorns around yourself or an ally that grants 40 armor. When the shield expires, a burst of ice thorns shoot out and damage nearby enemies.

DragonSongExplosion.description: A burst of firey breath that deals damage to enemies in a cone in the direction you're facing. Added spell damage applies at 900% effectiveness.

Soulfire Shield.description: Toggles between fire immunity and necrotic immunity at the cost of one soul ember.
Soulfire Shield.skillLore: <#C686FF>Soulfire Shield</color> ability gained while inside the Soulfire Basition

Amber Lantern.description:
Enemies outside the Amber's light deal much more damage and take much less damage.

Activate this ability to move the Amber to a target location or recall it.

While your burning Amber is attached to you, it loses illumination when you are hit, reducing the radius at which it illuminates enemies. The illumination lost depends on the damage dealt as a percentage of your maximum health.

Illumination can be restored by slaying an Amber Elemental.
Amber Lantern.skillLore: <#C686FF>Burning Amber</color> ability gained while inside The Lightless Arbor

FrozenGroundCircle.description: Leave a circle of frozen ground which chills enemies that stand on it.

Trigger explosive devices, damaging enemies in a small area.

Your Ballista's added bow damage is applied at 250% effectiveness.

Skeletal Mages Cold Projectile.description: Cast a razor sharp shard of ice at the target direction. Added spell damage applies at 150% effectiveness.

WolfIceBite.description:
Bites the enemy with icy fangs, dealing melee cold damage. 
Added damage applies at 200% effectiveness.

Runemaster 37 Lightning Mine.description: Places a lightning glyph on the ground that explodes after a short duration. Added spell damage applies at 250% effectiveness.

Runemaster 39 Shocking Orb.description: Creates a slow moving orb in the target direction. 4 times a second lightning arcs from the orb to up to 7 enemies around it, dealing lightning damage. Added spell damage applies at 100% effectiveness to the orb and each zap hit.

Runemaster 46 Discharging snap.description: Creates a rapidly expanding circle that deals lightning damage on hit. Added spell damage applies at 250% effectiveness.

Runemaster 42 Lightning Zigzags.description:
Creates a burst of erratic projectiles that deal lightning damage on hit and grants you ward on hit. The ward gained is equal to 10 + 1 per intelligence.

Multiple projectiles cannot hit the same target.

Lightning arcs between allies and enemies around the target location. Enemies hit take lightning damage. Allies hit gain a buff that grants +100% chance to shock on hit and +10 lightning damage for spells and attacks. This buffs last 4 seconds and can stack multiple times, but each target can only be hit once per second.

Allies hit also gain Frenzy for 4 seconds. Frenzy is a buff that grants 20% increased attack and cast speed, and does not stack.

The lightning can arc to you and buff you, but only if you're close enough to the target location or to another target to which it has already arced.

Runemaster 20 Bouncing Cold Lightning.description:
Hurls an arcane bolt that rapidly ricochets between enemies, dealing cold damage on hit and creating a small lightning explosion.

The bolt can hit the same enemy multiple times and added spell damage applies at 200% effectiveness to each hit. Its hits have a freeze rate of 80.

The lightning explosions hit the original target that caused them and enemies in a small area around them. Added spell damage applies to them at 200% effectiveness.

Runemaster 18 Ice Shield.description:
Casts a shield of mystic frost which grants you a large burst of ward immediately and a smaller amount of ward every 0.4 seconds. If you run out of ward the shield breaks immediately. Otherwise it lasts 13 seconds. While the shield is up you have +100% freeze rate multiplier.

Initial ward granted: 100 + 3 per intelligence.

Ward granted every 0.4 seconds: 20 + 1 per intelligence.

When the shield expires it deals a burst of cold damage to enemies around you. This burst has a freeze rate of 100 and added spell damage applies to it at 250% effectiveness.

Runemaster 47 Rune Lightning Web.description: Lightning repeatedly arcs between enemies around the target. Each enemy can be hit up to three times and added spell damage applies to each hit at 250% effectiveness.

Added spell damage applies at 300% effectiveness to the aura hit and the detonation. Enemies can only be hit by the aura once, but can be hit by both the aura and the detonation.

Runemaster 40.1 Sparks.description: Creates several wild sparks that move randomly and deal lightning damage over time to enemies around them.

Frenzy is a non-stacking buff that grants 20% increased attack and cast speed. It lasts 4 seconds when gained this way.

Fire Aura deals fire damage over time in a small area around you.

Duration increases to Frenzy and Fire Aura are applied as usual.

Added spell damage applies to the explosion at 250% effectiveness.

Added spell damage applies to each stack of Fire Aura at 140% effectiveness per second.

Increased Area for Area Skills stats can affect both the explosion and Fire Aura, but if the stat only affects Runic Invocation then it will not affect stacks of Fire Aura even if they are gained from this invocation.

TimeTravel AoE Teleport.description: Travel between the Divine and Imperial eras without moving, dragging nearby enemies along with you.
TimeTravel AoE Teleport.skillLore: <#C686FF>Temporal Rift</color> ability gained while inside the Oerden's Watch Woven Echo.

Flay Blood Explosion.description: Blood erupts from the enemy, dealing physical spell damage to it and all other enemies in an area.
Flay Blood Explosion.altText: Added spell damage applies at 200% effectiveness.

Time Beast Wings 01 Cyclone.description: Create a burst of fire damage around a minion. Has 400% added damage effectiveness.

Time Beast Wings 02 Dive Bomb.description: A series of fast dash attacks. Requires dual wielding.
Time Beast Wings 02 Dive Bomb.altText: Dancing Strikes' movement does not scale with attack speed, but Dancing Strikes deals 1% more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per 3% increased attack speed.

components.ability: Time Beast Wings 02.1 Dive Bomb Impact

Time Beast Fire Head 01.1 Fireball Morta.description: Throughs a ball of ice in an arc. It explodes when it reaches the target.

components.ability: Time Beast Fire Head 01.2 Fireball Mortar Explosion

Time Beast Fire Head 02 Incinerate.description: Cast a ball of void dealing moderate damage

Time Beast Tentacles 01 Flower Spit.description: Cast a ball of fire dealing moderate damage

Time Beast Cold Head 01 Ice Storm.description: Create a burst of fire damage around a minion. Has 400% added damage effectiveness.

Time Beast 03 Pounce Dash.description: A series of fast dash attacks. Requires dual wielding.
Time Beast 03 Pounce Dash.altText: Dancing Strikes' movement does not scale with attack speed, but Dancing Strikes deals 1% more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per 3% increased attack speed.

Time Beast Fangs 02 Roar of Time.description: Create a burst of fire damage around a minion. Has 400% added damage effectiveness.

components.ability: Time Beast Armor 02.1 Scale Shot Projectiles

Time Beast Armor 02.1 Scale Shot Project.description: Capsule Man Ability copied from Fireball. Cast a ball of fire towards the target. Has 25% chance to ignite on hit. Added spell damage applies at 125% effectiveness.

components.ability: Time Beast Armor 02.2 Scale Shot Impact

Time Beast Armor 02.2 Scale Shot Impact.description: Create a burst of fire damage around a minion. Has 400% added damage effectiveness.

Time Beast Tail Spikes 01.1 Tail Swipe P.description: Capsule Man Ability copied from Fireball. Cast a ball of fire towards the target. Has 25% chance to ignite on hit. Added spell damage applies at 125% effectiveness.

components.ability: Time Beast Fangs 01.2 Summon Ancient Enemies

Time Beast Fire Head 02.1 Fire Cone.description: Freezes enemies in a cone in front of you. Freeze lasts for 2 seconds.

Time Beast 03.2 Pounce Shadow Delayer.description: Freezes enemies in a cone in front of you. Freeze lasts for 2 seconds.

Time Beast Lightning Horns 01.11 LIghtni.description: Create a burst of fire damage around a minion. Has 400% added damage effectiveness.

Time Beast 16.1 Lightning Damage.description: Create a burst of fire damage around a minion. Has 400% added damage effectiveness.

components.ability: Time Beast Tail Spikes 02.1 Slam Damage

Time Beast 13 Upheaval.description: Sunders the ground in a line in front of you, dealing damage to enemies along the path.
Time Beast 13 Upheaval.altText: Added damage is applied at 150% effectiveness.

Abomination Consume Minions.description: Rapidly devours minions that had previously been absorbed to create the Abomination. Restores 10% of the Abomination's health for each minion devoured.

Abomination EternalArrow.description:
The abomination's archer shoots an arrow that seeks the heart of a nearby target, passing harmlessly through other enemies. Whenever it hits its target it has a chance to continue through it and {Recurve} to strike it again. 

Subsequent {Recurve} chance is multiplied by 0.8 each time the arrow {Recurves}. If the target dies, it will choose a new target.
Abomination EternalArrow.altText:
Base recurve chance is 100%.

Added damage applies at 100% effectiveness.

Abomination Minion Stomp.description: The abomination stomps the ground, dealing physical damage to enemies in the area.
Abomination Minion Stomp.altText: Added damage is applied at 300% effectiveness.

AuraOfRot.description: An aura surrounding the abomination which poisons it every second. Enemies near it are poisoned four times a second, and the abomination's chance to poison on hit applies to each of these instances at 25% effectiveness.

Aura of Decay Cold Retaliation.description: An icy wave that erupts from you which deals no damage, but has 400 Freeze Rate.

Wildfire Wisp.description: Creates a Wildfire Wisp at the target location

Summon AncientOasis01 Primordial Minion.description:
Summons Anuroks to fill your unused companion slots.

Anuroks are not affected by increased area of effect stats, but gain 3% more damage for each 1% increased Area of Effect for Minion Area Skills.

PrimordialBloodSplatter.description:
Primordial Blood Splatter is a physical spell that deals damage to other enemies around the target.

Added damage applies at 150% effectiveness.

RaptorFireBreath.description: Your raptor breathes fire on enemies in a cone in front of it, dealing fire spell damage over time for 1 second.
RaptorFireBreath.altText: Added spell damage applies at 400% effectiveness per second.

BearThornBurst.description: Releases a burst of thorns, damaging all nearby enemies.
BearThornBurst.altText: Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

PrimalBear Teleport.description: Your bear teleports towards an enemy at an unbearable speed.

Time Beast 17 Meteor.description: Call a meteor from the sky that deals a large amount of damage upon landing. Added damage is applied at five times its normal value.

Time Beast 18 Poison Pool Projectile.description: Capsule Man Ability copied from Fireball. Cast a ball of fire towards the target. Has 25% chance to ignite on hit. Added spell damage applies at 125% effectiveness.

Time Beast 18.2 Poison Pool DoT.description: Leave a pool of poison the ground for several seconds that poisons enemies within it each second.

Time Beast 19.1 Block Buff.description: Create a burst of fire damage around a minion. Has 400% added damage effectiveness.

Time Beast Lightning Storm.description: Repeatedly strikes around a target area with bolts of lightning.
Time Beast Lightning Storm.altText:
Added damage is applied at 55% effectiveness.

Increased Area for Area Skills stats apply to the area of the individual lightning strikes, but not to the area of the storm.

Time Beast Lightning Storm Bolt.description: Strikes a nearby enemy with a bolt of lightning.
Time Beast Lightning Storm Bolt.altText: Added damage is applied at 55% effectiveness.

Void Nagasa Boss 01 screen nuke.description: Freezes enemies in a cone in front of you. Freeze lasts for 2 seconds.

components.ability: Void Nagasa Boss 01.1 screen nuke damage

Void Nagasa Boss 01.1 screen nuke damage.description: Slam the ground with your weapon damaging enemies in a large area and creating 2 to 4 aftershocks nearby.
Void Nagasa Boss 01.1 screen nuke damage.altText: Added melee damage applies at 300% effectiveness.

Summon Time Beast.description:
Summons a Rift Beast.

The Rift Beast has evolutions matching the evolutions of the Rift Beast that dropped this item.
Summon Time Beast.altText: Press A to give your minions an attack command.

Summon Giant T_Rex Minion.description:
Summons a Tyrannosaur minion that follows you into combat. It can roar, granting your other minions +25 physical damage with spells and attacks, and the bonuses from Tyrant's Skull are applied to them at 20% effectiveness. The roar's buff lasts for 12 seconds, and also grants frenzy to all allies hit for the same duration.

The roar also applies frailty, slow, and armor shred to nearby enemies.
Summon Giant T_Rex Minion.altText: Press A to give your minions an attack command.

RuptureCorpse.description: Rips apart an allied minion, dealing physical damage to enemies around it. Added damage applies at double effectiveness.

ShadowRend Bow.description:
Perform a short dash attack and manifest a shadow at your previous position, which will perform a sweeping melee attack or piercing bow attack for you after a short delay.

The shadow will persist afterwards for up to 5 seconds. Shadows will imitate your next Shadow Cascade, Shurikens, Umbral Blades, Explosive Trap, or Acid Flask. Up to 3 shadows can be active at once.
ShadowRend Bow.altText:
The initial attack has 100% damage effectiveness, and the shadow's attack has 500% damage effectiveness.

Modifiers to skills used by shadows affect the shadow's attack.

ShadowBlade.description: Throw a ghastly blade at a nearby enemy, with 100% chance to inflict Shadow Daggers.

HammerExplosion.description:
Trigger explosive devices, damaging enemies in a small area.

Your Ballista's added bow damage is applied at 250% effectiveness.

DivineBoltRetaliation.description: Cast a bolt of divine fire towards the target.
DivineBoltRetaliation.altText: Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

SummonPrimalSerpent.description:
Summon a Primal Serpent, a melee minion that poisons on hit. They have an unlimited duration, but do not regenerate health.

You are limited to one primal serpent at a time, but Primal Serpents do not count towards your companion limit.

Primal Serpents have 500 base health.

SummonCrowTotem.description:
Summons a totem that attacks with Swipe. It only scales with totem and minion stats, but it is affected by your Swipe Tree.

Claw Totems have 120 base health and last for 12 seconds.

DevouringOrbProjectileMode.description:
An orb of pure void energy that seeks out your enemies, dealing a large amount of void damage to the target and a smaller amount in an area around them.

Added spell damage applies to the primary hit at 200% effectiveness and at 100% to the area of effect.

HolyFireWave.description:
A melee attack that release a wave of flames from your weapon cleaving through enemies in a cone infront of you. Deals up to 50% less damage to distant enemies. 

Deals 16 additional base fire damage. Other added melee damage applies at 200% effectiveness.

ExplosiveArrowExplosion.description: Throw a highly explosive flask at a target.
ExplosiveArrowExplosion.altText: Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

HammerThrowChanneled.description: Spin towards the mouse while you hold down the ability key, striking nearby enemies as you move.
HammerThrowChanneled.altText:
You have 20% less movement speed while spinning (multiplicative with other modifiers). Hits at twice your attack rate, but added damage applies at 60% effectiveness and there is a 40% less chance to apply ailments on hit. 

You cannot be stunned while spinning.

Not affected by weapon range.

SmokeBombMeleeHit.description: Melee Attack that releases a smoke cloud

TeleportReturn.altText: Using a Traversal skill puts all other traversal skills on cooldown and traversal skills' cooldowns do not recover while you are using a traversal skill.

TeleportChillNova.description: Casts a cold chill nova around you on arrival.
TeleportChillNova.altText: Adds 3 stacks of chill on enemies.

BladeStormExplosion.description: The Bladestorm detonates, causing an explosion of damage in an area that is twice the size of the Bladestorm.

SmeltersWrath AxeThrow.description: Throws an axe at a nearby enemy.
SmeltersWrath AxeThrow.altText:
This is a throwing attack that scales with throwing attack damage and throwing attack speed. It is not a melee attack or spell.

Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

Omen Absorb.description:
Feasts on the souls of {Cursed} enemies, dealing necrotic damage to them, and drawing fragments of their souls back to you. The soul fragments each grant 3 ward when they reach you.

Feasts on up to 13 enemies, prioritising those closest to you.
Omen Absorb.altText: Added spell damage is applied at 250% effectiveness.

Swipe2.description: A melee attack that hits all enemies in an area in front of you. Unaffected by weapon range.
Swipe2.altText: Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

ChannelledHungeringSouls.description:
Calls forth five hungering souls that seeks out enemies, on hit they deal necrotic damage and then possesses the target.

Possessed enemies take necrotic damage over time for 1.5 seconds. Enemies cannot be possessed by multiple souls at once.
ChannelledHungeringSouls.altText:
Possess's damage counts as spell damage and it is affected by modifiers to base spell damage.

Added spell damage applies to the initial hit at 45% effectiveness and to possess at 75% effectiveness over its full duration.

BoneSplinters.description:
Unleashes multiple splinters of bone in a cone behind Marrow Shards.
An enemy can only be hit by Marrow Shards or one projectile from Bone Splinters.
BoneSplinters.altText: Added damage is applied at 125% effectiveness.

SplinterNova.description: Splintered bones fly out in all directions, impaling enemies.
SplinterNova.altText: Added damage is applied at 125% effectiveness.

BurningGroundMeteor.description: A Burning patch on the ground which ignites all enemies twice per second.

LungeExplosion.description: An explosion that deals fire damage in an area.

VenomStrike.description: A slow melee attack that poisons and release a spray of venom

PrimalChallenge.description: Pulls in nearby enemies, stunning them and increasing the duration of stuns on them for 5 seconds

Innervate.description: Grants 50 ward and grants 100% increased mana efficiency for 5 seconds. Can be cast instantly.

Impale.description: Calls forth thorns from the earth, impaling enemies in a cone infront of you and causing them to bleed.

CallOfTheHunt.description: Call your minions to hunt a specific target. The target takes 10% increased damage for 3 seconds. This debuff can stack multiple times but can only be on one target at once.

DarkFissure.description: A powerful melee attack that leaves a dark fissure that lasts 4 seconds. Enemies near the fissure are inflected with despair, which reduces their damage by 40%.

DetonateCorpse.description: Detonates the corpse of an enemy, dealing physical damage to living enemies around it. Added damage applies at double effectiveness.

Shadow Form.description: Rapidly drains health and disables regaining health, but prevents being hit.
