1.description: Multishot costs less mana.

2.description: Multishot deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) when used directly, but has less attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).
2.altText: This effect still applies to double shots from the {Back to Back} if the Multishot that triggered it was a direct use.

3.description: Multishot hits have a chance to apply armor shred on hit.

4.description: Multishot has a chance to be shot when you use another bow attack with increased chance to stun, but it costs significantly more mana.

5.description: Multishot has increased attack speed and chance to gain {Haste} when you use or trigger Multishot from another skill.

6.description: Multishot deals more hit damage, but deals less hit damage as it travels (both multiplicative with other modifiers).
6.altText: It loses damage steadily as it travels, falling to its maximum damage loss at 22 units (the base distance Multishot arrows travel).

stats.statName: Less Hit Damage To Far Away Targets

7.description: When directly using Multishot, every 6th attack is a double shot.

8.description:
Reduce the amount of attacks to double shoot with Multishot.

Additionally, Multishot deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

9.description: Multishot has increased attack speed.

10.description: Multishot arrows pierce enemies (continue through enemies hit) up to a limit.

11.description: Multishot's critical strikes deal more damage.

12.description: Multishot deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) if you haven't moved in the past second.

13.description: You have a chance to gain {Haste} for 2 seconds when you use Multishot while {Stand My Ground} is activate.

14.description: Multishot has increased critical strike chance.

15.description: Multishot has additional arrows, but costs more mana.

16.description:
Multishot deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but hits in a smaller cone and can only shoot a maximum of 3 arrows.

Additionally, Multishot hits have a chance to shred enemy armor per arrow before the limit.
16.altText:
Modifiers that grant benefits per arrow apply before the limit of this node.

For example if your Multishot would have 9 total arrows, this node will grant 90% armor shred chance even if you only shoot 3 arrows.

stats.statName: Armor Shred Chance Per Arrow Before Limit

17.description: Multishot hits have a chance to inflict poison.

18.description: Multishot hits in a wider cone.

19.description: Multishot hits have a chance to slow and inflict bleed on enemies.

20.description: Multishot deals more hit damage to slowed targets (multiplicative with other modifiers).

21.description: Multishot has increased slow and bleed duration per point of Dexterity.

22.description: Multishot penetrates enemy physical resistance.

23.description:
Multishot hits have a chance to knock enemies on hit.

This effect only works on direct uses and has a 2 second cooldown.

24.description: When you are out of mana Multishot is free to use, but it can't shoot more than a few arrows. Other bonuses still apply.

26.description: Multishot deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and arrows travel faster.

28.description: Multishot arrows from the same attack can hit the same target and have an increased chance to stun enemies, but {Multishot} deals significantly less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

stats.statName: Projectiles Can Hit The Same Target

1.altText: Each point of intelligence grants 4% ward retention and improves skills that rely on carefully studied magic, such as Rip Blood and Summon Skeleton.

3.description: You have additional ward decay threshold. Additionally, whenever a nearby enemy, ally, or minion dies, you have a chance to gain ward.
3.altText: Ward is an overshield shield that protects your health. It has no maximum and decays over time.

stats.statName: Chance To Gain Ward On Nearby Death

4.altText: Each point of vitality grants 6 health and 1% poison and necrotic resistance.

5.description: When damage leaves you below half health, you summon a {Revenant,} a melee minion with decaying health whose damage scales with your intelligence. This effect has a 15 second cooldown.
5.altText: The more modifiers for the Revenant's damage and health are multiplicative with other modifiers.
5.pointBonusDescription:
The Revenant deals more damage based on the combined minion skill level of your equipped skills.
For example if you have two minion skills equipped that are level 10, it will gain 20% more damage.

stats.statName: More Revenant Damage Per Minion Skill Level

6.description: You deal increased damage, but you lose a percentage of your current health each second if you have killed an enemy recently (last 4 seconds).

stats.statName: Current Health Drained Per Second On Kill

8.description: You have a chance to poison on hit, and additional poison resistance.

10.pointBonusDescription: When you use a potion you also consume your lowest health minion, killing it to restore your health. The health gained is equal to half the minion's maximum health.

stats.statName: Minion Health Consumed On Potion Use

12.description: You have a chance when one of your Skeletons dies to summon a new one after 3 seconds.
12.altText: Only affects minions from {Summon Skeleton}. The chance to resummon is additive with other sources of the same effect, and has no benefit beyond 100% chance.

13.description: You have additional ward per second for each minion you have active, up to 20 minions.

14.description: You and your minions deal increased physical and necrotic damage.
14.pointBonusDescription: When one of your minions dies, enemies within 4 meters are marked for death. This effect can occur up to 2 times per 3 seconds.

stats.statName: Minion Deaths Mark Nearby Enemies For Death

15.description: You have increased ward retention, and are granted ward whenever one of your minions die.

18.description: Your minions have additional chance to critically strike.

19.pointBonusDescription: Your minions gain stun immunity. Additionally, you and your minions take 30% reduced bonus damage from critical hits.

stats.statName: Shared Reduced Bonus Damage Taken From Crits

20.altText:
The threshold bonus also affects any generic minion added melee damage. granting it as minion added throwing physical damage.
The threshold bonus only applies to the stats you grant when summoning minions, not to temporary effects applied to existing minions.
20.pointBonusDescription: Your minions gain all of their added melee physical damage as added throwing physical damage.

stats.statName: Minion Added Melee Physical -> Minion Added Throwing Physical

22.description: Instead of healing you, your leech drains the health of an enemy within 6 meters every 0.25 seconds.
22.altText: "While leeching" effects are still able to apply to you.

24.description: Grants you Vitality and all resistances, and grants your minions all resistances.

25.altText:
The threshold bonus's effect is individual to each resistance, and only considers your necrotic and elemental resistances.
For example if you have 100% fire resistance, you are 25% overcapped on fire resistance and your minions will gain 5% fire penetration.
25.pointBonusDescription: Your minions gain penetration based on your overcapped necrotic or elemental resistances.

28.pointBonusDescription: Your minions have increased critical strike chance per point of your Intelligence, and your minions deal more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers) per point of your Vitality.

stats.statName: Minion Increased Crit Chance Per Intelligence
Minion More Damage Over Time Per Vitality

29.description: You deal increased damage. This bonus is tripled when you are at low life.
29.altText: You are at low life when at 35% health or less.

32.description: You and your minions have a chance to inflict bleed and frostbite on hit.

34.description: You and your minions deal increased damage over time.
34.pointBonusDescription:
Whenever you kill an enemy you have a chance to summon a {Skeletal Vanguard} from its corpse, a minion that deals melee physical damage using a spear. You are limited to 3 Skeletal Vanguards.
Additionally, your Skeletal Vanguards from all sources have additional chance to inflict bleed on hit.

35.description: Your spells and melee attacks instantly kill enemies that they leave below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health).
35.altText: If you have a similar effect from an item or skill tree node then the highest threshold is used.
35.pointBonusDescription: You have additional dodge rating per Intelligence and increased dodge rating per Vitality.

36.description: When a hit taken leaves you below half health, you gain ward based on your uncapped poison resistance. This effect has a 6 second cooldown.

stats.statName: Ward Gained per 1% Uncapped Poison Resistance

38.description: You have additional Intelligence, but your elemental resistances are lowered.
38.altText: Each point of intelligence grants 4% ward retention and improves skills that rely on carefully studied magic, such as Rip Blood and Hungering Souls.

39.description: You have additional Vitality, and you and your minions have increased health regeneration.
39.altText: Each point of vitality grants 6 health and 1% poison and necrotic resistance.
39.pointBonusDescription: Vitality also grants increased health regeneration.

42.description: Your and your minions deal additional spell necrotic damage and melee necrotic damage.

43.description: You can dual wield melee weapons by equipping a dagger or axe in your offhand. While dual wielding, you have increased attack and cast speed, but take more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

stats.statName: Can Equip Axes Or Daggers In Offhand
Attack And Cast Speed While Dual Wielding

44.description: You take less damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).
44.pointBonusDescription: All damage over time taken bypasses ward.

stats.statName: Damage Over Time Taken Bypasses Ward

45.description: You have increased movement speed with a dagger equipped, more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) with an axe equipped, and additional ward per second with a catalyst equipped.

stats.statName: Increased Movement Speed With A Dagger
Ward Per Second With A Catalyst

46.description: You have a chance to poison on hit, and take less poison damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
46.pointBonusDescription: Half of all damage over time taken is taken as poison damage.

stats.statName: Damage Over Time Taken As Poison

47.description: You deal increased spell damage if you do not have a shield equipped.
47.pointBonusDescription: You deal additional spell damage if you do not have a shield equipped.

48.pointBonusDescription: You gain a percentage of your missing health as ward per second.

stats.statName: Missing Health Gained As Ward Per Second

50.pointBonusDescription:
You gain a chance per {Curse} on the enemy to gain mana on hit.

This effect has a 3 second cooldown.

stats.statName: Chance Per Curse to gain Mana on hit

52.description:
You deal increased fire damage and have a chance to ignite on hit with fire skills, and you deal increased necrotic damage and have a chance to inflict damned on hit with necrotic skills.

These effects also apply to your minions.

53.pointBonusDescription: You deal more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers) to {Cursed} enemies.

stats.statName: More Damage over Time to Cursed

54.pointBonusDescription: You have more armor (multiplicative with other modifiers) per unique {Curse} on the attacker when they hit you.

stats.statName: More Armor per Curse on Target

55.description: Your minions have increased attack and cast speed. This bonus also applies to you if you have used a minion skill in the last 10 seconds.

stats.statName: Applies To Player For 10 Seconds On Minion Skill Use

56.description: A percentage of your current health is drained each second, but you gain a percentage of your missing health as ward each second.

stats.statName: Missing Health Gained As Ward Per Second

58.pointBonusDescription: You gain increased armor equal to half your increased mana regeneration.

59.description: You have additional Vitality, and your minions have additional armor and damage reflection.
59.pointBonusDescription: Your minions have increased armor per point of your Intelligence, and they have increased health per point of your Vitality.

60.description: Your minions leech a percentage of the damage they deal as health.

61.altText: Affects your {Summon Skeleton} skill, but not {Summon Skeletal Mage}.

62.description: You and your minions have increased attack and cast speed.

63.description: You and your minions have increased critical strike chance and leech a percentage of critical strike damage dealt as health.

stats.statName: Shared Critical Strike Damage Leeched As Health

64.description: You have increased health regeneration and additional armor for each minion you control, up to 20 minions.

65.description: Your minions deal additional spell damage and have increased cast speed.

69.description: You have additional health, and a percentage of hit damage taken from bosses and rare enemies is dealt over 4 seconds instead.
69.altText: Delayed damage cannot be altered after the hit and is unaffected by temporary immunity effects. It does not count as damage over time.

stats.statName: Delayed Hit Damage From Bosses And Rares

70.pointBonusDescription: You deal more damage over time based on your current health drained per second.

stats.statName: Damage Over Time Leeched As Health
More Damage Over Time Per 7% Current Health Drain

71.altText: Leech from this node only applies to hits, not to damage over time.

stats.statName: Damage Leeched as Health on Hit

73.altText: The threshold bonus's ward gain ignores your base critical strike multiplier.
73.pointBonusDescription: When you critically strike an enemy you gain a percentage of your added global critical strike multiplier as ward. This effect can trigger up to 3 times per 2 seconds.

stats.statName: Critical Multiplier Granted As Ward On Crit

74.description: A percentage of your damage taken is redirected to your lowest health minion.
74.pointBonusDescription: When one of your minions dies, your other minions restore health equal to 20% of its maximum health.

stats.statName: Damage Redirected To Lowest Health Minion
Minion Health Restored On Minion Death

75.description: Your minions have a chance to shred armor on hit.
75.pointBonusDescription:
When a minion dies, there is a chance for a Skeletal Vanguard to be summoned from its corpse. Skeletal Vanguards are a minion that deals melee physical damage using a spear. You are limited to 3 Skeletal Vanguards.
Additionally, Skeletal Vanguards from any source have additional melee physical damage.

stats.statName: Melee Physical Damage For Skeletal Vanguards

76.description: Your minions deal additional fire and necrotic damage with spells and attacks, and have additional chance to inflict ignite and damned on hit.

77.description: You have a chance to gain Haste for 2 seconds when a minion dies or kills an enemy. Additionally, you have increased movement speed.
77.pointBonusDescription: Whenever you cast a spell, you sacrifice 5% of your current health to grant your minions {Haste} and {Frenzy} for a duration. This effect has a 10 second cooldown.

stats.statName: Haste Chance On Minion Death Or Kill

78.description: You gain additional leech and have significantly increased leech and leech rate, but your leech stacks are removed when you reach 66% health instead of 100%.

80.description: Your minions have additional armor per character level.
80.altText: Character level is the level of your character, not your minions.

82.description: You and your minions deal increased necrotic damage and you have a chance to apply Damned on hit.
82.altText: This node does not give your minions a chance to apply Damned on hit.

83.description: You deal increased poison damage and your minions have a chance to poison on hit.

84.description: You and your minions deal increased physical damage and have increased bleed duration

86.pointBonusDescription: When you cast a physical skill and enemies within 15 meters have a combined 25 or more stacks of bleed, you cast {Rip Blood} at up to 5 nearby enemies and gain {Bleed Overload}.

stats.statName: Rip Blood on up to 5 enemies

87.pointBonusDescription: You take less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per unique {Curse} on the target.

stats.statName: Less Damage Taken Per Curse On Target

88.pointBonusDescription: When you cast a damage over time skill and enemies within 15 meters have a combined 25 or more stacks of poison, you gain {Poison Overload} for 12 seconds and cast {Defiling Nova} which expands outwards poisoning enemies it hits.

89.description:
You gain additional ward decay threshold and you gain ward on kill. 

You also gain ward per 2 points of Intelligence while channeling a skill.

stats.statName: Ward Per Second Per 3 Intelligence While Channeling

90.description: Your {Rip Blood's} hits have a chance to inflict bleed on enemies.
90.pointBonusDescription: While you have {Bleed Overload} you cast {Rip Blood} at a nearby enemy each second.

stats.statName: Rip Blood Casts Each Second With Bleed Overload
Ward Decay Threshold Per 2% Necro Res

92.description: You take less damage while channeling and deal more damage to damned enemies while channeling (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

stats.statName: More Damage to Damned while Channeling

93.description: A portion of the damage you do is returned to you as health over 3 seconds.

94.description: You gain ward and mana when you use a potion.
94.pointBonusDescription: While you have {Poison Overload} using a potion spreads stacks of your poison from all enemies within 15 meters to up to 2 other nearby enemies.

stats.statName: Potion Spreads Poisons during Poison Overload

96.pointBonusDescription: You take less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) from {Withered} enemies.

97.pointBonusDescription: When you cast a fire skill and enemies within 15 meters have a combined 25 or more stacks of ignite, you strike up to three nearby ignited enemies with {Flame Whip} and gain {Ignite Overload} for 12 seconds.

98.altText: Chaining an enemy to the ground deals necrotic damage over time and immobilizes them.
98.pointBonusDescription: When you cast a necrotic skill and enemies within 15 meters have a combined 20 stacks or more of Damned, you {Chain} all damned enemies to the ground for 2 seconds and gain {Damned Overload} for 12 seconds.

100.description: When you directly cast a {Curse} skill you also afflict a number of enemies around the target location with {Anguish}.

101.pointBonusDescription: When you gain {Ignite Overload} or {Damned Overload} all ignited and damned enemies within 15 meters are inflicted with {Witchfire} for 12 seconds.

stats.statName: Witchfire on Ignite or Damned Overload

102.description:
Your hits have a chance to deal double damage.

Additionally your hits have a chance to deal double damage per {Curse} on the target.

103.pointBonusDescription: While you have {Ignite Overload}, and you kill an ignited enemy or hit an ignited boss or rare enemy you cast {Flame Whip} at a nearby enemy.

stats.statName: Flame Whip on Hit or Kill against Ignited

104.description: The Chains from the {Chains of Ruin} node last longer. Additionally damned that you inflict last longer.
104.pointBonusDescription: While you have {Damned Overload} you have a chance to {Chain} nearby damned enemies to the ground each second.

stats.statName: Chance to Chain Damned enemies each second

105.pointBonusDescription: Hitting a boss or rare enemy now also triggers the damage from {Anguish}.

stats.statName: Hitting Boss or Rare triggers Anguish

106.description:
You have a chance to gain {Haste} for 2 seconds when you kill a {Cursed} enemy or hit a {Cursed} boss or rare enemy.

Additionally {Haste} on you has increased effect.

stats.statName: Haste Chance when Hitting Boss or Rare

107.pointBonusDescription: You deal more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers) for each active {Ailment Overload}.

stats.statName: More Damage Over Time per Overload

108.pointBonusDescription: The double damage from the {Chaotic Strikes} node has additional critical strike multiplier.

109.pointBonusDescription:
When damage leaves you below 35% health you cleanse all of your {Curses} on you and on enemies within 15 meters and gain ward per {Curse} cleansed this way.

This effect has a 5 second cooldown.

stats.statName: Cleanse all Curses when reaching Low Health
Ward Gain per Cleansed Curse on You

110.description:
{Witchfire} that you inflict deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per 1% global chance to ignite with fire skills and per 1% global chance to inflict damned with necrotic skills.

Additionally while you have {Ignite} or {Damned Overload} your hits spread {Witchfire} to a number of enemies within 10 meters.
110.altText: These damage modifiers to Witchfire are additive with each other, but multiplicative with all other modifiers.

stats.statName: More Witchfire Damage per Ignite chance
More Witchfire Damage per Damned chance

111.description: You have increased health and you deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of each negative ailment on you up to a maximum of 90.
111.pointBonusDescription: You inflict damned on yourself when you or your minions kill a target or take a hit.

stats.statName: More Damage per Negative Ailment on You
Damn Yourself on Kill or Minion Kill

112.pointBonusDescription: You gain additional mana per point of Intelligence.

114.description: Health leech also grants increased damage.
114.altText:
For example, at 3 points invested, "1% of spell damage leeched as health" would also grant "6% increased damage".
This does not remove the effect of {Scornful Blood}.

115.description: You have more health (multiplicative with other modifiers) and gain a percentage of your maximum health as endurance threshold.
115.pointBonusDescription: Your current health and your ward each cannot exceed 50% of your maximum health. You always count as being at low life.

stats.statName: Maximum Health Gained As Endurance Threshold
Health And Ward Cannot Exceed Max Health Percentage
Always Count As At Low Life

masteries.classDescription: A rebellious scion who disobeyed her masters to seek out forbidden magic, the Acolyte will let nothing stop her from becoming more powerful.
A commander of undeath, they send their animated thralls to battle perfectly willing to sacrifice them as they deem fit.
passiveBonuses: +1 max Skeleton
+1 max Skeleton Mage
Your minions deal 50% increased damage

masteries.classDescription: An acolyte who embraces the corruption of their power and uses the magic of blood and death even at the expense of their own health.
passiveBonuses: 1% of damage dealt is leeched as health
Spells and Melee attacks deal increased damage equal to your missing health

masteries.classDescription: A master of the forbidden arts, they tear into the essence of their foes, corrupting their spirits with relentless curses, necrotic magic and flames to burn their flesh.
passiveBonuses: 5% more damage per curse on the target
+35% fire and necrotic resistance

0.loreText: Roots burst from the earth to snare and hinder your foes

2.description: Root Wave hits have a chance to poison enemies.

3.description: Entangling Roots' base physical damage over time is converted to poison and it now has the poison tag. Consequently this damage scales with increases to poison damage, but not increases to physical damage.
3.altText: This has no effect if you have taken the {Winternid Thorns} node.

4.description: Rooted enemies are also blinded.

5.description:
Entangling Roots now creates seeds in the area. When an enemy draws too close to a seed it bursts, releasing a burst of spores that slow and poison enemies.

If you have taken the {Winternid Thorns} node, the seed bursts inflict {Frostbite} and {Chill} instead of slow and poison.

6.description:
The spores from {Seeds} now heal you and your allies. 

This effect is tripled for minions.

7.description: Seeds now burst when an ally draws close to them which grants you and your allies the {Haste} buff, granting you 30% increased movement speed.

8.description: Seeds now burst when you hit them with {Upheaval} and deal damage in a larger area when detonated this way.

9.description: Seeds will now grow {Vines} when they burst.
9.altText: These vines scale with your {Spriggan Form} tree as if they had been summoned by the {Summon Vines} skill.

10.description: Root Wave immobilizes enemies for a longer duration.

11.description: Root Wave cannot be dodged.

12.description: Entanging Roots now wraps around your totems and vines for twice the duration as enemies, granting them additional armor and increased attack and cast speed.

stats.statName: Attack Speed To Totems And Vines
Cast Speed To Totems And Vines

13.description: Entangling Roots now also wraps around your Spriggans for twice the duration as enemies, granting them all buffs from {Frenzying Thorns} as well as additional projectiles with their {Thorn Volley}.

14.description: Entangling Roots leeches a portion of the damage it deals as health to you.

15.description: Entangling Roots deal more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).
15.altText: This also affects any damage over time ailments that Entangling Roots applies.

16.description: Entangling Roots damage accelerates over time, dealing more damage each second (multiplicative with other modifiers).

17.description: You now cause Entangling Roots to expand in a circle around you rather than a cone in front, but it now has a cooldown.

18.description: Entangling Roots is now cast from the nearest totem to your cursor.

19.description:
When you are stunned, you now cast Entangling Roots. 

This effect has a 20 seconds cooldown, which doesn't affect Entangling Root's cooldown.

20.description: Root Wave hits shred enemy physical resistance.

21.description: Root Wave's hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and have a higher chance to stun enemiess.

22.description:
Entangling Roots' base damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to physical damage. It also has a chance to freeze enemies.

Physical Resistance Shred from all sources is converted to Cold Resistance Shred chance and effects related to Physical Resistance Shred now depend on Cold Resistance Shred instead.

23.description:
Root Wave has a chance to inflict {Frostbite}. 

Poison chance from all sources is converted to Frostbite for Root Wave and effects related to poison now depend on Frostbite instead.

24.description: Root Wave gains additional freeze rate per character level.

25.description:
Root Wave now heals other allies it hits. The amount of health gained is increased by healing effectiveness.

This effect is tripled for minions.

26.description: Root Wave causes your minions and other allies it hits to deal additional physical damage with spells and attacks for 8 seconds. This effect does not stack.

27.description: Root Wave causes your minions and other allies it hits to deal additional damage with spells for 8 seconds. This effect does not stack.

28.description: Root Wave causes your Wolves and Bear it hits to have improved base critical strile chance and deal more damage with critical strikes for 8 seconds. This effect does not stack.

stats.statName: Wolves And Bear Base Crit Chance

29.description:
Root Wave causes your minions and other allies it hits to have additional chance to poison on hit. This buff lasts 8 seconds and does not stack.

The effect is tripled for Scorpions and Serpents.

0.altText: Each point of intelligence grants 4% ward retention and improves skills that rely on carefully studied magic, such as Lightning Blast and Mana Strike.

2.description: Increases your elemental damage
2.altText: Fire, cold, and lightning damage are all considered elemental damage.

3.description: When you drop below 70% health you gain a burst of ward based on your maximum health. This effect has a 12 second cooldown.
3.altText: Ward is a shield that protects your health. It has no maximum and decays over time.

4.description: Every 3 seconds, your next elemental spell deals increased damage and has a chance to slow enemies on hit.

stats.statName: Increased Cooldown Recovery Speed for Teleport
Increased Cooldown Recovery Speed for Snap Freeze

6.description: When you hit an enemy with a lightning skill you cast {Lightning Blast} at other enemies within 6 meters of your target. This effect has a 5 second cooldown.
6.altText: This effect cannot choose the same enemy more than once from a single trigger.
6.pointBonusDescription: Lightning Blast has more critical strike chance when cast this way.

7.description: When you hit an enemy with a fire skill you {Ignite} additional nearby enemies. This effect has a 5 second cooldown.
7.altText: This effect can ignite the initial enemy you hit unless it was killed by that hit.
7.pointBonusDescription: Your hits deal more fire damage to ignited enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

8.altText: Ward is a shield that protects your health. It has no maximum and decays over time. Ward retention slows that decay.

11.description: Each stack of {Arcane Momentum} lasts longer and also increases your spell damage.
11.pointBonusDescription: While at maximum Arcane Momentum stacks you have increased movement speed.

stats.statName: Ward Per Second Per 10 Max Mana

13.description:
When you cast a spell you gain a stack of {Arcane Momentum} for 2 seconds and refreshing the duration of all existing stacks.

Each stacks of Arcane Momentum increases your cast speed.
13.altText: You can only have one instance of Arcane Momentum.

14.altText: This does not require exact thresholds of 100 mana. For example, gaining 10 maximum mana will always grant 0.3% increased mana regen.

stats.statName: Increased Mana Regen per 100 Max Mana

15.description: You gain ward based on your current mana when you directly use a skill that costs at least 40 mana.
15.altText: Ward is a decaying shield that protects your health

20.altText: Each point of intelligence grants 4% ward retention and improves skills that rely on carefully studied magic, such as Lightning Blast and Mana Strike.

stats.statName: Increased Spell Critical Strike Chance per Intelligence

21.pointBonusDescription: Whenever you take a hit that leaves you below half health, you freeze nearby enemies. This effect has a 10 second cooldown.

22.description: You have an increased chance to critically strike with spells. This effect is doubled for lightning skills.

23.pointBonusDescription: You deal more fire damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers) to enemies inflicted with {Spreading Flames}.

24.description:
Increases your chance to freeze and converts lightning blast and volcanic orb to cold spells, changing their base damage type to cold and giving them a chance to freeze.

Lightning Blast gains a base freeze rate of 46.

Volcanic Orb's core gains a base freeze rate of 40 and its shrapnel gains a freeze rate of 32.

25.altText: Each point of vitality grants 6 health and 1% poison and necrotic resistance.

27.description: You have additional mana and a portion of the damage you take is dealt to your mana before health.

stats.statName: Damage Dealt to Mana Before Health

28.description:
You have a chance to be granted ward whenever you hit an enemy with a fire, cold, or lightning skill.

This effect has a 10 second cooldown, but the cooldown is not shared between different elements, so you can gain ward from a fire hit and a lightning hit within the same 10 second duration.

29.description: You deal more lightning damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to shocked enemies.
29.pointBonusDescription: Static Orb has a chance to inflict a {Spark Charge} on hit.

stats.statName: Spark Charge Chance With Static Orb

30.description:
You have additional spell damage and you have a chance to refund a portion of the mana cost paid when directly using a skill.

These values are doubled if you have 300 maximum mana and tripled if you have 1000 maximum mana.

stats.statName: Chance To Refund 20% Of Mana Cost

32.description: You gain ward when you use an elemental melee attack and hit at least one enemy.
32.pointBonusDescription: You have additional ward decay threshold based on your maximum health.

stats.statName: Ward Decay Threshold Per 10 Max Health

34.description: Your fire melee attacks have a chance to ignite on hit. Your cold melee attacks have a chance to chill on hit. Your lightning melee attacks have a chance to shock on hit.

stats.statName: Ignite Chance For Fire Melee Attacks
Chill Chance For Cold Melee Attacks
Shock Chance For Lightning Melee Attacks

35.description: You have additional melee damage and spell damage.

36.description: Your melee attacks deal additional cold damage and you have a higher chance to freeze enemies.
36.pointBonusDescription: You deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to chilled or frozen enemies.

37.description: You have increased armor and additional health.
37.altText: Arcane Shield's damage reduction is multiplicative with other modifiers.
37.pointBonusDescription: You gain Arcane Shield for 4 seconds when you directly use a melee attack and hit at least one enemy. Arcane Shield is a buff that grants less damage taken (multiplicative with other modifiers) and ward per second, and stacks up to 4 times.

38.description:
While moving or using a melee attack, you have a chance each second to cast {Fire Aura}. 

This chance is doubled if you have less than 3 stacks of {Fire Aura}.
38.altText: Fire Aura is a fire spell that deals damage over time to enemies around you for four seconds.
38.pointBonusDescription: Each of your {Fire Auras} have a chance to shred enemy fire resistance each second.

stats.statName: Fire Res Shred Chance Per Second

39.description:
When you use a melee attack and hit at least one enemy you have a chance to cast {Frost Claw}.

This consumes mana equal to a portion of {Frost Claw's} mana cost.

40.altText: Each point of vitality grants 6 health and 1% poison and necrotic resistance.

41.description: You have additional health and you have a chance to regain mana when you use a melee attack and hit at least one enemy.

42.description: Your {Fire Auras} from all sources deal damage in a larger area.
42.pointBonusDescription:
{Fire Aura} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) based on your uncapped fire resistance.

If {Fire Aura} is converted to cold or lightning, then this benefit is based on your cold or lightning resistance.

stats.statName: Fire Aura Damage Per 1% Uncapped Fire Resistance

43.description: Each stack of {Arcane Shielding} also grants increased armor.
43.pointBonusDescription: You gain multiple stacks of Arcane Shielding when you use {Surge} or {Enchant Weapon}.

stats.statName: Arcane Shielding Stacks Gained From Surge or Enchant Weapon

44.pointBonusDescription:
{Fire Aura} is converted to lightning, unless it has already been converted to cold.

Each stack of {Fire Aura} you gain also grants charges of {Static} if it's on your bar.

stats.statName: Static Charges Granted from Gaining Fire Aura

45.description:
You deal increased fire and lightning damage.

You gain ward when you use a lightning skill or a fire skill. This effect has a 7 second cooldown, but the cooldown is not shared between different elements, so you can gain ward from a fire skill and a lightning skill within the same 7 second duration.
45.altText: Ward is a shield that protects your health. It has no maximum and decays over time.

46.description: You have additional armor and gain ward per second.
46.pointBonusDescription: You gain ward retention equal to a percentage of your increased armor.

47.description: You have additional fire resistance and you have a chance to cast {Fire Aura} when you use a melee attack and hit at least one enemy, up to a limited number of times per second.
47.altText: This limit only applies to gaining {Fire Aura} from {Burning Hands}, not other sources.

stats.statName: Fire Aura Trigger Limit Per Second

48.description: You have increased movement speed, attack speed, and dodge rating.

49.description: You have additional intelligence and endurance.

50.description:
When you use a melee attack that costs less than 10 mana you gain a stack of {Blade Weaving}, up to a maximum.

When you use a melee attack that costs 10 or more mana the stacks are consumed and the attack deals 15% more elemental damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack consumed.
50.altText: The damage bonus also affects the damage dealt by all the ailments the attack applies and the spells it triggers from its trees, excluding equippable spells.

51.description: You gain ward per second scaling with your intelligence.
51.altText: For example, if you have 24 Intelligence you would gain +1.6% added crit chance.

52.description:
You have additional mana.

When you indirectly cast a spell you gain a stack of {Blade Conduit} for 4 seconds, up to 6 stacks. Each stack grants increased mana regeneration.
52.pointBonusDescription: You have no mana regeneration for 1 second after directly casting a non-instant spell.

stats.statName: Blade Conduit Mana Regen Per Stack
No Mana Regen Duration After Direct Cast (seconds)

54.pointBonusDescription: You deal more spell damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) if you have more current ward than the target has remaining health.

55.description: You have additional health and you take less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) from ignited, shocked or chilled enemies.
55.altText: The damage reduction only applies once even if an enemy is afflicted by more than one of these ailments.

stats.statName: Less Damage Taken from Ignited Shocked or Chilled Enemies

56.altText:
Skills cast during the cooldown do not count towards this effect.

Ward is a shield that protects your health. It has no maximum and decays over time.

Skills such as Mana Strike and Focus cost zero mana by default, while others such as Fireball and Lightning Blast can have their costs reduced to zero via skill tree nodes or a weapon with a -Mana Cost of Spells modifier.

If a skill costs mana, but that mana is refunded afterwards it does not count as a zero cost skill.
56.pointBonusDescription:
Whenever you directly use 3 skills in a row that cost 0 mana you gain a burst of mana and ward.

This effect has a 3 second cooldown.

57.pointBonusDescription: These effects are doubled if you have at least 50 intelligence.

58.description: When you hit an enemy with a cold skill you {Chill} additional nearby enemies. This effect has a 5 second cooldown.
58.altText: This effect can chill the initial enemy you hit unless it was killed by that hit.

60.description: You deal increased spell damage and have additional ward retention.
60.altText: The doubled increased spell damage also applies to the skill that triggers it.
60.pointBonusDescription: These effects are doubled if you have recently (in the last 4 seconds) either used a skill that costs 40 mana or started channelling a skill that costs at least 8 mana per second while channelling.

61.altText: Penetration can bring enemies below 0% resistance, causing them to take more damage. It applies to all damage, including damage over time.

62.altText: Penetration can bring enemies below 0% resistance, causing them to take more damage. It applies to all damage, including damage over time.

63.altText: Penetration can bring enemies below 0% resistance, causing them to take more damage. It applies to all damage, including damage over time.

64.description: When you critically strike an enemy from at least 4 meters away, you have a chance to cast {Spark Nova,} a spell that deals lightning damage to nearby enemies.
64.altText: {Spark Nova} critical strikes cannot result in more Spark Novas.

66.description: You have a chance to chill enemies when you are hit, and your skills have a chance to chill enemies on hit. This effect is doubled for cold skills.

stats.statName: Chance To Chill Attackers When Hit
Increased Stun Chance With Elemental Spells

69.description: You have additional Intelligence and you gain additional ward decay threshold scaling with your Intelligence.

70.description: You deal increased cold damage and have a higher freeze rate multiplier.
70.pointBonusDescription: {Fire Aura} is converted to cold. This converts its base damage and gives it a chance to freeze enemies within its area of effect.

stats.statName: Fire Aura Freeze Rate Per Second

71.pointBonusDescription: You have increased critical strike chance per point of Dexterity.

72.description: Your melee attacks deal additional lightning damage and your lightning melee attacks have a chance to apply a {Spark Charge} on hit.

stats.statName: Spark Charge Chance with Lightning Melee Attacks

73.description: Your melee hits have a chance to ignite on hit and the ignites they inflict have increased effect.
73.altText: Increased ignite effect increases the damage of ignite, multiplicatively with other modifiers.

74.description: Your melee attacks deal more elemental damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) if they cost 10 or more mana.
74.pointBonusDescription: When you directly use a melee attack that costs 10 or more mana, all {Fire Aura} stacks are consumed to restore mana per stack.

stats.statName: More Elemental Damage with High Cost Melee Attacks
Mana Gained Per Fire Aura Consumed

75.description: You have additional dexterity and intelligence.
75.pointBonusDescription: You have additional dodge rating based on your intelligence, up to a maximum.

stats.statName: Dodge Rating per 1 Intelligence, up to +100

76.description: Whenever you use a potion, you gain ward based on to your intelligence.

stats.statName: Ward on Potion Use per Intelligence

77.description: You have increased melee attack speed, and you gain ward when you use an elemental melee attack and hit at least one enemy.
77.altText: Ward is a shield that protects your health. It has no maximum and decays over time.

78.description: Augments the ward gain effects of the {Reactive Ward} and {Sun and Storms} nodes, causing them to grant more ward and have shorter cooldowns.
78.altText: Ward is a shield that protects your health. It has no maximum and decays over time.

80.description: Your melee attacks deal additional lightning damage and you have a chance to parry attacks.

stats.statName: Increased Cast Speed with Snap Freeze

82.description: You have additional health and your ward decays more slowly.

stats.statName: Increased Cooldown Recovery Speed for Surge

84.description: You can dual wield melee weapons by equipping a sword in your off hand. While dual wielding, you have increased attack and cast speed, but take more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

stats.statName: Attack And Cast Speed While Dual Wielding

86.altText: Ward is a shield that protects your health. It has no maximum and decays over time.

stats.statName: Ward Gain on Direct Spell Cast

87.description: After using a traversal skill, your next non-channeled spell has additional spell damage and a higher chance to critically strike.
87.pointBonusDescription: The critical strike chance bonus is doubled if the spell cost at least 30 mana.

stats.statName: Crit Chance bonus Doubled for 30+ Mana Cost

89.description: While using a Catalyst you have additional Intelligence and take reduced bonus damage from critical strikes.
89.altText: This effect cannot reduce the damage of a crit below that of a regular hit. It is multiplicative with other damage modifiers, but multiple sources of this stat are additive.

stats.statName: Bonus Damage from Crits with a Catalyst

90.description: The spell damage and crit chance from the {Never Late} node now also apply to {Traversal} skills, and you gain ward when you use a {Traversal} skill.
90.altText: Ward is a shield that protects your health. It has no maximum and decays over time.

stats.statName: Ward Gained on Traversal Skill Use
Bonuses from Never Late apply to Traversal Skills

91.altText: Ward is a shield that protects your health. It has no maximum and decays over time.
91.pointBonusDescription: You passively gain ward over time, and the amount of ward is tripled if you have at least 60 intelligence.

stats.statName: Additional Ward per Second with 60 Intelligence

92.description: You have additional critical strike multiplier while using a wand, additional ward retention while using a sceptre, and increased cast speed while using a staff.

stats.statName: Critical Strike Multiplier with a Wand

93.description: You deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to Bosses and Rare enemies.
93.pointBonusDescription: This effect is doubled if you have an active {Rah Rune} or if you have passed through a {Frost Wall} recently.

stats.statName: More Damage to Bosses and Rares
Doubled effect with Rah Rune or Frost Wall

94.altText: Ward is a shield that protects your health. It has no maximum and decays over time.
94.pointBonusDescription: This effect is doubled if you have an active {Heo Rune} or are standing in your {Glyph of Dominion} during its duration.

stats.statName: Doubled Effect with Heo Rune or Glyph of Dominion

95.description: Your damage over time has additional elemental penetration
95.pointBonusDescription: Lightning skills that cost at least 15 mana apply {Brand of Deception} on hit.

stats.statName: Elemental Penetration with Damage Over Time

96.description:
You gain ward when you critically strike enemies.

This can trigger a maximum of 5 times per second.
96.altText: Ward is a shield that protects your health. It has no maximum and decays over time.
96.pointBonusDescription: You have more Critical Strike Multiplier (multiplicative with other modifiers) against Bosses and Rare enemies based on your current ward, up to 20%.

stats.statName: More Crit Multi per 100 Ward vs Bosses

97.pointBonusDescription: You gain increased cooldown recovery speed scaling with your Intelligence.

98.description: You have additional armor while channeling per active {Rune} from {Runic Invocation}.
98.altText: Ward is a shield that protects your health. It has no maximum and decays over time.
98.pointBonusDescription: After channeling for 2 seconds you gain a burst of ward equal to a portion of your armor.

99.description: You deal more damage over time to {Branded} enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).
99.altText:
Branded enemies are enemies afflicted by Brand of Deception, Brand of Trespass, or Brand of Subjugation.

Your Shock Chance for this scaling does not include more specific Shock Chance stats such "Chance to Shock with Spells".
99.pointBonusDescription: {Brand of Deception} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) based on your Shock Chance.

stats.statName: Brand of Deception Damage per 1% Shock Chance

100.description:
When you directly use a Cold Skill you have a chance to gain {Runeword: Avalanche}, a buff that grants additional Spell Cold Damage and grants additional Endurance Threshold per stack of Ignite on the attacker.

This buff lasts 6 seconds and does not stack.
100.altText: The additional Endurance Threshold applies to attacks from individual enemies based on how many stacks of Ignite are on that enemy. As an example, if an enemy has 10 stacks of Ignite, you have 20 additional Endurance Threshold against that enemy's attacks.

stats.statName: Runeword: Avalanche chance on Cold Skill use
Spell Cold Damage with Runeword: Avalanche
Endurance Threshold per Ignite with Runeword: Avalanche

101.altText: Branded enemies are enemies afflicted by {Brand of Deception, Brand of Trespass, or Brand of Subjugation}.
101.pointBonusDescription: You deal more spell damage to {Branded} bosses and rare enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers), and you gain ward when you hit a {Branded} boss or rare enemy with a spell. The ward gain has a 1 second cooldown.

stats.statName: Ward Gain vs Branded Bosses (1 second cooldown)

102.pointBonusDescription: When you gain a {Runeword Buff}, all allied party members within 16 meters also gain the buff.

104.altText: Enemies below 35% of max health count as on Low Health.
104.pointBonusDescription: When you critically strike an enemy you gain {Runeword: Cataclysm} for 6 seconds, which grants you more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to enemies on low health. This buff does not stack.

stats.statName: Damage vs Low Health with Runeword: Cataclysm

105.description: After using a {Traversal} skill you gain increased cast speed and movement speed for a short duration. This buff cannot stack.

106.description: Your area skills have increased area, and when you directly use an area skill and hit an enemy you gain ward per active {Rune} from {Runic Invocation}.
106.altText: When casting Runic Invocation itself, the ward is gained before the runes are consumed, as long as the invocation is an area invocation.

stats.statName: Ward Per Rune On Area Skill Use And Hit

107.pointBonusDescription: Your armor shred chance is converted to {Frostbite} chance for cold spells.

108.pointBonusDescription: The increased mana regen effect is doubled if you have an active {Gon Rune} or have cast {Runebolt} in the past 6 seconds.

stats.statName: Doubled effect with Gon Rune or Runebolt

109.description: You have additional endurance and maximum mana.
109.pointBonusDescription: You gain a percentage of your maximum mana as endurance threshold.

110.description:
When you directly use a Fire Skill you have a chance to gain {Runeword: Inferno}, a buff that grants additional Spell Fire Damage and grants you more Armor per stack of Shock on the Attacker.

This buff lasts 6 seconds and does not stack.
110.altText: The armor bonus is multiplicative with other modifiers, and applies to attacks from individual enemies based on how many stacks of Shock are on that enemy. As an example, if an enemy has 10 stacks of Shock, you have 30% more Armor against that enemy's attacks.

stats.statName: Runeword: Inferno chance on Fire Skill use
Spell Fire Damage with Runeword: Inferno
Armor per Shock with Runeword: Inferno

111.pointBonusDescription: A portion of your health regeneration now also applies to ward.

stats.statName: Health Regen also Applies to Ward

112.description:
When you directly use a Lightning Skill you have a chance to gain {Runeword: Hurricane}, a buff that grants additional Spell Lightning Damage and Freeze Rate Multiplier.

This buff lasts 6 seconds and does not stack.

stats.statName: Runeword: Hurricane chance on Lightning Skill use
Spell Lightning Damage with Runeword: Hurricane
Freeze Rate Multiplier with Runeword: Hurricane

114.description: You have additional spell damage, but your spells take longer to cast.

masteries.classDescription: An Elder cresting his prime, the Mage wields the power of the arcane to make up for his past wrongs and to give the world a new future.
A master of the arcane who wields unprecedented power to devastate their foes from a distance.
passiveBonuses: +50 mana
Spells deal increased damage equal to their mana cost

masteries.classDescription: A mage who has mixed martial prowess and cunning with their mastery of spells to face enemies in close range.
passiveBonuses: 4 ward gained on melee hit
Mana spent on melee attacks is converted to ward

masteries.classDescription: A savant of the art of runes, able to infuse magic into offensive and protective wards that devastate those who trespass them.
passiveBonuses: 30% increased Elemental Damage
10% increased Cast Speed with Elemental Spells

0.description: Sunders the ground in a line in front of you, dealing damage to enemies along the path.

2.description: When you directly use Upheaval and hit at least one enemy you gain a stack of {Earth Shattering} up to a maximum, causing your next {Fury Leap} or {Earthquake} to consume all stacks to gain additional physical penetration and increased area per stack consumed.
2.altText: This has no effect if Upheaval is used by a totem.

stats.statName: Buff To Next Fury Leap Or Earthquake

3.description:
Upheaval now splits up into 3 fault lines in front of you, but Upheaval costs additional mana. Enemies can only be hit by 1 Fault Line at a time.

Upheaval Totems now have 50% less attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

4.description: Upheaval now travels in 5 fault lines in a star around you.

5.description:
Upheaval's base physical damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Upheaval has a chance to freeze enemies on hit.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to {Frostbite} chance and slow chance from all sources is converted to chill chance.

6.description: When Upheaval hits an enemy it has a chance to release a {Shockwave}, a melee physical subskill. The Shockwave cannot hit enemies already hit by Upheaval and vice versa.
6.altText: Enemies hit by a Shockwave can not create a Shockwave, even if hit by Upheaval.

7.description: Upheaval costs less mana and has a chance to shred enemy armor.

8.description: Improves Upheaval's base critical strike chance and it cannot be dodged.

9.description: Upheaval critical strikes deal more damage.

10.description: Creating an Upheaval Totem consumes all active {Thorn Totems} to grant it more damage per totem consumed (multiplicative with other modifiers). You can now create an additional maximum Upheaval totem and you have an additional charge.

stats.statName: Upheaval Totem Damage Per Totem Consumed

11.description: You can now create an additional maximum Upheaval Totem and you have an additional charge.

12.description: Upheaval deals additional melee cold damage, and also deals more melee damage to frozen enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

13.description: Upheaval has additional freeze rate and has additional chance to inflict Frostbite on hit.

14.description: You cast {Shatter} on enemies you kill with Upheaval, a spell subskill dealing cold damage in an area.

15.description: Upheaval now creates additional fault lines and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but costs more mana.

16.description:
Upheaval hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed and have a chance to slow them.

This effect is doubled while using a two handed weapon.

17.description: Upheaval deals damage in a wider area.
17.altText: This does not cause Upheaval to travel further.

18.description: When you use Upheaval and hit at least one enemy you gain a stack of {Earth Armor} for 6 seconds up to a maximum amount of stacks, granting you additional armor and endurance threshold per stack of Attunement.
18.altText: This has no effect if Upheaval is used by a totem.

stats.statName: Endurance Threshold Per Attunement Per Stack

19.description: While you have {Earth Armor}, if you fall below 6 stacks of {Maelstrom} you consume all stacks of Earth Armor to cast Maelstrom once per stack consumed.

stats.statName: Consume Earth Armor Falling Below 6 Maelstroms

20.description: Upheaval travels further.

21.description:
Upheaval deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has an increased chance to stun enemies, but no longer scales with modifiers to attack speed.

These effects are doubled when Upheaval is directly used.

22.description:
Upheaval penetrates enemy physical and cold resistance.

This effect is doubled while using a two handed weapon.

23.description: Upheaval has increased area while using a mace, additional bleed chance while using an axe and additional cold penetration while using a staff.

24.description: Upheaval deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a higher chance to stun enemies.

25.description: Upheaval deals more melee damage to enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers) based on how close they are to you, up to a maximum.
25.altText:
This is fully effective within 2 meters and has no effect after 6 meters. 
This is based on your distance to the enemy, even with {Upheaval Totems}.

26.description: Upheaval hits have a chance to apply {Frailty} to enemies and it penetrates enemy physical resistance, but travels a shorter distance.
26.altText: The physical penetration is affected by conversions to Upheaval's base damage.

27.description: When Upheaval hits your totems it has a chance to release a {Shockwave} from the totem.
27.altText: Totems hit by a Shockwave can create a Shockwave when hit by Upheaval.

28.description: Upheaval hits grant your totems increased armor and more damage (each stack multiplicative with each other and other modifiers) for 4 seconds. This effect can stack up to 4 times.

29.description: Upheaval and {Shockwave} hits from the {Sundering Strikes} node now {Shatter} totems, releasing shards of rock and debris dealing spell physical damage and heals you per point of Attunement.
29.altText: Upheaval Totems cannot be shattered this way.

30.description:
You now create an {Upheaval Totem} that attacks with Upheaval from it rather than yourself. You are limited to 1 of these totems. Upheaval now has a cooldown and costs significantly more mana.

Upheaval Totems last 8 seconds.

32.description: Upheaval Totems last longer, and they deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

2.description: Drain Life deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

3.description: When a target is killed by Drain Life you cast Soul Blast at their location, dealing spell necrotic damage to enemies in an area around them.

4.description: {Soul Blast} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

6.description: Drain Life can now target your minions. You gain 10 mana per second for each minion you are draining.

7.description: Drain Life can now only target minions. Drain Life leeches a higher percentage of damage as health.

8.description: Drain Life deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but the health leech from its base effect and nodes on this tree is removed.

9.description: Drain Life has a chance to summon a {Soul Wisp} when it kills an enemy, a minion that deals necrotic damage to enemies.

10.description:
Drain Life's base necrotic damage is converted to poison damage. Consequently this damage scales with increases to poison damage, but not increases to necrotic damage.

Swaps Drain Life's {Necrotic} tag for a {Poison} tag.
10.altText: This also converts the explosion from the {Soul Blast} node to poison.

11.description: Drain Life no longer costs mana. Instead, it drains a portion of your current health per second while channelling. Nodes that modify mana drain now modify this health drain instead.
11.altText:
Does not affect the up-front mana cost added by the {Dark Shackles} node.

Does not cause your mana to regenerate while channelling.

12.description: You are granted ward when Drain Life kills an enemy.

13.description: Drain Life has a chance to slow and fear its targets each second.

14.description: Drain Life can drain an additional target.

15.description:
You gain a stack of {Contempt} when you have channelled on the same enemy for 2 seconds.

Contempt grants more armor (multiplicative with other modifiers) and adds to all resistances. All stacks of Contempt are lost when you stop channelling.
15.altText: You can only gain 1 stack of Contempt from each enemy.

16.description: {Contempt} stacks last for a duration after you stop channelling Drain Life.

17.description: When Drain Life has channelled on the same target for 2 seconds, it stuns them for 2 seconds.

18.description: The stun inflicted by {Stagger} lasts longer and Drain Life deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) against bosses and rare enemies.

19.description: Drain Life costs less mana per second.

20.description: Drain Life applies stacks of {Damned} each second. {Damned} is an ailment that deals necrotic damage over time.

21.description: {Damned} inflicted by Drain Life lasts longer.

22.description: If {Wandering Spirits} is active when you start channeling Drain Life it does not expire until you stop channeling.
22.altText: Individual spirits still expire as normal, but new ones keep being revealed.

stats.statName: Wandering Spirits does not expire while channeling

23.description: Drain Life leeches a higher percentage of damage as health and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to targets that are on low health.
23.altText: Low health is defined as below 35% of maximum health.

24.description: Drain Life leeches a higher percentage of damage as health, but costs more mana per second.

25.description: Drain Life is now cast instead of channelled. Lasts for 3 seconds. Adds an up-front mana cost, and this cost is affected by modifiers to mana drain, except for the {Blood Pact} node.

26.description: {Dark Shackles} lasts longer, but Drain Life costs more mana.

27.description: {Dark Shackles} can hit up to 10 additional targets, and slows enemies hit each second, but Drain Life costs significantly more mana.

28.description: When a target is killed by Drain Life, you chill enemies in an area around them for a duration.

30.description: Drain Life deals 3% more damage per stack of {Damned} on enemies affected by {Damned}, up to a cap (multiplicative with other modifiers).

32.description:
You gain ward over time while channelling based on your maximum mana.

Drain Life can affect enemies in a wider area. This does not affect the maximum number of enemies you can drain from at a time.

33.description: Increased Area stats from this tree and other sources has no effect on Drain Life's area of effect, but instead grants you additional Ward Retention while channelling Drain Life.

stats.statName: Increased Area Stats no longer affect Area

0.description: Unleash a mighty roar that stuns and knocks back nearby enemies.

2.description: Warcry affects a larger area.

3.description: You and allies affected by Warcry gain increased crit chance for 4 seconds.

4.description:
While Warcry is on cooldown, your critical strikes have a chance to use Warcry for you. 

This effect can only happen once per direct Warcry use, and it will reset the cooldown.

5.description:
Warcry now freezes enemies instead of stunning them, but it no longer knocks enemies back.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to {Frostbite} chance and effects related to bleed now depend on Frostbite instead.
5.altText: Physical damage from {Kinetic Scream} is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to physical damage.

6.description: You and allies affected by Warcry deal increased cold damage for 4 seconds.

7.description: You and your cold minions affected by Warcry gain increased crit chance and additional chill chance for 4 seconds.
7.altText: As an example if you take the {Tundra Stalkers} on your {Summon Wolf's} tree, it would gain the cold tag and be considered a cold minion.

8.description: Warcry inflicts stacks of {Frostbite} to affected enemies.

9.description: Enemies frozen by Warcry take increased damage from hits.

10.description: Warcry applies one stack of {Frailty} to affected enemies for a short duration.

11.description: For 4 seconds after using Warcry, your {Wolves} have a chance to cause enemies to bleed and your {Scorpion} has a chance to poison enemies.

12.description: You are invulnerable for 1 second after using Warcry.

13.description:
Warcry now also restores your health. 

The amount of healing is increased by healing effectiveness and is doubled if used while on low health.

14.description:
You now cast {Maelstrom} when you use Warcry. 

Maelstrom cast this way costs less mana.

15.description: Warcry now cleanses negative ailments on you.

16.description:
Warcry now also restores ally health for the same amount as from {Breath of Eterra}. 

The amount of healing is increased by healing effectiveness and is doubled if used while on low health.

17.description: If Warcry hits at least one enemy, you gain {Haste} for 1 second.

18.description: Warcry costs less mana and {Haste} gained from {Hastily Advance} lasts longer.

19.description: You gain {Frenzy} for the same duration as you have Haste from {Hastily Advance}.

20.description: Warcry now fears enemies for 2 seconds instead of stunning them.
20.altText:
Fear causes enemies to flee from you and your allies. Enemies can only be affected by Fear once.

This has no effect if you have {Jormun's Wrath}.

21.description: Fear inflicted by Warcry lasts longer and each stack of the {Berserk} buff from the Berserker node now also causes you to deal more damage to Feared enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

stats.statName: Damage to Feared per Berserk Stack

22.description:
You gain the {Berserk} buff for 1.5 seconds when you use Warcry, granting you additional melee damage.

While you have Berserk, you gain additional stacks of Berserk on melee hit up to a maximum, and melee hits refresh all stacks.
22.altText: With {Totemic Heart} you gain Berserk when you place the totem.

stats.statName: Berserk Stacks On Hit While Berserk

24.description: {Berserk} has increased duration and additional maximum stacks.
24.altText: While you have Berserk, you gain additional stacks of Berserk on melee hit up to a maximum, and melee hits refresh all stacks.

25.description: {Berserk} now also affects your Raptor and Bear.
25.altText: While you have Berserk, you gain additional stacks of Berserk on melee hit up to a maximum, and melee hits refresh all stacks.

26.description: {Berserk} now also grants you increased attack speed per stack of Berserk up to a maximum.
26.altText: While you have Berserk, you gain additional stacks of Berserk on melee hit up to a maximum, and melee hits refresh all stacks.

27.description: Warcry knocks enemies further back.

28.description: Warcry now pulls enemies instead of knocking them back.
28.altText: Modifiers to knockback distance now affect pull distance.

29.description: Warcry now also taunts affected enemies for a short duration.
29.altText: This effect does not work if Warcry is used by a totem.

30.description: Warcry now hits enemies and deals spell physical damage.
30.altText: Added spell damage now applies to Warcry at 200% effectiveness.

31.description: Warcry causes enemies to bleed.

32.description: Warcry now has a cooldown of 5 seconds which cannot be reduced by stunning or freezing enemies, but Warcry no longer has a guaranteed stun, freeze, or fear.
32.altText: This cooldown can be affected by other sources of cooldown reduction.

33.description: You now place down a totem for 3 seconds that repeatedly uses Warcry instead of you, but Warcry costs more mana.
33.altText:
Warcry cannot taunt if used by a totem.

When used by a totem Warcry benefits from your minion and totem stats rather than your own stats.

2.description: Runic Invocation deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per {Rune} consumed.

3.description:
When you directly cast Runic Invocation you leap backwards a short distance, hovering in the air for a moment. In this state you take less damage and directly casting Runic Invocation deals more damage (both multiplicative with other modifiers). 

The effect of {Enigma} no longer works when taking this node.

Runic Invocation gains the {Movement} tag.

4.description:
When you directly cast Runic Invocation now leap forwards instead of backwards. 

The effect of {Enigma} no longer works when taking this node.

Runic Invocation gains the {Movement} tag.

5.description:
During the leap you also cast the Invocation corresponding to your first two {Runes}, consuming its mana cost.

Your Invocation must have at least two runes for this effect to occur.

6.description:
During the leap you also cast the Invocation corresponding to your first {Rune}, consuming its mana cost.

Your Invocation must have at least one rune for this effect to occur.

7.description: Runic Invocation grants ward per {Rune} consumed and on direct casts you refund a portion of its mana cost.

8.description: Runic Invocation has increased cast speed and when directly casting an {Invocation} you gain ward equal to a portion of your current mana.

9.description: When you directly cast Runic Invocation, the next non-channelled elemental spell you cast penetrates enemy elemental resistance and deals damage in a larger area.

10.description: When you consume {Runes} with a skill other than Runic Invocation you have a chance to also cast the corresponding {Invocation} for those runes.

stats.statName: Invocations Chance On Other Skill Use

11.description: {Invocations} that deal damage in an area now deal damage in a larger area.

12.description: {Invocations} that include at least one {Rah Rune} have a chance to ignite enemies and deal additional spell fire damage.

stats.statName: Spell Fire Damage With Rah Rune

13.description:
Runes now provide you with passive effects while you have them.

{Rah Rune}: Grants increased mana regeneration per {Rune} of this type.
{Gon Rune}: Grants ward per second per {Rune} of this type.
{Heo Rune}: Grants a higher chance to freeze enemies per {Rune} of this type.

stats.statName: Increased Mana Regen per Rah Rune
Ward Gain Per Second per Gon Rune
Freeze Rate Multiplier per Heo Rune

14.description: Every second you go without casting a Runic Invocation you gain a stack of {Runic Energy} up to a maximum. {Invocations} consume all {Runic Energy} to deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per {Runic Energy}.

stats.statName: Damage Per Stack Of Runic Energy

15.description:
When you directly cast Runic Invocation with at least 12 {Runic Energy} you also proc a random equipped non-channeling skill of the same element as each of the {Runes} consumed.

This effect consumes these skills' mana costs and puts them on cooldown (excluding movement skills and skills that are currently on cooldown).

These skills are cast at 0.24 second intervals after the {Invocation}.

stats.statName: Cast Random Equipped Skill With 12 Energy

16.description: Runic Invocation now has a chance to be repeated per stack of {Runic Energy}.

17.description: While you have 3 runes and your combination of runes changes without casting an invocation, you gain {Runic Energy}.

stats.statName: Gain Runic Energy While At 3 Runes

18.description: Your maximum {Runic Energy} is tripled, but bonuses per {Runic Energy} are halved. When you cast a skill you gain {Runic Energy} per mana spent.

19.description: Each unique {Invocation} you directly cast causes {Runic Energy} to accumulate faster until you repeat an {Invocation}.

stats.statName: Accumulation Speed Resets On Repeat Invocation

20.description: {Invocations} that include at least one {Heo Rune} have a chance to chill enemies and have a higher chance to freeze them.

stats.statName: Freeze Rate Multiplier With Heo Rune

21.description: Directly casting Runic Invocation now refunds its mana cost and it deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but it now has a cooldown when cast this way.
21.altText: You cannot refund more than 100% of Runic Invocation's mana cost.

22.description:
Whenever you gain a {Rune}, instead of it depending on the type of skill cast, it always results in your sequence of {Runes} mirroring the first three skills on your action bar from left to right.

This effect ignores skills that don't have an elemental tag.
22.altText:
If a skill has multiple elements, the {Rune} it provides is chosen based on the least common elements among all 3 skills. 

For example casting {Disintegrate, Lightning Blast, Static Orb} in a sequence gives {Rah, Gon and Gon Runes}.

This effect ignores Runic Invocation itself when looking at the abilities on your bar.

stats.statName: Rune Gain Depend On Skills On Action Bar

23.description: Runic Invocation has a shorter cooldown.

24.description: While you have 3 {Runes} and your combination of {Runes} changes without casting an {Invocation}, Runic Invocation's remaining cooldown is reduced.

stats.statName: Cooldown Reduction When Rune Combination Changes

25.description:
Whenever you directly cast an {Invocation} you blink to the target location first, but Runic Invocation now has a cooldown. 

{Invocations} cast this way automatically targets a random nearby enemy.

Runic Invocation gains the {Traversal} tag.
25.altText: All the effects of this node do not affect Runic Invocation if you have taken the {Stride to Safety} node.

26.description:
After casting Runic Invocation you gain additional spell damage and cast speed for a short duration. 

The buff duration scales with amount of {Runes} consumed.

27.description: {Invocations} that include at least one {Gon Rune} have a chance to shock enemies and have a higher chance to critically hit enemies.

stats.statName: Critical Strike Chance With Gon Rune

28.description: Runic Invocation deals more damage per type of {Rune} consumed.

29.description: When you cast an {Invocation} using a sequence of three different {Runes} you gain ward per point of intelligence.

stats.statName: Ward Gain Per Intelligence With Different Runes

30.description:
Whenever you cast Runic Invocation, you also cast up to one of each type of {Elemental Nova} that you can cast directly. Each unique {Rune} you have when casting Runic Invocation represents different {Elemental Nova}. 

These {Novas} are cast with a 0.3 second interval.

This effect consumes mana equal to {Elemental Nova's} mana cost.
30.altText:
{Rah Rune}: Fire Nova
{Gon Rune}: Lightning Nova
{Heo Rune}: Ice Nova

If you don't have any of the three Elemental Nova types unlocked, then you'll cast one Elemental Nova if you have at least one rune.

stats.statName: Cast Elemental Novas From Runes In Invocation

32.description:
You gain {Runes} faster while channelling.

You gain a burst of ward based on your maximum mana when your number of runes increases from channelling.

34.description: Runic Invocation penetrates elemental resistances per point of Intelligence.

1.description: Runebolt has increased cast speed and it has a chance to grant you the {Haste} buff for a short duration.

After several seconds {Runestone} consumes mana to explode.
