Maul and Rampage's base physical damage is converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Armor Shred and bleed chance from all sources is converted to shock and effects related to armor shred or bleed now depend on shock instead for Maul and Rampage.

stats.statName: Armor Shred And Bleed -> Shock Chance

27.description: Maul deals more melee damage to stunned enemies and you regain {Rage} when you hit a stunned enemy with Maul.

stats.statName: Rage Gained With Maul To Stunned

29.description: Your {Rage} decays slower while in Werebear Form.

31.description:
Your {Fury Leap} tree now applies to Maul. 

This consumes Fury Leap's mana cost as Rage.
31.altText: You still use Maul's travel distance.

stats.statName: Consumes Fury Leap's Mana Cost As Rage

32.description:
After using Maul, you now use {Upheaval} towards your target.

This consumes Upheaval's mana cost.
32.altText: If you have the {Skull Crusher} node that makes {Fury Leap}'s tree apply to Maul and you have the {Violent Upheaval} node that tree causes it to cast {Upheaval} then instead of Upheaval being cast twice, it is cast once but that cast deals 30% more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

33.description:
After directly using Roar, Human Form is now replaced with {Swarm Call}, which summons a {Locust} for each nearby stunned enemy up to 6 and transforms you to {Swarmblade Form}.

This requires you to have Swarmblade Form unlocked.

34.description:
After using Maul, you now cast {Entangling Roots}.

This consumes Entangling Roots' mana cost as Rage.

2.description: Cinder Strike has a chance to ignite enemies and ignites inflicted by the first attack have increased duration.

4.description: Cinder Strike has a chance to blind enemies while using a bow and a chance to apply {Frailty} to enemies while using a melee weapon.

5.description: Cinder Strike's first attack deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

6.description: Cinder Strike now only has the first attack and it deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but costs significantly more mana.

7.description: Cinder Strike's second and third attacks have increased attack speed.

8.description: Blind chance from all sources is converted to {Critical Vulnerability} chance for Cinder Strike.

9.description: Cinder Strike deals more critical strike damage. This bonus is doubled for the first attack.

10.description: Cinder Strike costs less mana.

11.description: When you use Cinder Strike and hit with its first attack it has a chance to throw a {Volatile Flask} at a nearby target.
11.altText: {Volatile Flask} scales with increases to fire and throwing damage.

12.description: {Volatile Flask} deals more explosion damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

13.description: Cinder Strike has a chance to cause an explosion on kill. This counts as a {Volatile Flask} explosion.

14.description: Cinder Strike hits deals additional fire damage for each ignited enemy you have hit recently up to a maximum.

15.description: Cinder Strike's first attack has more critical strike chance (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of ignite on the target up to a maximum.

16.description: Cinder Strike deals increased fire damage over time per point of Dexterity.

stats.statName: Fire Damage Over Time per Dex

17.description: Poison chance from all sources is converted to ignite chance for Cinder Strike.

18.description: If you use and hit at least one enemy with Cinder Strike you are granted {Oil Coating} granting you increased fire damage. This effect can stack and lasts 4 seconds.

19.description:
If you have at least 3 stacks of {Oil Coating} you are granted additional fire penetration.

This effect is doubled for ignites inflicted by Cinder Strike.

20.description: {Oil Coating} is limited to 5 stacks. If you would gain another stack you instead regain health and mana.

21.description: You have additional chance to dodge and additional fire resistance per stack of {Oil Coating}.

22.description: {Oil Coating} now grants you increased elemental damage rather than just fire damage.

23.description: {Oil Coating} now also grants additional throwing fire damage.

24.description: Cinder Strike has a chance to shred enemy fire resistance.

25.description: If you use and hit at least one enemy with Cinder Strike it consumes 8 mana granting you a {Burning Dagger} that circles you for a second before launching at the nearest enemy.
25.altText: {Burning Dagger} deals fire throwing damage and ignites the enemy.

26.description: {Burning Daggers} from all sources deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), and Burning Daggers from {Molten Arsenal} consume less mana.

27.description: You now also throw 5 {Burning Daggers} in a cone in front of you on Cinder Strike's first attack.

stats.statName: Burning Daggers Cone On First Attack

28.description: All your {Shadows} now also throw 5 {Burning Daggers} in a cone in front of them when you do. This consumes all active {Shadows}.

29.description: Cinder Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers and its hits deal additional fire damage.

2.description: You now have a chance to gain a stack of {Gladiator of Lagon} when you cast a {Tempest}.
2.altText: This effect can still only trigger a maximum of 3 times per second.

3.description:
{Frigid Tempest} has a higher chance to freeze enemies.
{Thunder Tempest} has a chance to shock enemies.
{Wind Tempest} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

4.description: You have a chance to also cast {Thunder Tempest} when you attack with cold or physical Tempest Strike.

5.description: You have a chance to also cast {Wind Tempest} when you attack with lightning or cold Tempest Strike.

6.description: If Tempest Strike's melee attack does not hit an enemy you consume a stack of {Gladiator of Lagon} to cast a {Tempest} of the respective type.

7.description: {Gladiator of Lagon} has double the effect on your totems and {Storm Crows} if you have at least 50 Intelligence.

8.description: Tempest Strike penetrates enemy physical resistance per active physical minion, penetrates cold resistance per cold minion and penetrates lightning resistance per lightning minion.
8.altText: For example Wolves are a physical minion by default but can be specialized into being either a cold or lightning minion.

9.description: Whenever you cast a {Tempest} you also regain a portion of your Endurance Threshold as health.

10.description:
While transformed and you use any melee attack and hit at least one enemy you have a chance to cast each {Tempest} of a matching damage type.

This consumes mana equal to a portion of Tempest Strike's mana cost.
10.altText: For example if you use {Swipe} while transformed as a {Werebear}, you have a chance to cast a {Wind Tempest} on hit.

11.description: Tempest Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per 1 mana cost, but it also costs additional mana.

12.description: You now create a {Tempest Totem} that casts a {Tempest} of the corresponding strike that created the totem. You are limited to 1 of each type of totem.
12.altText:
Disabling a type of {Tempest} causes the respective totem to cast cold projectiles instead.

Attack speed modifiers from this tree affect the summoning speed, but not the totem's cast speed.

Effects that occur "when you cast a Tempest" also occur when a Tempest Totem casts a Tempest.

13.description: Your {Tempest Totems} gain a random amount of more cast speed (multiplicative with other modifiers) when summoned.

14.description:
You now expend {Storm Stacks} when you use Tempest Strike and hit at least one enemy with the melee attack.

{Storm Bolts} cast this way deal more damage.

15.description: Tempest Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

16.description: Tempest Strike deals additional melee damage per equipped axe or mace and additional spell damage while wielding a 2 handed weapon.

stats.statName: Melee Damage With Axe Or Mace

17.description:
Tempest Strike deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

These effects are doubled while wielding a 2 handed weapon.

18.description:
Tempest Strike can no longer cast {Wind Tempest}, but it does not remove the physical strike from the combo.

Additioanlly, Tempest Strike has increased attack speed and costs less mana.

19.description:
Tempest Strike deals additional melee damage per 2 Attunement.

All the melee strikes have a higher chance to freeze enemies.

20.description:
Tempest Strike can no longer cast {Thunder Tempest}, but it does not remove the lightning strike from the combo.

Additioanlly, Tempest Strike has increased attack speed and costs less mana.

21.description:
The melee hits grant you a stack of {Gladiator of Lagon} for 8 seconds which grants you and your minions additional spell damage.

This effect can trigger a maximum of 3 times per second.

23.description: You recover mana if whenever you use Tempest Strike and it hits an enemy and it doesn't cast a {Tempest}.

stats.statName: Mana Gain On Hit With No Tempest

24.description:
Tempest Strike can no longer cast {Frigid Tempest}, but it does not remove the cold strike from the combo.

Additioanlly, Tempest Strike has increased attack speed and costs less mana.

25.description: Tempest Strike has increased attack speed and costs less mana.

26.description: Tempest Strike penetrates enemy resistances per your uncapped resistances corresponding to a specific type.

stats.statName: Physical Pen Per 5% Uncapped Physical Res
Cold Pen Per 5% Uncapped Cold Res
Lighting Pen Per 5% Uncapped Lighting Res

27.description:
Whenever you cast {Wind Tempest} you and your other allies it touches gain {Haste} for a short duration.

Additionally, Tempest Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) while you have Haste.

28.description:
Whenever you cast {Wind Tempest} you have a chance to also cast {Tornado}.

This consumes mana equal to a portion of Tornado's mana cost.
28.altText: This Tornado is always cast by you, even if the effect was triggered by a Tempest Totem.

29.description: {Tornados} cast from {Wind Tempest} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

30.description: You have a chance to also cast {Frigid Tempest} when you attack with lightning or physical Tempest Strike.

32.description:
{Frigid Tempest} chills on enemies it hits.

Additionally, Tempest Strike has a higher chance to freeze enemies.

33.description: While channeling {Avalanche} you now also cast {Frigid Tempest} every second.

stats.statName: Frigid Tempest Each Second During Avalanche

34.description:
{Thunder Tempest} shocks enemies it hits.

Additionally, Tempest Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to shocked enemies.

35.description: Whenever you cast {Thunder Tempest} you also cast it around your nearest {Storm Totem}.

0.loreText: Time is your anvil and you may bend reality upon it

2.description: Volatile Reversal has a shorter cooldown.

3.description: Volatile Reversal's forwards jump has a significantly shorter maximum distance, but its cooldown is reduced.
3.altText: This means that the maximum jump distance is reduced to 6 meters, from 20 meters.

4.description: Volatile Reversal has additional critical strike chance.

5.description: When you critically strike at least one enemy with Volatile Reversal you regain mana.
5.altText: This effect can occur once per use for the attack, and separately once per use for Void Bolts.

6.description: You gain the {Haste} buff for a short duration, when you jump backwards in time.

7.description: While you are able to jump backwards in time, a percentage of your armor mitigation also applies to damage over time.

stats.statName: Armor Mitigation Applied to Damage Over Time

8.description: You gain the {Frenzy} buff, while you are able to jump backwards in time.

stats.statName: Frenzy While Able To Jump Back

9.description: You can use Volatile Reversal's second combo ability for a longer period of time and it deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

10.description:
When you jump forwards in time, your existing {Devouring Orbs} become older.

This causes them to expire sooner.

11.description: When you jump backwards in time, {Devouring Orb} recovers some of its cooldown scaling with the amount of {Devouring Orbs} that expired after jumping forwards in time.

12.description: When you jump forwards in time, all your {Devouring Orbs} are pulled towards you and trigger a {Void Rift}, but Volatile Reversal costs additional mana.

13.description:
When you jump backwards in time, your existing {Devouring Orbs} become younger.

This causes them to expire later, and each orb can only benefit from this once.

14.description: Volatile Reversal's second combo ability is removed, but the melee attack deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and Volatile Reversal deals damage in a larger area.

15.description: Volatile Reversal deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

16.description: Volatile Reversal's second combo ability now jumps you forward in time to your target location, instead of backwards.

17.description: Volatile Reversal deals damage in a larger area.

18.description:
Volatile Reversal's base void damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to void damage.

Time Rot chance from this tree is converted to ignite chance.

Swaps Volatile Reversal's {Void} tag for a {Fire} tag.

19.description: When you jump forwards in time, your arrival location is slightly randomized, but the melee attack deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and Volatile Reversal deals damage in a larger area.

20.description: Volatile Reversal's hits have a chance to slow enemies and it deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of slow on the enemy.

21.description: When you travel at least 4 meters by jumping through time, your next direct melee attack or spell is guaranteed to {Echo}, if it is able to.

stats.statName: Guaranteed Echoed Skill With Far Jump

22.description: When you jump backwards in time, Volatile Reversal deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per meter travelled, up to a maximum.
22.altText:
This counts the distance you travelled when going forwards and backwards.

Volatile Reversal has a maximum jump distance of 20 meters.

23.description: Volatile Reversal's melee hits have a chance to grant you a {Void Essence}.

24.description: When you directly use Volatile Reversal you now also cast a {Void Bolt} at up to 3 enemies near your starting location, but Volatile Reversal costs additional mana.

25.description: Volatile Reversal's {Void Bolts} have a chance to inflict time rot.

26.description: Enemies hit by Volatile Reversal's {Void Bolts} take increased damage over time for several seconds. This effect does not stack.

27.description:
Your {Void Bolts} return to you.

All returning Void Bolts can hit the same targets again. (This means a single cast of the Void Bolt spell can hit a single enemy up to 4 times)

stats.statName: Returning Void Bolts Can Hit Again

28.description: When you directly use Volatile Reversal you now also cast a {Void Bolt} at up to 3 enemies near your arrival location, but Volatile Reversal costs additional mana.

29.description:
The {Void Bolts} from the {Terminal Void Bolt} node are now replaced with a single cast of {Abyssal Echoes}.

This consumes mana equal to a portion of {Abyssal Echoes'} mana cost.

stats.statName: Abyssal Echoes Instead Of Void Bolts

0.altText: Each point of Dexterity adds 4 dodge rating and improves skills that rely on the skillfull handling of weapons, such as Flurry and Shurikens.

2.description: You have increased dodge rating, and you gain health when hitting an enemy.
2.pointBonusDescription:
Gain a stack of {Flow} whenever you directly use a unique skill. Directly using a fourth unique skill consumes all stacks causing the skill to deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). Flow can only be consumed by non-channeled melee or throwing skills. Stacks fall off after 4 seconds.

When using a combo ability, each ability in the combo counts as a unique skill for {Flow}.

3.description: You have increased bow attack speed and when you use a bow attack and hit at least one enemy you regain health.

4.description: You have a chance to parry hits, and increased mana regeneration.
4.pointBonusDescription: Your hits have a chance to inflict Frailty.

6.description: Your melee, throwing, and bow attacks have increased attack speed and deal additional physical damage.

7.description: You take less damage while moving (multiplicative with other modifiers) and have increased dodge rating.

8.description: You have a chance to gain {Haste} for one second on hit and deal increased damage based on your increased movement speed.

stats.statName: Increased Damage per 1% Increased Movement Speed

9.description: You have additional dodge rating and a chance to receieve a {Glancing Blow} when hit.
9.altText: Glancing Blows deal 35% less damage.

10.description: You can dual wield melee weapons by equipping a sword or dagger in your off hand. While dual wielding, you have increased attack and cast speed, but take more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

stats.statName: Attack And Cast Speed While Dual Wielding
Increased Dodge Rating while Dual Wielding

12.description: Every third melee, throwing, or bow attack deals increased damage.

13.description: You have a chance to poison on hit while you have a dagger or bow equipped.

14.description: When you directly use a skill that costs zero mana and hit an enemy you regain health and mana.

15.description: You have increased critical strike chance per sword, bow, or dagger you have equipped.

stats.statName: Increased Critical Strike Chance per Sword
Increased Critical Strike Chance per Dagger
Increased Critical Strike Chance with a Bow

16.description: Every third non-channelling melee, throwing, or bow attack also inflicts bleed.

17.description: When you directly use a melee or bow attack that costs mana, it consumes additional mana to deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

18.description: You have additional health and whenever you receive a glancing blow you recover health.

21.description: You have additional Dexterity and when you hit a boss or rare enemy you reduce its dodge rating for 8 seconds.
21.pointBonusDescription: You gain {Haste} for 1 second after you use {Evade}.

22.description: By default you have {Concentration} which grants you more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). If you are hit by an enemy within 4m you lose concentration for 4 seconds. Subsequent hits do not reset the cooldown.

23.description: You have increased bow and throwing attack damage and you have a chance to shred armour on hit.

24.description: If you have a bow equipped you gain 1 {Elemental Arrow} per second, up to a maximum of 3. Using a bow attack expends an Elemental Arrow to deal additional bow fire damage and bow lightning damage.

25.description: You have a chance to inflict Critical Vulnerability on hit.

26.description: You take less damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers). While wielding a bow you deal increased damage over time.

stats.statName: Damage Over Time while wielding a Bow

27.description: If you have a bow equipped you deal increased elemental damage and gain {Elemental Arrows} more frequently.

29.description: You can hold additional {Elemental Arrows} and you gain ward per {Elemental Arrow} when you use them.

30.description: You have a chance to avoid critical strikes and your critical strikes with bow attacks deal more damage.

stats.statName: Less Hit Damage Taken With Concentration

32.description: You can consume [1] additional {Elemental Arrow} with each bow attack. If you consume 3 arrows with a single attack it has 200% additional shock and ignite chance

stats.statName: Elemental Arrow consumed per bow attack
Shock and Ignite chance when consuming 3 Arrows

33.description: When you use a bow attack you gain {Arrow Storm} which increases your bow attack speed for 3 seconds. You can only gain Arrow Storm once every 10 seconds.

stats.statName: Increased Bow Attack Speed with Arrow Storm

35.description: Non-elemental bow attacks cannot consume {Elemental Arrows}, but instead generate an Elemental Arrow on use. Consuming an Elemental Arrow also increases the elemental damage of the attack that consumes them.

stats.statName: Increased Elemental Damage with Elemental Arrow
Non-Elemental Bow Attacks Generate Elemental Arrows
Only Elemental Bow Attacks Consume Elemental Arrows

36.description: When you proc {Arrowstorm} you gain stacks of {Silver Shroud}. Silver Shroud is a buff that gives you 100% chance to dodge the next hit. Dodging a hit with Silver Shroud consumes all stacks, granting you 100 ward per stack.
36.altText: Ward is an overshield shield that protects your health. It has no maximum and decays over time.

stats.statName: Increased damage taken from nearby enemies

38.description: You have additional poison penetration and bow attacks have additional chance to poison on hit.

39.description: Chance to gain a stack of Sharpshooter when you hit an enemy based on your how far you are from that enemy, up to a maximum at 10m. Each stack of Sharpshooter increases bow damage and lasts 8 seconds.

40.description: You have increased mana and mana regen and your bow attacks deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) equal to a portion of their mana cost.

41.description: Adds {Barrage of Pain} to your Marksman Passive, Bow Mastery. You gain a stack and refresh all existing stacks of Bow Mastery by using a bow attack and hitting at least one enemy.
41.altText: Bow Mastery still increases bow attack speed

42.description: Adds a chance to cause a {Rain of Arrows} to descend upon your target when you proc {Arrow Storm}. Rain of Arrows is a physical bow attack that hits all enemies in an area around the target.
42.altText: Rain of Arrows is unrelated to the active skill Hail of Arrows and is not affected by its tree.

43.description: When you directly use a skill that costs zero mana and hit an enemy you regain mana, but bow attacks cost more mana.

44.description: Each stack of Sharpshooter also increases stun chance and adds a chance to shred armour on hit

stats.statName: Increased Stun Chance per stack of Sharpshooter
Armour Shred Chance per stack of Sharpshooter

46.description: Each stack of Bow Mastery with {Barrage of Pain} also grants additional critical strike multiplier and health gained on crit.

48.pointBonusDescription: Your {Falcon} and {Ballistas} have additional base crit chance.

50.description: You have additional dexterity and you have a chance to receive a {Glancing Blow} when hit.

52.description: You deal additional physical damage with melee and throwing attacks, and you have additional dodge rating, doubled if you have been hit recently.
52.pointBonusDescription: Shadow Daggers deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to rare enemies and bosses.

stats.statName: Dodge Rating, Doubled if Hit Recently
Shadow Daggers Damage to Rares and Bosses

53.description: When you create a shadow you regain health, and skills used by shadows deal increased damage.
53.pointBonusDescription: Shadow Daggers deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to rare enemies and bosses

54.description: Skills that generate or consume {Flow} deal increased damage and have additional critical strike multiplier.
54.pointBonusDescription: Generating a stack of {Flow} increases your melee and throwing attack speed for 4 seconds. This buff can stack.

stats.statName: Increased Damage when generating or consuming Flow
Critical Multiplier when generating or consuming Flow

55.description: You deal increased physical damage and have a chance to inflict bleed on hit with melee and throwing attacks.
55.pointBonusDescription: You have a chance to gain a stack of {Crimson Shroud} when you directly use a melee or throwing attack and hit at least one enemy.

56.description: You have additional health and critical strike avoidance.

57.description: {Flow} is consumed when you use a 5th unique skill rather than a 4th, but the skill that consumes Flow has more critical strike chance and deals more damage over time (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

stats.statName: More Crit Chance when Consuming Flow
More Damage Over Time when Consuming Flow
Unique Skills Required to Consume Flow

58.description: You have increased melee and throwing attack speed. When you use a melee or throwing attack and hit at least one enemy you have a chance to gain a stack of {Dusk Shroud}. Each stack of Dusk Shroud adds 50 dodge rating and 5% chance to receive a {Glancing Blow} when hit.

59.description: You have additional parry chance and increased critical strike chance.

60.description: You have additional resistances and endurance.

61.description: Your dodge chance is added as twice as much chance to receive a glancing blow, but you cannot dodge.
61.altText:
Does not prevent dodging with {Silver Shroud}.
Glancing Blows deal 35% less damage.

stats.statName: Increased Melee Attack Speed while Dual Wielding
Increased Throwing Attack Speed while Dual Wielding

63.description: You leech a portion of melee damage as health, and a portion of your damage over time as health.

stats.statName: Damage Leeched as Health from Damage Over Time

64.description: You have additional dodge rating. You have deal increased damage, tripled while at full health.

stats.statName: Increased Damage, tripled while at full health

65.description: You gain a bonus while dual wielding depending on your weapon combination.

stats.statName: Increased Crit Chance with a Sword and Dagger
Bleed Chance with an Axe and a Sword
Physical Damage Leeched as Health with an Axe and Dagger
Increased Stun Duration with a Mace and Sword
Critical Multiplier with a Mace and Dagger

66.description: You have additional vitality and deal increased damage over time.
66.pointBonusDescription: Bleeds you inflict deal more damage per poison on the enemy, up to a maximum. Poisons you inflict deal more damage per bleed on the enemy, up to a maximum. Both of these effects are multiplicative with other modifiers.

stats.statName: More Bleed Damage per 10 Poisons on Enemy, up to 20%
More Poison Damage per 10 Bleeds on Enemy, up to 20%

67.description: When you use a melee attack and hit at least one enemy you gain a stack of Perfection. When you receive a hit you lose all stacks. Each stack of perfection increases your damage.

stats.statName: Increased Damage per Stack of Perfection

68.description: You have increased critical strike chance and you have a chance to inflict {Critical Vulnerability} on hit.
68.altText: Critical Vulnerability is a stacking ailment that adds a 5% additional chance to be crit and reduces critical strike avoidance by 10%.
68.pointBonusDescription: You have additional critical strike avoidance.

69.description: You have additional health. When you kill an enemy or hit a rare or boss enemy, you regain health for each stack of any {Shroud} on you.
69.altText: Shrouds include {Dusk Shroud}, {Crimson Shroud}, and {Silver Shroud}.
69.pointBonusDescription: When damage taken from enemies puts you below 70% health you gain stacks of {Silver Shroud}. This effect has a 15 second cooldown.

stats.statName: Health Gained per Stack of Shroud
Silver Shroud Stacks when Damaged to Below 70%

70.description: You deal increased damage at full health, and each stack of {Perfection} also grants additional armor and dodge rating.
70.pointBonusDescription: While at full health, you gain an additional stack of {Perfection} when you directly use a melee attack and hit at least one enemy.

stats.statName: Dodge Rating per Stack of Perfection
Additional Perfection Stack per Melee Attack at Full Health

71.description:
While at low health you take less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and you have additional critical strike multiplier.

Additionally, when damage leaves you at low health you gain these benefits for 5 seconds if you aren't already at low health.

stats.statName: Damage Taken While At Low Health
Crit Multi While At Low Health

72.description: Your hits have a chance to shred armor and inflict bleed.
72.pointBonusDescription: Your throwing attacks have a lower mana cost.

73.description: You have a higher critical strike multiplier, but you deal less damage with non-critical hits and damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

stats.statName: Less Damage Dealt by Non-critical Hits

74.description: Skills used by shadows deal increased damage, and you have a chance to gain a stack of {Dusk Shroud} when you use a melee or throwing attack and hit at least one enemy.
74.altText: You can have a maximum of 3 shadows at once by default.
74.pointBonusDescription: You can have an additional shadow.

75.pointBonusDescription: You have additional glancing blow chance with at least 50 dexterity, increased attack speed with at least 75 dexterity, and increased movement speed with at least 100 dexterity.

stats.statName: Chance to inflict Bleed on Bow Hit

78.description:
You have a chance to gain haste for 2 seconds when you or your {Falcon} hits an enemy.

Additionally, you deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) while you have haste.

80.description: You have a chance to gain a stack of {Crimson Shroud} when your {Falcon} or {Ballistas} hit an enemy.

81.pointBonusDescription: Your {Falcon} deals additonal throwing damage per point of your Dexterity.

82.description: You have additional dodge rating and you gain a portion of your maximum health as endurance threshold if you have not been hit recently.

stats.statName: Maximum Health Gained As Endurance Threshold

83.pointBonusDescription:
You have increased melee attack speed while wielding a 2 handed sword.
You have additional fire penetration while wielding a staff.
You deal additional melee damage per 10 Dexterity while wielding a spear.

stats.statName: Increased Melee Attack Speed With 2h Sword
Fire Penetration Per Int With Staff
Melee Damage Per 10 Dex With Spear

85.description: You deal increased damage while wielding a bow and your bow hits have a chance to grant your {Falcon} additional melee damage for 4 seconds. This has no stack limit.

86.pointBonusDescription:
You gain mana when you dodge. 

This effect has a 1 second cooldown.

88.pointBonusDescription: You have additional block chance while wielding a 1 handed weapon and you have additional block effectiveness per point of Dexterity.

89.description: You deal increased damage and have an additional chance to inflict bleed while wielding a spear.
89.pointBonusDescription:
You have increased attack speed with {Flurry} while wielding a spear.

You have increased range with {Puncture} while wielding a spear.

stats.statName: Increased Flurry Attack Speed With Spear

90.pointBonusDescription: Your {Falcon} gains a portion of your added throwing damage as added melee and throwing damage.

stats.statName: Added Throwing Damage Conversion To Falcon

91.description: Your area skills and your minions' area skills deal damage in a larger area.
91.altText: Traps include: {Explosive Trap}, {Net Trap} and {Acid Trap}.
91.pointBonusDescription: You gain mana when one of your {Decoys} detonate.

stats.statName: Increased Area for Minion Area Skills

93.description: When you use a certain ability on your bar, you gain 3 stacks of Silver Shroud. This effect has a 10 second cooldown.

94.pointBonusDescription: You regain health per point of Dexterity when your {Falcon} hits an enemy.

stats.statName: Health Gain on Falcon Hit Per 3 Dex

95.description: You have additional block and a chance to receive a glancing blow. Additionally, you regain health whenever you block or recieve a glancing blow.
95.pointBonusDescription: All of your block chance is converted to glancing blow chance.

stats.statName: Health On Block Or Glancing Blow

97.description:
{Falcon Strikes} and {Dive Bomb} are now instant cast.

Additionally, {Falcon Strikes} and {Dive Bomb} have a longer cooldown.

98.description:
You have additional dodge rating and you now have a chance to drop {Caltrops} around you when you dodge and there is an enemy within 4 meters of you.

This effect has a 2 second cooldown.

stats.statName: Chance To Throw Caltrops On Dodge

99.pointBonusDescription: A portion of your chance to inflict bleed and poison on hit is applied to your {Falcon}.

101.pointBonusDescription: Your {Caltrops} from all sources apply 3 stacks of frailty on hit.

102.description: You have additional armor per point of Dexterity.
102.pointBonusDescription: You have increased armor for each time your {Falcon} has hit an enemy recently.

103.description: Haste on you has increased effect and you gain haste for a short duration whenever you use a potion.
103.pointBonusDescription: You have an additional potion slot.

104.pointBonusDescription: Your chance to receive a glancing blow is doubled if you have not been hit recently.

stats.statName: Double Glancing Blow Chance If Not Hit

105.description:
You take less damage while moving. Additionally, you have increased movement speed and dodge rating.

These effects are doubled if your {Falcon} has hit an enemy recently.

stats.statName: Double Effects With Recent Falcon Hit

106.description:
You regain health when you or your minions crits an enemy.

You have additional critical strike avoidance.
106.pointBonusDescription: Your minions gain additional critical strike multiplier per 3% of your uncapped critical strike avoidance.

stats.statName: Minion Critical Multiplier per 3% Crit Avoidance

107.pointBonusDescription: You deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of slow on the target.

masteries.classDescription: Unrivaled in bow and blade, the rogue strikes out from the shadows to find a higher purpose for her deadly talents.
An artisan of shadows, they dash in and out of the reach of their enemies, each movement another deadly cut.
passiveBonuses: +1 max Shadows
+15 melee physical damage
15% more dodge rating (multiplicative with other modifiers)

masteries.classDescription: A master of the bow, adept at engaging foes from a distance and keeping them there.
passiveBonuses: Bow Mastery: Using a bow attack grants 5% increased attack speed. Can stack 5 times. All stacks fall off after if you have not used a bow attack recently.
Bow Mastery: 50% increased damage while using a bow

masteries.classDescription: A master tactician who employs deceptive traps and a fearsome bird of prey to gain an advantage against her enemies.

2.description: Disintegrate has a chance to slow enemies caught within the beam.

4.description: Flame Energy builds up more quickly.

5.description: Disintegrate deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

6.description: You gain ward each second based on your Intelligence while channeling Disintegrate.

stats.statName: Ward Gained Per 3 Int Per Second

7.description: Your skills recover their cooldowns faster while you are channeling Disintegrate.

8.description:
Disintegrate now has two beams, and each beam deals damage independently, so enemies caught in both take double damage.

Disintegrate costs more mana per second to channel, and each beam deals less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

10.description: Disintegrate deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but has a delay before casting. This delay is reduced by increased cast speed.

11.description: Disintegrate has a chance to shock enemies caught within the beam.

12.description:
Disintegrate’s base fire damage is converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to fire damage.

Disintegrate loses the {fire} tag.

13.description: Disintegrate no longer costs mana while channeling, but it also deals less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

14.description: Disintegrate deals more lightning damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) based on your maximum mana.

15.description: Shock inflicted by Disintegrate lasts longer and Disintegrate deals more direct damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of Shock on the target.
15.altText: Direct damage modifiers do not affect damage of ailments or subskills.

16.description:
You have a chance each second to cast {Lightning Blast} at a nearby enemy.

This consumes mana equal to {Lightning Blast's} mana cost.

17.description: Disintegrate is upgraded to tier 2 after 2 seconds of channeling. Tier 2 Disintegrate deals more damage, but costs more mana to channel.

18.description: Disintegrate is upgraded to tier 3 after 4 seconds of channeling. Tier 3 grants double the bonuses of tier 2.

19.description:
While your Disintegrate is at tier 3 you have a chance to inflict {Spreading Flames} and {Spark Charges} on enemies in the beam each second while channeling.

If Disintegrate is converted to {fire}, the {Spark Charges} are converted to {Spreading Flames}.

If Disintegrate is converted to {lightning}, the {Spreading Flames} is converted to {Spark Charges}.

20.description: Disintegrate upgrades to the next Tier faster. This also affects the rate at which you gain stacks of {Lucomancer}.

21.description: Disintegrate deals more damage while at Tier 2, but also causes you to take more damage while at tier 2 (both multiplicative with other modifiers and each other), and these effects are are doubled at Tier 3.

22.description: Disintegrate gains a portion of your chance to ignite with fire spells on hit as ignite chance per second.

stats.statName: Ignite Chance On Hit -> Ignite Chance Per Second

23.description:
Disintegrate’s base lightning damage is converted to fire damage, unless you have the {Electrify} node.

Disintegrate loses the {lightning} tag.

24.description: You have a chance each second to cast {Fire Aura} while channeling Disintegrate.

25.description: Disintegrate has a longer range.

26.description:
For every 2 seconds you spend channeling Disintegrate, you gain a stack of {Lucomancer}, up to 2 stacks and each stack lasts 4 seconds. Stacks are refreshed when you gain a new one.

Lucomancer grants global more damage to ignited or shocked enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers) and global reduced mana cost.

stats.statName: Global Damage to Ignited or Shocked Enemies

28.description: You take less damage while channeling Disintegrate (multiplicative with other modifiers).

30.description: Disintegrate deals more fire damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) based on your Intelligence.

32.description: Flame energy builds up on enemies within the beam, causing an explosion that deals fire damage around them after 3 seconds of taking damage.
32.altText: 3 seconds if the target stays in the beam.

34.description:
Every 3 seconds of channelling Disintegrate, you cast {Static Orb} or {Volcanic Orb}, chosen randomly.

If Disintegrate is converted to {fire}, you always cast {Volcanic Orb}.

If Disintegrate is converted to {lightning}, you always cast {Static Orb}.

This consumes mana equal to the mana cost of those respective abilities.

35.description: You gain {Static Charges} each second while channeling Disintegrate.

36.description:
If you start channeling Disintegrate while having at least 1 stack of {Lucomancer} it starts at Tier 2.

If you also have the {Amplification} node and at least 2 stacks of {Lucomancer}, Disintegrate starts at Tier 3 instead.

stats.statName: Starts At Tier 3 With 2 Stacks Of Lucomancer

37.description:
When you stop channeling Disintegrate, you cast {Fireball} at nearby enemies twice per second spent channeling, up to a maximum.

This consumes mana equal to {Fireball's} mana cost.

0.description:
A melee directional attack that that stuns enemies for 1 second. 100% increased stun chance against non-boss enemies.

1% more damage per 1% block chance (up to 100%, multiplicative with other modifiers).

1.description: Stuns caused by Shield Bash last longer.

2.description: If Shield Bash is used while Ring of Shields is active, the shields form a wall which increases the width of Shield Bash, based on the number of active shields.
2.altText: The wall can be up to a maximum of 7 shields wide.

3.description: You are granted health when you stun an enemy with Shield Bash.

4.description:
If Shield Bash is used while you have a shield equipped, it fires shield fragments in a cone in front of you.

While Shield Bash is on cooldown you cannot block.

Only works if Shield Bash has a cooldown.
4.altText: Shield Fragments deal melee damage, and added melee damage applies to them at 150% effectiveness.

5.description: You are granted health per point of Strength, when you stun an enemy with Shield Bash.

stats.statName: Health Gain On Stun Per Strength

6.description: Shield Bash deals damage in a wider area.

7.description: Shield Bash now applies {Frailty} to enemies hit.

8.description:
Shield Bash deals additional melee fire damage.

If Shield Bash has a cooldown, it also deals more fire damage per block chance (multiplicative with other modifiers) up to 100%.

stats.statName: Max Fire Damage Bonus From Block Chance

9.description:
Shield Bash causes your next melee or throwing attack to have additional ignite chance and critical strike chance. Excludes channelled skills.

This effect is significantly reduced if Shield Bash does not have a cooldown.

10.description:
Shield Bash no longer has a guaranteed stun, but instead applies additional stacks of ignite. All stun duration modifiers from this tree are converted to affect ignite duration instead.

Shield Bash's base physical damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to physical damage. 

Swaps Shield Bash's {Physical} tag for a {Fire} tag.

11.description: Shield Bash grant you additional block chance and block effectiveness for a short duration after use.

12.description:
After you use Shield Rush or Lunge, you Shield Bash in the direction you traveled.

Shield Bash must have a cooldown, be charged and on your action bar for this effect to work.

stats.statName: Shield Bash After Shield Rush Or Lunge

13.description:
For 4 seconds after using Shield Bash, you are guaranteed to block a limited number of hits.

Only works if Shield Bash has a cooldown.

14.description: Shield Bash now also blinds enemies hit.

15.description: Your next {Shield Throw} can ricochet 5 additional times, after using Shield Bash.

16.description: Shield Bash now also slows enemies.

17.description: Shield Bash deals damage in a longer area.

18.description: Shield Bash will cause one enemy that was hit to drop a potion if Shield Bash has a cooldown.

19.description: Slows caused by Shield Bash last longer.

20.description: Shield Bash now also knocks enemies back, if Shield Bash has a cooldown.

21.description: You gain an additional charge of Shield Bash, but it has a longer cooldown.

22.description: Using Shield Bash consumes all charges and deals significantly more damage per extra charge consumed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

23.description: Shield Bash deals additional melee physical damage.

24.description: Shield Bash no longer requires a shield to use, but costs more mana.

25.description: Shield Bash reduces enemy armor and costs less mana.

26.description: Shield Bash causes enemies to bleed, but costs more mana.

27.description: Shield Bash deals more physical damage per point of Strength (multiplicative with other modifiers).

28.description: Shield Bash no longer has a cooldown, but costs significantly more mana and no longer has a guaranteed stun or ignite.

29.description: Shield Bash deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

30.description: Shield Bash has an increased chance to stun and stuns it inflicts last longer.

32.description: Shield Bash has added melee damage based on your block effectiveness.

34.description: Shield Bash has increased attack speed scaling with your block chance up to a maximum.

1.description: Ghostflame has a chance to inflict damned and ignite enemies each second.

2.description:
Ghostflames's base necrotic and fire damage is converted to physical. Consequently this damage scales with increases to physical damage, but not increases to necrotic or fire damage.

Damned and ignite chance from all sources are converted to bleed chance per second.

Ghostflame now drains a portion of your health each second.

Swaps Ghostflames's {Necrotic} and {Fire} tags for a {Physical} tag.

3.description:
You leech a portion of the physical damage you deal as health while channeling Ghostflame.

A portion of your global bleed chance on hit now applies as bleed chance per second for Ghostflame.

stats.statName: Bleed Chance -> Bleed Chance per second

4.description:
Damaging an enemy with Ghostflame causes you to cast {Marrow Shards} towards them.

This effect can occur a maximum number of times each second.

stats.statName: Max Marrow Shards per second against 1 target

5.description:
Increases the frequency of {Marrow Shards} per second from the {Feast of Bones} node.

Improves the {Marrow Shards'} base critical strike chance cast this way.

6.description: Ghostflame has increased ignite and damned duration per point of Intelligence.

7.description:
A portion of your global ignite chance on hit now applies as ignite chance per second for Ghostflame.

A portion of your global damned chance on hit now applies as damned chance per second for Ghostflame.

stats.statName: Ignite Chance -> Ignite Chance per second
Damned Chance -> Damned Chance per second

8.description:
After channelling Ghostflame for a short duration, the skull releases a terrible screech, cursing all nearby enemies with {Decrepify}.

Ghost Flame gains the {Curse} tag, but its direct damage still does not scale with increased curse damage.

9.description: The screech from the {Decrepit Mortals} node has a shorter delay before being released and a larger area.

10.description: The screech from the {Decrepit Mortals} node now also fears enemies and Ghostflame deals more direct damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to feared enemies.
10.altText: Direct damage modifiers do not affect damage of ailments and subskills from Ghostflame.

11.description: Ghostflame deals more damage, but has a higher channel cost (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

12.description: You take less damage from ignited, damned or bleeding enemies while channeling Ghostflame, but it costs more mana to channel.

13.description: Ghostflame deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

14.description:
You leech a portion of the damage you deal as health against {Cursed} enemies while channeling Ghostflame.

Additionally, Ghostflame has a chance to inflict Frailty each second.

15.description:
When you stop channeling Ghostflame after having channeled for at least 1 second, you gain the {Haste} buff for a short duration.

Additionally, when you stop channeling you gain ward per {Cursed} enemy.

stats.statName: Ward Gain per Cursed enemy after Channeling

16.description:
After channeling for 1.1 seconds Ghostflame detaches itself, and persists for short duration without you needing to channel.

This effect ends early if you start channeling Ghostflame again.

17.description: The duration from the {Memorial of Flames} node is longer, but Ghostflame now has an upfront mana cost.

18.description: The detached Ghostflame now slowly seeks out nearby enemies.

19.description: After channeling for 1 second, Ghostflame consumes a portion of your current ward, and it deals damage in a larger area per ward consumed.

20.description:
For each 200 ward consumed by the {Silver Oblation} node you now cast a {Stygian Beam} at a nearby enemy dealing spell necrotic damage.

Enemies cannot be hit by more than 1 beam.

21.description:
All your {Wraiths}, {Spectres}, and {Revenants} gain a stack of {Spirit Kindling} every 0.5 seconds while they are inside Ghostflame's area of effect.

Each stack of {Spirit Kindling} lasts 5 seconds, drains health per second, and grants increased movement speed, melee attack speed, and ignite chance equal to a portion of your ignite chance.

stats.statName: Current Health Drain per second per stack
Ignite Chance -> Minion Ignite Chance per stack

22.description: Ghostflame now deals damage in a full circle around you, but it has a higher channel cost.

23.description: You now move towards the target location while channeling Ghostflame with increased movement speed, but it has a higher channel cost.

24.description: Ghostflame has a lower channel cost, but you move slower while channeling Ghostflame.

25.description: You move faster while channeling Ghostflame.

26.description: Ghostflame deals more direct damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per second you spend channeling Ghostflame.
26.altText: Direct damage modifiers do not affect damage of ailments and subskills from Ghostflame.

27.description: Ghostflame has a lower channel cost and you gain a portion of your current mana as ward each second while channeling Ghostflame.

stats.statName: Current Mana -> Ward Gain while Channeling

28.description: You gain additional dodge rating per intelligence while channeling Ghostflame, as well as more dodge rating (multiplicative with other modifiers) while channeling Ghostflame.

stats.statName: Dodge Rating per Intelligence while Channeling

29.description: All of your dodge rating is converted to armor while channeling Ghostflame.

0.loreText: Creativity stems from the simplicity of fire.

2.description: Fireball now pierces enemies (continue through targets it hits), but costs more mana.

3.description: Fireball hits have additional fire penetration and lightning penetration.

4.description: Improves Fireball's base critical strike chance.

5.description:
Half of Fireball's base fire damage is converted to lightning. Consequently this portion of its damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to fire damage.

Fireball gains a {Lightning} tag.

Fireball also gains additional critical strike multiplier.

6.description: Fireball deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and travels faster, causing it to travel farther.

7.description: Fireball releases additional projectiles that fire in a cone when cast, but costs more mana.
7.altText: Projectiles are fired all at once in a cone

8.description: Fireball has additional critical strike chance, but it has less cast speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

9.description: Fireball releases additional projectiles that fire in a cone when cast, but costs more mana.

10.description: Nodes on this tree that add crit chance instead increase stun chance by 20 times the stated value.

11.description: Directly cast Fireballs fire in sequence in the same direction and can now hit the same target, but Fireball releases fewer projectiles and has less cast speed for each extra projectile (multiplicative with other modifiers).
11.altText: This node enables the extra projectiles to hit the same enemy

stats.statName: Projectiles Can Hit The Same Target

12.description: Fireball releases additional projectiles. These additional projectiles are NOT reduced by the extra projectiles penalty via the {Embers} node.
12.altText: Not affected by Embers' penalty to the number of extra projectiles

13.description: Fireball hits have a higher chance to ignite enemies.

14.description:
Fireball hits have a chance to apply {Spreading Flames}, an ailment which deals fire damage over time and spreads to nearby enemies.

Additionally all damage over time ailments applied by Fireball deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifier).

15.description: {Spreading Flames} applied by fireball has additional fire penetration

16.description: Fireball hits have more critical strike chance against ignited enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

stats.statName: More Crit Chance Against Ignited Enemies

17.description: Fireball has increased cast speed.

18.description: Fireball hits have a chance to reduce enemy fire resistance.
18.altText: This effect grants an equal amount of lightning resistance shred chance if Fireball has been converted to lightning.

19.description: Fireballs now seek nearby targets.

20.description: Hitting the same enemy with several fireballs triggers a {Flame Burst} around them.
20.altText: {Flame Burst} is a fire spell that deals high damage in an area.

21.description: Flame Burst requires fewer hits with Fireball to trigger.
21.altText: {Flame Burst} is a fire spell that deals high damage in an area.

22.description: Fireball deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and costs less mana.

23.description: Fireball has increased cast speed and deals more damage for each extra projectile (multiplicative with other modifiers), but no longer fires extra projectiles.

24.description: Fireball becomes a channelled ability that rapidly spews fireballs from your hand, but rapidly drains your mana. You do not regenerate mana while channelling.
24.altText: Increased cast speed affects how quickly you start channelling, but does not affect the number of fireballs per second.

25.description: Fireballs have a chance to pierce enemies (continue through targets it hits), but {Flamethrower} costs more mana per second to channel.

26.description: {Flamethrower} costs less mana per second to channel.
26.altText: This is additive with the channel cost modifier from the {Ghostfire} node.

27.description: You have additional Armor and Fire Resistance while channeling Fireball's {Flamethrower}.

28.description: Fireballs last longer, causing them to travel further.

2.description: Net's hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

3.description: Net snares enemies in a larger area.

4.description: Net's hits cannot be dodged.

5.description: Net's hits slows enemies.

6.description: Netted enemies and enemies slowed by the {Tanglewire} node cannot dodge and cannot avoid critical strikes.
6.altText: This overrides enemies' chance to dodge or avoid crits.

7.description: Using Net grants you the {Huntress Advantage} buff for a short duration, granting you more global damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) against slowed or immobilized enemies.

8.description: While you have {Huntress Advantage} you now also have global increased throwing attack speed.

9.description: Net causes enemies to take physical damage over time and causes them to bleed each second.

10.description:
Net's base physical damage is converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Bleed chance on hit from all sources is converted to lightning resistance shred for Net.

Additionally, Net deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per global shock chance.

Swaps Net's {Physical} tag for a {Lightning} tag.

11.description: Net deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) scaling with your dodge chance.

12.description: Net deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and bleeds that it inflicts last longer.

13.description:
Net's base physical damage is converted to poison. Consequently this damage scales with increases to poison damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Bleed chance on hit from all sources is converted to poison chance for Net.

Net gains the {Poison} tag.

14.description: You no longer flip back when using Net.

15.description:
Net now throws a trap that releases a net at a nearby enemy when it triggers.

You can have a maximum of 6 Net Traps active at once and they last up to 30 seconds.
15.altText: If you reach your maximum number of active traps, throwing additional traps will destroy the oldest traps without detonating them.

16.description:
Net Traps now also use {Puncture} for you when they are triggered. This will use the melee or bow version of Puncture depending on your equipped weapon.

This consumes mana equal to a portion of {Puncture's} mana cost.
16.altText: If Puncture has no mana cost this effect would still cost 0 mana. 115% of 0 is still 0.

17.description: You now throw additional Net traps with each throw, but Net costs additional mana.

18.description: When using Net you drop {Caltrops} at your starting location after jumping.

19.description: {Caltrops} from all sources deal damage in a larger area.

20.description: Improves {Caltrops'} base critical strike chance from all sources per 10% global slow chance.

stats.statName: Caltrops Crit Chance Per 10% Slow Chance

21.description:
If Net hits an enemy you now also throw {Caltrops} at your target location where the Net hits.

This effect can occur once per 2 seconds.

22.description: You jump further when using Net.

23.description: You now jump forwards when using Net instead of backwards and it is thrown behind you.

24.description: When directly using Net you now throw a {Smoke Bomb} after jumping.
24.altText: This effect only works if Smoke Bomb is off cooldown.

25.description: Net snares enemies for a longer duration.

26.description:
Net's hits chill bosses and rare enemies while other enemies are stunned for a short duration. Additionally, you gain mana for each moving enemy hit.

This effect adds a 10 second cooldown.

stats.statName: Chill Stacks On Bosses And Rares

27.description: Net has a shorter cooldown.

28.description:
You now jump further when using Net and it has a reduced cooldown.

Net gains the {Traversal} tag.

29.description: Netted enemies deal less physical damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

30.description: Your {Falcon} deals more global damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to netted enemies.

31.description: Net's hits apply frailty to enemies.

0.loreText: Strike First!

2.description: You regain a percentage of your missing health when you use Lunge.

3.description: Lunge deals damage in a wider area along its path.

4.description: Lunge gains an additional charge, but it has a longer cooldown.

6.description: Other allies caught in the path gain {Haste} for a short duration.

7.description: You can now Lunge to other allies.
7.altText: You cannot Lunge to shields from {Ring of Shields}.

8.description: You now heal allies and cleanse negative ailments on allies you Lunge to. The amount of health gained is increased by healing effectiveness.

9.description: Lunge now hits all enemies along its path to your target.
9.altText: Increased Area for Area Skills stats affect the width of the path

11.description: Lunge hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed along its path but not its final hit.

12.description: Lunge deals more damage to enemies along its path and with its final hit.

14.description:
Lunge's base physical damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to physical damage or other damage types.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to ignite chance.

Swaps Lunge's {Physical} tag for a {Fire} tag.

This has no effect if you have taken the {Voidbringer} node.

15.description: You have a high chance to block while Lunging.

16.description: Lunge's final hit has a chance to apply {Frailty} to enemies based on distance traveled up to a maximum.

17.description: Lunge's final hit now {Immobilizes} enemies for a short duration.

18.description: Improves Lunge's base critical strike chance when using a spear.

20.description: Lunge's final hit deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area based on distance traveled up to a maximum.

21.description:
Lunge hits instantly kills enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health). The threshold is based on distance traveled up to a maximum.

If you have a similar effect from an item or passive node then the highest threshold is used.

22.description: After using Lunge you gain additional physical penetration per enemy hit along the path. This buff lasts 4 seconds.
22.altText:
This buff can stack if you use Lunge multiple times within 4 seconds.

If Lunge is converted to Void then this buff grants Void Penetration instead.

If Lunge is converted to Fire then this buff grants Fire Penetration instead.

24.description: Lunge's final hit has a chance to cast {Smite} at up to 3 nearby targets based on distance traveled up to a maximum.
24.altText: If there are 3 available targets and this effect triggers it will always cast smite at all 3 targets. The cast chance is not rolled individually.

25.description: You are invulnerable while Lunging.

27.description: Killing an enemy with Lunge grants you {Frenzy} for a short duration.

28.description:
Lunge's base physical damage is converted to void. Consequently this damage scales with increases to void damage, but not increases to physical damage or other damage types.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to chance to inflict {Time Rot}.

Swaps Lunge's {Physical} tag for a {Void} tag.

29.description: Killing an enemy with Lunge resets the cooldowns of {Void Cleave}, {Erasing Strike}, {Forge Strike} and {Judgement}

30.description: Lunge's final hit now deals damage in an extended rectangle instead of a circle when using a spear.

31.description:
Lunge's final hit now causes you to use {Javelin} when using a spear.

This consumes Javelin's mana cost.

32.description:
You reduce a portion of Lunge's remaining cooldown when you use a different melee attack and hit at least one enemy. 

This effect can only occur a limited number of times per use of Lunge.

33.description: Lunge deals more melee damage to enemies at high health (multiplicative with other modifiers).
33.altText: Targets above 65% max health are considered to be at high health.

34.description: You grant other nearby allies {Haste} at the end of the charge for a short duration based on distance traveled, up to a maximum.
34.altText: This does not grant you Haste, but does affect your minions.

35.description: {Warrior's Renewal} recovers an additional amount of Lunge's cooldown and also grants you health when it triggers.

2.description: Symbols of Hope grants you and your allies increased mana regeneration.

4.description: Symbols of Hope grants you and your allies additional chance to electrify on hit.

5.description: Symbols grant you and your allies a chance to ignite enemies.

6.description: You and your allies gain increased critical strike chance per Symbol.

7.description: Symbols grant you and your allies increased healing effectiveness.

8.description: Symbols of Hope costs less mana and the active effect lasts longer.

9.description: You can summon an additional Symbol.

10.description: When you activate Symbols of Hope, gain ward equal to a portion of your maximum health per symbol consumed.

stats.statName: Portion Of Health To Ward Per Symbol

11.description: You have a chance to regain a Symbol after activation.

12.description: Symbol of Hope's active effect also grants increased healing effectiveness for its duration.

13.description: Symbol of Hope's active effect also grants Haste for its duration.

14.description: Activating Symbols of Hope now heals you for a portion of your maximum health.

15.description: Symbols grant you and your allies additional endurance threshold

16.description: You gain Symbols of Hope faster.

17.description:
Symbol of Hope's active effect creates a {Divine Flare} that deals fire damage to enemies in an area around you and heals allies for 50 health per Symbol consumed, but it no longer grants damage reduction.

Symbol of Hope's cooldown is significantly reduced, and it is no longer instant cast.
17.altText: At least one symbol must be consumed to create a Divine Flare.

18.description: Directly cast Divine Flares which hit a rare enemy or boss have a chance per symbol consumed to recast Divine Flare.
18.altText:
Exceeding 100% chance can recast multiple times.
Recasts do not consume symbols, but benefit based on the amount of symbols consumed by the original activation.

20.description: {Divine Flare} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area per Symbol consumed.

21.description: Divine Flare now has a chance per Symbol consumed to cleanse negative ailments on allies, and a chance per Symbol consumed to blind nearby enemies.

22.description: {Divine Flare} now has a chance to gain a Symbol on kill or when hitting a boss or rare enemy.

23.description: Symbols of Hope has a shorter cooldown.

24.description: Symbols now only affect you, but provide twice as much health regeneration.

25.description: You can now cast Symbols of Hope's active effect on your allies. Any effects from this tree will now be granted to the recipient.

stats.statName: Symbols Of Hope Cast On Allies

26.description: Symbols grant additional block chance and block effectiveness.

28.description: You can summon an additional Symbol.

29.description: Symbols grant you and your allies additional fire damage.

30.description: Fire damage provided by Symbols is converted to void damage. Each Symbol now grants 15% increased void damage, but no longer increases health regeneration.

stats.statName: Increased Void Damage Per Active Symbol
Symbols Do Not Increase Health Regen

32.description: Symbols increase the damage of you and your allies.

34.description: Your Symbols of Hope have increased effect on your other allies.
34.altText: This affects your minions and party members, but not you.

stats.statName: Increased Symbols Effect For Other Allies

0.description: Summon a decoy.

1.description: Decoy's final explosion deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and explodes in a larger area.

2.description: All explosions from Decoy deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

3.description: Decoy has a chance to cause a small explosion when hit, up to a maximum of 2 explosions.

4.description:
All explosions' base fire damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to fire damage. Explosions also gain a base freeze rate.

Ignite chance from all sources is converted to chill chance and effects related to ignite now depend on chill instead.

5.description:
Decoy becomes a combo ability. The first cast creates the decoy, and the second detonates it. The remote detonation costs mana.

Has no effect if Decoy has additional charges.

6.description: Detonation costs less mana.

7.description: All explosions have a higher chance to freeze enemies.

8.description: Decoy can cause additional small explosions.

9.description: Decoy lasts longer, but has a longer cooldown.

10.description: Decoy reflects a percentage of damage to attackers.

11.description: You have additional dodge chance while the decoy exists.

12.description: When the decoy expires, for the next 4 seconds you have additional critical strike multiplier equal to your dodge chance while the decoy was active.

13.description: The Decoy is on fire and ignites nearby enemies each second, but costs more mana.
13.altText: This is not affected by {Frostfire Powder}.

14.description: The Decoy has increased ignite frequency.

15.description:
Small explosions are replaced by Acid Flask detonations. The final explosion is replaced by three Acid Flasks ejected from the decoy.
{On Fire} now inflicts poison instead of ignite.
15.altText: Acid Flasks cannot have extra projectiles when ejected from the Decoy.

16.description: Decoy can store an additional charge.

18.description: Decoy costs less mana.

19.description: The Decoy emits a {Sonic Wave} when it appears, inflicting {Frailty} and armor shred to nearby enemies.

20.description: {Sonic Wave} grants {Haste} to you and your allies hit for a duration.

21.description: {Sonic Wave} inflicts additional stacks of armor shred, and armor shred it applies lasts longer.

22.description: {Sonic Wave} Fears enemies for a duration.
22.altText: Fear causes enemies to flee from you and your allies. Enemies can only be affected by Fear once.

23.description:
{Sonic Wave} inflicts fire resistance shred instead of armour shred.

If you have taken {Frostfire Powder} it instead inflicts cold resistance shred.

24.description: Decoy's final explosion deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but Decoy has a shorter duration.

25.description: Decoy leaves a {Shadow} in its place after detonating.

26.description: Decoy's final explosion ignites enemies.

27.description: Decoy's final explosion deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but costs more mana.

28.description: Throw additional Decoys near the target location. Decoy location is slightly randomised.

2.description: Profane Veil's area has a chance to slow enemies each second. Additionally, you leech a portion of the global damage you deal as health while in Profane Veil.

3.description:
Profane Veil's base necrotic damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to necrotic damage.

Profane Form now has a chance to ignite enemies each second.

Swaps Profane Form's {Necrotic} tag for a {Fire} tag.

4.description: While in Profane Veil you gain a percentage of your damned, bleed, poison, slow and ignite chance on hit as chance to ignite per second for Profane Form.

5.description:
You move faster equal to a portion of your chance to ignite on hit up to a maximum, but Profane Veil has a shorter duration per chance to ignite on hit up to a maximum.

Profane Veil gains the {Traversal} tag.

6.description:
When you first damage an enemy with Profane Veil you have a chance to cast {Infernal Shade} on them.

This effect can occur a maximum amount of times per cast of Profane Veil.

7.description: Profane Veil Immobilizes {Cursed} enemies for a short duration, but Bosses and Rare enemies will instead be chilled, rather than Immobilized.

stats.statName: Chill stacks on Cursed Rares and Bosses

8.description: You deal more global damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to {Cursed} enemies while in Profane Veil.

9.description:
Directly casting a {Curse} skill reduces Profane Veil's remaining cooldown.

This effect can occur a maximum number of times.

10.description: Profane Veil affects a larger area.

11.description:
Profane Veil gains additional effects depending on the weapon type you are wielding. 

{Staff}: Increased area.
{Wand}: More damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
{Scepter}: Increased duration.
{Dagger}: Increased movement speed.
{Axe}: Kill threshold.

12.description: You now fear nearby enemies for a short duration when you exit Profane Veil. Additionally, Profane Veil deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to feared or slowed enemies for the same duration.

13.description: Damage reduction from armor now also applies to damage over time taken while in Profane Veil.

14.description:
When a {Wandering Spirit} is revealed inside Profane Veil's area the {Spirit} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area for the rest of the {Spirit's} duration. 

Additionally, for each {Spirit} revealed inside Profane Veil's area you gain ward scaling with your necrotic resistance.

stats.statName: Ward Gain per 15% Uncapped Necrotic Res

15.description: You gain ward per dexterity when you dodge while in Profane Veil.

stats.statName: Ward Gain on Dodge per Dex

16.description: Profane Veil lasts longer and you move faster while in it.

17.description:
While in Profane Veil you move faster and it has a shorter cooldown, but you can no longer change direction while concealed and it has a shorter duration without being able to extend its duration.

Profane Veil gains the {Traversal} tag.

18.description: Profane Veil's area now consumes your minions, and consuming minions this way grants you ward equal to a portion of their maximum health as well as extending its remaining duration by a small amount.

stats.statName: Portion of Minion health to Ward Gain

19.description:
You now summon {Volatile Zombies} when you exit Profane Veil equal to the number of minions consumed up to a maximum from the {Vampiric Pool} node.

{Zombies} summoned deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area per Intelligence.

20.description:
The benefits from the {Vampiric Pool} and {Apocalypse} nodes now also trigger when you kill enemies with Profane Veil.

The limit from {Vampiric Pool} remains the same.

21.description:
Profane Veil's base necrotic damage is converted to physical. Consequently this damage scales with increases to physical damage, but not increases to necrotic damage.

Profane Veil deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per 10% global Bleed chance on hit.

Swaps Profane Veil's {Necrotic} tag for a {Physical} tag.

22.description: You now cast {Bone Curse} when you enter and exit Profane Veil.
22.altText: If you have the {Forked Tongue} node then this also casts {Bone Curse} at the second area.

stats.statName: Bone Curse on you on Enter or Exit
Bone Curse at Target Location with Forked Tongue

23.description: You now create a secondary Profane Veil area that is detached from you and moves towards enemies, but Profane Veil now has a higher mana cost.
23.altText: The secondary area has the same movespeed as you, enemies can be damaged by both areas at once and it ends the end at the same time.

24.description: The secondary area from {Forked Tongue} is now created at the target location, but Profane Veil costs additional mana.

25.description: Profane Veil costs less mana and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

26.description: Profane Veil's area now applies {Mark for Death} to enemies, but entering Profane Veil applies {Mark for Death} to you.

27.description: When you apply {Mark for Death} to an enemy or yourself by any method, all your stacks of damned and poison on them spread to a number of nearby enemies.

stats.statName: Damned Spreads with Mark for Death
Poison Spreads with Mark for Death

28.description: While in Profane Veil, you consume 6 mana to cast a {Profane Orb} each second that seek out enemies.
28.altText: The Orb is affected by damage conversion nodes.

29.description: Increases the frequency of {Profane Orb} per 1% increased cast speed for {Curses} you have. Additionally, {Profane Orb} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per {Curse} on the target.

stats.statName: Profane Orb Frequency per 1% Cast Speed

30.description: Profane Veil costs less mana.

31.description: Profane Veil's area inflicts {Penance} to enemies, which is a {Curse} that causes enemies to take fire damage when they hit a target. Additionally Penance deals more damage per 1% of Damage Reflected (multiplicative with other modifiers).

stats.statName: Penance Damage per 1% of Damage Reflected

32.description: You now cleanse all negative ailments on you when you enter Profane Veil.

7.description: You have a chance for your echoes to spawn with the {Memory Amber} reward type.
7.altText:
Chance is similar to Exalted item rewards. With 100% increased chance, the chance is equal to Exalted item reward type.

Memory Amber is the currency used to increased your rank with The Woven faction. It can be used to buy Woven Echoes and is needed to respecialize your Weaver Tree.

8.altText:
Chance is similar to Exalted item rewards. With 100% increased chance, the chance is equal to Exalted item reward type.

Woven Echoes are echoes in the form of an item that can be placed on a Timeline Echo Web through the Altar of the Weaver.

11.description: You have a chance for a pile of gold to drop when you complete an echo objective.
