13.description: You have a chance for a pile of {Runes} to drop when you complete an echo objective.

21.description: Arena echoes no longer appear on your echo web.

22.description:
Beacons never appear.

Your echoes have a chance to contain additional spiderling packs.

23.description: {Arena} echoes are more common on your echo web.

24.description: Your {Arena} echoes have a chance to be replaced by more difficult {Super Arena} echoes, which contain additional {Champions}.
24.altText: Champions are more formidable Rare Enemies which drop more items and items with affixes tied to their modifiers.

25.description: {Beacons} in your echo web have a chance to be replaced by {Super Beacons}.
25.altText: Super Beacons reveal echoes further than a normal Beacon, but are guarded by more dangerous enemies.

41.description: Place a weapon or jewelry item to imprint it in this slot to have a small chance to drop a pile of similar items when killing enemies in your regular echoes.
41.altText:
Similar items are more likely to have the same rarity, sub type and affixes as the imprinted item. When imprinting a unique item, the similar items also have an increased chance of being the exact same unique.

Items dropped this way are affected by normal drop requirements and cannot be gifted without a resonance. They cannot include sub types, affixes, or uniques, that are not dropped by regular enemies.

42.description: Place an armor or weapon item to imprint it in this slot to have a chance to drop a pile of similar items when opening {Lost Caches} in your echoes.
42.altText:
Lost Caches are chests that contain lots of different valuable rewards.

Similar items are more likely to have the same rarity, sub type and affixes as the imprinted item. When imprinting a unique item, the similar items also have an increased chance of being the exact same unique.

Items dropped this way are affected by normal drop requirements and cannot be gifted without a resonance. They cannot include sub types, affixes, or uniques, that are not dropped by regular enemies

43.description: Place an armor or jewelry item to imprint it in this slot to have a chance to drop a pile of similar items as an extra reward when you receive echo rewards.
43.altText:
Similar items are more likely to have the same rarity, sub type and affixes as the imprinted item. When imprinting a unique item, the similar items also have an increased chance of being the exact same unique.

Items dropped this way are affected by normal drop requirements and cannot be gifted without a resonance. They cannot include sub types, affixes, or uniques, that are not dropped by regular enemies

44.description:
Place an item to imprint it in this slot to make {Champions} sometimes drop a pile of items of the same item type that always have a sealed affix matching one of the affixes on the imprinted item. 

The tier of the sealed affix can roll up to the tier of the corresponding affix on the item. The number of items in the pile is equal to the number of affixes on the item.
44.altText: Champions are more formidable Rare Enemies which drop more items and items with affixes tied to their modifiers.

45.description: Place a {Woven Echo} to imprint it in this slot for it to have a chance to spawn on your echo web when a new echo is generated.
45.altText:
Rarer Woven Echoes have lower chance to spawn.

Woven Echoes are echoes in the form of an item that can be placed on a Timeline Echo Web through the Altar of the Weaver.

46.description: Place a {Woven Echo} to imprint it in this slot for it to have a chance to spawn on your echo web when a new echo is generated.
46.altText:
Rarer Woven Echoes have lower chance to spawn.

Woven Echoes are echoes in the form of an item that can be placed on a Timeline Echo Web through the Altar of the Weaver.

51.description: You gain increased bonus {Timeline Stability} from killing enemies in your echoes.

53.description: {Rune Prisons} have a chance to spawn two {Exiled Mages} inside your echoes.

54.description: Your echoes have a chance to spawn a rare enemy alongside a pack from a specific dungeon, that drop that dungeon’s respective key and have a chance to drop the respective dungeon boss’s unique items.

stats.statName: Rare And Dungeon Enemy Pack Chance

55.description: Rare enemies in your echoes have a chance to drop a {Weaver’s Will} item.

stats.statName: Chance To Drop Weaver's Will Item

56.description: You have a 7% chance for {Zerrick} to join you in your echoes, who fights alongside you and increases your gold drops significantly.

57.description: {Nemesis} encounters are more common in your echoes.
57.altText: Nemeses are encounters that you can choose interact with and fight to claim their items.

58.description: {Lost Caches} drop an additional exalted item in your echoes.
58.altText: Caches are found throughout Eterra and the Monolith and when opened offer great rewards.

59.description: You have a chance for {Favor Caches} to spawn in your echoes.
59.altText: Caches are found throughout Eterra and the Monolith and when opened offer great rewards.

60.description: Boss objective echoes have a chance to contain two bosses instead of one. They deal more damage, have more health, and drop an additional unique item when slain.

61.description:
A random {Shade of Orobyss} can sometimes ambush you in your echoes.

This Shade has normal item drops and it scales off of distance, like any other Shade.
61.altText: Killing this {Shade of Orobyss} does not grant any corruption or reset your timeline.

62.description: All rare enemies are permanently {Enraged}, but they drop additional {Runes} and {Glyphs}.
62.altText: Enraged enemies have 35% increased movement speend and 60% increased attack and cast speed.

63.description: Killing {Shades of Orobyss} no longer grants corruption in your Timelines.

64.description:
Bosses and rare enemies in your echoes have a chance to be possessed by {Souls of the Erased}.

Additionally, some enemies in the last wave of your {Arena Echoes} have a chance to be possessed by {Souls of the Erased}.
64.altText:
Tombs can spawn in most regular Monolith Echoes, where you can find Memory Amber, Woven Echoes and additional Echo rewards.

Memory Amber can be spend to buy Woven Echoes and increase your Weaver Faction rank.

101.description: {Weaver's Will} value in unique items found in your echoes has a chance to be rolled twice and keep the higher value.

102.description: When a {Nemesis} escapes through a portal after being {Empowered}, it drops exalted weapons that can be upgraded if you kill a {Harbinger}.
102.altText: Nemeses are encounters that you can choose interact with and fight to claim their items.

103.description: You have increased drop rate of {Memory Amber} in your echoes.
103.altText: Memory Amber is the currency used to increased your rank with The Woven faction. It can be used to buy Woven Echoes and is needed to respecialize your Weaver Tree.

104.description: {Exiled Mages} in your echoes have a chance to drop a pile of items with +level of skill affixes.
104.altText: Exiled Mages are powerful mages. Free them and slay them to take their experimental items.

105.description: When a {Boss Woven Echo} drops it has a chance to be duplicated.
105.altText: Woven Echoes are echoes in the form of an item that can be placed on a Timeline Echo Web through the Altar of the Weaver.

121.description: {Cemeteries} are more common on your echo web.
121.altText: Cemeteries contain an Altar to the Weaver, where you can insert Woven Echoes into your current Echo Web. In Cemeteries you can collect Memory Amber as well as a Woven Echo when defeating the Altar Guardian boss.

122.description: {Tombs of the Erased} are more common on your echo web.
122.altText: Tombs can spawn in most regular Monolith Echoes, where you can find Memory Amber, Woven Echoes and additional Echo rewards.

Tombs can spawn in most regular Monolith Echoes, where you can find Memory Amber, Woven Echoes and additional Echo rewards.

124.description:
Your {Tombs of the Erased} have increased packsize.
Your {Arena} echoes have increased packsize.
Your {Arena} echoes drop {Memory Amber} on completion.

125.description: Rare enemies inside your {Tombs} and {Cemeteries} have an additional chance to drop {Woven Echoes}.

Cemeteries contain an Altar to the Weaver, where you can insert Woven Echoes into your current Echo Web. In Cemeteries you can collect Memory Amber as well as a Woven Echo when defeating the Altar Guardian boss.

126.description: Rare enemies in your {Tombs} and {Cemeteries of the Erased} have a small chance to drop that timeline's boss specific rewards.
126.altText:
Tombs can spawn in most regular Monolith Echoes, where you can find Memory Amber, Woven Echoes and additional Echo rewards.

Cemeteries contain an Altar to the Weaver, where you can insert Woven Echoes into your current Echo Web. In Cemeteries you can collect Memory Amber as well as a Woven Echo when defeating the Altar Guardian boss.

127.description: {Tombs} and {Cemeteries of the Erased} in your echoes have a chance to include a {Possessed Nemesis} encounter.
127.altText:
Tombs are side zones able to spawn in most regular Monolith Echoes. Tombs are a good source of collecting Memory Amber and finding Woven Echoes. Completing a Tomb also grants additional Echo rewards.

Cemeteries contain an Altar to the Weaver, where you are able to insert Woven Echoes direct into the Echo Web of your current Timeline. Like Tombs, Cemeteries are also a great source of Memory Amber as well as a guaranteed Woven Echo when defeating the boss guarding the Altar.

Nemeses are encounters that you can choose interact with and fight to claim their items.

128.description: Your {Tombs} and {Cemeteries} have a guaranteed {Rune Prison} with a {Posessed Exiled Mage}.
128.altText:
Tombs can spawn in most regular Monolith Echoes, where you can find Memory Amber, Woven Echoes and additional Echo rewards.

Cemeteries contain an Altar to the Weaver, where you can insert Woven Echoes into your current Echo Web. In Cemeteries you can collect Memory Amber as well as a Woven Echo when defeating the Altar Guardian boss.

Exiled Mages are powerful mages. Free them and slay them to take their experimental items.

129.description: You have a chance for {Masque} to accompany you in {Tombs} and {Cemeteries}. He provides defensive buffs and casts spells at enemies.
129.altText:
Tombs can spawn in most regular Monolith Echoes, where you can find Memory Amber, Woven Echoes and additional Echo rewards.

Cemeteries contain an Altar to the Weaver, where you can insert Woven Echoes into your current Echo Web. In Cemeteries you can collect Memory Amber as well as a Woven Echo when defeating the Altar Guardian boss.

130.description: {Silken Cocoons} have a higher chance to contain {Incubated Silk} in your echoes.
130.altText: Incubated Silk is a possessed and trapped soul incubating inside Silken Cocoons that will hunt and kill you.

131.description:
Completing a {Tomb of the Erased} or killing a {Shade of Orobyss} in your echoes has a chance to drop the {Confluence of Oblivion}.

The {Confluence of Oblivion} is a woven echo that is guarded by a {Gauntlet of Shades}.
131.altText: Tombs are side zones able to spawn in most regular Monolith Echoes. Tombs are a good source of collecting Memory Amber and finding Woven Echoes. Completing a Tomb also grants additional Echo rewards.

152.description: {Champions} have a chance to be accompanied by a {Blue} or {Green Loot Lizard}.

Your echoes have a high chance to spawn a {Champion}.

181.description: {Rift Beasts} are more common in your echoes.
181.altText:
Rift Beasts are enemies that gain different abilities depending on how they have evolved.
This node affects both the number of normally occuring Rift Beasts and the number of Rift Beast Ambushes from the {Primordial Ambush} node.

182.description: {Rift Beasts} that emerge from rifts are accompanied by other enemies from the Ancient Era that drop Ancient Bones when slain.
182.altText:
Rift Beasts are enemies that gain different abilities depending on how they have evolved.
Ancient Bones can be used to purchase items from Skarven Bloodhorn.

183.description: {Rift Beasts} have higher chance to have {Crystallized Hearts}, and Rift Beasts with Crystallized Hearts have more health and damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
183.altText:
Rift Beasts are enemies that gain different abilities depending on how they have evolved.
Rift Beasts that have Crystallized Hearts are more dangerous but drop their Crystallized Heart upon death. 
Crystallized Hearts can be used to purchase items from Skarven Bloodhorn.

184.description:
You have a chance to be ambushed by randomly evolved {Rift Beasts} in your echoes.

These Rift Beasts have a slightly higher chance to drop {Primordial Unique Items} that cannot be purchased from {Skarven Bloodhorn}.
184.altText:
Rift Beasts are enemies that gain different abilities depending on how they have evolved.
The number of evolutions for Ambushing Rift Beasts is random and can vary from 3 to 6 depending in corruption.
Primordial Unique Items are a type of Primordial item. Only one Primordial item can be equipped at a time.

185.description:
Most regular echoes in your echo web appear in {Echo Chains} rather than as single echoes.

Cemeteries and imprinted Woven Echoes appear to the sides of chains rather than inside them.

Beacons no longer appear.
185.altText: This does not affect the spawn rate of special echo chains, which can be revealed without this node.

stats.statName: Chance for Omens to spawn a void Champion

0.description: Target minion takes 3% max health per second for each second the shade has been active, but it and minions around it deal 25% more damage. Each minion only benefits from one Dread Shade aura. Expires after 20 seconds. Max 4 active shades.

2.description: Dread Shade costs less mana and has increased cast speed.

3.description: Dread Shade now grants minions armor based on your vitality, but Dread Shade decays your minions faster.

4.description: You can control one additional Dread Shade or Infernal Shade at once.

6.description: Dread Shade now grants frenzy to affected minions for a fixed duration after being cast.

7.description: Dread Shade now grants the targeted minion {Haste} while it persists, but it also applies a stack of ignite to the targeted minion each second.

8.description: Dread Shade drains your minions' health more slowly and all affected minions deal additional necrotic damage with spells and attacks.

9.description: Dread Shade has increased area of effect per active minion when cast, up to a maximum benefit.

10.description: Dread Shade no longer decays your minions' health, but instead inflicts a stack of {Everlasting Poison} each second.
10.altText: Everlasting Poison is the same as Poison, but does not expire.

12.description: The minion targeted by Dread Shade has additional critical strike chance and critical strike multiplier, but also has additional chance to be critically hit.

13.description: Dread Shade now roots the targeted minion and causes it to taunt enemies around it.

14.description: Dread Shade grants the targeted minion significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but Dread Shade no longer buffs other minions.

15.description: Dread Shade now increases the attack and cast speed of the targeted minion, but they have less critical strike chance (multiplicative with other modifiers).

16.description: Dread Shade grants affected minions increased attack and cast speed.

17.description: Minions affected by Dread Shade have a chance to inflict {Damned} to enemies they hit.

18.description: Dread Shade now inflicts {Damned} each second to all enemies and friendly minions in its area.

19.description: Dread Shade affects minions in a larger area.

20.description: Dread Shade affects minions in a larger area and grants more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but the targeted minion's health decays more quickly.

21.description:
Dread Shade applies {Mark for Death} to nearby enemies and minions when it expires.

Mark for Death is a curse that reduces all resistances by 25%. It cannot stack.

22.description: When any of your minions targeted by Dread Shade dies, it casts {Sacrifice} on additional minions, with each cast consuming mana equal to Sacrifice's mana cost.

23.description:
Dread Shade now attaches to enemies instead, still buffing your minions, but Dread Shade now has a duration, and this duration cannot be increased.

This does not buff or drain the health of enemies.

24.description: You are affected by the beneficial buffs of Dread Shade's aura.
24.altText: For example you will not apply {Doom Brand} to yourself.

25.description: Dread Shade now drains the health of other minions, and marks them with {Doom Brand}. When they die, the brand explodes dealing necrotic spell damage to surrounding enemies.
25.altText: Doom brand's explosion counts as your ability, not the minion's.

26.description: {Doom Brand} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

27.description: Dread Shade grants increased effect of all its buffs for each 3% of missing health on the targeted minion.
27.altText: If Dread Shade is cast on an enemy, the increased buff effect will be dependent on that enemy's missing health.

stats.statName: Increased Buff Effect Per 3% Missing Health

28.description: Casting Dread Shade refreshes the duration of your {Infernal Shades.} Each Infernal Shade can only be refreshed a maximum number of times.

stats.statName: Refresh Infernal Shade Duration On Cast

29.description: Dread Shade applies {Spirit Plague} to a nearby enemy whenever it expires.

30.description: When a minion targeted by a Dread Shade dies, you have a chance to summon a single {Volatile Zombie} from its corpse.

31.description: Dread Shade no longer drains the health of the minion it is attached to, but you are limited to one active Dread Shade. Increases to health drain from this tree instead increase damage taken by the minion.
31.altText: This does not affect your maximum number of infernal shades.

stats.statName: Health Drain Increases -> increased Damage Taken

32.description: Dread Shade now increases poison damage instead of necrotic damage, and converts added necrotic damage from the base skill and this tree to chance to poison on hit.

stats.statName: Poison Chance per 1 Added Necrotic Damage

34.description: Dread Shade grants affected minions more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

0.altText: Each point of strength increases armor by 4%, and improves skills that scale with strength, such as Warpath and Rive.

1.description: You have a higher chance to block hits and take less damage from hits that you block.
1.altText: Hits that are blocked deal less damage depending on your block effectiveness and the current area level.

2.description: Adds armour and reduces the damage you take from nearby enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers)

3.description: You have a 25% chance to gain health whenever you block.

4.altText: The base stun immunity lasts for 1 second after the stun has ended.
4.pointBonusDescription: You are immune to stuns for a longer duration after being stunned.

5.description: Adds physical damage to your melee attacks and increases their chance to stun.

6.description: You can dual wield melee weapons by equipping a sword in your off hand. While dual wielding, you have increased attack and cast speed, but take more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

stats.statName: Attack And Cast Speed While Dual Wielding

7.description: Whenever you hit an enemy you have a chance to throw an {Axe} at the nearest enemy, dealing physical damage to all enemies in its path. This effect has a 1 second cooldown.
7.altText: The {Axe's} damage scales with your strength and dexterity and with increases to physical damage and throwing attack damage.

stats.statName: Chance To Cast Axe Throw On Hit

8.altText: Movement skills are any skill that have the movement tag. Adding or removing the movement tag through that skill's tree will change its compatibility with this node.

stats.statName: Increased Cooldown Recovery Speed for Movement Skills

12.description: You leech a portion of your melee and void damage as health.

stats.statName: Reduced Bonus Damage Taken From Crits

16.description:
You have increased health.

Whenever you kill an enemy, you have a chance to absorb 5% of their health.

stats.statName: Chance To Absorb Health On Kill

17.description:
You have increased cast speed and you have a chance to cast a {Void Beam} at the target when you directly cast {Smite}. 

This effect can occur up to 2 times per 2 seconds.
17.pointBonusDescription: {Smite} now gains spell void damage per point of Vitality, but no longer gains increased damage per point of Attunement or increased healing effectiveness per point of Attunement.

stats.statName: Smite Void Spell Damage per Vitality

18.description:
Your melee hits deal increased void damage and instantly kill enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health).

If you have a similar effect from an item or passive node, then the highest threshold is used.

19.pointBonusDescription: Your Abyssal Echo has an additional chance to be echoed 1 second later, if it can echo.

22.pointBonusDescription: You have additional health per point of Vitality.

23.pointBonusDescription: You gain mana when a skill echoes. This effect has an 8 second cooldown.

24.description: If you take a hit that deals at least 25% of your max health as damage, consume a {Void Essence} to gain {Void Aegis} for 4 seconds, which grants a portion of your maximum health gained as endurance threshold.

stats.statName: Void Aegis When Taking Big Hit
Max Health -> Endurance Threshold With Buff

25.description:
You have a chance to gain a {Void Essence} on kill.

Void Essences last 8 seconds and grant 3% more void damage and 3% more melee damage (both multiplicative with other modifiers), and 15% reduced duration of stuns on you.

You can have a maximum of 3 Void Essences at once, and you cannot gain more than 1 every 4 seconds.

stats.statName: Void Essence Chance On Boss Or Rare Hit

27.description: You have a higher chance to block hits and take less damage from hits that you block.

28.description: If you have been hit recently you increased armor.
28.altText: Recently refers to the last 4 seconds.

29.description: You have additional armor for each hit you have blocked recently (last 4 seconds).

34.pointBonusDescription: You reflect damage back to attackers per percentage of your armor mitigation.

stats.statName: Damage Taken by Attackers when Hit

35.description:
You have a chance to cast a shield from {Ring of Shields} when you block a hit and you have additional block effectiveness per shield from {Ring of Shields}.

This effect can trigger up to 3 times every 6 seconds.

Additionally, your minions have increased health and armor.
35.altText: This does not put Ring of Shields on cooldown if you have it equipped.

stats.statName: Chance To Cast Shield On Block

36.description: You have increased mana regen and your melee and throwing attacks deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) based on their mana cost.
36.altText:
For example with 5 points in the node, a melee or throwing attack which costs 50 mana will gain 25% more damage.

Applies to all damage dealt by the attack, not just the damage of the initial hit.

stats.statName: More Damage Per 1 Mana Cost For Throwing Or Melee Attacks

37.description: You and your minions have a chance to inflict bleeding and ignite on hit. This bonus is doubled for you if you are using a two handed melee weapon.

stats.statName: Doubled for you with a 2h weapon

38.description: You and your minions have increased armor and chance to find potions if you have used a potion recently (last 4 seconds).
38.pointBonusDescription: You heal your minions for an amount equal to your armor when you use a potion.

stats.statName: Shared Increased Armor On Potion Use
Increased Chance To Find Potions On Potion Use

39.pointBonusDescription: After directly using an ability that costs 20 or more mana, your minions gain increased attack speed for a short duration.

stats.statName: Minion Increased Attack Speed On 20 Mana Cost Skill

40.description: Your melee attacks, throwing attacks, and void spells have a higher chance to be echoed 1 second later.

stats.statName: Time Rot Chance On Skill Echo

41.description: While you are using a shield you have additional armor.

42.description: You have additional Dexterity and you take reduced bonus damage from critical strikes.
42.altText: Each point of Dexterity adds 4 dodge rating and improves skills that rely on the skillfull handling of weapons, such as Lunge and Hammer Throw.
42.pointBonusDescription: Your dodge rating is converted to armor. This conversion occurs after modifiers such as increased dodge rating and increased armor are applied.

stats.statName: Reduced Bonus Damage Taken From Crits
Increased Throwing Attack Critical Strike Chance

45.pointBonusDescription: You have additional fire and physical penetration per 5 points of Strength.

46.pointBonusDescription: Your throwing attacks have additional base critical strike chance per 5 points of Dexterity.

47.description:
While you are using a shield you have additional elemental resistance and deal increased fire damage over time.

These effects also affect your minions.
47.altText: Overcapped refers to the amount of resistance above the normal 75% cap.
47.pointBonusDescription: You take less fire damage per point of {Overcapped} fire resistance, up to a maximum.

stats.statName: Shared Elemental Resistance with a Shield
Shared Increased Fire Damage over Time with a Shield
Less Fire Damage Taken Per 10% Overcapped Fire Res
Maximum Less Fire Damage Taken From Overcapped Fire Res

48.description:
You take less damage, and this effect is double if you have at least 50% block chance.

Additionally, you have an additional chance to block hits.

stats.statName: Doubled Less Damage Taken With 50% Block Chance

49.altText: Each point of vitality grants 6 health and 1% poison and necrotic resistance.

50.description: When you are hit you have a chance to counter attack enemies with {Retribution,} a melee physical attack that deals damage to nearby enemies. This effect has a 0.2 second cooldown.
50.altText: Retribution is a melee attack. Its damage scales with your strength and your modifiers to melee damage. This effect has a 0.2 second cooldown.

52.description: Your throwing attacks cost more mana, but shred physical and fire resistance.

53.description: You have additional melee and throwing physical and fire damage.
53.pointBonusDescription: Your Forge Strike and Smelter's Wrath penetrate enemy physical and fire resistances.

stats.statName: Physical Penetration With Forge Strike and Smelter's Wrath
Fire Penetration With Forge Strike and Smelter's Wrath

54.description:
While you have 3 or more {Void Essences,} if you drop below 0 mana, you consume 3 void essences to set your mana to 30% of your maximum mana pool.

This effect has a 4 second cooldown.

stats.statName: Consume 3 Void Essences To Refund Mana

55.description: {Retribution} deals increased damage and has additional chance to critically strike.
55.altText: Retribution is a melee attack. Its damage scales with your strength and your modifiers to melee damage. This effect has a 0.2 second cooldown.

56.description: Your critical strikes deal more damage for each passive point you have invested in the Void Knight tree.
56.altText: Your points in Void Knight are displayed on the buttons to the left.

stats.statName: Critical Multiplier Per Point Spent In Void Knight

57.description: Your hits have a chance to inflict enemies with {Time Rot} and whenever you kill an enemy afflicted with Time Rot, nearby enemies have a chance to be inflicted with Time Rot.

stats.statName: Time Rot Spread On Kill Chance

58.description: Your spells and attacks deal additional void damage.

59.pointBonusDescription: Your {Devouring Orb} immediately creates a {Void Rift} on cast.

stats.statName: Devouring Orb Creates Void Rift On Cast

60.description:
Your hits have a chance to inflict enemies with {Time Rot}.

Additionally, {Time Rot} deals more damage per 1% global chance to slow with void skills, more damage per 1% global {Time Rot} chance with void skills and more damage per 1% increased melee attack, throwing or cast speed, whichever is lowest, (all multiplicative with each other and with all other modifiers).

stats.statName: Time Rot Damage Per 1% Slow Chance With Void Skills
Time Rot Damage Per 1% Time Rot Chance With Void Skills
Time Rot Damage Per 1% Attack Or Cast Speed

61.description:
You deal more void damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

This effect is doubled if you have less than 30% block chance.
61.pointBonusDescription: You take less damage from slowed enemies and from time rotting enemies. These effects are multiplicative with each other and other modifiers.

stats.statName: Damage Taken From Time Rotting Enemies
Increased Melee Attack Speed With Sword

66.altText: Each point of attunement grants 2 mana and improves skills that rely on the innate magic inside you and your surroundings, such as Manifest Armour and Ring of Shields.
66.pointBonusDescription: A portion of your armor mitigation percentage applies to damage over time taken per 2 points of Attunement.

stats.statName: Damage Over Time Mitigation From Armor Per 2 Attunement

67.description: You take less damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers) and have additional physical resistance. These bonuses are doubled if you have used a potion recently.

stats.statName: Doubled if you have used a potion recently

68.description: You gain a bonus depending on the type of weapon you are wielding.

stats.statName: Increased Attack Speed While Dual Wielding
Reduced Bonus Damage Taken From Crits With Shield

69.altText: Increased healing effectiveness increases the health restored by healing skills only.

70.altText: Each point of attunement grants 2 mana and improves skills that rely on the innate magic inside you and your surroundings, such as Smite and Judgement.
70.pointBonusDescription: You have increased mana regen per 1% block chance above 50%.

stats.statName: Increased Mana Regen Per 1% Block Chance Above 50%

71.altText: Each point of attunement grants 2 mana and improves skills that rely on the innate magic inside you and your surroundings, such as Smite and Judgement.

stats.statName: Endurance Threshold Per 2% Uncapped Elemental Resistance

72.description: You are less likely to be stunned, you have a higher chance to block hits and you take less damage from hits that you block.

73.description: You have additional strength, and you have a chance to shred enemy fire resistance scaling with your Strength.
73.altText: Each point of strength increases armor by 4%, and improves skills that scale with strength, such as Warpath and Rive.

stats.statName: Fire Res Shred Chance Per 2 Strength

74.description: Whenever you hit an enemy with a melee attack you have a chance to cast {Divine Bolt,} a blast of holy energy that deals fire damage to a random nearby enemy. This effect can trigger up to twice per second.

stats.statName: Chance To Cast Divine Bolt On Melee Hit

76.description:
When you block you cast {Holy Symbol,} healing yourself and granting you ward over 3 seconds.

This effect has a 3 second cooldown.
76.altText: {Holy Symbol}'s health and ward granted both scale with increased healing effectiveness. It gains 4% increased healing effectiveness per point of attunement.

77.altText: Penetration can bring enemies below 0% resistance, causing them to take more damage. It applies to all damage, including damage over time.

78.description: {Holy Symbol} also heals allies in an area around you.

79.description:
You have increased melee and throwing attack speed.

Your melee attacks, throwing attacks, and void spells have a higher chance to be echoed 1 second later.

stats.statName: Increased Melee And Throwing Attack Speed

81.description: Your melee and throwing attacks have a chance to cause enemies to bleed, but you have a chance to inflict bleed when an enemy hits you with a melee attack.

stats.statName: Chance to Inflict Bleed When Hit

83.altText: Increased healing effectiveness increases the health restored by healing skills only.

84.description: Your hits have a chance to ignite.

86.description: You have an increased chance to critically strike and additional critical strike multiplier.

87.description: Bleed you inflict penetrates physical resistance, and you have a chance to be granted increased damage over time if you have received a stack of bleeding from {Penance} recently (last 4 seconds).

stats.statName: Fire Penetration Per 100% Increased Healing Effectiveness

89.description: You have a higher chance to block, you regain heath on block and stuns on you last a shorter duration, but you have a lower chance to dodge.

91.description: You have additional health and endurance threshold.
91.altText: Endurance reduces the damage you take below your endurance threshold. You have a base Endurance Threshold of 20% of your maximum health. Endurance is capped at 60%.
91.pointBonusDescription: Gain haste for 2 second on heal while you are below your endurance threshold. This effect has a 5 second cooldown.

stats.statName: Haste On Heal When Below Endurance Threshold

92.pointBonusDescription: Whenever you activate Holy Aura, it causes all of your ignite stacks on enemies in the Aura's area to deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

stats.statName: Increased Mana Regen From Holy Aura
Armor Mitigation Applies To Damage Over Time
Health Regen From Symbols Of Hope

96.description:
You have a chance to be granted a {Divine Essence} each second while at high health (above 65% of max health).

Divine Essences last 10 seconds and grant 15% increased armor and healing effectiveness. They also reduce damage over time you take by 5%.

You can have a maximum of 3 Divine Essences at once.
96.altText: Heal over time effects cannot grant a Divine Essence.

stats.statName: Divine Essence Chance Per Second On High Health

100.description:
Your {Manifest Armor} and {Forged Weapons} deal additional physical damage with their melee attacks.

Additionally, your {Forged Weapons} last longer.
100.altText: Forged Weapons are melee minions summoned on hit by Forge Strike
100.pointBonusDescription: You can now control additional {Forged Weapons}.

102.description: Your melee attacks, throwing attacks, and void spells have a much higher chance to echo, you have increased armor, but you have reduced melee attack speed and throwing attack speed and your skills cost more mana.

106.description: You regain mana and a portion of your missing health when you directly use {Rive}, {Vengeance}, {Smite}, or {Multistrike}.

107.description: You deal increased damage while you have a mace or sceptre equipped.

108.description: You have increased attack and cast speed while you have a sword or axe equipped.
108.altText: If you are dual wielding and have both an axe and sword equipped you still only receive the regular benefit from this node, not double.

110.description: While you have a shield equipped your blocks are more effective and you deal additional physical damage with throwing attacks.

stats.statName: Physical Throwing Attack Damage with a Shield

111.description: You have increased critical strike chance while wielding a 2 handed weapon.
111.pointBonusDescription: You gain additional critical strike multiplier, scaling with your Strength, while wielding a 2 handed weapon.

112.description: You and your minions gain increased fire and physical damage.
112.altText: Stalwart is the mastery passive buff that is gained when you are hit. It grants 5% increased armor for 10 seconds, stacking up to 10 times.
112.pointBonusDescription: When you directly use a melee area or throwing area ability that costs at least 10 mana you consume all stacks of Stalwart, causing that ability to deal damage in a larger area.

stats.statName: Increased Area Per Stalwart Stack Consumed

114.description: You have additional spell damage while you have a shield equipped.

stats.statName: Reduced Bonus Damage Taken From Crits

116.pointBonusDescription:
You gain {Mortal Cleave} when you hit an enemy that is on low health (below 35%).

{Mortal Cleave} grants you more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for 8 seconds.

stats.statName: Gain Mortal Cleave On Hit Against Low Health Enemy

118.pointBonusDescription: You deal more lightning damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers) per 2% added critical strike multiplier above the base 200%.

stats.statName: More Lightning Damage Over Time Per 2% Crit Multi

119.description: Holy Aura and Symbols of Hope have increased effect of their passive benefits.

stats.statName: Increased Holy Aura And Symbols Of Hope Effect

120.description:
You can equip a shield alongside a two handed axe, mace, sword, or spear.

While you have a two handed weapon and a shield equipped, you and your minions deal less damage and have less attack and cast speed, and Haste grants you block chance instead of increased movement speed.
120.pointBonusDescription: When you directly use a melee area or throwing area ability that costs at least 10 mana you consume all stacks of Stalwart, causing that ability to deal damage in a larger area.

stats.statName: Equip Shield and Two Handed Axe, Mace, Sword, or Spear
Less Damage for You and Your Minions
Less Attack and Cast Speed for You and Your Minions
Haste instead grants Added Block Chance

masteries.classDescription: A former soldier of Rahyeh’s army who left their ranks to pursue a more noble path.
A fallen knight who has taken part of the void inside themselves and uses it to devastate their foes even at the cost of their own life.
passiveBonuses: 75% increased melee void damage
Your melee attacks, throwing attacks and void spells have a 10% chance to be repeated by an echo 0.5s later (excludes movement abilities and Anomaly).

masteries.classDescription: A bulwark of strength and steel whose mastery of weapons, armor, and the animation of molten metal dominates the battlefield.
passiveBonuses: +35% physical and fire resistance
3% increased armor for each hit you have taken in the last 10 seconds

masteries.classDescription: You are a righteous warrior, your conviction empowering your allies and burning away the dark with righteous fire.
passiveBonuses: You deal increased fire, lightning, and physical damage equal to your percent health remaining.
1% increased healing effectiveness per point of attunement

0.loreText: Eterra will guide you, and her avatars will keep you safe.

2.description:
Your Spriggan can now use {Summon Vine}, melee minions that poison enemies they hit, up to a maximum of 6 Vines.

These Vines are not affected by your Vine limit or nodes on the {Spriggan Form} tree.

3.description: Your Spriggan's Summon Vine ability has a shorter cooldown.

4.description: Your Spriggan's summoned {Vines} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

5.description: Your Spriggan's {Summon Vine} ability now summons three vines at a time, but has a significantly longer cooldown (multiplicative with other modifiers).

6.description: Your Spriggan's summoned {Vines} have more health (multiplicative with other modifiers) and additional poison resistance.

7.description: Your Spriggan deals more spell damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

8.description: Your Spriggan's {Thorn Volley} has a chance to fire 2 extra Thorns.

9.description: Your Spriggan's {Thorn Volley} always fires 1 extra Thorn and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

10.description: Your Spriggan's {Thorn Volley} hits deal more damage to immobilized, stunned or frozen enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

stats.statName: Thorn Hit Damage To Immobilized Enemies
Thorn Hit Damage To Stunned Enemies
Thorn Hit Damage To Frozen Enemies

11.description: Your Spriggan's {Thorn Volley} hits deal more damage to poisoned enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

stats.statName: Thorn Hit Damage To Poisoned Enemies

12.description: Your Spriggan's {Healing Aura} and {Rejuvenating Wind} restore more health.
12.altText: Your spriggan's {Healing Aura} is a constantly active aura that affects all allies within a 20 meter radius of your spriggan.

13.description: Your Spriggan's {Healing Aura} now also grants allies additional spell damage.
13.altText: Your spriggan's {Healing Aura} is a constantly active aura that affects all allies within a 20 meter radius of your spriggan.

14.description: Your Spriggan's {Healing Aura} now also grants allies additional base critical chance and critical strike avoidance.
14.altText: Your spriggan's {Healing Aura} is a constantly active aura that affects all allies within a 20 meter radius of your spriggan.

15.description: Your Spriggan has more health (multiplicative with other modifiers).

16.description: Your Spriggan has additional armor and physical resistance.

17.description: Your Spriggan can now cast {Ensnaring Roots}, a wave of roots deals physical damage and roots enemies it hits for 1.5 seconds. Rooted enemies take physical damage over time until they are freed.

18.description: Your Spriggan's {Ensnaring Roots} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

20.description:
Thorn Volley's and Ensnaring Roots' base physical damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to physical damage. They also have a chance to freeze enemies.

Poison chance from all sources, for both skills, is converted to {Frostbite} and effects related to poison now depend on Frostbite instead.

21.description: Your Spriggan now casts {Ensnaring Roots} towards you whenever there are enemies around you, rather than it casting towards enemies near itself.

22.description: Your Spriggan's {Ensnaring Roots} has a shorter cooldown.

23.description: Your Spriggan's {Ensnaring Roots} lasts longer.

24.description: Your Spriggan's {Healing Aura} restores significantly more health to minions.
24.altText: Your spriggan's {Healing Aura} is a constantly active aura that affects all allies within a 20 meter radius of your spriggan.

25.description: Your Spriggan has a higher chance to freeze enemies. Your Spriggans Aura grants its allies a higher chance to freeze enemies.

26.description:
Your Spriggan's {Healing Aura} now also grants allies additional dodge rating per point of your Attunement.

This effect is doubled on minions.
26.altText: Your spriggan's {Healing Aura} is a constantly active aura that affects all allies within a 20 meter radius of your spriggan.

27.description: Your Spriggan's {Ensnaring Roots} now heals allies it hits.

28.description: Your Spriggan's {Ensnaring Roots} can no longer be dodged.

29.description: For each Spriggan you control, you and your Spriggans reflect flat damage to attackers per point of Vitality.

30.description:
Your Spriggan's {Healing Aura} grants additional effects based on the amount of active companions you have.
For each {Wolf}, it grants increased attack and cast speed.
For each {Storm Crow}, it grants increased mana regeneration.
For each {Raptor}, it grants additional critical strike multiplier.
30.altText:
Squirrels grant half as much increased attack and cast speed as Wolves.
If multiple players are providing Spriggans with these effects, only the strongest of each effect will apply.

Your spriggan's {Healing Aura} is a constantly active aura that affects all allies within a 20 meter radius of your spriggan.

stats.statName: Attack and Cast Speed per Wolf

31.description:
Your Spriggan's {Healing Aura} grants additional effects based on your active companions.
With a {Bear}, it grants a percentage of max health gained as endurance threshold.
With a {Sabertooth},  it grants increased dodge rating.
With a {Scorpion}, it grants increased area of effect.
31.altText: Your spriggan's {Healing Aura} is a constantly active aura that affects all allies within a 20 meter radius of your spriggan.

stats.statName: Maximum Health Gained As Endurance Threshold with Bear

0.description: Repeatedly casts Ice Shareds in a target direction.
0.loreText: None escape the wrath of winter

2.description: Ice Barrage hits have a higher chance to freeze enemies.

3.description:
When a target is frozen by Ice Barrage, you are granted increased cast speed for 4 seconds.

This effect can stack a limited number of times.

4.description:
Each ice shard released by Ice Barrage has a higher chance of freezing enemies than the previous shard.

This effect resets when Ice Barrage is recast.

stats.statName: Freeze Rate Multiplier Per Ice Shard

5.description: When Ice Barrage hits an enemy it has a chance to cast {Frost Nova}, a cold spell that damages nearby enemies.

6.description: Ice Barrage has a faster rate of fire.

7.description: You have a chance to gain ward on hit with Ice Barrage.

8.description: Ice Barrage deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but has a shorter duration.

9.description: Ice Barrage has a faster rate of fire, but you move more slowly while it is active.

10.description:
When you cast Ice Barrage you now also summon an {Ice Shield} in the target direction, a shield that blocks projectiles. Ice Shield lasts 2 seconds.

Ice Barrage has a longer cooldown.
10.loreText: They stood protected behind the Cryomancer, as his icy shield took the brunt of the force.

11.description: When {Ice Shield} expires it explodes, freezing nearby enemies.

12.description: {Ice Shield} lasts longer, but Ice Barrage has a longer cooldown.

13.description: While {Ice Shield} is active, you deal more global cold damage and take less cold damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

14.description:
Each ice shard released by Ice Barrage deals more damage than the previous shard (multiplicative with other modifiers).

This bonus stacks, but is reset on recasting Ice Barrage.

15.description: Ice Barrage has significantly increased fire rate, but while it is active all skills have increased mana cost.

16.description: Ice Barrage lasts longer.

17.description: Ice Barrage hits against bosses and rare enemies grant increased fire rate to the remaining hits. This effect stacks up to a cap.
17.altText: This bonus is additive with other sources of Increased Rate of Fire on this tree.

stats.statName: Increased Fire Rate Against Rare Enemies

19.description: Ice Barrage hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but no longer seek nearby enemies.

20.description: Ice Barrage creates a {Chilling Aura} around you. The aura repeatedly applies chill to nearby enemies for a duration. This effect can apply multiple stacks of chill to the same enemy.

21.description: Ice Barrage deals more cold damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has more critical strike chance.

22.description: Each ice shard cast by Ice Barrage has a chance to pierce all enemies (continue through enemies hit).

23.description: Ice Shards that pierce enemies have a chance to inflict them with {Frostbite}.

24.description:
Ice Barrage deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), and its ice shards become larger.

Ice Barrage has a slower fire rate, and there is a longer delay between each shard being created and released.
24.altText:
The fire rate modifier is multiplicative with other fire rate modifiers on this tree.

The change to the delay does not affect the frequence at which shards are created.

25.description: Ice Barrage now fire 5 ice shards in a cone in front of you, but has a slower fire rate and costs more mana.
25.altText: The fire rate modifier is multiplicative with other fire rate modifiers on this tree.

26.description: Ice Barrage releases ice shards in a wider cone.

27.description: Ice Shards cast by Ice Barrage shatter and deal cold damage in a cone behind the target. This does not work on piercing projectiles.

28.description: Ice Barrage deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a shorter cooldown, but now only lasts 1 second and fires 3 projectiles.
28.altText: This node does not prevent additional projectiles created with Wintry Blast or Ice Burst.

29.description: Ice Barrage has more critical strike chance against frozen targets (multiplicative with other modifiers).

stats.statName: More Crit Chance Against Frozen Targets

30.description: Ice Barrage hits deal more damage to frozen targets (multiplicative with other modifiers).

stats.statName: More Hit Damage To Frozen Targets

31.description: Ice Barrage instantly fires 5 ice shards in a cone.

32.description: Ice shards released via {Ice Burst} have a higher chance to freeze enemies, and deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

0.loreText: Unlimited power concentrated in a single crackling bolt

2.description: Lightning Blast chains an additional time for each Lightning Blast you have directly cast recently up to a maximum.
2.altText:
This raises the maximum chains from the base effect. It is not a separate counter.
Recently refers to the last 4 seconds. Does not include triggered casts of Lightning Blast.

stats.statName: Additional Chains Per Recent Direct Cast

3.description: Lightning Blast chains have increased range.

4.description: Lightning Blast has increased cast speed.

5.description: Lightning Blast hits deal more damage to chilled or shocked enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).
5.altText: These bonuses stack multiplicatively with each other if an enemy is both shocked and chilled.

6.description: Lightning Blast can now chain to you or your allies, granting increased damage and critical strike chance for 4 seconds. This buff cannot stack.

7.description: Lightning Blast hits have a chance to blind enemies.

8.description: Lightning Blast has a chance to create a {Spark Nova} around the first enemy hit. Spark Nova deals spell lightning damage to all enemies in a small area.

9.description: Lightning Blast hits have a chance to shock enemies.

10.description:
Lightning Blast now has a chance to freeze and its base lightning damage is converted to cold damage. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to lightning damage.

Shock chance from this tree is converted to chill chance.

11.description: Lightning Blast has a higher chance to freeze enemies.

12.description: Lightning Blast hits grant you ward.

13.description:
Lightning Blast is now a powerful channelled attack, hitting enemies caught within it but costs mana per second to channel and provides less ward when you hit enemies. You do not regenerate mana while channelling.

This is incompatible with the {Focal Blast} node. If you have taken both, this will not work.

Lightning Blast cannot double cast and only chains every 5th cast if it is channelled.

Lightning blast hits grant half as much ward from the {Positive Protection} node and have 50% reduced chance to apply ailments.

14.description: Casting Lightning Blast grants you ward per mana spent. This only counts the upfront mana cost, not the channelling cost if Lightning Blast is channelled.

15.description: Improves Lightning Blast's base critical strike chance, and Lightning Blast deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

16.description: Lightning blast can chain additional times, but costs more mana.

17.description:
Lightning Blast now deals damage to all enemies in a line, but no longer chains or forks. Lightning Blast hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for each time it would have chained (up to your maximum).

This node is incompatible with the {Insidious Conduction} node. If you have taken both, {Insidious Conduction} will not work.

stats.statName: Lightning Blast Deals Damage In A Line

18.description: Lightning Blast chains now hit the same target after a delay, but no longer chains to additional enemies. Lightning Blast chains half as many times rounded up.
18.altText: This effect overrides the forking behavior from {Divergence}.

stats.statName: Lightning Blast Chains Only To First Target Hit

19.description: Lightning Blast hits have added lightning damage, and Lightning Blast chains can fork in addition to chain.
19.altText: Lightning Blast hits an additional target when it forks. Forking counts as chaining for number of targets that it can hit.

stats.statName: Lightning Blast Can Fork Or Chain

21.description: When you cast Lightning Blast you have a chance to be granted {Lightning Aegis,} which grants 50% increased lightning damage and 25% less damage taken. Lightning Aegis causes an explosion of lightning damage when you lose 25% of your health or after 10 seconds.

22.description:
Lightning Blast has a chance to double cast, and Lightning Blast critical strikes deal more damage.

Lightning Blast cannot double cast if it is channelled or cast by another skill.

24.description: Lightning Blast deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but this damage bonus is lessened each time Lightning Blast chains.
24.altText: The less bonus damage per chain results in no bonus damage from this node on the fourth chain and beyond, but does not negatively impact your damage any further.

25.description: Lightning Blast hits have a chance to apply a {Spark Charge}.

26.description: {Spark Charges} applied by Lightning Blast deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

27.description: If Lightning Blast hits an enemy already affected by {Spark Charge} the Spark Charge explodes, dealing lightning damage to all nearby enemies.

28.description: While out of mana, Lightning Blast has no cost, but cannot chain.

30.description:
When double casting, Lightning Blast instead has a chance to quadruple cast.

Lightning Blast cannot quadruple cast if it is channelled.

32.description: Reduces Lightning Blast's channel cost if Lightning Blast cannot chain.
32.altText: Taking the {Arcing Power} node prevents this mana cost reduction even if your first lightning blast cast does not chain.

stats.statName: Mana Cost Per Second if Lightning Blast Cannot Chain

1.description: Bladestorms have an increased duration and lower mana cost.

2.description: Directly casting Bladestorm throws up to your maximum number of Bladestorms in a spread in front of you, but Bladestorm has additional mana cost.

3.description: Bladestorms have increased movement speed based on your dexterity.

4.description: Bladestorms gain more movement speed (multiplicative with other modifiers) for 1 second if you {Shift} through any part of the Bladestorm.

5.description: Each {Umbral Blade} thrown into a Bladestorm is destroyed upon landing to grant the Bladestorm more damage and radius (both multiplicative with other modifiers) for 4 seconds, up to 40 stacks.

6.description: Each Bladestorm created grants stacks of {Blade Frenzy}. Your next direct cast of Shurikens or Umbral Blades consumes all stacks to gain additional throwing damage and projectiles thrown per stack.

stats.statName: Blade Frenzy Stacks Gained per Bladestorm Created

7.description: Bladestorms cast {Shurikens} with increased frequency.

8.description: Bladestorms have a chance to shred armor on hit.

9.description: {Acid Flasks} which explode inside a Bladestorm deal more damage and have more radius (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

10.description:
Bladestorm has increased area with a two handed melee weapon or bow equipped.

Bladestorm has increased hit rate while dual wielding.
10.altText: Hit rate modifies how frequently Bladestorms hit enemies within their area.

stats.statName: Area with Two Handed Melee Weapon or Bow

11.description: Bladestorm has additional critical strike chance per equipped dagger, chance to inflict bleed on hit per equipped one handed sword, and additional critical strike multiplier with a two handed sword.

stats.statName: Bleed Chance per One Handed Sword
Critical Multiplier with Two Handed Sword

12.description: Bladestorm has increased area and increased attack speed.
12.altText: Modifiers to attack speed affect the time it takes to throw the Bladestorm, but not the frequency that it hits enemies within its area.

13.description: Bladestorm has additional critical strike chance.

14.description: Bladestorm deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

15.description: Bladestorm deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a lower mana cost.

16.description: Bladestorm has a chance on hit to inflict {Shadow Daggers}. This chance is doubled if the enemy is inside a {Smoke Bomb}.

17.description: {Blade Detonations} create {Caltrops} in the area. This effect can occur a limited number of times per 2 seconds.

18.description: You and allies hit by {Blade Detonation} gain Haste for a duration.

19.description: You gain mana each time you are hit by one of your own {Blade Detonations}.

stats.statName: Mana Gain When Hit By Blade Shatter

20.description: Bladestorm has a chance to inflict bleed on hit.

21.description: Bladestorm has a chance to slow enemies on hit.

22.description: Bladestorm slowly seeks out enemies.
22.altText: Bladestorms have a base movement speed of 3 meters per second.

23.description:
Bladestorms have more movement speed (multiplicative with other modifiers), and multiple Bladestorms can now hit the same target simultaneously.

Bladestorm has increased mana cost and duration. Your maximum number of Bladestorms is reduced.

24.description: Bladestorms repeatedly cast {Shurikens} at enemies within 10 meters of them, consuming 4 mana or Shurikens's mana cost, whichever is higher. This effect is only active while you are above half mana.

25.description: Bladestorms hit by {Shadow Cascade} will instantly hit enemies in their area.
25.altText: This instant hit still obeys the ability's normal rules for hits. For example, multiple Bladestorms can't hit the same enemy unless {Alloy Animation} is allocated.

stats.statName: Bladestorms Instantly Hit when Hit by Shadow Cascade

26.description: When your Bladestorms collide, they are destroyed and each cause a {Blade Detonation}.
26.altText: An enemy can be hit by Blade Detonations from multiple Bladestorms at once.

27.description:
Bleed chance from all sources is converted to poison chance for Bladestorm.

This node has no effect if {Frostblade} is allocated.

28.description:
Bladestorm's base physical damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold, but not increases to physical damage.

Bleed chance and poison chance from all sources is converted to frostbite chance.

0.description: Summons a ballista that fires fire arrows at nearby enemies.

2.description: Ballista costs significantly less mana, but has a shorter duration.

4.description: Ballista has a chance to shoot extra projectiles.

5.description: Ballista now also explodes when it expires or is destroyed. This explosion deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and hits enemies in a larger area based on your Dexterity.

6.description: Ballista has more attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers), but deals less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

7.description: Ballista has a chance to shred enemy armor.

8.description: Ballista has a chance to fire twice in quick succession.

9.description: Ballista now has shields in front of it.

10.description: Ballista bolts are lit on fire dealing additional fire damage and have a chance to ignite enemies.

11.description: Ballista has increased attack speed.

12.description: Ballista's bolts now explode on hit dealing fire damage in an area, but has less attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

13.description:
The explosion's base fire damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to fire damage. The explosion also has a chance to freeze enemies.

Ignite chance from inside this skill tree is converted to chill chance.
13.altText: The damage added by the {Flaming Shots} node is also converted to cold.

14.description: Ballista deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has more attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers), but has a shorter duration.

15.description: Ballista has more health and lasts longer.

16.description: Ballista has a chance to slow enemies.

17.description:
Hitting your Ballista with {Acid Flask} gives it a chance to poison enemies and more poison damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

If {Acid Flask} damage is converted to fire, this is instead ignite chance and more fire damage.

18.description: Ballista takes less time to place and has increased attack speed based on your Dexterity.

19.description: Your ailment modifiers also apply to your Ballista, but at a reduced ratio.
19.altText:
Your Ballista will receive your ailment chance, ailment duration, and ailment effect.
If you have 100% chance to inflict bleed on hit, 15% ailment stat ratio would give your Ballista 15% chance to inflict bleed on hit.

20.description: Ballista gains increased attack speed with each hit.

21.description: Your Ballistae gain {Frenzy} while you are standing near them.

22.description: Your damage modifiers also apply to your Ballista, but at a reduced ratio.

23.description: Ballista deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but has less attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

24.description: Ballista shields are wider.

25.description: Ballista deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) if constructed within 4 seconds of using a potion.

26.description: Improves Ballista's base critical strike chance.

27.description: Your critical strike chance and critical strike multipliers also apply to your Ballista, but at a reduced ratio.

28.description: Ballista bolts pierces enemies (continue through targets they hit).

29.description: Every 5 seconds Ballista shoots a {Harpoon Shot}, that sticks into an enemy and pulls them towards the Ballista.

31.description: Ballistae which have hit an enemy have a chance to drop a potion when destroyed, based on the time they existed.

32.description: When you construct a second ballista a tripwire is created between it and the existing ballista. Enemies that cross the tripwire cause both ballistae to explode.

0.loreText: The fury of one thousand winters.

2.description: Shatter Strike costs less mana and grants ward on hit.

3.description: Shatter Strike has a chance to inflict enemies with {Frostbite}.

4.description: {Frostbite} inflicted by Shatter Strike has additional Cold Penetration.

5.description: Shatter Strike hits convert all stacks of ignite on enemies into {Frostbite}.

6.description: Shatter Strike deals more damage, but has less attack speed (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

7.description:
Shatter Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

This effect is doubled against enemies at high health.
7.altText: Targets above 65% max health are considered to be at high health.

8.description: Shatter Strike deals damage in a larger area and penetrates enemy cold resistance.
8.altText: The cold penetration is affected by conversions to Shatter Strike's base damage.

9.description: Shatter Strike’s critical strikes deal more damage per equipped sword.

10.description: Shatter Strike's instant kill on frozen enemies occurs at a higher health threshold, and Shatter Strike has additional critical strike chance.

11.description: Shatter Strike grants mana when it kills an enemy, doubled if that enemy was frozen.

12.description: Shatter Strike pulls enemies towards a point in front of you.

13.description: Shatter Strike chills enemies, and has additional freeze rate based on its chill chance.

14.description: Shatter Strike grants {Haste} for two seconds when it kills a frozen enemy.

15.description: Shatter Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has increased area of effect.

16.description: Shatter Strike recasts after it finishes, but costs more mana and has less attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers). You can use other skills during the recasts.

17.description: Shatter Strike has increased attack speed with a one handed weapon equipped, and it has a chance to recast two additional times with a two handed weapon equipped.
17.altText: These additional recasts do not consume mana or affect the mana cost.

stats.statName: Attack Speed with One Handed Weapon
Chance for Two Recasts with Two Handed Weapon

18.description: You deal more cold damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and are more likely to freeze enemies if you have used Shatter Strike recently (past 4 seconds).
18.altText: The more damage granted is affected by conversions to Shatter Strike's base damage.

19.description: Shatter Strike hits grant a stack of {Ice Barrier} for 4 seconds, granting additional armor. This effect can trigger a limited number of times per 4 seconds.

20.description:
You take less cold damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for 4 seconds after hitting an enemy with Shatter Strike. 

This effect is doubled when hitting a frozen enemy.
20.altText: The less damage taken is affected by conversions to Shatter Strike's base damage.

stats.statName: Less Cold Damage Taken On Hit

21.description:
Shatter Strike hits grant ward.

This effect is doubled for hits against frozen enemies.

22.description:
Shatter Strike fires 8 {Ice Spikes}. Indirect casts create half as many Ice Spikes.

An enemy can be hit by both Shatter Strike and up to 1 Ice Spike from each cast.
22.altText: Affected by conversions to Shatter Strike's base damage.

23.description: {Ice Spikes} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). Ice Spikes from direct casts of Shatter Strike move faster, causing them to travel farther.
23.altText: {Ice spikes} are cold spells. They scale with intelligence, spell damage, and cold damage.

stats.statName: Ice Spikes Projectile Speed for Direct Casts

24.description: Shatter Strike has a higher chance to freeze enemies and costs less mana.

25.description:
Shatter Strike's hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

This effect is doubled against frozen enemies.
25.altText: Multiplicative with other modifiers

26.description: {Ice Spikes} have a chance on hit to create a random size {Glacier}, consuming a percentage of Glacier's mana cost.
26.altText: Modifiers to which sizes of {Glacier} explosions can occur will affect {Unrelenting Winter}.

28.description:
Shatter Strike's base cold damage is converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to cold damage.
Frostbite chance from all sources is converted to shock chance.
Swaps Shatter Strike's {Cold} tag for a {Lightning} tag.

Shatter Strike can no longer freeze enemies. Effects within Shatter Strike's tree which require a frozen target instead require that the target has 10 stacks of shock.

30.description: Shatter Strike deals more lightning damage per stack of shock on the target.
30.altText: The cold penetration is affected by conversions to Shatter Strike's base damage.

2.description: Smelter's Wrath charges up faster to reach its maximum area sooner.
2.altText: This does not affect Smelter's Wrath's damage while charging.

3.description: Smelter's Wrath hits have a chance to ignite enemies for each second channelled.

4.description:
Smelter's Wrath has additional critical strike chance for each second channeled.

Additionally, it has additional critical strike multiplier for each second channeled.

stats.statName: Added Critical Strike Chance Per Second

5.description: Smelter's Wrath has doubled crit chance and deals more damage when fully charged (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

stats.statName: More Crit Chance At Full Charge

6.description: When Smelter's Wrath is released, a duplicate attack is released in the opposite direction.
6.altText: This node has no effect if you have the Detonation node.

7.description: Smelter's Wrath deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for each second channelled.

8.description: While charging Smelter's Wrath you have more armor and endurance threshold (multiplicative with other modifiers)

9.description: Smelter's Wrath deals more melee damage and fire damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). These bonuses are increased by charging for longer.
9.altText: Melee fire damage benefits from both the melee and the fire damage bonuses from this node and they are multiplicative with each other.

10.description: Smelter's Wrath hits deal more damage (multiplciative with other modifiers) for each second channelled, but Smelter's Wrath charges more slowly.
10.altText: This charge speed modifier is also multiplicative with other modifiers

11.description: Smelter's Wrath hits deal more damage to ignited enemies per stack of ignite, up to a maximum of 150%.  This effect is multiplicative with other modifiers.

stats.statName: More Hit Damage Per Ignite Stack

12.description: Smelter's Wrath spews {Furnace} while charging, a fire spell that deals damage over time in a cone to enemies.
12.altText:
Furnace is not affected by stats per second charging, and its area is not affected by increased area for area skills.
Furnace's area is not affected by {Detonation}.

13.description: {Furnace} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

14.description: {Furnace} has a chance to ignite enemies each second.

15.description: {Furnace} has a chance to slow enemies each second.

16.description: {Furnace} has a chance to reduce enemy armor each second.

17.description: Smelter's Wrath hits have an increased chance to stun enemies per second channelled.

18.description:
Smelter's Wrath charges up slower to reach its maximum area later (multiplicative with other channel speed modifiers).

Additionally, Smeler's Wrath gains additional physical and fire penetration per second channeled.

19.description: When releasing a fully charged Smelter's Wrath you also release five throwing axes in a cone in front of you, a throwing attack dealing physical damage to enemies hit.

20.description: {Axe Volley} hits deal more hit damage per point of Dexterity.

stats.statName: Axe Volley Hit Damage per Dexterity

21.description: Smelter's Wrath converts your increased attack speed to increased critical strike chance.

stats.statName: Increased Attack Speed -> Increased Critical Chance

22.description: Smelter's Wrath hits deal more damage to rare enemies and bosses (multiplicative with other modifiers).

stats.statName: More Hit Damage Against Rares And Bosses

23.description: Smelter's Wrath hits instantly kill enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health). This kill threshold is doubled at maximum charge.
23.altText: If you have a similar effect from an item or passive node, then the highest threshold is used.

24.description: Smelter's Wrath hits have a chance to shred enemies' armor for each second channelled.

25.description: Smelter's Wrath now releases in a nova around you instead of a cone, but costs additional mana.

26.description:
When fully charged, Smelter's Wrath leaves behind a {Burning Patch} for 6 seconds which ignites all enemies who stand in it twice per second.

Smelter's Wrath costs additional mana.

28.description: Increased Area for Area Skills stats no longer increases Smelter's Wrath's charge speed and instead grants its more fire damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).
28.altText: This bonus does affect the {Furnace} sub skill if you have the Furnace node.

stats.statName: More Fire Damage Over Time per 1% Increased Area
Increased Area no longer affects Charge Speed

0.loreText: The strength of the python and the venom of the cobra are yours to channel

2.description: When Serpent Strike kills an enemy or hits a rare or boss enemy, you have a chance to summon a {Primal Serpent}.

stats.statName: Summon Chance on Rare or Boss Hit

3.description: Serpent Strike hits have a chance to instantly kill enemies that are below a threshold (a percentage of their maximum health).
3.altText: If you have a similar effect from an item or passive node, then the highest threshold is used.

4.description: Serpent Strike hits have a higher chance to freeze enemies.

5.description: Serpent Strike hits have a chance to inflict {Serpent Venom}, an ailment that deals poison damage over time and prevents enemies from landing critical strikes. It lasts 3 seconds and cannot stack.

6.description: Serpent Venom deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) based on your Vitality, and if you have 50 Vitality you regain mana when you inflict an enemy with Serpent Venom or refresh its duration.

stats.statName: Mana Gain with at least 50 Vitality

7.description: Serpent Strike hits have a higher chance to poison on hit and they deal more melee damage per stack of poison on the target, up to a limit.

8.description:
When you lunge forwards with Serpent Strike, if you have a {Scorpion} it casts its companion ability, {Venom Nova}, twice, once centred on itself, and once centred on you.

This effect has a 12 second cooldown, but ignores Venom Nova's regular cooldown and does not put it on cooldown.

stats.statName: Venom Novas on Lunge (12 Second Cooldown)

9.description: When you attempt to use Serpent Strike against a target that is slightly out of range you will lunge forwards before attacking.

stats.statName: Lunge if Slightly Out of Range

10.description: You gain a stack of {Constrictor} every 0.5 seconds, up to a maximum of 4. When you use Serpent Strike all stacks are consumed causing the attack to deal more damage per stack (multiplicative with other modifiers).
10.altText: The stacks are not multiplicative with each other.

11.description: Each stack of {Constrictor} also grants Serpent Strike additional poison chance and increased poison duration when consumed

12.description: You regain mana when you consume a stack of {Constrictor}.

13.description:
You gain {Slither} for 4 seconds when you use Serpent Strike and hit at least one enemy.

Each stack grants you more dodge rating (multiplicative with other modifiers).

14.description: Serpent Strike hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

15.description: Serpent Strike has increased attack speed.

16.description: Serpent Strike hits have a chance to shred enemy armor and posion resistance.

17.description: You regain health when Serpent Strikes kills or critically strikes an enemy.

18.description: Serpent Strike's critical strikes deal more damage.

20.description:
Serpent Strike now has a chance to freeze and its base physical damage is converted to cold damage. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to Frostbite chance.

21.description: {Primal Serpents} have increased melee attack speed and are granted health when they hit enemies with a melee attack.

stats.statName: Primal Serpent Health Granted On Melee Hit

22.description: {Primal Serpents} have more health (multiplicative with other modifiers) and additional armour

23.description: {Primal Serpents}'s hits have an additional chance to poison enemies and inflict {frailty}.

24.description: Instead of summoning a new serpent when the {Primal Serpent} node's effect triggers, you heal your current serpent to full health and it deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for 10 seconds. This damage buff can stack.
24.altText: This effect triggers when you kill an enemy and roll to summon.

26.description: Frosbite inflicted by Serpent Strike lasts longer and has additional cold penetration

27.description: You have additional dodge rating per cold resistance, for each stack of the {Slither} buff.

28.description: Each active stack of {Maelstrom} grants Serpent Strike additional chance to inflict bleed on hit and more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

29.description: Armour Shred inflicted by Serpent Strike has an increased effect based on your Dexterity.

30.description: Serpent Venom deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) based on the number of poison and frostbite stacks on them, up to a maximum benefit from each ailment.
30.altText: For example with 2 points invested, you can receive up to 200% more damage from poison by having 100 poison stacks on the enemy, and up to 200% more damage from frostbite by having 100 frostbite stacks on the enemy.

stats.statName: Serpent Venom Damage Per Frostbite Stack

31.description:
Serpent Venom deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) based on your melee critical strike chance.

If your melee crit chance is above 50% then Serpent Venom deals its damage twice as quickly. This does not increase the total damage it deals over its full duration, but rather halves its duration and doubles its damage per second.

stats.statName: Serpent Venom Damage per Melee Crit Chance
Serpent Venom Speed with >50% Melee Crit Chance

32.description: Ailments applied by Serpent Strike and {Primal Serpents} have additional poison penetration.

2.description: Flame Rush costs less mana and has a shorter cooldown. These effects are doubled if you have enough uncapped fire resistance.

stats.statName: Double Effects With 150% Uncapped Fire Res

3.description: Flame Rush deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per 40 current mana.

4.description:
Flame Rush now casts {Glyph of Dominion} at the target location instead of channeling and Flame Rush ends when reaching the Glyph.

This effect consumes mana equal to a portion of {Glyph of Dominion's} mana cost.
4.altText: You will always reach your target after 1.5 seconds, but modifiers to travel speed affect the maximum possible distance.

stats.statName: Glyph of Dominion At Target Location

5.description:
Flame Rush now casts {Volcanic Orb} that is attached to you and only detonates when you end Flame Rush, alongside any other active {Volcanic Orbs}.

This effect consumes mana equal to a portion of {Volcanic Orb's} mana cost.

6.description:
You take less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) during Flame Rush.

This effect is doubled against damage over time effects.

7.description: All buff effects from the Flame Rush tree persist afterwards for a portion of the time equal to the duration you spent in Flame Rush.
7.altText: This includes effects like ward per second and the less damage taken during Flame Rush effect from the base skill.

stats.statName: Buff Duration Equal To Time In Flame Rush

8.description: You gain ward per second during Flame Rush and you gain a burst of ward when Flame Rush ends.

9.description:
{Flame Rush's} base fire damage is converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to fire damage.

{Fire Resistance Shred} chance from all sources is converted to {Lightning Resistance Shred} for Flame Rush and effects related to Fire Shred now depend on Lightning Shred instead.

Swaps {Flame Rush's} {Fire} tag for a {Lightning} tag.

10.description:
Flame Rush now also casts a {Static Orb} in the opposite direction.
