This effect consumes mana equal to a portion of {Static Orb's} mana cost.

11.description:
{Flame Rush's} base lightning damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to lightning damage.

{Lightning Resistance Shred} chance from all sources is converted to {Cold Resistance Shred} for Flame Rush and effects related to Lightning Shred now depend on Cold Shred instead.

Swaps {Flame Rush's} {Lightning} tag for a {Cold} tag.

13.description: Flame Rush now inflicts {Brand of Subjugation} to enemies you pass through. The Brand does not stack but deals a large amount of cold damage over time and it deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per your chance to chill.

stats.statName: Brand of Subjugation On Pass Through
Brand of Subjugation Damage Per 1% Chill Chance

14.description: You are granted the {Frenzy} buff for a short duration when you end Flame Rush.

15.description:
You cast {Runic Invocation} when you exit Flame Rush, if you have it on your action bar.

This effect consumes mana equal to a percentage of {Runic Invocation's} mana cost.

16.description: Casting {Fireball} and then using Flame Rush in the same direction within 2 seconds causes that Flame Rush to deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area and grants you mana on cast.

stats.statName: Flame Rush Buff In Fireball Direction

17.description: Whenever you hit an enemy with {Fireball} during Flame Rush it causes a {Runic Burst} around the target.
17.altText: This can trigger at most once every 0.2 seconds.

stats.statName: Runic Burst On Fireball During Rush

18.description: Flame Rush now applies {Fire Resistance Shred} on enemies it passes through.
18.altText: This effect does not apply to the explosion.

stats.statName: Fire Shred Stacks On Pass Through

19.description:
Whenever you pass through an ignited enemy you gain ward and consume all your ignite stacks on that enemy. 

Consuming your ignite stacks this way grants you ward per your ignite stack on them, but they don't deal their remaining damage.

stats.statName: Ignited Enemy Ward Gain On Pass Through
Ward Gain Per Ignite On Pass Through

20.description:
Whenever you pass through an ignited enemy with Flame Rush, instead of gaining ward per stack of ignite on the enemy and consuming your ignite stacks without dealing damage, you lose 12 ward per stack of ignite and the ignite stacks instantly deal their remaining damage on the enemy.

If you do not have enough ward for this effect, a percentage of your remaining health is consumed instead, up to a maximum. Ignite stacks consumed this way deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per point of intelligence.
20.altText: This effect takes into account ignite stacks inflicted by Flame Rush itself.

stats.statName: % Of Current Health Consumed Per Ignite Without Ward

21.description: You travel faster and further with Flame Rush.

22.description: Flame Rush deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

23.description: Whenever you pass through a {Frost Wall} during Flame Rush it causes the explosion to deal damage in a much larger area and its chance to critically hit is doubled.

24.description: Every 0.4 seconds during Flame Rush you create a {Rune Ember}, up to a maximum. Every 0.25 seconds while not in Flame Rush you fire a {Rune Ember} at a nearby enemy if you have any.

stats.statName: Fire Rune Embers While Not In Flame Rush

25.description: {Rune Embers} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

26.description: Casting Flame Rush creates additional {Rune Embers}.

27.description: {Rune Embers} now pierce enemies.

28.description: You now have a chance to create a {Rune Ember} on kill during Flame Rush and you create {Rune Embers} faster during Flame Rush.

stats.statName: Rune Ember Frequency During Flame Rush

0.loreText: Fanning the flames of fury.

2.description: Flame Reave has increased attack speed and costs less mana, but travels more slowly, reducing its range.

3.description: Using Flame Reave grants 4 stacks of {Rhythm of Fire}. If you already have 12 stacks, Flame Reave instead consumes all the stacks to gain significantly more width, range, and damage (all multiplicative with other modifiers).
3.altText:
If you have the {Worldfire} node the damage and range increases apply as normal, but the width increase has no effect.

The use of Flame Reave that consumes the stacks does not generate any stacks itself. This results in stacks being consumed every 4 uses of Flame Reave by default.

4.description:
Directly using Surge, Fireball, Mana Strike, or Firebrand also grants stacks of {Rhythm of Fire}.

These skills cannot consume stacks of {Rhythm of Fire} and you cannot exceed the number of stacks required for Flame Reave to consume stacks, which is 12 by default.

5.description:
Flame Reave hits have a chance to apply {Spreading Flames}.

Flame Reave deals more fire damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

6.description:
Flame Reave hits have a chance to grant you {Frenzy} for 3 seconds.

In addition to Frenzy's base effect it now grants Flame Reave additional melee fire damage.

stats.statName: Flame Reave Fire Damage during Frenzy

7.description: Flame Reave hits deal additional melee fire damage per equipped sword.

8.description:
Half of Flame Reave's base damage is converted to lightning, meaning that this half of the damage scales with increases to lightning damage but not with increases to fire damage.

Fire damage bonuses from this tree now also apply to Lightning.

Ignite chance from this tree now also grants an equal amount of shock chance.

Flame Reave gains a {Lightning} tag.

stats.statName: Fire Damage modifiers on tree also apply to Lightning Damage
Ignite Chance from tree also grants Shock Chance

9.description: Flame Reave deals more fire damage (multiplicative with other modifiers)

10.description: When you directly use Flame Reave and kill an enemy or hit a boss or rare enemy, you cast {Fireball} at a random enemy within 6 meters. This effect can occur a limited number of times per 2 seconds, and consumes a percentage of Fireball's mana cost.

stats.statName: Fireball on Kill or Boss or Rare Hit

11.description: When you directly use Flame Reave and kill an enemy or hit a boss or rare enemy, you cast {Lightning Blast} at a random enemy within 6 meters. This effect can occur a limited number of times per 2 seconds, and consumes a percentage of Lightning Blast's mana cost.

stats.statName: Lightning Blast on Kill or Rare or Boss Hit

12.description: Flame Reave deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and it deals added melee damage based on your added spell damage.
12.altText: All types of added spell damage, such as added spell fire damage and added spell void damage, count and will be added as the corresponding type of melee damage.

13.description: Flame Reave deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

14.description: When you directly cast Flame Reave and consume {Rhythm of Fire}, you cast {Elemental Nova} with more area and damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). This effect consumes a percentage of Elemental Nova's mana cost.

stats.statName: Rhythm of Fire Casts Elemental Nova

16.description: Flame Reave now has a cooldown, but it expands and returns a second time. This can hit the same enemy two additional times.
16.altText: The additional expanding and returning hits from {Reflash} always have the 50% less damage penalty.

17.description: Flame Reave can store an additional charge and has increased cooldown recovery rate, but it also has additional mana cost.

18.description: Flame Reave returns to you. This can hit the same enemy again.
18.altText: Flame Reave's baseline damage penalty from expansion still applies, meaning a returning hit always has 50% less damage.

19.description: Each time Flame Reave returns, it pulls enemies to you and grants you {Haste} for a duration.

20.description: Flame Reave has additional critical strike chance, but deals damage in a narrower area.
20.altText: Does not make Flame Reave narrower if you have the {Worldfire} node.

21.description: When you attack with Flame Reave and critically strike at least one enemy you gain ward.

22.description: Flame Reave hits have a chance to ignite enemies.

23.description: Flame Reave hits deal more melee damage against ignited enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

24.description: Flame Reave melee hits have more critical strike chance against ignited enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

25.description: Flame Reave travels faster, increasing its range.
25.altText: Multiplicative with the reduced speed from the {Dancing Flames} node.

26.description: Flame Reave's critical strikes deal more damage.

27.description: Flame Reave deals damage in a larger area.

28.description: Flame Reave hits enemies in an expanding circle centered on you, but has less range and costs significantly more mana.

29.description:
You have a chance to cast {Fire Aura} when you directly use Flame Reave. Flame Reave has additional chance to Ignite on hit per active Fire Aura.

These effects are tripled if Flame Reave has a cooldown.

30.description:
Flame Reave requires fewer stacks of {Rhythm of Fire} to consume all stacks. This does not affect the bonuses from consuming stacks.

Additionally when Flame Reave consumes {Rhythm of Fire} stacks it gains additional critical strike chance.

0.loreText: All things eventually decay...

2.description: Aura of Decay applies poison and other ailments to enemies more frequently.

3.description:
Aura of Decay is converted to cold, inflicting frostbite instead of poison. Your chance to inflict frostbite applies to Aura of Decay at 100% effectiveness. 

All of its effects related to poison and poison resistance are converted to frostbite and cold resistance. Effects from Aura of Decay which granted less poison damage taken instead grant less cold damage over time taken.

Swaps Aura of Decay's {Poison} tag for a {Cold} tag.
3.altText: When converted, Aura of Decay no longer benefits from your chance to poison on hit.

4.description: While Aura of Decay is active, you have a chance when hit to cast {Freezing Blast}. This effect has a 4 second cooldown.

5.description: Aura of Decay applies Poison and other ailments to enemies more frequently, but drains mana each second.

6.description: Aura of Decay applies poison and other ailments to enemies more frequently, but also applies poison to yourself more frequently.

7.description: Poison and other ailments inflicted by Aura of Decay last longer. This does not include ailments that slow.

8.description:
Aura of Decay is converted to physical, inflicting bleed instead of poison. Your chance to inflict bleed applies to Aura of Decay at 75% effectiveness. 

All of its effects related to poison and poison resistance are converted to bleed and physical resistance. Effects from Aura of Decay which granted less poison damage taken instead grant less physical damage over time taken.

Swaps Aura of Decay's {Poison} tag for a {Physical} tag.
8.altText:
This node has no effect if {Cold Death} is allocated.
When converted, Aura of Decay no longer benefits from your chance to poison on hit.

9.description: Aura of Decay has a chance to shred the armor of nearby enemies every second. A percentage of your chance to shred armor on hit also contributes to this chance per second.
9.altText: For example if you have 3 points invested in this node and also have 100% chance to shred armor on hit, this node will grant a total of 105% armor shred chance per second.

stats.statName: Percent of Armor Shred Chance on Hit Contribution

10.description: Aura of Decay has a chance to slow nearby enemies every second.

11.description: While Aura of Decay is active, when using a traversal skill or {Evade} you leave behind a {Putrid Bomb}. Putrid Bombs explode after a 1 second delay and Poison all enemies they hit.

12.description: Enemies are inflicted with multiple stacks of poison when they hit you, but you also gain poison stacks when hit.

13.description: Allies within range are healed by Aura of Decay each second. Aura of Decay heals more health the less health you currently have.
13.altText: "Allies" includes you.

14.description: Minions within Aura of Decay’s area of effect have a chance to poison on hit, but are poisoned every second.

15.description: Minions within Aura of Decay’s area of effect deal more poison damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
15.altText: If Aura of Decay is converted to a different ailment, this effect causes minions to deal more damage over time of that ailment's damage type.

16.description: You gain {Fester} stacks faster while channeling.

stats.statName: Fester Stack Gain Rate while Channeling

17.description:
While Aura of Decay is active and you are stationary, you gain two stacks of {Fester} per second, up to a maximum. You lose two stacks per second while moving.

{Fester} grants your active Aura of Decay more damage per stack (multiplicative with other modifiers).
17.altText: Fester does not affect the damage of Aura of Decay's subskills.

stats.statName: Aura of Decay Damage per Stack

18.description: When you lose a stack of {Fester} or gain a stack while already at maximum stacks, you fire a {Poison Bolt} at a nearby enemy.

stats.statName: Poison Bolt on Stack Gain at Max Stacks

19.description: {Fester}'s maximum stacks is increased, and the rate at which you lose stacks while moving is reduced.

stats.statName: Fester Stack Loss Rate While Moving

20.description: You take less poison damage while Aura of Decay is active (multiplicative with other modifiers).

21.description: Enemies within Aura of Decay’s area of effect have less Poison Resistance.
21.altText: This does not apply the {Poison Resistance Shred} ailment, but instead stacks additively with it.

22.description: You and Enemies within Aura of Decay’s area of effect have less poison resistance for each point of intelligence you have.

24.description: You have a chance when you would lose a stack of {Fester} to instead gain a stack. Additionally, you lose Fester stacks at an increased rate while moving.

stats.statName: Chance to Gain Fester Stack Instead of Losing
Fester Stack Loss Rate While Moving

25.description: Enemies that die within Aura of Decay’s area of effect have a chance to emit a {Poison Nova}, which poisons all enemies it hits. This effect can occur a limited number of times per 3 seconds.

26.description: {Poison Nova} can occur an additional number of times per 3 seconds.

27.description: Aura of Decay has a chance to inflict nearby enemies with {Plague} each second, and Aura of Decay deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

28.description: Aura of Decay affects a larger area.

29.description: Aura of Decay has a chance to chill nearby enemies every second.

30.description: You have additional poison resistance while in Aura of Decay and you have increased health regeneration if you have deactivated Aura of Decay recently (past 4 seconds).

stats.statName: Poison Resistance in Aura of Decay

31.description:
Aura of Decay consumes mana every 15 seconds to emit a powerful {Defiling Nova}, as long as there is a boss or rare enemy nearby.

This effect occurs with increased frequency based on your uncapped poison resistance.
31.altText:
This effect can not be converted to other damage types.

While there is no boss or rare enemy nearby, the cooldown can still recover, but the effect won't trigger or start its cooldown.

Uncapped poison resistance is the amount of total poison resistance you have, ignoring the cap. For example at 3 points invested with 100% poison resistance, this effect will have 60% increased frequency.
Sources of increased cooldown recovery speed do not affect Defiling Nova.

1.description: You summon additional shields.

2.description: Every 6 seconds each Shield heals nearby allies.

3.description: When Shields heal allies, they also increase their armor for 4 seconds. This effect does not stack.

4.description: When Shields heal allies, they also grant them a non stacking increased block effectiveness buff for 4 seconds.
4.altText: You can only receive buffs from a single shield at a time. Increasing the number of shields will not increase the stats received. Shields do also buff each other.

5.description: While using {Warpath}, your Shields spin faster and take less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

6.description: Shields have increased healing effectiveness.

7.description: Ring of Shields costs less mana, but Shields have reduced health.

8.description: You are healed any time one of your Shields dies.

9.description: Shields shatter into {Shrapnel} when they die, dealing physical damage to surrounding enemies.

10.description: {Shrapnel} created by your dying Shields has a signficantly increased chance to stun enemies.
10.altText: {Shrapnel} deals physical damage to surrounding enemies.

11.description: You have additional chance to block and a higher block effectiveness if you have cast Ring of Shields recently (last 4 seconds).

12.description: You are invulnerable for 1 second after casting Ring of Shields, but you cannot move or use abilities.

13.description: While using {Shield Rush}, your Shields form a wall in front of you, increasing the area you hit.

14.description: Shields have a chance to slow enemies that hit them.

15.description: Shields push enemies away from you every 4 seconds.

16.description: Shields have increased health and additional physical resistance.

17.description: Ring of Shields lasts longer.

18.description: Consuming a potion also heals your Shields.

19.description: Shields reflect a percentage of damage taken to attackers.

20.description:
Shields take less fire damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), and have a chance to ignite enemies that hit them. 

If you have the {Collateral Damage} node the base physical damage of the {Shrapnel} it creates is converted to fire damage.
20.altText: The only direct source of damage that Ring of Shields can do is with the Shrapnel node.

stats.statName: Chance To Ignite Enemy When Hit

21.description: Shields now emanate {Forge Flames}, dealing fire damage over time to surrounding enemies.
21.altText: An enemy can be damaged by Forge Flames from multiple shields simultaneously.

22.description: Shields deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and shields rotate faster.

23.description: You deal additional fire damage with spells and attacks if you have cast Ring of Shields recently (last 4 seconds).

24.description: Shields rotate around you at a greater distance.

26.description: Ring of Shields summons additional Shields, but costs more mana.

27.description: Ring of Shields is cast at your target location instead, but Shields no longer follow you. Shields have more health (multiplicative with other modifiers) and last much longer.
27.altText: The health increase is multiplicative with other modifiers

28.description: You deal increased melee fire damage if you have cast Ring of Shields recently (last 4 seconds).

1.description: You leech a portion of Heartseeker's damage and it has an additional chance to {Recurve}.

2.description: Heartseeker has additional critical strike chance and its critical strikes deal more damage.

3.description: Heartseeker deals more bow damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) after each recurve, up to a maximum.

4.description: Heartseeker's hits have a chance to apply frailty and shred enemy armor, but it no longer seeks new targets when the first target dies.

5.description: When Heartseeker's target dies, you shoot {Puncture} at a nearby enemy for each {Recurve} it would have triggered after the target died.

6.description: Heartseeker has a chance on {Recurve} to grant you a {Dusk Shroud}, up to a maximum every 2 seconds.

7.description: When you directly use Heartseeker and hit at least one enemy, it has a chance to consume one of your {Shadows} to use Heartseeker at the same target.

8.description:
After a Heartseeker arrow {Recurves} at least 3 times, it has a chance to leave a {Black Arrow} between you and the target enemy if the enemy is at least 6 meters away.

This effect can occur a limited number of times every 3 seconds.

9.description: Heartseeker's hits cannot be dodged and it deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

10.description:
Heartseeker's base physical damage is converted to cold and it now has a base freeze rate. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Bleed chance on hit from all sources is converted to frostbite chance for Heartseeker.

Swaps Heartseeker's {Physical} tag for a {Cold} tag.
10.altText: This has no effect if you have taken the fire conversion node.

11.description: Heartseeker's hits have a higher chance to freeze and have a chance to chill enemies.

12.description: Heartseeker penetrate additional cold resistance scaling with your cold overcapped resistance.

stats.statName: Cold Penetration Per 10% Overcapped Cold Res

13.description:
Heartseeker's base physical damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to physical damage. 

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to ignite chance.

Swaps Heartseeker's {Physical} tag for a {Fire} tag.

14.description: Heartseeker has a chance to grant you a {Burning Dagger} on {Recurve} consuming mana.

15.description: Consecutive {Recurves} each grant a stack of {Dragonfang} for 10 seconds. Higher stacks can only be achieved by a higher amount of consecutive {Recurves}, up to a maximum of 20.
15.altText: If Heartseeker {Recurves} twice, you will get two stacks. If the next Heartseeker {Recurves} three times, the first two stacks are refreshed and you will gain a third stack.

16.description:
Directly using Heartseeker and hitting at least one enemy grants you frenzy for a short duration. 

This effect has a 10 second cooldown.

17.description: When directly used, Heartseeker arrows have a chance to grant mana and health on hit.

18.description: Heartseeker has increased attack speed and costs less mana.

19.description: Heartseeker's hits have a chance to poison enemies and poison it inflicts last longer.

20.description: Heartseeker's hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed and bleed it inflicts penetrate enemy physical resistance.

21.description: Heartseeker deals more ailment damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) after each recurve, up to a maximum.

22.description: Heartseeker has a chance to grant you {Crimson Shroud} on {Recurve}.

23.description: Heartseeker has an additional chance to {Recurve}.

24.description: Heartseeker has an additional chance to {Recurve}, and it deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but it now has a cooldown.

25.description: Heartseeker has additional charges.

26.description: Your Heartseeker restores a charge whenever you pick up a {Black Arrow}.

27.description: Heartseeker now has a minimum chance to {Recurve}.
27.altText: Its {Recurve} chance can't be reduced below its minimum {Recurve} chance.

28.description: Heartseeker has an additional chance to {Recurve} scaling with Dexterity.

29.description: Whenever Heartseeker {Recurves}, it extends the duration of your most recent {Hail of Arrows} by a small amount, up to 10 times per use of {Hail of Arrows}.

stats.statName: Hail of Arrows Duration On Recurve

30.description: Heartseeker now twists around in a semi-cirle to {Recurve} and its hits have a chance to slow enemies.
30.altText: The twisting and turning effect is only a visual change.

31.description: Armor shred chance from all sources is converted to poison chance.

0.loreText: Measure twice, cut thrice.

2.description: Rive deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has an increased chance to stun enemies.

3.description: When Rive kills an enemy or hits a boss or rare enemy, you have a chance to summon a {Forged Weapon}.

stats.statName: Forged Weapon chance on Hit vs Boss or Rare

4.description:
Rive's third strike {lacerates} enemies on it.

Lacerated enemies take melee damage over time for 3 seconds, with base damage equal to 300% of your added melee damage. Laceration does not stack.
4.altText: Added melee damage of all types is taken into account for Lacerate, but added melee damage without a type is applied as physical. For example if you have +20 Melee Damage and +10 Melee Fire Damage, Lacerate's base damage will be 60 Physical and 30 Fire.

5.description:
Rive's base physical damage is converted to void. Consequently this damage scales with increases to void damage, but not increases to physical damage or other damage types.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to chance to inflict {Time Rot}.

Swaps Rive's {Physical} tag for a {Void} tag. 

Additionally, your chance to {Echo} with Rive is doubled.
5.altText: Echoing is a Void Knight mastery bonus. It grants you a chance for your attacks to repeat after a second. This node's echo bonus has no effect unless you are a Void Knight.

6.description:
Rive deals additional melee physical damage per point of Dexterity if you are using a Sword.

Rive deals additional melee void damage per point of Vitality if you are using an Axe.

Rive deals additional melee fire damage per point of Attunement if you are using a Mace.

stats.statName: Physical Damage per Dexterity with a Sword
Void Damage per Vitality with an Axe
Fire Damage per Attunement with a Mace

7.description: Rive's third strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and restores mana if it hits at least one target.

8.description: Rive deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). This effect is tripled for {Echoes}.
8.altText: Echoing is a Void Knight mastery bonus. It grants you a chance for your attacks to repeat after a second. This node's echo bonus has no effect unless you are a Void Knight.

9.description: Rive's first strike has a chance to ignite enemies.

10.description: Rive's second strike has a chance to ignite enemies.

11.description: Rive's third strike consumes all stacks of ignite you applied to enemies it hits, granting you a buff that grants physical penetration per stack consumed, up to a maximum.
11.altText:
Ignite stacks applied by your minions or allies are not consumed.

If Rive is converted to Void this grants void penetration instead of physical penetration.

12.description: When you trigger {Flame Drinker's Blade's} effect you also gain an additional buff that causes you to leech a percentage of the damage you deal as health. Unlike the buff from Flame Drinker's Blade, this buff cannot stack.

13.description: Rive hits deal more damage to ignited targets (multiplicative with other modifiers).

stats.statName: More Hit Damage Vs Ignited Enemies

14.description: Whenever you would summon a {Forged Weapon} from any source, you instead gain a stack of Scrap Metal. Each stack grants more armour and more damage with Rive (multiplicative with other modifiers).
14.altText: Scrap Metal stacks have a base duration of 10 seconds, but modifiers to Forged Weapon duration now apply to Scrap Metal duration as well.

15.description: Rive's first and second strike have increased attack speed.

stats.statName: First And Second Strike Attack Speed

16.description: Improves Rive's base critical strike chance. This bonus is doubled for Rive's third strike.

stats.statName: First And Second Strike Base Crit Chance

17.description: Rive's first strike grants you increased critical strike chance on hit for 4 seconds. Stacks up to 4 times.

18.description: Rive's third strike has double crit chance and its critical strikes deal more damage, but strikes one and two can no longer critically strike.

stats.statName: First And Second Strike Never Crit

19.description: Rive's first and second strike have a chance to reduce enemy armor.

stats.statName: First And Second Strike Armor Shred Chance

20.description: Rive's first strike consumes mana to release a wave of energy that passes through enemies.

21.description: Changes Rive's sequence of strikes to {1, 2, 1, 2, 3.}

22.description: Rive's third strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and hits in a larger area, and has increased chance to stun enemies.

23.description: Rive skips its third strike.

24.description: If you are using a two handed weapon, stats on that weapon that directly add damage, increase damage or add a chance to apply an ailment on hit, have double effect for Rive.

stats.statName: Effect of Damage Stats on a 2h Weapon
Effect of Ailment Chance Stats on a 2h Weapon

26.description: Rive's second strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

27.description:
If you have positive mana, Rive's second strike pulls enemies.

Additionally, Rive's hits slow enemies.
27.altText: The area in which enemies are pulled is affected by Increased Area for Area Skills stats.

28.description: Rive's third strike deals damage in a larger area.

29.description: Rive's third strike leeches damage dealt as health.

30.description: Rive's third strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

31.description:
Rive's hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed. 

Additionally, bleeds inflicted by Rive's third strike last longer.

32.description: Rive's third strike instantly kills enemies below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health).
32.altText: If you have a similar effect from an item or passive node then the highest threshold is used.

1.description: Frost Wall has a chance to inflict a stack of Frostbite to enemies inside the wall every 0.25 seconds.

2.description:
One of Frost Wall's {Pillars} now casts {Lightning Blast} at nearby enemies when you first pass through the wall.

This effect consumes mana equal to {Lightning Blast's} mana cost.
2.altText: This requires you to be at positive mana when cast.

3.description:
Frost Wall's outer {Pillars} cast {Lightning Blast} at nearby enemies every other second.

This effect consumes mana equal to {Lightning Blast's} mana cost.

4.description: After Frost Wall has existed for a short duration, its outer {Pillars} cast {Lightning Blast} more often, up to a maximum, every time an enemy passes through the wall.

5.description:
After you pass through your Frost Wall your next {Runic Invocation} or {Glyph of Dominion} cast within 5 seconds is empowered. 

An empowered spell cast this way, costs less mana (multiplicative with other modifiers) and it also deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for each second the wall has existed, before you walk through it.

6.description: Frost Wall now cleanses negative ailments on you and your allies when they first pass through the wall.

stats.statName: Cleanses Negative Ailments On Pass Through

7.description: Frost Wall deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a higher chance to freeze enemies.

8.description:
Frost Wall now grants you and your allies ward and mana when they first pass through the wall.

These effects are doubled if the wall is placed at least 2 meters away from you.

9.description:
Frost Wall now grants the {Haste} and {Frenzy} buffs for a short duration, up to a maximum, when you and your allies when they first pass through the wall.

The maximum duration is equal to Frost Wall's age plus 1 second.

10.description: Frost Wall now creates three {Runic Detonations} shortly after you pass through it, dealing spell cold damage to nearby enemies.
10.altText:
This effect doesn't destroy the wall.

{Runic Detonations} can be converted to fire with the {Pyroglass} node and to lightning with the {Crackling Barrier} node.

An enemy can be hit by multiple detonations at once.

11.description: The {Runic Detonations} from {Runic Conclusion} intensify, destroying the wall in the process and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

12.description: The {Runic Detonations} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area if you are facing away from the wall when the detonations occur.

13.description:
You now cast Flame Ward on you or your allies (excluding their minions) that pass through your Frost Wall, if it has existed for at least 0.2 seconds.

Frost Wall now has a cooldown, which it shares with Flame Ward. Using one will put the other on cooldown.

stats.statName: Flame Ward On Ally Pass Through

14.description: If you haven't cast Frost Wall in the past 15 seconds, it has no mana cost and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

15.description: Frost Wall is larger and lasts longer.

16.description: You deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to chilled enemies while you have an active Frost Wall.

17.description:
Frost Wall deals more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers) per second the wall has existed.

This does not affect ailments or subskills.

stats.statName: Damage Over Time Per Second Of Existence

18.description: When you cast Frost Wall while having an existing wall active with more than half its duration remaining, the existing wall is moved to the new target location instead of being replaced and you gain mana equal to half the Frost Wall’s mana cost.
18.altText: This allows it to hit the same enemies or allies an additional time.

19.description: Frost Wall deals additional spell damage equal to a portion of your freeze rate multiplier.

stats.statName: Spell Damage Per 20% Freeze Rate Multiplier

20.description:
Frost Wall's initial freeze has increased duration, and the wall deals more damage over time to frozen enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

This does not affect ailments or subskills.

21.description: You are granted ward whenever enemies pass through the wall for the first time.

stats.statName: Ward Gain On Enemy Pass Through

22.description: Whenever an enemy passes through the wall for the first time, and after it has existed for 0.2 seconds, you gain ward equal to a small portion of the enemy's maximum health, up to a maximum amount of ward per enemy.

23.description:
{Frost Wall's} base cold damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to cold damage.

For Frost Wall, chill chance from all sources is converted to {Ignite}, and Frostbite chance from all sources is converted to {Fire Resistance Shred}.

Swaps {Frost Wall's} {Cold} tag for a {Fire} tag.

24.description:
Frost Wall now inflicts Brand of Trespass to enemies inside the wall. This Brand does not stack, but deals a large amount of fire damage over time.

Brand of Trespass deals more damage equal to your ignite chance.

stats.statName: Brand of Trespass On Enemy Pass Through

25.description:
Whenever an enemy passes through your Frost Wall, you have a chance to cast {Fireball} towards them.

This effect consumes mana equal to {Fireball's} mana cost.

stats.statName: Fireball Chance On Enemy Pass Through

26.description:
{Frost Wall's} base cold damage is converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to cold damage.

For Frost Wall, chill chance from all sources is converted to {Slow}, and Frostbite chance from all sources is converted to {Shock}.

Swaps Frost Wall's {Cold} tag for a {Lightning} tag.
26.altText: This node has no effect if Frost Wall is converted to Fire.

27.description:
Frost Wall now casts {Runebolt} in the original target direction the Wall was cast. The element of the bolts match the element of the Wall, regardless of {Runebolt's} tree.

This effect consumes 2 mana per projectile and does not cast if you are at negative mana.

28.description: Frost Wall casts {Runebolt} more often.

2.description: Your raptor has additional elemental resistance and have additional dodge chance.

3.description: Your raptor gains the ability to {Screech} at enemies, dealing damage and shredding their physical resistance. Screech has an 8 second cooldown.
3.altText: The damage and resistance shred of Screech can be converted by {Volcanic Adaptation}.

4.description: {Screech}'s cooldown is reduced, and it causes enemies it hits to {Bleed}.

6.description: Your raptor has increased cooldown recovery speed for its abilities.

7.description: Your raptor automatically reduces the cooldown of your other companions' activatable abilities by 3 seconds. This effect has an 8 second cooldown.
7.altText: Your Raptor's increased cooldown recovery speed applies to the cooldown of this effect.

stats.statName: Raptor Reduces Other Companion Cooldowns Every 8 Seconds

8.description: Your raptor deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has increased area of effect for its abilities.

9.description:
Your raptor becomes a {Dragon Raptor}. The base physical damage of your raptor's melee attacks are converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not with increases to physical damage.

Your raptor gains the {Fire Breath} ability, dealing spell fire damage over time with an 8 second cooldown.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to ignite chance for your raptor, and all effects in the tree related to bleed now depend on ignite.

10.description: {Fire Breath}'s cooldown is reduced, and it deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
10.altText: Using a town portal will reset this buff even if you return to the same zone.

11.description: Your raptor has increased attack and cast speed. This effect is doubled if it has killed an enemy in the past 4 seconds.

12.description: Your raptor deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

13.description: When a bleeding enemy dies within 12 meters, your raptor has a chance per stack of bleed on that enemy to gain Haste for 3 seconds.

stats.statName: Chance per Bleed for Haste on Enemy Death

14.description: Your raptor deals more melee damage per bleed on the enemy (multiplicative with other modifiers), up to a maximum.

stats.statName: Max More Melee Damage from Bleed

15.description: Your raptor's melee attacks have a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

16.description: Your raptor deals more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

17.description: Your raptor's attacks have a chance to inflict blind, poison, and slow on hit.
17.altText: Blinded enemies have 50% less critical hit chance and are less accurate at range. Does not stack.

19.description: When your raptor hits an enemy, bleeds on that enemy have a 25% chance to double in speed.

stats.statName: Chance On Hit To Double Bleed Speed

20.description: Your raptor deals more damage for each percent of its missing health (multiplicative with other modifiers), up to 50% missing health.
20.altText: At 2 points, this node gives the Raptor 198% more damage while it is at 1% health.

21.description: Your raptor has increased melee attack speed, but loses 5% of its current health with each attack while above 50% of maximum health.

stats.statName: Percent Of Current Health Lost On Melee Attack Above 50%

22.description: Your raptor gains increased effect from {Rampage}.
22.altText: Does not increase the size gain from Rampage.

23.description: Your raptor has additional critical strike chance.
23.altText: Base critical strike chance is 5%

24.description: {Rampage}'s duration is increased.

25.description: {Rampage} costs less mana.

26.description: Your raptor uses {Rampage} if it encounters a boss or rare enemy, if it is able to. This sets Rampage to 50% of its normal cooldown.

stats.statName: Raptor Rampages Near Rares And Bosses

27.description: {Rampage} also grants your raptor less damage taken for the duration.

28.description: While your raptor is {Rampaging}, its hits instantly kill enemies below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health).

29.description: {Rampage} also resets the cooldown of {Fire Breath}.
29.altText: Using a town portal will reset this buff even if you return to the same zone.

30.description: Your raptor has additional critical strike multiplier, and its attacks have a chance to shred armor on hit.

1.description: You have a chance to gain {Dusk Shroud} when you use Umbral Blades and hit at least one enemy.

2.description: You now throw just one large Umbral Blade with each throw that deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has increased radius.
2.altText: For subskills that scale with area such as {Bladestorm} and {Blade Explosion} the effect of this node's radius increase on the skills' area is additive with sources of increased area.

4.description: Umbral Blades has additional critical strike chance.

5.description: Umbral Blades has additional critical strike multiplier for each blade being thrown or recalled by the attack.

6.description: Umbral Blades hits inflict a stack of {Shadow Dagger} on hit, while using a dagger.
6.altText: This is not affected by Umbral Blades' reduction to ailment application chance.

7.description:
Umbral Blades deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of {Dusk Shroud} on you, up to 20. 

This effect is doubled while inside the area of {Smoke Bomb}.

stats.statName: Damage per Dusk Shroud, up to 20

8.description: Whenever one of your {Shadows} expire they now also leave behind an Umbral Blade.
8.altText: {Shadows} using Umbral Blades always throw a single Shadow Blade that deals 300% more damage.

10.description: Umbral Blades has increased attack speed and you gain ward on hit with recalled blades.

stats.statName: Ward Gain On Hit On Recall

11.description: Recalling the blades now sends each blade toward a different nearby enemy instead of to you, but recalled blades no longer pierce.
11.altText: If there are fewer enemies than blades, the remaining blades will go in random directions.

12.description: Recalled blades now have a chance to pierce enemies (pass through enemies it hits).

13.description:
You can now only recall blades by using {Shift}, rather than the combo itself.

You regain mana for each blade recalled.

14.description: Recalled blades deal more damage, but blades thrown out deal less damage (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

15.description: Recalled blade hits have a chance to slow enemies and a chance to cause them to bleed.
15.altText: These chances are not affected by Umbral Blades' reduction to ailment application chance.

16.description: Recalled blade hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of slow on the target and per bleed on the target, up to a maximum.

stats.statName: Recalled Blades Hit Damage Per Slow
Recalled Blades Hit Damage Per Bleed

17.description:
Umbral Blades hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed. 

When your blades are recalled you have a chance to gain {Haste} for 1 second.
17.altText: This bleed chance is not affected by Umbral Blades' reduction to ailment application chance.

18.description:
Converts bleed chance from all sources to poison chance for Umbral Blades and effects related to bleed now depend on poison instead. 

If you have the {Explosive Blades}, the explosion hit poisons enemies, but deals 80% less damage and it no longer deals any fire damage.

19.description: You now throw additional blades with Umbral Blades on the second throw.

20.description: Every 2 seconds you throw additional blades with Umbral Blades on the next throw.

stats.statName: Extra Blades On Next Throw Every 2 Seconds

21.description: Umbral Blades deals additional throwing physical damage.

22.description: You now throw a third time with Umbral Blades with 4 blades before recalling the blades.

23.description: You now throw additional blades with Umbral Blades on the third throw.

24.description:
Umbral Blades base physical damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to physical damage. It also has a chance to freeze enemies.

Swaps Umbral Blades' {Physical} tag for a {Cold} tag.

25.description: Umbral Blades hits have additional freeze rate and have a chance to chill enemies.
25.altText: This chill chance is not affected by Umbral Blades' reduction to ailment application chance.

26.description: Umbral Blades now throw towards a fixed distance in front of you, and you have increased attack speed with Umbral Blades.

27.description:
Blades in the ground now arm after 0.5 seconds, but can no longer be recalled and Umbral Blades has less attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers). If enemies walk over them the blades will cause a {Shard Explosion}, a subskill dealing physical damage in an area.

Blades expire and explode after 3 seconds if no enemies walk over them.

28.description: The {Shard Explosion} deals damage in a larger area and deals more damage per second the blade has remained on the ground (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

stats.statName: More Explosion Area Per Second On Ground
Explosion Damage Per Second On Ground

30.description: Recalled blades have a chance to create a {Shadow} at their position.

1.description: Your Falcon's other hits now have a chance to inflict {Falconer's Mark}.

stats.statName: Falcon Chance to inflict Falconer's Mark

2.description: Whenever the Falcon hits an enemy with {Falcon Strikes} it {Marks} them. Your next hit against a {Marked} target deals more damage and consumes the {Mark}.

4.description:
When you consume a {Falconer's Mark} your Falcon gains additional melee damage equal to a portion of your added melee damage, throwing damage, bow damage, or spell damage depending on the type of ability used to consume the mark.

This effect lasts 10 seconds and can stack a limited number of times.
4.altText: Stronger stacks can only be replaced by weaker stacks if their remaining duration is less than 2 seconds.

5.description:
Your Falcon now throws {Acid Flasks} for you. {Acid Flasks} thrown by the Falcon scale with your stats and your {Acid Flask} tree, but can apply {Falcon's Mark} from {Marking Strikes}.

This effect consumes mana equal to a portion of your {Acid Flask's} mana cost and has a 6 second cooldown.

6.description: Your Falcon has additional {Acid Flask} charges.

7.description: When you directly use {Acid Flask} your Falcon has a chance to gain additional {Acid Flask} charges.
7.altText: If the chance goes above 100% it means there's a chance for an additional Acid Flask charge.

stats.statName: Chance to grant Falcon Acid Flask Charges

8.description: Your Falcon deals more global damage per character level and per point of Dexterity (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

9.description:
Your Falcon deals more global damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). 

This effect is tripled for {Falcon Strikes}.

10.description: Your Falcon now more heavily prioritizes enemies close to you during combat.
10.altText: By default your Falcon, like other minions, takes proximity to its own position and to your position into account when deciding which enemies to target.

11.description: Your Falcon now heavily prioritizes enemies close to the target location of your most recent melee, throwing or bow attack.
11.altText: By default your Falcon, like other minions, takes proximity to its own position and to your position into account when deciding which enemies to target.

stats.statName: Falcon Prioritizes close to Recent Target

12.description:
Your Falcon deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

This effect is tripled against moving targets.

13.description: When your Falcon hits an enemy it has a chance to drop a {Black Arrow} at its location.

stats.statName: Black Arrow chance on Falcon Hit

14.description: A portion of your chance to inflict bleed, poison, shred armor, shred resistances, and slow on hit now also apply to your Falcon's hits.

15.description:
Your Falcon now uses {Feather Knives} at nearby enemies. This effect has a 10 second cooldown.

Your Falcon also throws a single Feather Knife whenever you consume {Falconer's Mark}.

16.description: A portion of your global throwing attack speed now applies to the Falcon's {Feather Knives} ability as increased cooldown recovery speed.

stats.statName: Throwing Attack Speed -> Increased Cooldown Recovery Speed

17.description: A portion of the highest of your global increased melee damage, increased throwing damage, or increased bow damage now apply to all your Falcon's damage.

18.description: Your critical strike chance modifiers now also apply to your {Falcon}, but at a reduced ratio.

19.description:
When you use a melee, throwing, or bow attack and critically strike at least one enemy, your Falcon gains a portion of your global melee, throwing, or bow critical strike multiplier respectively for 10 seconds.

This effect can occur at most twice every two second.

stats.statName: Crit Multi -> Falcon Crit Multi Buff after Attack

20.description: When you directly use a melee, throwing, or bow attack and hit at least one enemy, you reduce a portion of {Falcon Strike's} remaining cooldown.

stats.statName: Remaining Cooldown Reduction after skill use

21.description: After the first hit of {Falcon Strike} your Falcon lets out a {Screech} which slows and applies {Frailty} to enemies around it.

22.description:
Your Falcon's {Screech} now also fears enemies it hits.

Additionally, your Falcon moves to you when a hit leaves you at low health, and this effect will interrupt any skill it is currently using.

This effect can occur at most every 10 seconds.

stats.statName: Falcon Screech on you at Low Health

23.description: {Falcon Strikes} hits addtional times and your {Falcon} has increased melee attack speed.

24.description:
{Falcon Strikes} instantly kill enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health).

If you have a similar effect from an item or passive node then the highest threshold is used.

25.description: {Falcon Strikes} now cause your Falcon to swoop down in a line in front of you attacking all enemies in that line rather than hitting enemies individually.

26.description:
A portion of your global increased area for area skills now applies to the width of {Falcon Strikes}.

Additionally, {Falcon Strikes} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) if you have directly used an area skill in the past 8 seconds.

stats.statName: Falcon Strikes Damage after Area skill use

27.description:
If {Falcon Strikes} kills an enemy it will hit an additional time.

Additionally, when {Falcon Strikes} hits a boss or rare enemy it has a chance to hit an additional time.

stats.statName: Additional Falcon Strikes hits on kill
10% chance for Additional hits on Boss or Rares

28.description: When your Falcon kills an enemy or hits a boss or rare enemy it restores health and mana to you based on your total attributes. This effect can occur from hits a limited number of times per 3 seconds.
28.altText: The effect is not limited for kills, and kills do not contribute to the hit effect limit.

29.description:
When you consume {Falconer's Mark} you gain the {Falcon's Wake} buff for a short duration. 

This buff grants you increased movement speed, attack and cast speed.

30.description: Consuming a {Falconer's Mark} instantly recovers {Falcon Strike's} cooldown, but it now also costs additional mana.

2.description:
Flame Ward grants increased fire damage while active

If Flame Ward is converted to cold or lightning, then this damage increase is also converted.

3.description: Flame Ward's retaliation hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

4.description: Flame Ward's retaliation is centered on the enemy that hits you, but it hits in a smaller area.

5.description: Flame Ward's retaliation hits in a larger area.

6.description:
Flame Ward is converted to Cold. This converts the base damage of the retaliation, granting it a freeze rate, and converts any fire damage modifiers from nodes on this tree.

This also globally converts {Fire Aura} to cold and grants it a Freeze Rate.

stats.statName: Fire Aura Freeze Rate Per Second

7.description: Flame Ward grants armor while active.

8.description: Flame Ward grants additional block chance, block effectiveness, and ward on block while active.

9.description: Flame Ward's retaliation hits have a higher chance to freeze enemies.

10.description:
Flame Ward is converted to Lightning, unless it has been converted to cold. This converts the base damage of the retaliation, and any fire damage modifiers from nodes on this tree.

This also globally converts {Fire Aura} to lightning, unless it has been converted to cold.

11.description: Flame Ward costs less mana. Flame Ward and Fire Aura last longer.

12.description: While active, Flame Ward grants you {Fire Aura}, a spell that deals fire damage over time to surrounding enemies.

13.description: {Fire Aura} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). This also effects Fire Aura from sources other than Flame Ward.
13.altText: {Fire Aura} is a spell that deals fire damage over time to surrounding enemies.

14.description: Flame Ward grants ward over time while active.

15.description: Flame Ward grants increased ward retention while active.

16.description:
Flame Ward grants additional fire damage to attacks and spells while active.

If Flame Ward is converted to cold or lightning, then this added damage is also converted.

17.description: Flame Ward grants additional ward.

18.description: You take less damage from hits while Flame Ward is active (multiplicative with other modifiers).

19.description: Flame Ward reduces elemental damage taken while active (multiplicative with other modifiers).

20.description:
Flame Ward can be cast on allies.

This has no effect if you have taken the {Mental Aegis} node.

21.description: Flame Ward costs less mana.

22.description: Mana now absorbs damage while Flame Ward is active. Each point of mana shields 5 health and ward.

23.description: Flame Ward grants increased mana regeneration while active.

25.description: Flame Ward grants additional ward, but has a shorter duration.

27.description: Flame Ward grants significantly more ward, but no longer retaliates.

28.description: Flame Ward grants additional ward equal to a percentage of your missing health.

stats.statName: Percent Of Missing Health Granted As Ward

29.description: Flame Ward grants more ward, but has a longer cooldown.

30.description: Flame Ward can store an additional charge, allowing you to use it twice before it goes on cooldown.

31.description: Flame Ward is cast when you are stunned, if it is off cooldown and you have positive mana.

33.description: You have {Haste} while Flame Ward is active.
33.altText: {Haste} grants 30% increased movement speed. Does not stack.

34.description: Enemies around you are knocked back when you use Flame Ward

0.loreText: As they sow, so shall they reap.

2.description: Tornado lasts longer.

3.description: Tornado has increased pull strength.

4.description: When you use Tornado, you have a chance to create an additional Tornado, but Tornadoes have reduced pull strength.

5.description: Tornado casts {Storm Bolt} at an enemy within 8 meters every 2 seconds.
5.altText: Affected by modifiers to Storm Bolt, including its targeting area.

6.description: Tornado casts {Storm Bolt} more frequently.
6.altText: Storm Bolt scales with increased spell damage and lightning damage, but not with other nodes on this tree.

7.description: Tornado deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but costs more mana.

8.description:
Tornados' base physical damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Tornado deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
8.altText: Fire tornado scales with increases to fire damage, not physical damage.

9.description: Tornado is now stationary, but deals less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

10.description: Tornado deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and attach to you wherever you move, but you can no longer cast additional Tornadoes at once.

stats.statName: Can No Longer Cast Additional Tornadoes

11.description: {Storm Bolts} target enemies from further away.
11.altText: Storm Bolt scales with increased spell damage and lightning damage, but not with other nodes on this tree.

12.description: Tornado now create a {Storm Orb} every second, but Tornado has less cast speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).
12.altText: Storm orbs explode after one second dealing physical damage to nearby enemies.\n\nStorm orbs scale with increases to physical damage and spell damage, but not with other nodes on this tree.

13.description: Tornadoes cast {Storm Orbs} more frequently.

14.description: Tornado ignites nearby enemies every second.

15.description: Tornado gains a portion of your chance to ignite with fire spells as ignite chance per second.

stats.statName: Ignite Chance On Hit -> Ignite Chance Per Second

16.description: Tornado has increased cast speed and area of effect.

17.description: Casting Tornado grants {Aspect of the Storm} for 2 seconds, which grants 10% increased movespeed.
17.altText: You can only have one instance of Aspect of the Storm at once.

18.description: {Aspect of the Storm} now also grants increased attack and cast speed.

stats.statName: Aspect of the Storm Attack Speed
Aspect of the Storm Cast Speed

19.description: Tornado costs less mana, and {Aspect of the Storm} grants increased mana regeneration.

stats.statName: Aspect of the Storm Mana Regen

20.description: {Aspect of the Storm} lasts longer.

21.description: Tornado is now instant cast and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but now has a 4 second cooldown.
21.altText: If Tornado is a channelled skill, this node does not make it cast instantly, but the damage modifier and cooldown still apply.

22.description: Tornado has a shorter cooldown and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

23.description: Tornado is now a channelled skill, sustaining a single tornado that follows your cursor. This tornado deals much more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has an increased area of effect. Modifiers to duration affect its damage instead.
23.altText: Modifiers for the channelled tornado do not apply to indirect casts of tornado.

24.description: While channelling Tornado you take less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), and have increased dodge rating.

2.description:
Void Cleave hits ignite enemies and half of its base damage is converted to fire, meaning that this half of the damage scales with increases to fire damage but not with increases to void damage.

Ignite inflicted by Void Cleave gains additional fire penetration based on your increased void damage.

Void Cleave gains the {fire} tag.
2.altText: Generic increased damage is not taken into account for adding fire penetration for ignite. Neither is more void damage or increased melee void damage. Only increased void damage has any effect.

stats.statName: Fire Penetration with Ignite per 10% increased Void Damage

3.description:
All of Void Cleave's base void damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to void damage.

Additionally your next non-channeled fire attack or spell after Void Cleave deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

Void resistance shred chance from all sources is converted to fire resistance shred and effects related to void resistance shred now depend on fire resistance shred instead.

Void Cleave loses the {void} tag.

stats.statName: Void Res -> Fire Res Shred Chance
Damage On Next Fire Attack Or Spell

4.description: When you use Void Cleave and hit at least one enemy, your minions gain a stack of {Molten Infusion} for 4 seconds, granting them additional melee fire damage and a chance to ignite enemies.

5.description: Minions only gain a stack of {Molten Infusion} when you directly hit them with Void Cleave, but {Molten Infusion} has significantly increased effect.

stats.statName: Molten Infusion Only On Minion Hit

6.description: You can travel farther with Void Cleave and it deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

7.description: After channelling {Warpath} for at least 2 seconds your next Void Cleave within 1 second deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

8.description: Void Cleave deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in an increased area.

9.description: Improves Void Cleave's base critical strike chance and it cannot be dodged.

10.description: Void Cleave deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to enemies on high health.
10.altText: Targets above 65% max health are considered to be at high health.

11.description: Void Cleave hits apply {Critical Vulnerability} and Void Cleave has increased critical strike chance.

12.description: Void Cleave critical strikes deal more damage and you gain mana with Void Cleave critical strikes.

13.description: If Void Cleave hits at least one enemy your next {Erasing Strike} is always a critical strike.

14.description:
Void Cleave deals additional melee void damage. 

This effect is tripled for echoed Void Cleaves.

15.description: Void Cleave deals significantly more melee void damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to enemies on low health.
15.altText: Targets below 35% max health are considered to be at low health.

stats.statName: Melee Void Damage To Low Health

16.description: Void Cleave hits slow enemies, have increased stun chance and increased stun duration.

17.description: Void Cleave has a shorter cooldown.

18.description: Void Cleave hits shred enemy void resistance.

19.description:
You cast {Abyssal Echoes} after using Void Cleave.

Abyssal Echoes cast this way uses its mana cost.

20.description: Void Cleave hits inflict enemies with {Time Rot}.

21.description: When you use Void Cleave you gain {Ravaging Aura} for a short duration scaling with the amount of enemies hit up to 10.

22.description: {Ravaging Aura} deals additional spell void damage and has an increased area of effect.

23.description: {Ravaging Aura} leeches a portion of the damage it deals as health.

24.description: If Void Cleave hits at least one enemy your next throwing attack inflicts enemies with {Time Rot}.

stats.statName: Time Rot Stacks For Next Throwing

25.description: Void Cleave deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of {Time Rot} on the target.

26.description: Void Cleave hits shred enemy armor and {Armor Shred} applied by Void Cleave has increased effect and duration.

27.description: If Void Cleave hits at least one enemy your next throwing attack deals additional void damage.

28.description: You can store an additional charge of Void Cleave, but Void Cleave costs more mana.

29.description: Void Cleave deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of bleed up to a maximum.
29.altText: This effect is based on ignite rather than bleed if you have the [Riftflame] node.

30.description: Your increases to physical damage also apply to fire damage for Void Cleave.

32.description: You can travel much further with Void Cleave (multiplicative with other modifiers), but it has a longer cooldown and now counts as a {Traversal} skill.
32.altText: Using a Traversal skill puts all other traversal skills on cooldown and traversal skills' cooldowns do not recover while you are using a traversal skill.

0.loreText: Rahyeh's wrath can fall on anyone.

2.description:
Directly casting Smite consumes 10 mana to cause a {Fissure} underneath the target, dealing fire damage to enemies who stand on it.

{Fissure} lasts 3 seconds, and can be triggered once per second.
2.altText: Fissure can be converted to void by {Fallen from Grace}, or to lightning by {Order of Lagon}.

3.description: {Fissure} deals damage in a larger area.
3.altText: {Fissures} are summoned at Smite targets, dealing fire damage in an area to enemies who stand on it.

4.description: {Fissure} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
4.altText: {Fissures} are created at Smite targets, dealing fire damage in an area to enemies who stand on it.

5.description: {Fissure} instantly kills enemies that are below a health threshold (percentage of their maximum health).
5.altText: If you have a similar effect from an item or passive node, then the highest threshold is used.

6.description: {Fissures} can be triggered more frequently.
6.altText: For example with 1 point in Aftershock, Fissure can be triggered up to 2 times per second.

7.description: When you directly cast Smite, you appear at Smite's targeted location, dealing physical damage to surrounding enemies. Smite costs more mana, has a cooldown, and counts as a {Traversal} skill.
7.altText:
Descends damage scales with modifiers to spell damage.

Using a Traversal skill puts all other traversal skills on cooldown and traversal skills' cooldowns do not recover while you are using a traversal skill.

8.description: Smite hits knock enemies back.

9.description: Smite heals in a larger area.

10.description: You deal additional melee fire damage if you have hit an enemy with Smite recently (last 4 seconds).

11.description: You have increased attack and cast speed if you have hit an enemy with Smite recently (last 4 seconds).

12.description: Being healed by a direct cast of Smite has a chance to cleanse all negative ailments, such as ignite and chill, from you and allies.

13.description: When you are out of mana Smite is free, but cannot heal, cleanse, or create {Fissures}.

14.description: Being healed by Smite grants you or your allies increased health and mana regeneration for 4 seconds (does not stack).

15.description: When you directly cast smite, you have a chance to double cast. The additional cast does not incur a mana cost and cannot teleport you if you have the Descend node.

16.description: Smite hits have a chance to ignite enemies.

17.description: Smite hits deal more damage to ignited enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).
17.altText: Deals more Hit Damage to Electrified or Slowed enemies if converted to Lightning or Void respectively.

18.description:
Smite hits have a chance to apply {Spreading Flames}.

Additionally, Smite deals more fire damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

19.description: Enemies killed by Smite have a chance to explode, dealing fire damage to nearby enemies.

20.description: Smite hits have a chance to blind enemies and deal more damage to blinded enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

21.description:
Smite's base fire damage is converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to fire damage.

Ignite chance from all sources is converted to electrify chance for Smite and effects related to ignite now depend on electrify instead.
21.altText:
Secondary effects like Fissure and Spreading Flames are unaffected.

This node has no effect if Smite is already converted to void.

22.description: Smite hits also cast a {Lightning Bolt} at 3 nearby enemies, dealing lightning damage. Smite costs more mana.

23.description: Electrify applied by Smite has increased duration and additional Lightning Penetration

24.description: {Lightning Bolts} created by Smite hit additional enemies.

25.description: Improves Smite's base critical strike chance.

26.description: Smite critical strikes deal more damage.

27.description: Smite heals allies for more health.

28.description: The {Sacrifice} node costs less health.

30.description: Smite deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but Smite consumes a percent of your current health on cast.

31.description: Smite has a chance to {Electrify} on hit.

32.description:
Smite's base fire damage is converted to void. Consequently this damage scales with increases to void damage, but not increases to fire damage.

Ignite chance from all sources is converted to {Time Rot} chance for Smite and effects related to ignite now depend on {Time Rot} instead.

Smite no longer heals.

0.loreText: The quick hunter catches the prey

2.description: Your sabertooth has more health (multiplicative with other modifiers) and recovers a percentage of its maximum health when it leaps.

3.description: Your sabertooth has additional cold resistance and it has a chance to chill attackers that hit it. It also has more health (multiplicative with other modifiers).

4.description: All physical damage dealt to your sabertooth is converted to cold damage. Consequently it is reduced by cold resistance, but not by physical resistance.

5.description: Your sabertooth has increased attack speed. Additionally, it deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) with {Flurry Swipes}.

6.description: Your sabertooth has more dodge rating (multiplicative with other modifiers), and it gains additional dodge rating for each point of Dexterity you have.
6.altText: This scales with your dexterity, not the dexterity of your sabertooth.

7.description: When your sabertooth directly uses a melee attack and hits at least one target it has a chance to use {Flurry Swipes}.

8.description: Your sabertooth deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and its melee attacks have increased area.

9.description: Your sabertooth has additional critical strike chance.

10.description: Your sabertooth has additional critical strike multiplier.

12.description: Your sabertooth has increased attack speed.

13.description: Your sabertooth gains Frenzy for 2 seconds after using {Flurry Swipes}.

14.description: While your sabertooth is on low health it deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and leeches a portion of the melee damage it deals as health.
14.altText: Low health is defined as below 35% of maximum health.

15.description: Your sabertooth deals more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

16.description: Your sabertooth deals additional cold damage with spells and melee attacks.

17.description:
Your sabertooth becomes an {Ice Tiger}, converting 100% of its base melee physical damage to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not with increases to physical damage. The ice tiger's melee attacks have a freeze rate equal to twice their base damage.

All bleed chance is converted to frostbite chance for your ice tiger.

The ice tiger's melee attacks' {Physical} tags are swapped for {Cold} tags.

18.description: Your sabertooth deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of chill on the target.

19.description: Your sabertooth has a a chance to inflict frostbite and chill on hit.

20.description: Your sabertooth has additional Freeze Rate Multiplier and it has more Freeze Rate per stack of Chill on the target (multiplicative with other modifiers)

21.description: Your sabertooth deals additional cold melee damage based on your dexterity.
21.altText: This includes abilities granted from this tree.

22.description: Your sabertooth deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has an increased chance to stun enemies, but your Sabertooth can no longer leap.

23.description:
Your sabertooth's attacks which hit at least one enemy have a chance to trigger {Upheaval}. Upheaval cast in this way uses your sabertooth's stats, but your Upheaval tree.

This chance is halved if Upheaval creates multiple fault lines.
23.altText: If Upheaval creates totems, those totems still count as created by you, using your minion stats.

stats.statName: Halved Chance with Multiple Fault Lines

24.description: When your sabertooth leaps, it uses {Upheaval} when it lands

25.description: When your sabertooth leaps you gain {Haste} for a duration.

stats.statName: You gain Haste when your Sabertooth Leaps

26.description: Your sabertooth's {Flurry Swipes} inflict Bleed on hit and if you or your Sabertoth are below half health it always crits.
26.altText: This scales with your dexterity, not the dexterity of your sabertooth.

stats.statName: Flurry Swipes Crit Chance if You or Sabertooth are below 50% Health

27.description: Your ancestral sabertooths have increased duration per point of your attunement. Additionally, your sabertooth gains attunement scaling equivalent to its strength scaling.

stats.statName: Attunement Scaling Equivalent to Strength Scaling

28.description: Your sabertooth's hits now have a chance to summon an {Ancestral Sabertooth} that attacks nearby enemies for a short duration. This effect can trigger a limited number of times per 5 seconds.

29.description: Your sabertooth's hits have a higher chance to summon {Ancestral Sabertooths} and they deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

30.description: Your sabertooth's hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed and a chance to shred armor.

0.loreText: All shall fall before swirling path of war

2.description:
Warpath deals additional melee void damage. 

This effect is doubled while wielding a 2 handed weapon.

4.description:
Warpath's base physical damage is converted to void. Consequently this damage scales with increases to void damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Warpath has a chance to inflict {Time Rot}. Bleed and ignite chance from all sources are converted to Time Rot chance for Warpath.

Swaps Warpath's {Physical} tag for a {Void} tag.
4.altText: The added chance is not affected by Warpath's reduction to ailment application chance, the converted chance is affected as normal.

stats.statName: Bleed And Ignite -> Time Rot Chance

5.description: Warpath hits deal more damage against enemies per stack of {Time Rot} on them (multiplicative with other modifiers).

6.description: While spinning, you have additional block chance and block effectiveness.
6.altText: You can block without wielding a shield.

7.description: Warpath deals damage in a larger area while wielding a two handed weapon.

8.description: While spinning, you gain mana every three seconds while wielding a two handed weapon.

9.description:
Warpath hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed and bleed stacks inflicted by Warpath have increased duration.

Both effects will instead apply to ignite or time rot if you have {Earthscorcher} or {Apocalypse Whirl}.
9.altText: The chance is not affected by Warpath's reduction to ailment application chance.

10.description:
Warpath's base physical damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to ignite for Warpath.

Swaps Warpath's {Physical} tag for a {Fire} tag.
10.altText: This node has no effect if you have taken the {Apoclypse Whirl} node.

11.description: While spinning, you leave behind a burning trail that ignites enemies each second. If ignite has been converted to {Time Rot} with {Apocalypse Whirl} this trail inflicts Time Rot instead.
11.altText: The width of the trail does not scale with area modifiers.

stats.statName: Ignite Stacks In Trail Each Second

12.description: Warpath deals damage in a larger area.

13.description: While spinning, you have increased movement speed.

14.description:
Warpath deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

This effect is doubled while using a two handed weapon or dual wielding.

16.description: While spinning, you have additional spell damage.

17.description: While spinning, you and your allies are healed each second within Warpath's area of effect. The amount of health gained is increased by healing effectiveness.

18.description:
While spinning, you have a chance to cast {Smite} each second on a nearby enemy.

This consumes Smite's mana cost.

19.description: Warpath hits deal more melee fire damage to ignited enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers) and ignite it inflicts has additional Fire Penetration

20.description: For each second you continuously spin, Warpath deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has increased area, but costs additional mana per second. These effects will stop scaling after a duration.
20.altText:
This effect only applies to Warpath when it is directly used.
After the maximum scaling duration ends, the effects still apply, but they will stop growing.

21.description: After spinning for at least 2 seconds you do a {Warslash} when you stop spinning. This deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area for each second you spent spinning, up to a maximum duration.

22.description: Warpath deals more melee damage to enemies on low health (multiplicative with other modifiers).
22.altText: Targets below 35% max health are considered to be at low health.

23.description: Warpath costs less mana per second.

25.description: While spinning, you have additional melee leech while wielding an axe, additional base crit chance while wielding a sword, additional physical penetration while wielding a mace and additional fire penetration while wielding a sceptre.

stats.statName: Global Melee Health Leech With Axe
Global Base Critical Chance With Sword

27.description: Warpath costs significantly less mana per second, but you have reduced elemental resistance while spinning.
27.altText: You can add resistances through other means to mitigate this reduction.

28.description: Warpath hits shred enemy armor.
28.altText: The chance is not affected by Warpath's reduction to ailment application chance.

29.description: While spinning, you summon {Forged Weapons} every 5 seconds as if you had hit an enemy with {Forge Strike}.

30.description: While spinning, you summon {Forged Weapons} more frequently.

31.description:
While spinning, you deal increased void damage and you have a chance each second to create an {Echo} at a recent location that uses Warpath on the spot for 2 seconds. This chance is equal to twice your chance for skills to echo.

You can only create a Warpath echo if you have been spinning for at least 2 seconds and have travelled at least 4 metres in the past 2 seconds.
31.altText: Echoing is a Void Knight mastery bonus. It grants you a chance for your attacks to repeat after a second. This node's echo bonus has no effect unless become a Void Knight.

32.description:
While spinning, you cast {Abyssal Echoes} every 5 seconds.

This consumes Abyssal Echoes' mana cost.

1.description: Soul Feast has increased cast speed and costs less mana.

2.description: Soul Feast no longer requires targets to be {Cursed} and no longer has a target limit, but now hits all enemies a small cone in front of you.

3.description: Soul Feast deals damage in a larger area and has a chance to apply {Frailty} on hit.

4.description: Soul Feast deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but {Soul Fragments} grant less ward.

5.description: If you go 2 seconds without directly casting Soul Feast you gain a stack of {Infernal Hunger}. When you next cast Soul Feast directly, all stacks of {Infernal Hunger} are consumed to cast Soul Feast an additional time per stack.
5.altText: Average number of recasts is equal to the number of points in the node.

stats.statName: Extra Casts per Stack of Infernal Hunger
