6.description: Damned inflicted by Soul Feast has additional necrotic penetration.
6.altText: This increases both the damage of Damned and its reduction to health regen.

7.description: Soul Feast costs less mana and can hit more targets.

8.description: Soul Feast's hits have a chance to poison enemies on hit.

9.description: Casting Soul Feast grant you a chance to poison enemies with all hits for 4 seconds, but also inflicts you with poison. This buff cannot stack.

10.description:
Soul Feast consumes poison stacks you applied on the target, granting you more armor (multiplicative with other modifiers) and additional poison resistance per stack.

This buff lasts 6 seconds and can stack a maximum number of times.

Poison stacks applied by minions or other party members are not cleansed and are not counted for the buff.
10.altText: The armour modifiers from individual stacks are not multiplicative with each other, just with all armour modifiers from other sources.

11.description: {Soul Fragments} grant additional ward based on your intelligence.
11.altText: The effect of this node is not rounded. If it granted you 1 ward additional ward per 25 intelligence, but you only had 10 intelligence, it would grant 0.4 additional ward.

12.description:
Soul Feast's base necrotic damage is converted to physical damage. Consequently this damage scales with increases to physical damage, but not increases to necrotic damage.

{Soul Fragments} now restore health instead of granting ward. The health restored is equal to the ward you would have been granted.

13.description:
Soul Feast has a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

Physical ailments inflicted by Soul Feast deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) based on your missing health.

stats.statName: Physical Ailment Damage per 100 Missing Health

14.description: Soul Feast has a chance to cast {Blood Tether} on enemies it hits.
14.altText:
{Blood Tether} is a spell that attaches to an enemy, drawing blood from them to deal physical damage over time. 25% of the damage dealt is leeched as health.

An enemy cannot have more than one tether at a time. Tethers last 5 seconds.

15.description: When you kill an enemy with Soul Feast it has a chance to create a {Blood Splatter} around the target.

16.description: Soul Feast has additional chance to inflict damned on hit based on your Intelligence.

17.description: When you kill a damned enemy with Soul Feast, you have a chance to grant your minions {Frenzy} for 3 seconds.

stats.statName: Minion Frenzy Chance On Damned Kills

18.description: If the number of cursed enemies within 15 meters is at or below a threshold shortly after you cast Soul Feast, then a number of enemies within that range are {Marked for Death} to reach that threshold of cursed enemies.
18.altText: For example if the threshold is 6 and only 2 cursed enemies remain in the area after casting Soul Feast up to 4 other enemies in the area will be Marked for Death.

stats.statName: Marks For Death to reach threshold

19.description: For each {Curse} on the target, Soul Feast hits grant more ward and deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

20.description: {Soul Fragments} from bosses or rare enemies grant significantly more ward.

stats.statName: Ward Granted From Rares Or Bosses

21.description: {Soul Fragments} from rare or boss enemies also grant you mana. Modifiers to the amount of ward granted by Soul Fragments also apply to the amount of mana gained from this node.

stats.statName: Mana Granted From Rares Or Bosses

22.description:
When you hit a poisoned enemy with Soul Feast it spreads all stacks of your stacks of poison from that enemy to a number of other enemies within 5 metres.

Has no effect if you have the {Toxic Craving} node.

23.description: Soul Feast costs less mana and has a chance based on your current mana to draw back {Greater Soul Fragments}, which grant more ward (multiplicative with other modifiers).

stats.statName: Greater Fragment Chance per 10 Current Mana

24.description: When Soul Feast hits an enemy {Cursed} with {Spirit Plague}, {Decrepify}, {Marked for Death}, or {Penance} it spreads those {Cursed} from that enemy to a number of other enemies within 5 metres.
24.altText: This does not spread {Curses} that the enemy hit by Soul Feast is not afflicted by.

25.description: {Soul Fragments} return to you faster and Soul Feast has a chance to grant you {Haste} for 4 seconds.

26.description: Soul Feast can hit more targets.

27.description: Soul Feast inflicts {Withering} on hit, an ailment which increases the curse damage taken.

28.description:
Poison Chance from all sources is converted to armor shred for Soul Feast and armor shred applied by Soul Feast has increased effect.

The {Diseased Soul} node now inflicts you with armor shred on cast instead of poison.

stats.statName: Poison Self on Cast -> Armor Shred

0.description: An extended melee stab or piercing bow attack that causes enemies to bleed.

2.description: Puncture has a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

3.description: Puncture deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but has less attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

4.description:
Puncture can be charged up, causing Puncture with a melee weapon to deal damage in a larger area and causes Puncture with a bow to deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per second charged.

After 1 second it releases automatically.

5.description: Puncture has a chance to shred enemy physical resistance.

6.description: Puncture deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per second charged.

7.description: Attacking with Puncture and hitting at least one enemy grants {Frenzy} for a short duration.

8.description: Puncture has a chance to apply {Efficacious Toxin} on hit, causing them to take increased damage over time.

9.description: Puncture has a chance to poison on hit.

10.description: Directly using Puncture causes several {Mirages} to briefly appear at either side of you, attacking in the same direction as you.

11.description: Directly using Puncture and hitting at least one enemy grants you {Bleeding Fury}, a buff that grants bleed chance and stacks up to 3 times. Each stack falls off after 3 seconds of not attacking.
11.altText: Effects which specifically convert Puncture's ailment chance will also convert the ailment chance provided by this buff.

12.description: {Bleeding Fury} can have more maximum stacks.

13.description:
Puncture has a chance to shred enemy armor. 

Armor Shred applied by Puncture has increased effect.

14.description:
Puncture has a chance to apply a {Shadow Dagger} on hit.

This chance is doubled when you directly use Puncture.

15.description: Puncture deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of slow on the target.

16.description: Puncture hits deal more damage against slowed and {Immobilized} targets (multiplicative with other modifiers).
16.altText: {Immobilized} targets are unable to move for 1 second.

17.description:
Converts bleed chance from all sources to poison chance.
Converts physical resistance shred from all sources to poison resistance shred. Poison applied by Puncture has increased duration.

18.description: Directly using Puncture and hitting at least one enemy restores mana. Puncture also has physical penetration based on your maximum mana.
18.altText: Effects which specifically convert Puncture's ailment chance will also convert the penetration provided by this effect.

19.description: When used with a melee weapon Puncture has increased range.

20.description: When used with a bow, Puncture deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per enemy pierced.

21.description: Puncture hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per unique negative ailment on the target.

22.description: If you use Puncture with a bow while you have a {Black Arrow}, Puncture charges 100% faster and blinds on hit.
22.altText: If your maximum charge is 1 second, this will reduce the time it takes to reach maximum charge to 0.5 seconds, but you will still benefit as if you had charged for 1 second.

23.description: Every 10 seconds, your next Puncture {Immobilizes} enemies on hit, causing them to be unable to move for 1 second.

24.description: Every third Puncture deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), and if it is a melee attack it has increased area.

25.description:
Converts poison chance from all sources to bleed chance.

This has no effect if you have {Scalebane}.

26.description: Instead of applying bleed, the greater Puncture consumes all stacks of bleed on the target, causing them to deal damage immediately and restoring health per stack consumed.

28.description: Every 4 seconds your first few direct uses of Puncture are rapid strikes, which have increased attack speed.
28.altText: The 4 second timer to reset your number of Rapid Strike starts after the first Rapid Strike.

0.description: Teleport a short fixed distance in the target direction.

2.description: Shifting heals you. The amount of health gained is increased by healing effectiveness.

3.description: You travel farther with Shift, but it has a longer cooldown.

4.description: You have additional dodge chance per point of Dexterity for 1 second after Shifting.

5.description: Shifting heals you for a portion equal to your Dexterity. The amount of health gained is increased by healing effectiveness.

6.description: Shifting cleanses all negative ailments on you.

7.description: If a single hit deals at least 50% of your health, Shift's cooldown is reset. This can only occur once every 10 seconds.

8.description: You deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) with your next damaging non-channelled skill after Shifting.
8.altText: This damage modifier is additive with other damage modifiers on this tree, but multiplicative with other modifiers.

9.description: You gain 50% increased movement speed for a brief moment after Shifting.

10.description: You have a chance to cause bleeding with your next damaging non-channelled skill after Shifting.

11.description: After Shifting your next damaging non-channelled skill has increased bleed duration and bleed it inflicts has additional Physical Penetration.

12.description:
Using Shift grants you {Jade Arrows.} 

Using a bow attack consumes a {Jade Arrow} to have increased critical strike chance and a chance to poison enemies.

stats.statName: Jade Arrow Increased Critical Strike Chance

13.description: Consuming a {Jade Arrow} also causes your next bow attack's critical strikes to deal more damage.

14.description: Consuming a {Jade Arrow} also grants your next bow attack increased damage over time.

15.description: Shift restores mana on use. This amount is tripled when below half health.

16.description: You are invulnerable while Shifting.

17.description: Shift consumes a health potion on use if you are below 50% health.

18.description: The next damaging non-channelled skill you use after Shifting is always a critical strike.

stats.statName: Always Crit With Next Non-Channelled Skill

19.description: If using a melee weapon, when Shifting you perform an {Unseen Strike}, hitting enemies along your path.
19.altText: Deals melee physical damage, with 100% added damage effectiveness.

20.description: You throw {Shurikens} at nearby enemies after Shifting.
20.altText: This will grant {Chakram} 10% more damage per point (multiplicative with other modifiers) if you have the {Keen Throw} node.

21.description: {Unseen Strike} hits in a wider area.

22.description: You leave behind a {Shadow} at the place you Shifted from.

23.description: When the {Shadow} created by Shift is consumed, you return to its location.

24.description: After using Shift you use {Shadow Cascade}.

25.description: You have a chance to drop an {Acid Flask} on arrival.
25.altText: Acid Flask can not have extra projectiles when thrown from Shift.

26.description: You have a chance to drop an {Acid Flask} on departure.
26.altText: Acid Flask can not have extra projectiles when thrown from Shift.

27.description: Shift has a shorter cooldown and costs less mana.

28.description: {Unseen Strike} has a chance to inflict {Shadow Dagger} to enemies hit.

29.description: {Unseen Strike} slows enemies it hits.

30.description:
{Unseen Strike} instantly kills enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health).

If you have a similar effect from an item or passive node then the highest threshold is used.

32.description: You deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) with your next damaging non-channelled skill after Shifting, but travel a shorter distance with Shift.
32.altText: This damage modifier is additive with other damage modifiers on this tree, but multiplicative with other modifiers.

0.loreText: Infinite depth of wisdom

2.description: Focus grants increased health regeneration while channeled.

3.description: Focus grants increased mana regeneration while channeled proportional to the amount of mana you are missing when you start channeling.
3.altText: Each point of negative mana counts as missing an addional point of mana. For example, with 1 point invested, if you have 10 maximum mana and are at -10 mana then this node will increase mana regen by 20%.

stats.statName: Increased Mana Regen Per Missing Mana

4.description: Casting Focus while at negative mana instantly grants mana equal to a percentage of your maximum mana, but Focus has a longer cooldown.

5.description: Casting Focus while at negative mana instantly grants mana equal to a percentage of your maximum mana, but Focus has a longer cooldown.

6.description: The mana gained from the Null Profusion and Null Infusion nodes is also gained as ward, but Focus has a longer cooldown.

stats.statName: Instant Mana Gain Also Applies To Ward

7.description: Focus grants increased mana regeneration while channeled.

8.description: Focus grants a chance to shock nearby enemies each second while channeled and causes you to take less damage from shocked enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

9.description: Shocks, chills and ignites inflicted by Focus have a longer duration.

10.description: Focus grants a chance to ignite nearby enemies each second while channeled and causes you to take less damage from ignited enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

11.description: Focus heightens your armor while channeling (multiplicative with other modifiers) and grants you additional armor based on your intelligence.

12.description: Focus grants a chance to chill nearby enemies each second while channeled and causes you to take less damage from chilled enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

13.description: Focus grants less elemental damage taken while channeled (multiplicative with other modifiers).

14.description: Focus heals the target each second while channeled.
14.altText: This effect is affected by increased healing effectiveness.

15.description: Focus has increased healing effectiveness per point of intelligence.

16.description: Focus can increase your current mana to a percentage above your maximum mana. The excess decays at a rate of 10 mana per second after you stop channeling.

17.description: Focus grants additional resistance while channeled.

18.description: Focus can be cast on allies.
18.altText: All effects granted by Focus are applied to the ally instead unless they specify "you".

19.description: Focus grants additional ward retention while channeled.

20.description: When you finish channeling, you unleash a wave of lightning with base damage equal to a percentage of the mana you gained while channeling.
20.altText: The lightning wave counts as a spell, and its damage scales with Intelligence.

21.description: You gain Haste for 1 second per 20 mana you gained while channeling once you finish channeling. Maximum of 10 seconds.

22.description: You gain ward equal to a percentage of the mana you gained once you finish channeling.

23.description: You unleash waves of lightning with base damage equal to a percentage of your maximum mana to nearby enemies each second while channeling.
23.altText: If cast on an ally, the waves of lightning will occur at their location.

24.description: {Energy Overflow} is cast more frequently.

25.description: The waves of lightning released by the Energy Overflow and Energy Battery nodes deal more damage while you are at full mana (multiplicative with other modifiers).

26.description: Focus grants additional ward per second while channeled.

27.description: The burst of ward and mana after channelling for exactly one second grants additional ward and mana.

28.description:
Focus no longer has a cooldown, but the burst no longer grants mana.

This node has no effect if you have either the {Null Profusion} node or the {Conveyance} node.

30.description:
You teleport to the target location when you start channelling Focus, as long as the location is accessible. This does not count as casting the Teleport skill and is not affected by Teleport's skill tree.

Focus now counts as a {Traversal} skill.
30.altText: Using a Traversal skill puts all other traversal skills on cooldown and traversal skills' cooldowns do not recover while you are using a traversal skill.

stats.statName: Does not use the Teleport Skill or Tree

2.description:
Chthonic Fissure costs less mana and it refunds some of its mana cost if there is a cursed player, rare enemy or boss within 20 meters when you cast it.

This effect also works if you are Cursed.

3.description: {Tormenting} an ignited enemy spreads all of your ignite stacks from it to a number of other enemies around it.
3.altText: Converted ailments are also spread.

4.description: The Fissure releases {Spirits} more frequently.

5.description: Chthonic Fissure now creates a secondary Fissure in the opposite direction that casts its own {Spirits}. Enemies can take damage from both Fissures if they stand on both, but Chthonic Fissure costs significantly more mana.
5.altText: This effect will not create more than 2 Fissures if you also have {The Sunderer's Domain} node.

6.description:
{Spirits} now have a chance to be replaced by a cast of {Chaos Bolts} that consumes a portion of its mana cost and scales with your {Chaos Bolts} tree.

{Chaos Bolts} cast this way have a chance to have no additional projectiles.

stats.statName: Chance to replace Spirits with Chaos Bolts

7.description: When {Tormented} enemies die they have a chance to release the {Spirit} to inflict and {Torment} another enemy within 8 meters.

8.description: The {Spirits'} hits shred enemy necrotic resistance.

9.description: The {Spirits'} hits shred enemy fire resistance.

10.description: When {Spirits} {Torment} an enemy afflicted by an {Infernal Shade} they consume the Shade, causing it to instantly deal its remaining damage and increases all existing Chthonic Fissures' frequency of releasing {Spirits} up to a maximum.

stats.statName: Infernal Shade deals its Remaining Damage

11.description: The {Spirits'} hits inflict enemies with {Damned}.

12.description: Chthonic Fissure and ailments it inflicts deal more necrotic damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per 1% Added Critical Strike Multiplier.
12.altText: This doesn't include the base 200% crit multi.

stats.statName: Necrotic Damage per 1% Added Crit Multi

13.description: {Torment} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) based on your uncapped necrotic resistance.

14.description:
Chthonic Fissure deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to rare enemies and bosses.

This effect is doubled if the enemy or you are cursed.

15.description:
{Spirits} now target you instead of enemies, and whenever you are {Tormented} or {Torment's} duration on you is refreshed, you gain additional spell damage and Endurance Threshold.

This buff can stack and has the same duration as {Torment}, but persists if {Torment} is cleansed.

16.description: The Fissure deals more direct damage for each second it is active (multiplicative with other modifiers) and you leech a portion of the damage it does.
16.altText: Direct damage modifiers do not affect damage of ailments and subskills from Chthonic Fissure.

stats.statName: Fissure Direct Damage bonus per Second

17.description:
You can now have additional Fissures active at a time, but {Spirits} are released less frequently.

If a Fissure is placed over an existing one, the new Fissure closes after 1 second.
17.altText: You cannot create more than 2 Fissures if you also have the {Of Gloom and Flames} node.

18.description: Chthonic Fissure deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but it no longer releases {Spirits}.

19.description:
Fissures now cast {Volatile Zombies} every 2 seconds, but consumes mana equal to a portion of {Volatile Zombies} mana cost.

{Volatile Zombie} cast this way has a chance to not create multiple {Zombies} if it would otherwise.

20.description:
Chthonic Fissure deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

This effect is doubled if you are cursed.

21.description: The Fissure's initial impact now hits enemies dealing spell fire damage, with added damage applying at 300% effectiveness for this hit.
21.altText: This hit can be converted to to physical by {Blood Gulch}, or to necrotic by {Valley of Defilement}.

22.description:
The Fissure's initial hit now deals additional spell damage with a higher chance to stun per 2% ignite chance.

This effects scales with bleed or poison if the Fissure is converted to physical or poison respectively.
22.altText: Ailment chance is counted before being converted.

stats.statName: Fissure Spell Damage per 2% Ignite Chance
Fissure Increased Stun Chance per 2% Ignite Chance

23.description: The Fissure's initial hit now Curse enemies with {Acid Skin}, which causes them to take poison damage over time and a chance to be critically struck by any hit.

24.description:
Your hits against enemies cursed by {Acid Skin} have additional base critical strike chance per 10% of your global increased poison damage.

This bonus critical strike chance is not affected by other critical strike chance modifiers.

stats.statName: Bonus Crit Chance per 10% Inc Poison Damage

25.description: The Fissure's initial impact now spreads all of your ignite stacks from the target to nearby enemies up to a maximum.

26.description:
When directly casting Chthonic Fissure you now travel along the Fissure as it opens, but this adds a cooldown to Chthonic Fissure.

Chthonic Fissure gains the {Traversal} tag.

27.description:
The Fissure gains a percentage of your global chance to ignite on hit as ignite chance per second. 

Additionally, the Fissure has a base chance to ignite enemies each second.
27.altText:
This effect still applies even if Chthonic Fissure is converted.

For example your global bleed chance will be converted to bleed chance per second with the {Blood Gulch} node.

stats.statName: Your Ignite Chance -> Ignite Chance per Second

28.description:
Chthonic Fissure's base fire damage is converted to physical. Consequently this damage scales with increases to physical damage, but not increases to fire damage.

Ignite chance from all sources are converted to bleed chance per second for the Fissure.

Swaps Chthonic Fissures' {Fire} tag for a {Physical} tag.

29.description: {Torment} lasts longer and any ignite, poison and bleed inflicted by Chthonic Fissure also last longer.

30.description: {Torment} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to ignited, poisoned or bleeding enemies.

31.description:
Chthonic Fissure's base fire damage over time is converted to poison. Consequently this damage scales with increases to poison damage, but not increases to fire damage.

Ignite chance from all sources is converted to poison chance per second for the Fissure.

Swaps Chthonic Fissures' {Fire} tag for a {Poison} tag.
31.altText: This has no effect if Chthonic Fissure is converted to Physical with the {Blood Gulch} node.

0.description: A melee attack which grants you a stack of firebrand buff if it hits an enemy. Firebrand buff increases the size of subsequent firebrand attacks and adds melee fire damage.

1.description: Firebrand deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

2.description: Firebrand deals more melee damage per stack of Firebrand (multiplicative with other modifiers).

3.description: Firebrand now shoots three lines instead of one in a cone in front of you, but costs more mana.

4.description: Using {Shatter Strike} consumes stacks of Firebrand to gain {Frostbite} Chance per stack consumed.

5.description: Firebrand has increased melee critical strike chance per stack of Firebrand.

stats.statName: Increased Melee Crit Chance Per Stack

6.description: Firebrand has additional melee critical strike multiplier per stack of Firebrand.

7.description: Your next melee attack, that is not Firebrand, consumes all stacks of Firebrand and deals more damage per stack consumed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

8.description: Consuming stacks of Firebrand with {Incineration} grants bonus critical strike chance and critical strike multiplier per stack.

9.description: Firebrand can have more maximum stacks.

10.description: Firebrand grants additional armor and fire resistance per stack of Firebrand.
10.altText: Effects which convert Firebrand's base damage also convert the resistance granted.

11.description:
Firebrands's base fire damage and added melee fire damage from stacks is converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to fire damage.

All ignite chance from this tree is converted to shock chance and effects related to ignite now depend on shock instead.

Swaps Firebrand's {Fire} tag for a {Lightning} tag.

12.description: While you have at least 1 stack of Firebrand, your next cast of {Lightning Blast} will consume all stacks to chain additional times per stack consumed.

stats.statName: Lightning Blast Chains per Firebrand Stack Consumed

13.description: Gain stacks of {Static} if Firebrand hits at least one enemy.

14.description: You gain ward when Firebrand hits at least one enemy.

15.description: You gain ward per second per stack of Firebrand.

16.description: Stacks of Firebrand last longer.

17.description: You refresh the duration of all stacks of Firebrand when gaining a new stack.

18.description: Firebrand can have more maximum stacks and deals more damage per stack, but it has less attack speed (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

19.description: Firebrand attacks faster per stack of Firebrand, up to a maximum.
19.altText: Attack speed bonus applies even if you have the {Ardent Branding} node.

20.description: Stacks of Firebrand now also grant added spell fire damage.
20.altText: Effects which convert the added melee fire damage per stack also convert the spell damage granted by this node.

21.description: Firebrand grants global spell critical strike multiplier per stack of Firebrand.

22.description: If Firebrand hits at least one enemy, it consumes mana to cast {Flame Wave}, a spell that deals fire damage in a line.

23.description: Firebrand has a chance to ignite enemies.

24.description:
Firebrand has a chance to inflict {Spreading Flames} when hitting an ignited enemy.

Stacks of Firebrand also grant more fire damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) against enemies afflicted by Spreading Flames.
24.altText: The more fire damage effect of each stack of Firebrand is also multiplicative with the effect from the other stacks.

stats.statName: More Fire Damage Per Stack vs Spreading Flames

25.description: Each stack of Firebrand grants you global Ignite Chance.

26.description: Using {Flame Reave} consumes stacks of Firebrand to gain {Ignite} Chance per stack consumed.

27.description: You gain an additional stack of Firebrand when attacking, but Firebrand costs more mana.

28.description: You gain ward when a stack of Firebrand expires or is consumed.
28.altText: This does not grant you ward if an extra stack above your maximum would cause an old stack to be replaced.

stats.statName: Ward Per Stack Consumed or Expired

30.description: Directly using Firebrand has a chance to grant a stack of Fire Aura based on your current Firebrand stacks. This effect can trigger a limited number of times per second.
30.altText: The more fire damage effect of each stack of Firebrand is also multiplicative with the effect from the other stacks.

stats.statName: Fire Aura Chance per Firebrand Stack

0.description: Summons a Volatile Zombie which shambles towards an enemy and explodes.

1.description: Zombies now leap towards their targets, up to a maximum distance.

2.description: Zombies deal more damage and have more movement speed (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

3.description: Zombies deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and the Zombies' health decays slower, but they also move slower.

4.description: You now summon a single large zombie with more health, that deals more damage in a larger area (all multiplicative with other modifiers), but Volatile Zombie costs more mana.
4.altText: Both the area and damage modifiers also affect {Repulsive Vomit}.

stats.statName: Chance to Summon from Indirect Casts

6.description: {Vomit} has a chance to shred enemy armor each second.

7.description:
When a Zombie dies you have a chance to cast {Marrow Shards} from the Zombie towards a nearby enemy.

Marrow Shards does not cost health when cast this way.

stats.statName: No Health Cost For Marrow Shards

8.description: Zombies will now {Vomit} on enemies before exploding, dealing physical and poison damage over time. Zombies lose 33% of their maximum health per second while vomiting.
8.altText:
The damage of the vomit can be converted by the {Flammable Vitae} and {Horrific Vessels} nodes.

The area of effect of the vomit is not affected by Increased Area for Minion Area Skills stats.

9.description: The explosion applies {Mark for Death} to enemies hit, but Volatile Zombie costs more mana.

stats.statName: Mark For Death On Explosion Hit

10.description: You summon additional Zombies per cast, but Volatile Zombie costs more mana and has additional cooldown duration.

stats.statName: Chance to For Additional Zombies from Indirect Casts

11.description: {Vomit} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

12.description: The explosion has a chance to poison enemies.

14.description: The explosion deals damage in a larger area.

15.description: The explosion deals damage in a larger area and when a Zombie dies it creates a {Skeleton Vanguard}, but Volatile Zombie costs more mana.

16.description: {Vomit} has a chance to poison enemies each second based on your maximum mana.

stats.statName: Poison Chance Per Second Per 2 Maximum Mana

17.description: When a Zombie dies it creates {Corpse Parasites} for 4 seconds, but Volatile Zombie costs more mana.

18.description: The explosion deals damage in a larger area, but Zombies no longer move.

19.description: When a Zombie dies you have a chance to cast {Sacrifice} on another nearby minion. This consumes mana equal to a percentage of Sacrifice's mana cost.

stats.statName: Percent of Sacrifice Mana Cost Consumed

20.description: You summon Zombies faster and Volatile Zombie costs less mana.

21.description:
You are healed for a portion of the Zombies' maximum health when they explode. 

The amount healed is affected by your increased healing effectiveness.
21.altText: As an example, if the Zombie has 1000 max health, you are healed for 10 health when it explodes.

22.description:
The explosion's base physical damage and {Vomit}'s base physical and poison damage are converted to fire. Consequently their damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to physical or poison damage.

Poison chance from all sources is converted to ignite chance and effects related to poison now depend on ignite instead.
22.altText: No effect if you have taken {Horrific Vessels}.

23.description: The explosion's base physical and fire damage and {Vomit}'s base physical damage are converted to necrotic. Consequently their damage scales with increases to necrotic damage, but not increases to physical or fire damage.

24.description:
Zombies instantly kill enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health).

If you have a similar effect from an item or passive node then the highest threshold is used.

25.description: The explosion now fears enemies for a short duration.
25.altText: Fear causes enemies to flee from you and your allies. Enemies can only be affected by Fear once.

26.description: When a Zombie dies you have a chance to cast {Infernal Shade} on an enemy near the zombie. This consumes mana equal to a percentage of Infernal Shade's mana cost.
26.altText: Infernal Shade is a spell that causes the target enemy and all nearby enemies take fire damage per second.

stats.statName: Percent of Infernal Shade Mana Cost Consumed

27.description: Zombies have increased movement speed per point of missing health, but their health decays faster.

28.description: The explosion's hit deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) against bosses and rare enemies.

stats.statName: Hit Damage to Bosses And Rare Enemies

29.description: You have a chance to cast {Dread Shade} on Zombies created by a direct cast of Volatile Zombie. This consumes mana equal to a percentage of Dread Shade's mana cost.
29.altText: If you are at your maximum number of Dread Shades, this effect will not occur.

stats.statName: Dread Shade Chance for Direct Casts
Percent of Dread Shade Mana Cost Consumed

31.description: When a minion dies you have a chance to cast Volatile Zombie at its location, expending its mana cost.
31.altText:
This cannot be triggered by Zombies or Corpse Parasites.
This cannot summon more than 1 Zombie.

stats.statName: Chance to Cast Volatile Zombie On Minion Death

32.description: {Necromantic Fervor} now grants ward rather than health. The amount of ward gained is not affected by increased healing effectiveness.

stats.statName: Health -> Ward From Zombie Max Health

0.description: A circular attack that's also used by your shadow clones. Requires dual wielding.

2.description: Lethal Mirage deals additional melee physical damage per equipped sword or dagger.

3.description: Lethal Mirage penetrates enemy physical resistance.

4.description:
Lethal Mirage deals additional melee lightning damage and its base physical damage is converted to Lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Physical penetration from this tree is converted to lightning penetration.

All bleed and poison chances are converted to shock chance.

Swaps Lethal Mirage's {Physical} tag for a {Lightning} tag.

6.description: Lethal Mirage has a chance to cause enemies to bleed, and bleed inflicted by Lethal Mirage has additional Physical Penetration.

7.description: Lethal Mirage hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of bleed on the target up to a maximum.

8.description: Lethal Mirage has more critical strike chance (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of stack of bleed on the target.

9.description: Lethal Mirage can now also hit allies granting them the {Mirage Form} buff for 4 seconds, granting bleed chance and additional dodge rating.
9.altText: Your Mirages do not hurt allies.

10.description: Lethal Mirage now targets allies rather than enemies.

11.description: When Lethal Mirage ends you gain {Mirage Form} for 1 second per critical strike landed. This can stack up to 6 seconds.

12.description: You gain health and mana per kill with Lethal Mirage.

14.description: Lethal Mirage gains an additional Mirage, resulting in more hits.

15.description: Mirages have a chance to leave behind a {Shadow}.

17.description: Mirages are created faster, causing Lethal Mirage to have a shorter duration.

18.description: Reduce Lethal Mirage's cooldown per enemy killed by Lethal Mirage up to a maximum.

19.description: Lethal Mirage deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and leeches a portion of the melee damage dealt as health.

20.description: Lethal Mirage consumes all active {Shadows} gaining additional Mirages per {Shadow} consumed, resulting in more hits.

21.description: Lethal Mirage deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per {Shadow} consumed.

22.description: When you reappear Lethal Mirage releases a burst of smoke blinding enemies and inflicts them with {Frailty}.

23.description: The smoke from {Umbral Burst} persists as a cloud blinding enemies and inflicting {Frailty} each second.

24.description: Allies within the smoke cloud avoid critical strikes.

25.description: The smoke cloud is converted to a poison cloud causing enemies to be poisoned each second, but no longer inflicts {Frailty}.

26.description: Poisons caused by Lethal Mirage last longer.
26.altText: This includes poison stacks from the poison cloud.

27.description: You gain {Haste} when you reappear.

28.description: Lethal Mirage gains an additional Mirage, resulting in more hits.

29.description: Mirages have a chance to use {Shadow Cascade} in addition to their normal attack.

30.description:
Lethal Mirage creates a {Shadow} at the location you disappear from.

This {Shadow} is not consumed by the {Shadow Eater} node.
30.altText:
Shadows will repeat one skill you use before vanishing. Shadows can repeat Acid Flask, Shurikens or Shadow Cascade, and their damage scales with your damage stats. 

You can have 3 Shadows at once, and they will disappear after 5 seconds.

31.description:
Lethal Mirage instantly kills enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health), but can no longer inflict bleed.

If you have a similar effect from an item or passive node then the highest threshold is used.

32.description: Improves Lethal Mirage's base critical strike chance, but it has fewer Mirages, resulting in fewer hits.

0.loreText: Shine like a beacon in the darkness.

2.description:
Your melee hits apply 10 stacks of {Fiery Inquisition} and the melee hits of other allies affected by the aura apply 1 stack. If an enemy reaches 60 stacks, the stacks are consumed to release a {Flame Burst}, dealing fire damage to surrounding enemies.

While Holy Aura is active twice as many stacks are applied.

The {Flame Burst} scales with the stats of the player or minion that triggers it.
2.altText: Modifiers to chance to apply ailments also modify the number of stacks applied. For example your {Warpath} hits apply 6 stacks, and allies' warpath hits have a 60% chance to apply 1 stack.

3.description: If you are the one to get the final hit to unleash {Flame Burst} on an enemy, it deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
3.altText: {Flame Burst} deals fire damage to surrounding enemies, and is unleashed after successive melee attacks on the same enemy.

4.description: Holy Aura grants you and your allies increased attack and cast speed.

5.description: Holy Aura grants you and your allies increased critical strike chance.

6.description: Holy Aura causes you and your allies' critical strikes to deal more damage.

7.description: Holy Aura grants you and your allies increased fire and lightning damage.

8.description: Holy Aura grants you and your allies a chance to ignite and electrify enemies.

9.description: Holy Aura causes you and your allies to penetrate enemy fire and lightning resistance.

10.description: Holy Aura grants you and your allies increased physical damage.

11.description: Holy Aura grants you and your allies increased throwing attack damage and increased stun chance with throwing attacks.

12.description: Holy Aura grants you and your allies additional elemental resistance and endurance threshold.

13.description: Holy Aura grants you and your allies additional dodge chance.

14.description: Holy Aura grants you and your allies increased healing effectiveness.

15.description: Holy Aura's active duration lasts longer, but Holy Aura's cooldown lasts longer and its passive is disabled during its cooldown.

16.description:
Holy Aura grants you and your allies additional poison resistance.
Activating Holy Aura cleanses ailments for you and your allies.

17.description: Activating Holy Aura grants you a chance to slow surrounding enemies each second.

18.description: Holy Aura grants you and your allies increasing throwing attack speed and a chance to gain {Haste} for 1 second on hit.

19.description: Holy Aura grants you and your allies increased health regeneration.

20.description: Holy Aura regenerates ward for you and nearby allies.

21.description: Holy Aura grants you and your allies increased ward retention.

22.description: Holy Aura grants you and your allies a burst of ward when activated, but Holy Aura has a longer cooldown.

23.description: Holy Aura grants you and your allies additional block effectiveness and health when blocking attacks.

24.description: Holy Aura grants you and your allies ward when blocking attacks.

26.description: When an enemy dies in Holy Aura's area of effect, there is a chance it spawns a {Health Globe}, healing for 70 health.
26.altText: {Health Globes} scale with increased healing effectiveness.

28.description: Your melee hits apply an additional stack of {Fiery Inquisition} and if you are the one to get the final hit to unleash {Flame Burst} on an enemy, it deals damage in an increased area.
28.altText: {Flame Burst} deals fire damage to surrounding enemies, and is unleashed after successive melee attacks on the same enemy.

0.description: Target enemy and all nearby enemies take fire damage per second . Each enemy can only have one Infernal Shade attached at a time. Expires after 5 seconds. Max 4 active shades.
0.altText:
Added spell damage applies at 100% effectiveness each second.

Your maximum number of shades is shared with Dread Shade.

1.description: Infernal Shade costs less mana and has increased cast speed.

2.description: You have a chance to create a {Blaze Shade} which deals more damage in a significantly larger area (multiplicative with other modifiers).

stats.statName: Area of Effect with Blaze Shade

3.description: {Blaze Shade} deals more damage, but has a shorter duration (multiplicative with other modifiers).

4.description: Infernal Shade deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

5.description: If no target is within range of your target location the shade will wait up to 10 seconds for a target to come within range and then attach to it.
5.altText: This node has no effect if the Hellfire node is taken.

6.description: Infernal Shade gains 15% fire penetration each second that it is unattached to a target.
6.altText: If you have the Blood Shade node this grants physical penetration instead.

7.description:
When directly casting Infernal Shade you will create extra shades if there are nearby enemies.

Infernal Shade costs more mana to cast.

Has no effect if you have taken the Hellfire node.

8.description: Infernal Shade deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but has reduced duration.

9.description: When Infernal Shade expires there is a large explosion which deals fire damage to nearby enemies.

10.description: The explosion which occurs when the Infernal Shade expires deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and affects a larger area.

11.description: Infernal Shade has reduce duration and the explosion which occurs when the Infernal Shade expires has added critical strike chance.
11.altText: This duration reduction is additive wih the reduction from the Wildfires node.

12.description: Infernal Shade deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but in a smaller area.

13.description: Infernal Shade has increased duration.

14.description: Infernal Shade has a chance to slow nearby enemies each second.

15.description:
Infernal Shade is now ground targeted and cannot attach to any targets.

Infernal Shade applies a stack of Fire Resistance Shred each second but now has a cooldown.

Prevents additional Shades from the Legion node being created.

16.description: Infernal Shade has a shorter cooldown.

17.description: You can cast an additional Infernal Shade or Dread Shade.

18.description: When Infernal Shade's target dies it has a chance to move to a new target.

19.description: Infernal Shade deals damage in a larger area.

20.description: Infernal Shade can now only attach to your minions, but your minions are also damaged by Infernal Shade.

21.description: Your minions gain {Haste} while they have an Infernal Shade attached to them.

22.description: Infernal Shade deals more direct damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for each second it has been active, up to a maximum.

23.description: Infernal Shades which attach to minions have unlimited increased duration.

24.description: Minions which have an Infernal Shade attached to them gain increased movement, attack and cast speed each second up to a maximum.

25.description: Infernal Shade has a chance to ignite nearby enemies each second.

26.description: Ignited inflicted by Infernal Shade has additional Fire Penetration

27.description:
Infernal Shade's base fire damage is converted to physical. Consequently this damage scales with increases to physical damage, but not increases to fire damage.

All ignite chance from this tree is converted to bleed chance and effects related to ignite now depend on bleed instead.

28.description: Infernal Shade has a chance to shred the armor of nearby enemies each second.

0.description: Hold ability key to channel to increase the area. When you release, combine all of your minions in the area into a single hulking abomination with states based on which minions are consumed.

2.description:
For each {Skeleton Warrior} absorbed, your abomination deals more melee damage and has more health (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

For each {Skeleton Rogue} absorbed, your abomination has increased attack speed.

For each {Skeleton Archer} absorbed, your abomination has increased area of effect.

Effects such as this which apply per skeleton absorbed can only consider up to 20 skeletons in total.
2.altText: If more than 20 skeletons are absorbed, the priority for consideration is warriors, then rogues, then archers. So if you absorb 15 warriors, 10 rogues, and 5 archers, then 15 warriors and 5 rogues will apply their benefits.

stats.statName: Melee Damage and Health per Skeleton Warrior

3.description:
Your abomination has additional critical strike chance.

For each {Skeleton Rogue} absorbed, your abomination has increased movement speed.

Effects such as this which apply per skeleton absorbed can only consider up to 20 skeletons in total.
3.altText: If more than 20 skeletons are absorbed, the priority for consideration is warriors, then rogues, then archers. So if you absorb 15 warriors, 10 rogues, and 5 archers, then 15 warriors and 5 rogues will apply their benefits.

4.description:
Your abomination casts {Aura of Rot}, poisoning itself and nearby enemies every second.

For each {Skeleton Rogue} absorbed, your abomination gains additional chance to inflict poison on hit.

Effects such as this which apply per skeleton absorbed can only consider up to 20 skeletons in total.
4.altText: If more than 20 skeletons are absorbed, the priority for consideration is warriors, then rogues, then archers. So if you absorb 15 warriors, 10 rogues, and 5 archers, then 15 warriors and 5 rogues will apply their benefits.

5.description: Your abomination has increased critical strike chance, but can no longer regenerate health or absorb {Bone Golems}.
5.altText: The Abomination can still recover health by methods other than health regen.

6.description:
If a {Skeleton Warrior} or {Skeleton Rogue} is absorbed, your abomination is granted the ability to {Double Strike} with a 6 second cooldown, dealing significant melee damage.

Double Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per Skeleton Warrior or Rogue consumed.

Effects such as this which apply per skeleton absorbed can only consider up to 20 skeletons in total.
6.altText: If more than 20 skeletons are absorbed, the priority for consideration is warriors, then rogues, then archers. So if you absorb 15 warriors, 10 rogues, and 5 archers, then 15 warriors and 5 rogues will apply their benefits.

stats.statName: Double Strike Gained on Warrior or Rogue Absorbed
Double Strike Damage per Warrior or Rogue Absorbed

7.description: Your abomination's melee hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but can no longer absorb {Skeletal Mages}.

9.description:
Your abomination can no longer absorb {Summoned Skeletons}.

Minions within 12 meters of your abomination gain increased attack speed.

11.description: Your abomination has more health (multiplicative with other modifiers) and generates more threat, which increases the likelihood of enemies targeting it.

12.description: Your abomination reflects a percentage of damage to attackers, and disassembles into a number of {Skeletal Vanguards} on death.

13.description: Your abomination deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

14.description: Your abomination deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but has reduced attack speed.

15.description: Your abomination has increased cooldown recovery speed for its abilities, but takes damage equal to a percentage of its maximum health each time it uses an ability with a cooldown.

16.description: Your abomination's hits leech a portion of the damage they deal as health.

17.description: Your abomination's melee attacks deal damage in a larger area.

18.description:
If a {Wraith} is absorbed, its melee attack is replaced with {Soul Reave}, which deals melee necrotic damage.

Soul Reave has 200% damage effectiveness compared to the basic melee attack's 150%, and Soul Reave has 15% more radius compared to the basic melee attack.

stats.statName: Soul Reave Gained On Wraith Absorbed

19.description: If a {Bone Golem} is absorbed, your abomination uses {Stomp}, a melee attack that deals physical damage and has a high chance to stun enemies in a large area.

20.description: Your abomination gains increased attack speed when it kills an enemy. This effect can occur a limited number of times per 5 seconds.
20.altText: Each stack falls off separately.

21.description: Your abomination has more health (multiplicative with other modifiers) and restores a larger percentage of its maximum health when devouring other minions.

stats.statName: Percent Max Health Restored on Devour

22.description: Your abomination gains more max health (multiplicative with other modifiers) for 8 seconds each time it devours a minion, up to a limited number of times per 8 seconds.
22.altText: Each stack of this effect falls off separately. Stacks are multiplicative with each other.

23.description:
If a {Skeletal Archer} is absorbed, your abomination casts {Eternal Arrow} every 4 seconds, a bow ability that deals physical damage and has 100% chance to Recurve.

Your abomination gains additional bow damage per point of your Intelligence.

stats.statName: Eternal Arrow Gained On Skeletal Archer Absorbed

24.description:
{Eternal Arrow} has a reduced cooldown.

For each {Skeleton Archer} absorbed, Eternal Arrow has additional Recurve chance.

Effects such as this which apply per skeleton absorbed can only consider up to 20 skeletons in total.
24.altText:
Modifiers which add to or subtract from a cooldown, such as this, are applied before increased cooldown recovery speed.

If more than 20 skeletons are absorbed, the priority for consideration is warriors, then rogues, then archers. So if you absorb 15 warriors, 10 rogues, and 5 archers, then 15 warriors and 5 rogues will apply their benefits.

stats.statName: Eternal Arrow Recurve Chance per Absorbed Archer

25.description: Your abomination will not devour {Volatile Zombies}, even if they were absorbed to create it.

26.description: Your abomination has more health and deals more damage (both multiplicative with other modifiers) for each type of minion absorbed to create it among {Summoned Skeleton}, {Skeletal Mage}, {Wraith}, and {Bone Golem}.
26.altText: The maximum benefit of this effect is achieved if the abomination absorbs at least one minion from each of the four types.

28.description: If the abomination was made by absorbing at least 1 of every type of minion mentioned by {Engorgement}, it gains more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), increased attack speed, and increased and movement speed.
28.altText: If a minion has a different name, it's considered a different type of minion

stats.statName: Attack Speed With All Types Absorbed
Movement Speed With All Types Absorbed

29.description: If a {Skeletal Mage} is absorbed, your abomination can cast {Devouring Souls}, a spell that releases multiple necrotic projectiles.

stats.statName: Devouring Souls Gained On Mage Absorbed

30.description:
{Devouring Souls} has a reduced cooldown.

Devouring Souls deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for each {Skeletal Mage} absorbed.

Devouring Souls releases an additional soul for each Skeletal Mage absorbed.

stats.statName: Devouring Souls Damage per Absorbed Mage

31.description: Your abomination has increased cooldown recovery speed for its abilities, and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) with abilities that have cooldowns.

32.description: If a {Volatile Zombie} is absorbed, your abomination gains an explosive {Tail Slam} ability.

stats.statName: Explosive Slam Attack Gained On Zombie Absorbed

33.description:
{Stomp} has a reduced cooldown.

For each {Bone Golem} absorbed,  Stomp deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has increased area of effect.

34.description: When your abomination would devour a minion, it will instead be {Sacrificed}, consuming a percentage of Sacrifice's mana cost. This Sacrifice is cast by you and uses your Sacrifice tree.
34.altText:
Minions that are Sacrificed will not grant the abomination any benefits that come from devouring.

If Sacrifice chains, it will not chain to the abomination.

If you do not have enough mana to consume, the minion will instead be devoured.

0.altText: Skeletons refers to Skeleton Archers, Skeleton Rogues, and Skeleton Warriors.
0.loreText: An army of the dead awaits your command

2.description: Skeleton Warriors have more maximum health, while Skeleton Rogues and Archers deal more damage (all multiplicative with other modifiers).

3.description: When one of your Skeletons dies, another Skeleton is healed to full health.
3.altText: Skeletons refers to Skeleton Archers, Skeleton Rogues, and Skeleton Warriors.

4.description: Summon Skeletons costs less mana, and your Skeletons have improved base critical strike chance.
4.altText: Skeletons refers to Skeleton Archers, Skeleton Rogues, and Skeleton Warriors.

5.description: You gain ward whenever one of your Skeletons dies.
5.altText:
Skeletons that are unsummoned do not trigger this effect.

Skeletons refers to Skeleton Archers, Skeleton Rogues, and Skeleton Warriors.

6.description: You gain mana whenever one of your Skeletons dies.
6.altText:
Skeletons that are unsummoned do not trigger this effect.

Skeletons refers to Skeleton Archers, Skeleton Rogues, and Skeleton Warriors.

7.description: You have increased spell damage if one of your Skeletons has died recently (past 4 seconds).
7.altText:
Skeletons that are unsummoned do not trigger this effect.

Skeletons refers to Skeleton Archers, Skeleton Rogues, and Skeleton Warriors.

8.description: Skeletons have increased attack speed, cast speed, and movement speed.
8.altText: Skeletons refers to Skeleton Archers, Skeleton Rogues, and Skeleton Warriors.

9.description: Your Skeletons have increased critical strike chance, but you can only have one Skeleton Warrior summoned at once.
9.altText:
This does not affect your overall Skeleton limit.

Skeletons refers to Skeleton Archers, Skeleton Rogues and Skeleton Warriors.

10.description: Skeleton Warriors are removed from the pool of Skeletons that can be summoned.

11.description: You can summon more Skeletons.
11.altText: Skeletons refers to Skeleton Archers, Skeleton Rogues, and Skeleton Warriors.

12.description: You can summon more Skeletons.
12.altText: Skeletons refers to Skeleton Archers, Skeleton Rogues, and Skeleton Warriors.

13.description: You can summon more Skeletons.
13.altText: Skeletons refers to Skeleton Archers, Skeleton Rogues, and Skeleton Warriors.

14.description: Skeleton Archers are removed from the pool of Skeletons that can be summoned.

15.description:
Skeleton Archers have their basic attack replaced with {Fire Arrow}, which is a more powerful bow attack that deals fire damage and ignites on hit.

Skeleton Archers have less attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).
15.abilityGrantedByNode: Summon Skeleton Archer Fire Bow Attack

16.description: {Fire Arrow} has a chance to shoot additional projectiles.

17.description: Converts {Fire Arrow} into {Ice Arrow}, converting its base fire damage to cold damage. Ignite chance from all sources is converted to frostbite chance for Ice Arrow.
17.altText: The freeze rate of {Ice Arrow} increases by 6% per point of intelligence. All nodes which affect Fire Arrow affect Ice Arrow instead.

stats.statName: Ignite -> Frostbite Chance for Ice Arrow

18.description: Skeletons deal more damage and have more health (both multiplicative with other modifiers) and are larger, but you can only summon half as many as you could before (rounded up).
18.altText:
More damage is multiplicative with other modifiers.

Skeletons refers to Skeleton Archers, Skeleton Rogues, and Skeleton Warriors.

19.description:
Skeleton Warriors can now cast {Bone Armor} for 4 seconds, which grants less damage taken (multiplicative with other modifiers).

This effect has a 4 second cooldown.

20.description: Skeleton Archers will randomly use Fire Arrow or Ice Arrow, but have additional chance to ignite or inflict frostbite depending on the arrow used.

stats.statName: Randomly Use Fire or Ice Arrow

21.description: Skeleton Warriors can target allies with {Bone Armor}.
21.altText: Allies refers to you, your minions, and your party members and their minions.

22.description: Skeletons leech a portion of the damage they deal as health and they have additional physical resistance.
22.altText: Skeletons refers to Skeleton Archers, Skeleton Rogues, and Skeleton Warriors.

23.description: You summon multiple Skeletons in a single cast, but Summon Skeleton costs more mana. This does not affect your maximum number of Skeletons.
23.altText:
This does not increase your maximum number of total Skeletons that you can have active at one time. This allows you to summon them simultaniously.

Skeletons refers to Skeleton Archers, Skeleton Rogues, and Skeleton Warriors.

24.description: Skeletons have an increased area of effect with melee attacks, and your Skeletons deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
24.altText: Skeletons refers to Skeleton Archers, Skeleton Rogues, and Skeleton Warriors.

25.description: Adds Skeleton Rogues to the pool of Skeletons that can be summoned. Rogues dash to distant enemies, throw shurikens, use melee attacks, and they poison enemies on hit.
25.altText:
Their dash ability has an 8 second cooldown by default.

Shurikens has a 4 second cooldown by default, and can store 2 charges.

26.description: When a Skeleton dies, there is a chance to summon a random new one at the same location after 3 seconds.
26.altText:
The new Skeleton will be a random one of the types active on this tree.

Skeletons refers to Skeleton Archers, Skeleton Rogues, and Skeleton Warriors.

27.description: Skeleton Rogues can now throw a {Vile Flask}, which inflicts poison and armor shred on hit. Vile Flask has a 5 second cooldown.
27.altText: The area of effect of Skeleton Rogues' Vile Flask is affected by Increased Area for Minion Area Skills stats.

28.description: Skeleton Rogues deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for each Skeleton Warrior or Archer you control.

stats.statName: Rogue Damage per Skeleton Warrior or Archer

0.loreText: Control is a mage's most important goal

2.description: Static Orb hits has a chance to shock enemies.

3.description: Static Orb deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per 25 maximum mana, but Static Orb costs additional mana equal to a portion of your maximum mana, up to a maximum.

4.description: The explosion now leaves behind {Charged Ground} dealing lightning damage over time in an area. Creating another Charged Ground halves the remaining duration of all existing ones.

5.description: {Charged Ground} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per additonal critical strike multiplier.

6.description: You and allies have additonal shock chance and increased shock effectiveness while inside {Charged Ground's} area.

7.description: Static Orb costs less mana, but it no longer pulls enemies.

8.description:
Static Orb costs significantly less mana, but it now has a chance to not explode.

If you {Scatter Blast} then you only have a chance to create small orbs, and if you have {Orbital Fulmination} all static orbs orbit you for a reduced duration.

stats.statName: Small Orb Chance with Scatter Blast

9.description:
If Static Orb does not explode it returns to you and deals damage on the way back, but it costs more mana.

This node has no effect if you have {Orbital Fulmination}.

10.description:
Static Orb's base lightning damage is converted to cold and it gains a base freeze rate, but it no longer pulls enemies. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to lightning damage.

Shock chance from all sources is converted to {Frostbite} and effects related to shock now depend on Frostbite instead.

11.description: The orb and the explosion have a higher chance to freeze enemies.

12.description: The orb and the explosion have a higher chance to freeze enemies, but the explosion no longer creates Tendrils.

13.description:
The orb now orbits you for up to 3 seconds before exploding, but you are limited to a few orbs and casting more will detonate older ones.

Static Orb gains damage and explosion area with time rather than travel distance, but scales up to the same maximum as before.

14.description: Static Orb deals more spell damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to shocked enemies.

15.description: Static Orb generates {Static Charges} on hit.
15.altText: This effect doesn't work for the explosion.

16.description: The explosion has a higher chance to stun, increased stun duration and you gain ward on stun with the explosion.

17.description: Static Orb's critical strikes deal more damage.

18.description: The explosion creates additional {Tendrils} to hit enemies outside the explosion area.

19.description: Static Orb grants you {Lightning Aegis} for a short duration on cast, which grants 50% increased lightning damage and 25% less damage taken. Lightning Aegis causes an explosion of lightning damage when you lose 25% of your health or after 10 seconds.

20.description: Static Orb deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area, but automatically explodes after 4 meters.

21.description: The explosion's damage ramps up more with distance, but it travels slower.

22.description: Static Orb deals more damage and now travel faster and in an arcing trajectory rather than a straight line, but it no longer pulls or hits enemies until it explodes.
22.altText: This effect does not affect small orbs from {Scatter Blast}.

23.description: After using Static Orb the next {Lightning Blasts} cast from any source chain 2 additonal times.

24.description:
For 4 seconds after using Static Orb directly casting {Lightning Blast} and hitting at least one enemy will return 25% of Static Orb's mana cost. 

This effect can only occur a limited number of times.

25.description: Static Orb travels faster and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

26.description: Static Orb explodes on hit rather than piercing enemies. The orb deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per 1 mana cost.

stats.statName: Orb Hit Damage Per 1 Mana Cost

27.description: You have a chance to cast an additional Static Orb towards the target when it hits a rare enemy or boss. This effect has a short cooldown.

28.description: Casting Static Orb sends out smaller orbs in a cone in front of you. These small orbs can hit the same target as the large orb, but cannot explode and do not pull.

0.loreText: The bones of many: divided in life, united in death.

2.description: Your Golem has increased attack speed, cast speed, and movement speed.

3.description: You summon an additional Golem, but each Golem has reduced maximum health, is smaller, and deals less damage (all multiplicative with other modifiers).
3.altText: This node's modifiers to health and damage are multiplicative with other modifiers

4.description: Your Golems deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). If Bone Golems have been replaced by another type of Golem, you now have an equal chance to summon a Bone Golem.

stats.statName: Golem Summons Also Summon A Bone Golem

5.description: Your Golem has a chance to ignite enemies, additional fire resistance, and deals more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

6.description: Your Golem deals additional fire damage with spells and melee attacks.

7.description:
You now summon a {Pyre Golem} instead of a Bone Golem.

The base physical damage of Pyre Golems' melee attacks is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to minion fire damage, but not increases to minion physical damage.

Pyre Golems also cast {Infernal Aura}, a spell that deals a burst of fire damage on cast and fire damage over time afterwards. Infernal Aura also ignites nearby enemies every second.
7.altText: If you have multiple golem type nodes, you will summon a random golem.

8.description: Your Golem deals more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers), and {Pyre Golems}’ {Infernal Aura} deals damage in a larger area.

9.description: Your Golem causes all nearby minions to move faster, including themselves. This bonus is doubled for the Golems themselves.

10.description: Your Golem has a chance to grant you a stack of {Putrid Coating} when it is hit. Each stack lasts for 8 seconds and grants you a chance to poison enemies.

stats.statName: Chance To Grant Putrid Coating When Hit

11.description: Your Golem deals additional melee cold damage and it has a chance to chill attackers when hit.

12.description:
You now summon a {Deathchill Golem} instead of a Bone Golem. 

The base physical damage of Deathchill Golems' melee attacks is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to minion cold damage, but not increases to minion physical damage. Death Chill Golems' melee attacks gain a Freeze Rate equal to twice their base damage.

Deathchill Golem also casts Freezing Grasp, a spell that deals cold damage and has high freeze rate. Bosses cannot be frozen by this.
12.altText: If you have multiple golem type nodes, you will summon a random golem.

13.description: Your Golem deals more damage and has more health and armor (each multiplicative with other modifiers).

14.description: Your Golem deals more damage with melee attacks (multiplicative with other modifers), and has an increased chance to stun with melee attacks.

15.description: Your Golem is larger (multiplicative with other modifiers), has increased area of effect, and generates more threat, which increases the likelihood of enemies targeting it.

16.description:
Your Golems have increased size and deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) if you have no other living golems when you summon them.

Your Golems have significantly higher armor for the first 15 seconds of their life when summoned near the corpse of another Golem.

stats.statName: Size if no other living Golems
Damage if no other living Golems

17.description: Your Golem grants additional armor to nearby minions, including itself.

18.description: Your Golem's hits restore health to you and itself. This effect restores additional health per 2 Vitality.

19.description:
You now summon a {Blood Golem} instead of a Bone Golem. 

Blood Golems can also cast {Sanguine Orb}, a spell that deals physical damage to nearby enemies over 2 seconds.
19.altText: If you have multiple golem type nodes, you will summon a random golem.

20.description: Your Golem deals more spell damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), and has an increased chance to stun.

21.description: Your Golem has a higher chance to retaliate with {Bone Shatter} when hit and its Bone Shatter deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

22.description: Your Golem's {Bone Shatter} has a chance to repeat from enemies hit by it. This effect can occur a limited number of times per second.
22.altText: The repeat can hit the enemy it repeats from.

23.description: Your Golem has additional health regeneration based on your total amount of health regeneration.

24.description: Your {Skeletons} which die within 18 meters of your Bone Golem grant it more armor and melee damage (both multiplicative with other modifiers) for 10 seconds. This effect can occur a limited number of times per 10 seconds.
24.altText: Each stack of this effect is multiplicative with other stacks.

25.description: If you only control one Golem, it has a much higher chance to retaliate with {Bone Shatter} when damaged by hits from allies.
25.altText:
This effect only applies to hits that damage the Bone Golem.

The default chance (without taking this node) for an ally's hit to cause a {Bone Shatter} is the same as the chance for hits from enemies.

stats.statName: Triple Bone Shatter Chance From Ally Hits

26.description: Your Golem's {Freezing Grasp} spell now has additional spell damage and base freeze rate per point of Vitality.

stats.statName: Freezing Grasp Freeze Rate per Vitality

28.description: Your {Skeletons} and {Skeletal Mages} which die within 18 meters of your Bone Golem grant it more fire damage over time to ignited enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers) for 10 seconds. This effect can occur a limited number of times per 10 seconds.

stats.statName: Infernal Aura Damage Per Skeleton or Skeletal Mage

0.loreText: Fierce and lethal, with a penchant for the weak.

1.description: Your scorpion has more health (multiplicative with other modifiers), additional physical and poison resistance, and increased size.

2.description: Your scorpion's attacks grant health on hit, and have a higher chance to poison on hit.

3.description: Your Scorpion deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of Poison on the target (up to 30).
3.altText: This effect can be converted to shock or frostbite. If converted to shock, the damage per stack is tripled.

4.description: Your Scorpion's melee attacks have increased area of effect, and your Scorpion has increased attack speed.

5.description: Your Scorpion has a chance to cause enemies to bleed, and it deals more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers)

6.description: Your Scorpion deals additional melee damage, and its Poison Chance from all sources is converted to Armour Shred Chance.

7.description: Your Scorpion spawns a number of {Baby Scorpions} every 5 seconds. Baby Scorpions have an unlimited duration but can be killed.
7.altText:
Baby Scorpions count as minions of your Scorpion rather than your minions, but still benefit from stats that affect your minions, such as Increased Minion Damage.

Whenever your Scorpion summons baby scorpions it summons the maximum amount it can control.

8.description: {Baby Scorpions} deal more damage (damage is multiplicative with other modifiers) and their attacks have a chance to poison enemies.

9.description: Activating your Scorpion's ability summons additional {Baby Scorpions.}
9.altText: This cannot exceed your maximum number of Baby Scorpions.

10.description: {Baby Scorpions} have more dodge rating (multiplicative with other modifiers).

11.description: {Baby Scorpions} have increased attack and movement speed.

12.description: Your Scorpion has additional elemental resistance, and its abilities have increased area of effect.

13.description:
Your scorpion takes less cold damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

The base physical damage of your scorpion's melee attacks is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to minion cold damage, but not with increases to minion physical damage. These melee attacks now have a {Cold} tag instead of a {Physical} tag.

Your scorpion's melee attacks also gain a chance to freeze, with a freeze rate equal to twice their base damage.

14.description: Your Scorpion deals more cold damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a higher chance to freeze enemies.

15.description: Your scorpion has a chance to cast {Maelstrom} whenever you do. Maelstroms cast by your scorpion in this way use your Scorpion's stats, but your Maelstrom tree.
15.altText: Your scorpion will only cast {Maelstrom} on itself, not others.

stats.statName: Chance to Gain Maelstrom When You Do

16.description:
Your Scorpion's activated ability is now {Shock Nova}, a spell that deals lightning damage and applies 3 stacks of {Shock} on hit.

The base physical damage of your scorpion's melee attacks is converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to physical damage. These melee attacks now have a {Lightning} tag instead of a {Physical} tag.

All sources of poison chance are converted to shock chance for your scorpion, and effects related to poison in this tree instead depend on shock.
16.altText:
This node has no effect if {Cold-Blooded} is allocated.

{Shock Nova} deals lightning damage in an area around the scorpion, with 400% effectiveness of added damage.

17.description: Your Scorpion has a chance to {Shock} on hit and deals more lightning damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of shock on the target.

18.description:
Your scorpion has a chance on melee hit to cause a large {Avalanche} boulder to land on the target. The Avalanche boulder uses your scorpion's stats, but your Avalanche tree.

This effect can occur a limited number of times per 2 seconds.

stats.statName: Large Avalanche Boulder on Melee Hit Chance

19.description:
Your {Storm Bolts} will strike your scorpion to grant it a stack of {Charged}, up to 20.

Your scorpion's {Shock Nova} consumes all stacks of Charged to deal more damage per stack.
19.altText: Storm Bolts will only target your scorpion if it is within 20 meters and has less than 20 stacks of {Charged}.

20.description: Your Scorpion deals more poison damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

22.description: Your scorpion's {Venom Nova} deals damage in a larger area, and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
22.altText: Increased poison effect multiplies poison's damage and its reduction to poison resistance.

23.description: {Venom Nova} leaves behind a {Poison Pool} for 4 seconds, which applies a stack of poison each second to enemies standing in the pool.

24.description: Your Scorpion has a chance when it is hit to create a {Poison Pool}. This effect has a 10 second cooldown.
24.altText: Poison Pool applies a stack of poison to enemies standing in it each second.

stats.statName: Chance To Create Poison Pool When Hit

25.description: {Poison Pools} grant you and your minions increased attack speed and cast speed and a chance to poison enemies.

26.description: Your scorpion has a chance to inflict {Frostbite} on hit and its Bleed Chance from all sources is converted to Frostbite Chance.

28.description: Your scorpion has additional critical strike chance, and whenever it kills an enemy it restores a percentage of its maximum health.

1.description: Anomaly hits enemies in a larger area.

2.description: Anomaly lasts longer.

3.description: Anomaly is cast instantly, but Anomaly has a longer cooldown.

4.description: When enemies return to the present a {Time Wave} is released, a spell dealing void damage to nearby enemies.

stats.statName: Time Wave Cast On Enemy Return

5.description: {Time Wave} deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area, and increases to Anomaly's area also affect Time Wave.

6.description: An additional {Time Wave} is released when you cast Anomaly.

7.description: Anomaly has a shorter cooldown.

8.description: {Future Strike} is applied to all enemies hit by Anomaly.

9.description: {Future Strikes} applied by Anomaly have additional Void Penetration

10.description: When enemies return to the present, all damaging ailments currently applied to them apply faster.
10.altText: This affects the duration of ailments, not damage.

11.description: When enemies return to the present, the duration of damaging ailments applied to them is reset.

12.description: Enemies hit by Anomaly are afflicted with {Time Rot} when they return.

13.description: {Time Rot} inflicted by Anomaly lasts longer and has additional Void Penetration

14.description: When enemies return to the present, they take increased void damage for a duration.

15.description: Anomaly now applies Ignite instead of Time Rot. Modifiers to Time Rot apply to Ignite instead.

16.description: Anomaly applies additional stacks of ignite.

17.description: Anomaly leaves behind a {Time Bubble} for 5 seconds, which slows enemies and shreds their void resistance.

stats.statName: Void Res Shred Stacks per Second

18.description: {Time Bubble} grants you and your allies increased critical strike chance while in its area.

19.description: {Time Bubble} lasts longer.

20.description: {Time Bubble} is now cast on yourself and moves with you, but Anomaly costs more mana.

stats.statName: Time Bubble Is Cast On You

22.description: {Time Bubble} grants you and your allies increased attack and cast speed while in its area.

23.description: {Time Bubble} grants you and your allies increased cooldown recovery speed while in its area.

24.description: {Time Bubble} grants you and your allies global health leech. This is doubled for void damage.

25.description: {Time Bubble} grants you and your allies increased health leech while in its area.

26.description: Anomaly no longer sends enemies foward in time. Effects that would be triggered when enemies return to the present are instead triggered immediately.

stats.statName: No Longer Sends Enemies Forward In Time

27.description:
When enemies return to the present they are afflicted by {Time Lock,} rendering them unable to move, attack, or cast spells for 2 seconds.

Anomaly costs more mana.

10% of remaining cooldown recovered whenever you {Time Lock} an enemy with Anomaly. This effect can occur a maximum of two times each second.
27.altText: Does not affect bosses.

28.description: {Time Lock} lasts longer.
