29.description: When enemies return to the present, enemies within the area of Anomaly's original cast are also time locked for 2 seconds.

stats.statName: Nearby Enemies Afflicted With Time Lock On Return

30.description: When allies or enemies exit {Time Bubble's} area of effect, effects caused or granted by Time Bubble persist for 2 seconds.

stats.statName: Time Bubble Effects Persist For 2 Seconds On Exit

1.description: {Consecrated Ground} has increased healing effectiveness.
1.altText: This stacks additively with other sources of increased healing effectiveness and is taken into account for Consecrated Ground's bonus spell damage per increased healing effectiveness.

2.description: {Consecrated Ground} lasts longer.

3.description: {Consecrated Ground} becomes a {Consecrating Aura} which surrounds you and has a longer duration, but Judgement costs more mana. Judgement deals significantly more damage over time.
3.altText: You can only have one Consecrating Aura active at once.

4.description: {Consecrated Ground} heals allies and deals damage in a larger area.

5.description: When {Consecrated Ground} finishes, it casts {Holy Eruption}, dealing fire damage to all nearby enemies and heals you and all your nearby allies for 80 health.

6.description: {Holy Eruption} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and restore more health.

7.description: {Holy Eruption} cleanses negative ailments, such as ignite and chill, on you and allies. This effect can occur a limited number of times per 10 seconds.
7.altText: {Holy Eruption} deals 30 fire damage to all nearby enemies and heals all nearby allies for 50 health.

8.description: {Consecrated Ground} restores more health, but has a shorter duration.

9.description: Judgement now pulls in enemies and slows them, but its initial hit no longer deals damage.

10.description: {Consecrated Ground} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

11.description: {Consecrated Ground} has a chance to shred enemy armor each second.

12.description: Judgement hits and {Conscrated Ground} deal more damage against enemies at high health (multiplicative with other modifiers).
12.altText: Targets above 65% max health are considered to be at high health.

stats.statName: Conscrated Ground Damage Against High Health

13.description: Judgement hits deal more hit damage to rare and boss enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

stats.statName: Hit Damage Against Rares And Bosses

14.description: Judgement consumes all of your {Symbols of Hope} to deal additional fire damage for each Symbol consumed.
14.altText: Consecrated Ground is affected by the spell fire damage gained per Symbol.

15.description: Judgement now also consumes a percentage of your current mana and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per mana consumed.

16.description: Judgement gains significant physical and fire penetration, but no longer leaves behind {Consecrated Ground}.

17.description: Judgement deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has an increased chance to stun enemies.

18.description: Judgement also casts {Smite} at nearby enemies. Smite consumes mana equal to its mana cost for each cast.

19.description: Judgement hits have a chance to ignite enemies and ignites applied by Judgement have additional Fire Penetration.

20.description: Judgement's melee attack heals you and nearby allied players for each enemy it hits. This healing is affected by your increased healing effectiveness.
20.altText: All allied players within 15 metres are healed.

21.description: Judgement hits and {Consecrated Ground} deal more damage against ignited enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

stats.statName: Conscrated Ground Damage Against Ignited Enemies

22.description: Judgement hits have more critical strike chance against ignited enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

23.description: Judgement critical strikes deal more damage.

24.description: Judgement has a shorter cooldown and a lower mana cost.

25.description: Judgement's melee attack cannot be dodged and deals more fire damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) based on your increased healing effectiveness.
25.altText: This fire damage modifier also applies to any ailments Judgement's melee attack inflicts, such as Ignite.

stats.statName: Fire Damage per 10% Increased Healing Effectiveness

26.description: You gain Frenzy for a duration after using Judgement if it hits at least one enemy.

27.description: If you hit at least one enemy with Judgement you gain the {Deliverance} buff, which drastically increases mana regen and health regen.

28.description: While you have the {Deliverance} buff whenever you directly use Vengeance, Rive, or Multistrike and hit at least one enemy you regain additional mana.

29.description: Judgement no longer has a cooldown, but costs substantially more mana and its healing restores less health (multiplicative with other modifiers). Its mana cost now counts as mana consumed for the effect of the {Pious Offering} node.
29.altText: The less healing for Consecrated Ground only affects the amount of health restored by the ability, it does not affect modifiers that are based on healing effectiveness.

0.altText:
Multiple thorns cannot hit the same target

Freeze rate grants a chance to freeze on hit that is higher against enemies with lower health
0.loreText: Release the rage of the thicket

2.description: Ice Thorns travel faster and farther, and you have a chance to release 6 additional thorns when casting Ice Thorns.

3.description: Ice Thorns travel faster and farther.

4.description: Ice Thorns has a chance to pierce enemies (pass through enemies they hits), and Ice Thorns hits deal additional base cold damage.

5.description: Ice Thorns now creates a {Thorn Barrier} for 1 second before releasing granting you armor.

6.description: {Thorn Barrier} lasts longer before releasing.

7.description: {Thorn Barrier} has a chance to recast when it expires.

8.description: You can cast {Thorn Barrier} on allies, and which will provide them armour and cause thorns to burst from them when it expires.

9.description: You have a chance to cast Ice Thorns when hit by enemies.

stats.statName: Chance To Cast Ice Thorns When Hit

10.description: You have a chance to cast Ice Thorns when hit by enemies, and Ice Thorns deals additional spell physical damage.

stats.statName: Chance To Cast Ice Thorns When Hit

11.description: Ice Thorns has a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

12.description: Kills with Ice Thorns have a chance to cast {Thorn Trail,} a spell which travels along the ground in a line dealing physical damage to enemies it hits, but Ice Thorns deals less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
12.altText: Thorn Trail scales with increases to physical and spell damage, but not with other nodes on this tree.

stats.statName: Chance To Cast Thorn Trail On Kill

13.description:
Ice Thorns hits have a chance to cast {Sundering Thorns}, a spell which travels in a line dealing physical damage to enemies hit.

Sundering Thorns has a 4 second cooldown.
13.altText: Sundering Thorns scales with increases to physical and spell damage, but not with other nodes on this tree.

stats.statName: Chance To Cast Sundering Thorns On Hit

14.description: {Sundering Thorns} has a shorter cooldown.

15.description: Ice Thorns deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). This effect is doubled if you have an active totem.

16.description: Ice Thorns deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for each of your active totems.

17.description: Ice Thorns deals more damage and you have a chance to cast Ice Thorns when hit if you have at least 2 active totems.

stats.statName: Chance To Cast Ice Thorns When Hit (2 Active Totems)

18.description: Ice Thorns now casts twice in quick succession, but has a 4 second cooldown.

19.description: Ice Thorns has a shorter cooldown, and {Thorn Barrier} grants a chance to avoid critical strikes.

20.description: Ice Thorns costs no mana if you're using a two-handed melee weapon.

21.description: {Thorn Barrier} grants additional armor.

22.description: Ice Thorns releases additional thorns, but costs more mana.

23.description: Ice Thorns releases additional thorns and deals additional spell physical damage, but thorns have a shorter duration and no longer home in on enemies.

24.description: Ice Thorns' base cold damage is converted to physical damage. Ice Thorns has higher cast speed, but can no longer freeze enemies.
24.loreText: As the winter thaws the meltwater leaves new life in its wake

25.description: Ice Thorns hits deal additional base cold damage and have a higher chance to freeze enemies.

26.description: Converts bleed chance from all sources to poison chance for Ice Thorns, and poison inflicted by Ice Thorns lasts longer.

27.description: When you use Ice Thorns you gain a stack of {Farwood Heart} for 4 seconds, a buff that grants 25% increased cold damage and +40% freeze rate multiplier.

28.description: Improves Ice Thorns' base critical strike chance, and Ice Thorns critical strikes deal more damage.

29.description:
You have a chance to summon a {Thorn Totem} when Ice Thorns kills an enemy.

You can only summon a Thorn Totem this way every 3 seconds.

2.description: Dive Bomb has a shorter cooldown.

3.description: You reduce a portion of Dive Bomb's remaining cooldown when you use a throwing or bow attack and hit at least one enemy.

4.description:
Before your Falcon dives it now uses {Featherfall} that causes razor-sharp feathers to strike a number of enemies in an area around the target location.

{Shadow Falcons} won't use {Featherfall}.

6.description: Dive Bomb's hits slows enemies and it deals damage in a larger area.

7.description: Dive Bomb's hits apply {Critical Vulnerability} on enemies.

8.description:
Dive Bomb and {Featherfall} hits grant you a stack of {Talon Blades} for 18 seconds.

You have increased critical strike chance and critical multiplier per stack.

All stacks of {Talon Blades} are lost if you directly use Dive Bomb again.

9.description: You move faster while you have at least 5 stacks of {Talon Blades}.

10.description:
If Dive Bomb hits your {Explosive Traps} they instantly explode dealing more damage in a larger area (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

Additionally, when you detonate an {Explosive Trap} this way you gain a stack of {Talon Blades}.

stats.statName: Explosive Traps Detonate From Dive Bomb

11.description: Dive Bomb's hits shred enemy physical resistance.

12.description: Dive Bomb's hits grant you a stack of {Crimson Shroud} per enemy hit, up to a maximum.

13.description:
Dive Bomb's hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of bleed on the target up to a maximum.

Additionally, it causes all bleed stacks inflicted by you or your Falcon to be consumed to deal their remaining damage instantly.

14.description: Dive Bomb deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and it has a shorter delay before the Falcon dives.

15.description: Dive Bomb deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and stuns caused by it last longer, but it has a longer cooldown.

18.description:
Dive Bomb now creates a {Shadow Falcon} to strike the location of your own {Shadows} and it will prioritize your {Shadows} nearest the target location, but {Shadow Falcons} deal less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) than the real Falcon.

The number of {Shadow Falcons} cannot exceed the number of {Shadows} you currently have.
18.altText: Increases to your own {Shadow} damage also apply to your {Shadow Falcons}.

19.description: You have a chance to gain a stack of {Dusk Shroud} for each {Shadow Falcon} that hit at least one enemy.

stats.statName: Dusk Shroud Chance From Shadow Falcons

20.description:
A {Shadow Falcon} takes your Falcon's place, that uses Dive Bomb. Your Falcon is able to attack and use other abilities during this.
If you do not have an active Falcon, Dive Bomb will scale with your stats instead.

21.description: Your {Shadow Falcons} that land inside the area of your {Smoke Bomb} have a chance to take off again after a short delay before diving again at a nearby enemy to deal damage around them.

stats.statName: Shadow Falcons Chance To Dive Again

22.description: Your {Shadow Falcons} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modfiers) per {Umbral Blade} you have on the ground, up to a maximum.
22.altText: This effect does not include Umbral Blades in flight, but it does include Blade Storms and Umbral blade waiting to explode.

stats.statName: Shadow Falcon Damage Per Umbral Blade
Max More Damage From Umbral Blades

23.description:
If you are wielding a spear you also leap to the target location when you use Dive Bomb. This deals damage in the area around the target.

Dive Bomb gains the {Traversal} tag.

24.description: Dive Bomb's hits cause enemies to bleed.

25.description: If you are dual wielding, a portion of the damage specific stats from both of your weapons apply to your Falcon's Dive Bomb.
25.altText: This doesn't include unique effects.

26.description: Dive Bomb deals more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers) per 10% of your increased stun chance.

stats.statName: Ailment Damage Per 10% Increased Stun Chance

27.description: If Dive Bomb hits at least one boss or rare enemy you regain mana and recover a portion of your remaining traversal skills' cooldown.

stats.statName: Mana Gain On Boss Or Rare Hit

28.description:
If Dive Bomb hits one of your {Decoy}, it detonates it, causing its explosion to deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

The effects from the {Rapid Pursuit} node are also gained when Dive Bomb hits one of your {Decoys}.

Dive Bomb cannot explode more than one {Decoy} per use.

29.description: Dive Bomb deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and costs less mana.

30.description:
If your Falcon lands inside the area of your {Smoke Bomb} the smoke area lasts longer.

This effect can occur once per Smoke Bomb.

32.description: {Featherfall's} hits shred enemy armor.

2.description: Aerial Assault deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a shorter cooldown.

3.description: After the initial {Wing Burst} your Falcon continues releasing {Featherstorm} at the target location for 5 seconds.

4.description:
{Featherstorm} now has a chance to slow enemies inside its area each second. 

Additionally, you and your allies have additional dodge rating while inside the area.

stats.statName: Dodge Rating per Dex inside Feather Storm

5.description: If there is a boss or rare enemy nearby, Aerial Assault now also creates a {Shadow Falcon} to use {Featherstorm} against it.

6.description:
Aerial Assault no longer moves you. Additionally, it deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and it no longer has a minimum range.

Aerial Assault loses its {Traversal} tag.

7.description: {Featherstorm} lasts longer and deals more direct damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per second it has been active.
7.altText: Direct damage modifiers do not affect damage of ailments from Featherstorm.

stats.statName: Feather Storm Damage Bonus Per Second

8.description: {Featherstorm} now has a chance each second to drop a {Black Arrow}.

9.description:
{Featherstorms'} base physical damage over time is converted to poison. Consequently this damage scales with increases to poison damage, but not increases to physical damage.

A portion of your global poison chance on hit now applies as poison chance per second for {Featherstorm}.

Swaps {Featherstorms'} {Physical} tag for a {Poison} tag.

10.description: A portion of Aerial Assault's cooldown is recovered when your Falcon hits an enemy. This effect can occur a limited number of times per 3 seconds.

stats.statName: Remaining Cooldown Recovered On Falcon Hit

11.description: Using Aerial Assault now also drops {Caltrops} at your location.

12.description: {Caltrops} from all sources have a chance to slow on hit and deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

13.description: You now drop additional {Caltrops} halfway through Aerial Assault's movement if you traveled at least 6 meters.

14.description:
{Caltrops'} hits from all sources have a chance to cause enemies to bleed. 

Additionally, when an enemy walks over your {Caltrops} your Falcon's hits gain additional bleed chance scaling with your Dexterity for 4 seconds. This effect can occur a limited number of times per 4 seconds.

stats.statName: Falcon Bleed Chance per 10 Dex with Buff

15.description: Directly using Aerial Assault recovers a portion of your missing mana.

16.description: Directly using Aerial Assault recovers a portion of the remaining cooldown of {Falconry} and {Dive Bomb} per 10 maximum mana you have.

17.description: Directly using Aerial Assault recovers a portion of your missing health.

18.description: Convert the health gain from the {Healing Gust} node to ward at half the effect.

19.description:
For the next 8 seconds after using Aerial Assault, critical strikes dealt by you or your {Falcon} grant you a stack of {Aerial Prowess} up to a maximum.

When you next use Aerial Assault, it consumes all stacks to restore health per stack and deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack.

20.description:
You have more global dodge rating (multiplicative with other modifiers) while traveling with Aerial Assault.

Additionally, each hit you dodge while traveling grants you a stack of {Aerial Prowess}.

21.description: Aerial Assault now has a chance to grant you {Aerial Prowess} stacks on non-critical strikes and when you kill an enemy.

22.description: Consuming stacks of {Aerial Assault} now grants you {Haste} and Frenzy for a short duration per stack consumed.

23.description: Directly using {Ballista,} {Explosive Trap}, or {Dive Bomb} now also consumes your stacks of {Aerial Prowess}, applying the damage bonus to the ability that consumed them.

stats.statName: Aerial Prowess applies to other Abilities

25.description: The {Wing Burst's} hits apply frailty.

26.description: After landing, all your active {Ballistas} prioritize targets around you, deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per Intelligence, and gain increased attack speed.

27.description: The {Wing Burst} deals damage in a larger area.
27.altText: This effect also applies to {Featherstorm}.

28.description: The {Wing Burst} deals more direct damage to enemies on high health.
28.altText:
Direct damage modifiers do not affect damage of ailments and subskills from Aerial Assault.

This direct damage modifier does affect {Featherstorm}.

29.description: The damage bonus from {Ambush} always applies against bosses and rare enemies, regardless of their health.

stats.statName: Damage bonus always applies to bosses and rares

30.description: When the {Wing Burst} kills an enemy and you have 3 or fewer active {Shadows}, it creates a {Shadow} at that enemy's location.

stats.statName: Shadow Falcon on Feather Burst Kill

31.description: A portion of your added, increased, and more throwing damage modifiers now apply to the {Wing Burst}.

32.description: The {Wing Burst} now also includes a few {Umbral Blades} that your Falcon throws for you.

33.description: The {Umbral Blades'} hits from the {Twilight Strike} node now shred enemy armor.

2.description: Javelin hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed and have a chance to slow.

4.description: Javelin hits deal more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to enemies the farther away they are, up to a maximum of 15 meters.

5.description: Javelin gains physical and lightning penetration for each second you have been standing still up to a maximum duration.
5.altText: Partial seconds are counted towards the maximum bonus. For examble standing still for half a second grants Javelin 6% physical and lightning penetration with one point allocated. This is counted when Javelin is thrown, not when you start throwing.

6.description: Javelin deals more damage, but has less attack speed (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

7.description: Javelin deals more lightning damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and its hits deal additional lightning damage.

8.description: Javelin hits have a chance to apply {Frailty} per point of Strength and a chance to shred enemy physical resistance per point of Dexterity.

stats.statName: Physical Res Shred Chance Per Dex

9.description:
Javelin's base physical damage is converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Ignite and bleed chance from all sources is converted to {Electrify} for Javelin and effects related to bleed or ignite now depend on Electrify instead.

Physical resistance shred chance from all sources is converted to lightning resistance shred chance and effects related to Physical resistance shred now depend on lightning resistance shred instead.

Swaps Javelin's {Physical} tag for a {Lightning} tag.

10.description: Javelin has a chance to {Electrify} enemies on hit. Electrify applied by Javelin has additional Lightning Penetration.

11.description: When Javelin hits an enemy it now splits into additional piercing lightning spears which aim towards enemies close to the target, but Javelin itself can no longer pierce and it costs more mana.
11.altText: If there are no other enemies nearby the target, only 2 lightning spears will be created.

12.description:
Javelin hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

This effect is doubled against enemies on high health.
12.altText: Targets above 65% max health are considered to be at high health.

13.description: Javelin hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) up to a maximum, for each enemy pierced.

14.description: Improves Javelin's base critical strike chance and its critical strikes deal more damage.

15.description: Javelin hits have a chance to shred enemy armor.

16.description: Javelin costs less mana.

17.description: Directly using Javelin causes your next melee attack to costs less mana.

18.description: Directly using Javelin and hitting an enemy causes your next {Judgement} or {Forge Strike} to deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

19.description: Javelin deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has increased attack speed.

20.description: Javelin hits have a chance to ignite enemies.

21.description: You now throw Javelin into the air causing 4 javelins to rain down at target location dealing damage in an area, but it costs more mana.

22.description:
Now only 1 Javelin rains down at the target location, it deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and persists for 4 seconds, but has a cooldown.

It has a {Battle Standard} attached granting you and other allies in its radius increased damage and added endurance threshold based on your attunement.
22.altText:
You are limited to 1 standard.

If Javelin would echo, the echo instead throws down a Javelin similar to the {Siege Barrage} node, rather than another Battle Standard.

23.description: The {Battle Standard} now heals allies around it each second. The amount of health gained is increased by healing effectiveness.

24.description: The {Battle Standard} now lasts longer, but is still limited to one standard.

25.description: If an enemy walks over the {Battle Standard} it captures it and carries the flag until it expires.
25.altText: This just means the {Battle Standard} aura moves with the enemy, not that they gain the buffs.

26.description: The {Battle Standard} now casts {Smite} at targets nearby every 1.5 seconds.

27.description: The {Battle Standard} casts {Smite} more frequently and Smite cast this way has improved base critical strike chance.

28.description:
Javelin is now a combo ability, the first part throws down the {Battle Standard} and the second part causes you to {Dash} to the flag.

Javelin's cooldown is now longer.
28.altText: This effect works even if the {Battle Standard} has been picked up by an enemy.

29.description: Additional Javelins rain down, but Javelin costs more mana.

31.description: Javelin now leaves behind a {Holy Trail}, that deals fire and lightning damage to enemies each second, heals you and your allies each second and lasts for 6 seconds, but Javelin now has a cooldown. The amount of health gained is increased by healing effectiveness
31.altText: This has no effect if you have taken the {Siege Barrage} node.

32.description: Javelin deals more fire and lightning damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and you have a chance to ignite and electrify enemies with melee attacks while Javelin is on cooldown.

33.description: Javelin deals more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

35.description: {Holy Trail} gains additional spell damage based on your increased healing effectiveness.

stats.statName: Spell Damage per 5% Increased Healing Effectivenes

0.description: Summons a Volatile Zombie which shambles towards an enemy and explodes.

1.description: Storm Crows have increased cast speed, movement speed and more health (multiplicative with other modifiers).

2.description: Storm Crows hits have a chance to shred enemy armor.

3.description: Storm Crows deal more damage per active crow (multiplicative with other modifiers).

4.description: Storm Crows hits have a chance to shred enemy armor per point of strength, and armor shred they apply has increased effectiveness per point of strength.

5.description: Your melee hits have a 20% chance to grant active Storm Crows more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for 10 seconds, stacking up to 3 times.

6.description: Storm Crows have a chance to shock enemies and have additional lightning resistance.

7.description: {Crowstorm} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has an increased chance to stun enemies.

8.description: Storm Crows have additional dodge chance and increased dodge chance.

9.description: {Crowstorm} deals damage in a larger area and has a chance to shock enemies it hits.

10.description:
Storm Crows' base lightning damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to lightning damage. It also has a chance to freeze enemies.

Shock chance from all sources is converted to {Frostbite} chance and effects related to shock now depend on Frostbite instead.

11.description: Storm Crows have a higher chance to freeze enemies.

12.description: Storm Crows deal more spell damage per stack of shock on the target (multiplicative with other modifiers), up to a maximum.

13.description: Your increases to lightning damage also apply to your Storm Crows, but at reduced effectiveness.
13.altText:
Elemental damage increases and increases that don't have a specific damage type also apply to the crows' lightning damage.

This node has no effect on non-lightning damage, even if the crows' damage type is converted.

14.description: Storm Crows' basic lightning spell has a chance to chain to up to 2 additional targets.

15.description: Storm Crows deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and have increased critical strike chance.

16.description: Storm Crows' critical strikes deal more damage.

17.description: Your melee hits have a 20% chance to improve active Storm Crows' base critical strike chance for 10 seconds, stacking up to 3 times.

18.description: Storm Crows' basic lightning spell deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for each second they spent moving since their previous attack, up to a maximum duration.

19.description: You can now only have 1 Storm Crow, it deals more damage, has more health (both multiplicative with other modifiers) and is larger.

20.description: Storm Crows' basic lightning spell deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but now consumes your mana.
20.altText: This effect does not work if you are out of mana.

21.description: Storm Crow hits have a chance to grant you a stack of {Aspect of the Crow} for 8 seconds, granting you additional melee and spell lightning damage per stack.

22.description: Your non-crow companions gain {Aspect of the Crow} when you do, but it has 50% reduced duration on them.

stats.statName: Aspect of the Crow On Other Companions

23.description:
Storm Crows fly to your companions below half health to heal them. This effect has a 10 second cooldown.

The amount of healing is increased by healing effectiveness.

24.description:
{Goodberries} now also grants the companion ward. 

The amount of ward gained is increased by healing effectiveness.

25.description: Storm Crows are able to use {Goodberries} more frequently.

26.description: Storm Crows can now also fly to and heal you with {Goodberries}.
26.altText: This also takes the effect of the {Silverberries} node.

27.description:
Every 10 seconds Storm Crows cast {Wisdom of the Storm} on its nearest ally, granting it {Aspect of the Crow}. 

This effect has 50% reduced duration on minions.

stats.statName: Wisdom of the Storm On Allies

28.description: You are granted additional Intelligence per active Storm Crow.

29.description: {Wisdom of the Storm} no longer has a cooldown, but can now only target totems.

stats.statName: Wisdom of the Storm On Totems

30.description:
When you directly cast {Crowstorm} you and your crows are teleported to the target location if it is accessible.

Crowstorm now counts as a {Traversal} skill.
30.altText: Using a Traversal skill puts all other traversal skills on cooldown and traversal skills' cooldowns do not recover while you are using a traversal skill.

31.description: {Crowstorm} deals more damage per contributing Crow (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a shorter cooldown.
31.altText: The damage bonus from Thunderous Blast is additive with Crowstorm's baseline more damage per contributing Crow.

0.loreText: Reap the death mark

2.description: Harvest hits have a chance to reduce enemy necrotic resistance, and Harvest deals more damage over time.

3.description:
Harvest grants you health each time it hits a cursed enemy.

Health gained scales with your intelligence stat.

stats.statName: Health Gained Per Point Of Intelligence

4.description: When Harvest hits a target afflicted by Spirit Plague, it applies Withering and has a chance to spread Spirit Plague to an additional target.

5.description: Harvest has increased area of effect, and is increased further if using a two handed weapon.

6.description: Improves Harvest's base critical strike chance, and increases Harvest's attack speed.

7.description: You have increased critical strike chance and critical strike multiplier if you have hit a {Cursed} enemy with Harvest recently (past 4 seconds).

8.description: Critical hits with Harvest have a chance to grant Haste for 2 seconds.

9.description: Harvest hits deal more damage against {Cursed} enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).
9.altText: Bone Curse, Marked For Death, and Spirit Plague are examples of Curses.

10.description:
Harvest grants you ward when it hits a {Cursed} enemy. This effect can occur a limited number of times per 5 seconds.
Harvest also deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

12.description: When you directly use Harvest, you restore mana for each enemy killed or each boss or rare enemy hit.

stats.statName: Mana Restored on Boss or Rare Enemy Hit

13.description:
When Harvest kills an enemy or hits at least one boss or rare enemy, you have a chance to gain a stack of {Stolen Spirit}, up to 5.

At 5 stacks, your next Harvest hit against a boss or rare enemy consumes all stacks to release a Wandering Spirit per stack.

stats.statName: Chance to Gain Stack on Kill
Chance to Gain Stack on Boss or Rare Hit
Spirits Released on Harvest Hit at 5 Stacks

14.description: Harvest hits have a chance to poison enemies.

15.description: Harvest hits deal more hit damage per unique ailment on the target (multiplicative with other modifiers), up to a maximum benefit.

16.description:
Harvest's base necrotic damage is converted to physical. Consequently this damage scales with increases to physical damage, but not increases to necrotic damage.

Harvest now gains bleed chance per point of intelligence. Harvest's added damage per dexterity scaling is now added physical melee damage.

Swaps Harvest's {Necrotic} tag for a {Physical} tag.

17.description: Harvest has a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

18.description:
When you hit an enemy with Harvest both you and the enemy are inflicted with bleed. Bleed stacks on enemies inflicted by Harvest have additional Physical Penetration.

The self-inflicted bleed does not scale with your stats.

19.description: When you directly use Harvest and hit at least one enemy, gain a percentage of your missing health as ward.

stats.statName: Percent Missing Health Gained as Ward

20.description: Harvest has additional critical strike chance and critical multiplier, but a percentage of your current health is also consumed on use.

stats.statName: Percent Current Health Consumed On Use

21.description: Minions have increased critical strike chance if you have landed a critical strike with Harvest recently (past 4 seconds).

22.description: Harvest hits instantly kill enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health), and Harvest deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
22.altText: If you have a similar effect from an item or passive node then the highest threshold is used.

23.description: When Harvest kills an enemy or hits a boss or rare enemy, you have a chance to summon a {Volatile Zombie}, consuming a percentage of its mana cost. This effect can occur a limited number of times per 3 seconds.

stats.statName: Percent of Volatile Zombie Mana Cost Consumed

24.description: Harvest hits leave a trace on enemies, causing enemies to take increased damage and be prioritized by your minions. Traces last for 5 seconds.

25.description: Harvest has a chance to summon a {Blood Specter} when it kills an enemy. You cannot summon more than one Blood Specter every 2 seconds.
25.altText: {Blood Specters} have a base of 100 health, decay over time, and use melee attacks.

26.description: {Blood Specters} summoned by Harvest have a significantly increased critical strike chance.
26.altText: {Blood Specters} have a base of 100 health, decay over time, and use melee attacks.

27.description: {Blood Specters} summoned by Harvest leech a signficant portion of the damage they deal as health.
27.altText: {Blood Specters} have a base of 100 health, decay over time, and use melee attacks.

28.description: {Blood Specters} summoned by Harvest deal additional melee necrotic damage.
28.altText: {Blood Specters} have a base of 100 health, decay over time, and use melee attacks.

29.description:
Harvest's base necrotic damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to necrotic damage.

Harvest now gains frostbite chance per point of intelligence. Harvest gains added cold melee damage per dexterity instead of added necrotic melee damage. Bleed chance from all sources is converted to frostbite chance.

Swaps Harvest's {Necrotic} tag for a {Cold} tag.
29.altText: This node has no effect if {Crimson Death} is allocated.

30.description: Harvest has increased attack speed, and is increased further if dual wielding.

2.description: Shadow Rend deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

3.description: Shadow Rend deals more damage, but has less attack speed (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

4.description: Shadows consumed by {Shadow Massacre} have a chance to manifest a new shadow afterwards, based on their distance from you. Maximum effect is reached for shadows that are at least 6 meters away.

5.description: Each shadow consumed by {Shadow Massacre} or {Hidden Strength} restores health based on your dexterity.

6.description: You have a chance to gain a stack of {Dusk Shroud} when you directly use Shadow Rend and hit at least one enemy with the shadow's attack.

7.description: The manifested shadow chooses a random enemy to dash toward, ignoring your targeted direction. It can target enemies that are further away.

8.description: For every {Dusk Shroud} on you up to 20, the shadow's attack deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and grants ward if it hits at least one enemy.

9.description: Shadow Rend has additional chance to inflict bleed on hit, doubled for the shadow's attack.

stats.statName: Bleed Chance, Doubled for Shadow Attack

10.description: Shadow Rend has additional critical strike chance.

11.description: Shadow Rend has additional chance to shock enemies on hit, and it has additional critical strike multiplier per shock on the enemy.

12.description: Shadow Rend has additional critical strike multiplier, and additional chance to blind enemies on hit.

13.description: The shadow's attack has a chance to inflict Shadow Daggers on hit.

stats.statName: Shadow Daggers Chance for Shadow Attack

14.description: Traversal skills consume all stacks of {Ghost Blades} over the course of their duration.

stats.statName: All Ghost Blades Stacks Consumed on Traversal

15.description: Shadow Rend has a chance to inflict frailty and slow on hit.

16.description: Shadow Rend has additional physical penetration per unique negative ailment on the enemy, up to 5.
16.altText: This can be converted to lightning penetration by {Dusklight}.

stats.statName: Physical Penetration per Unique Negative Ailment

17.description: Directly using Shadow Rend grants Frenzy for a duration, and Shadow Rend deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) while you have frenzy.

18.description: While you are inside your {Smoke Bomb}, Shadow Rend has increased attack speed and a lower mana cost.

19.description: Shadow Rend has increased attack speed and a lower mana cost.

20.description:
Shadow Rend has increased melee area for the shadow's attack.

The shadow's attack has a chance to shred armor on hit, doubled with a bow.

stats.statName: Armor Shred Chance for Shadow Attack, Doubled with Bow

21.description:
Directly using Shadow Rend consumes existing shadows to make them imitate Multishot or Shadow Cascade, depending on your equipped weapon type. Each Shadow Cascade or Multishot imitated consumes mana.

This node has no effect if {Hidden Strength} is allocated.

stats.statName: Shadows Imitate Multishot with a Bow
Shadows Imitate Shadow Cascade with a Melee Weapon

22.description: Shadow Rend no longer moves you. The manifested shadow dashes forward 5 meters in the targeted direction before attacking, and will choose a target within range upon arriving.
22.altText: {Shadow Rush} can still move you.

23.description:
Directly using Shadow Rend consumes all shadows. It restores mana if you consume at least 1 shadow.

For each shadow consumed after the first, it gains more damage and more melee area (both multiplicative with other modifiers).
23.altText: For example with 1 point invested and 3 shadows consumed, you will restore 2 mana and Shadow Rend will gain 40% more damage and 20% more area.

stats.statName: Mana Restored from First Shadow Consumed
Melee Area from Subsequent Shadows Consumed

24.description:
Shadow Rend is now a traversal skill. You dash up to 7 meters forward after manifesting the shadow.

Shadow Rend deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a cooldown.

25.description: Shadow Rend's base physical damage is converted to lightning damage. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to physical damage.

26.description: Directly using Shadow Rend and hitting at least one enemy with the shadow's attack grants stacks of {Ghost Blades}, up to 9. Stacks of Ghost Blades are consumed 3 times per second while moving to throw a Ghost Blade at a nearby enemy.
26.altText: Ghost Blades ignore conversions from effects such as {Dusklight}.

stats.statName: Ghost Blade Stacks Consumed per Second While Moving

27.description:
Bleed chance from all sources is converted to poison chance for Shadow Rend.

Shadow Rend deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per poison on the enemy, up to 30.

stats.statName: Hit Damage per Poison, up to 30

28.description: Shadow Rend deals more bow damage to damaged enemies. When used with a bow, Shadow Rend moves you forwards instead of backwards.

29.description: Shadow Rend has an additional charge.

30.description:
You have a chance to throw {Shurikens} or {Umbral Blades} at a nearby enemy when you jump and when you land, consuming 70% of the skill's mana cost each time.

The skill chosen is your most recently directly used skill among them, or else random.

stats.statName: Chance to Throw Shurikens or Umbral Blades on Leap
Chance to Throw Shurikens or Umbral Blades on Land

0.loreText: Wrath of the mountain

2.description: Avalanche is now channeled, creating 1 large boulder and 5 small boulders every second, but has a channeling cost every second.

3.description: Small boulders now fall in a smaller area up to a maximum, causing them to hit more precisely at the target location.

4.description:
Avalanche's every third large boulder creates an {Earthquake} on impact.

This effect consumes mana equal to a portion of {Earthquake's} mana cost.

5.description: Avalanche costs less mana.

6.description:
The persisting Avalanche is now cast around you and follows your movement.

The large boulders will automatically target enemies within 6 meters.

7.description: Avalance now persists after you stop channeling for a duration equal to how long you spent channeling, up to a maximum.

8.description: Avalanche deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

9.description: Avalanche's base cold damage is converted to physical damage, and freeze rate multiplier bonuses from this tree are converted to increased stun chance.
9.altText: If you have this and Frost, this node has no effect.

stats.statName: Freeze Rate Multiplier -> Increased Stun Chance

10.description:
Avalanche hits have an increased chance to stun enemies.

Additionally, the impact from the large boulders have a chance to create your {Upheaval} towards a nearby enemy.

This consumes mana equal to a portion of {Upheaval's} mana cost.

11.description:
Avalanche costs less mana.

If it's channeled l it will reduce the channel cost instead.

12.description: Avalanche hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) while you have at least one active totem.

13.description: While in range of a {Storm Totem}, Avalanche hits deal additional lightning damage.

stats.statName: Lightning Damage In Range Of Storm Totem

14.description: Boulder hits have a chance to grant you a {Storm Stack}.

15.description: Small boulders have a chance to be replaced by large boulders.

16.description:
Avalanche drops additional small boulders.

If Avalanche is channeled, small boulders drop more frequently instead.

17.description:
Large boulders will cause a {Fissure} to open underneath them, dealing physical damage over 4 seconds to enemies who stand on it.

You can have a maximum of 1 {Fissure} at a time.

18.description:
Improves Avalanche's base critical strike chance.

When a large boulder critically strikes, it has a chance to drop a small boulder at the same location.

19.description: Avalanche hits have an increased chance to freeze enemies.

20.description: Avalanche's base physical damage is converted to cold damage, and increased stun chance provided by this tree is converted to freeze rate multiplier.
20.altText: If you have this node and Rockfall, then the Rockfall node has no effect.

stats.statName: Increased Stun Chance -> Freeze Rate Multiplier

21.description: Avalanche's large boulders have a chance to leave behind {Frozen Ground,} which chills all enemies who stand on it.

stats.statName: Large Boulder Chance To Leave Frozen Ground

22.description:
{Frozen Ground} affects a larger area.

You and your allies standing on your {Frozen Ground} gain a chance to inflict frostbite on hit.

23.description:
Avalanche hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

This effect is doubled against frozen enemies.

24.description: Avalanche boulders fall in a larger area, and each boulder has a larger area of impact.

25.description: Avalanche boulders have a larger area of impact.

26.description: Boulders fall in a larger area. This reduces your chance to hit single targets.

27.description:
Large boulders have a chance to form into a {Coldstone Elemental}, which is a melee minion that deals cold and physical damage and decays over time.

You can summon up to 9 {Coldstone Elementals}, and summoning past this maximum will refresh the decay and health of the most decayed one.

28.description: When a {Coldstone Elemental} is hit by a boulder, they regain health and gain {Frenzy} and {Haste} for a short duration.

2.description: Flay deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), and has a chance to chill on hit.

3.description: Every second melee attack with Flay which hits a boss or rare enemy has a chance to trigger a Blood Eruption.

stats.statName: Blood Eruption Chance Every Second Attack

4.description: Flay deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), doubled against low life enemies.
4.altText: Enemies which are below 35% of their maximum health are at low life.

5.description: Enemies hit by Flay are inflicted with Marked for Death for a duration, and Flay hits instantly kill enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health).
5.altText: Marked for Death is a Curse that reduces all resistances by 25%. It cannot stack.

6.description: While using a dagger, Flay has increased attack speed.

7.description:
When you directly use Flay and hit at least one enemy, you have a chance to gain Haste for 2 seconds. This chance is tripled if Flay is a traversal skill.

Flay's Spirit Step can move you from a further distance.

stats.statName: Haste Chance Tripled if Flay is Traversal

8.description: When you directly use Flay and hit at least one enemy with the melee attack, your active {Aura of Decay} is granted more ailment frequency (multiplicative with other modifiers) and increased radius for 4 seconds.
8.altText: This effect stacks endlessly, but each stack falls off separately. Stacks are additive with each other.

stats.statName: Aura of Decay More Ailment Frequency

9.description:
Hitting a boss or rare enemy with Flay's melee attack transfers your active Aura of Decay to them for up to 6 seconds.

While the aura is attached to an enemy, you can move away from it to avoid the self-inflicted ailments.
9.altText: The aura will re-attach to you after the duration ends or the enemy dies. Subsequent Flay melee attacks can refresh the duration or transfer the effect to a different enemy.

stats.statName: Aura of Decay Transferable to Boss or Rare Enemies

10.description: Flay has increased area of effect and additional spell damage. These effects are doubled if there is a bleeding enemy within 15 meters.

stats.statName: Doubled with a Bleeding Enemy Within Distance (meters)

11.description: A percentage of the melee damage on your equipped axes or daggers is also applied as spell damage for the Blood Eruption.
11.altText: For example with 2 points invested, if a weapon has 10 melee physical damage, Blood Eruption will receive 5 spell physical damage. This applies to all affixes and implicits which directly provide melee damage on your axes and daggers, but not any other sources of melee damage.

stats.statName: Melee Damage On Axes Or Daggers As Spell Damage

12.description:
Flay and all skills triggered by its skill tree deal more spell damage per 100 maximum mana. 
Flay has additional mana cost.
12.altText: This applies to Blood Eruption and all skills triggered by Flay's skill tree, such as Chaos Bolts from {Chaos Rip}. It does not affect those skills if they were not triggered by Flay.

13.description:
Directly using Flay and hitting at least one enemy with the melee attack has a chance per 1 maximum mana to release a {Chaos Bolt} towards an enemy.
This effect consumes 2 mana per Chaos Bolt released.
13.altText: For example if you have 250 maximum mana, you will release 2 Chaos Bolts with a 50% chance for a third.

stats.statName: Chaos Bolt Chance per 1 Maximum Mana

14.description: Flay has additional critical strike chance, and leeches a percentage of damage dealt as health.

15.description:
Flay has additional critical strike multiplier.
Critically hitting at least one enemy with Flay's melee attack has a chance to release Marrow Shards towards another nearby enemy within 6 meters.
15.altText: The Marrow Shards will hit the initial enemy and then continue towards another nearby enemy. If they are not able to pierce, they will only hit the initial enemy.

16.description: Flay inflicts {Exposed Flesh} on hit, a Curse which reduces cold resistance and armor, and increases the target's chance to be frozen.

17.description: Blood Eruption has increased area of effect and deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for each of your curses that were on the enemy.

stats.statName: Blood Eruption Increased Area per Curse
Blood Eruption Hit Damage per Curse

18.description: Blood Eruption consumes mana to release a Wandering Spirit. This effect can trigger a limited number of times per 4 seconds.
18.altText: This effect will attempt to trigger each time a Blood Eruption is created by any means.

19.description: Blood Eruption spreads all bleeds on that enemy to a limited amount of other enemies within its range.
19.altText: The ailment which is spread by this effect can be altered by Flay's damage conversions.

20.description: Flay has a chance to inflict bleed on hit, and bleeds inflicted by Flay have increased duration.
20.altText: The ailment modified by this effect can be altered by Flay's damage conversions.

21.description:
Flay deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to chilled or frozen enemies.

Flay has additional freeze rate per active skeleton or bone golem.
21.altText: The freeze rate modifier counts all skeletons from Summon Skeleton and Skeletal Vanguards, along with all types of Bone Golem.

stats.statName: Hit Damage to Chilled or Frozen
Freeze Rate per Skeleton or Golem

22.description: If you directly use Flay and hit at least one enemy, but do not hit a boss or rare enemy, a spectral copy of Flay strikes a random nearby boss or rare enemy.

stats.statName: Spectral Flay on nearby Boss or Rare

23.description:
Directly using Flay and hitting at least one enemy has a chance to trigger a spectral copy of Flay against a nearby enemy if one would not be triggered otherwise.

Spectral copies of Flay have increased area of effect.
23.altText: This effect has a chance to trigger any time {Prince of Pain} was not triggered. Unlike Prince of Pain, this effect can result in a boss or rare enemy being hit by both the original Flay cast and the spectral Flay.

24.description: Directly using Flay consumes a percentage of your current health and ward. Flay gains additional melee damage per 30 health consumed and additional spell damage per 30 ward consumed by this effect, up to a limited amount of each.

stats.statName: Percent of Current Health and Ward Consumed

25.description:
Flay deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

Directly using Flay and hitting at least one enemy reduces the remaining cooldown of Reaper Form by a percentage. This can occur a limited number of times per use of Reaper Form or Reap.

stats.statName: Limit per Use of Reaper Form or Reap

26.description:
Flay has a chance to inflict bleed on hit, and Flay deals more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

Flay has less attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

27.description: Flay is now a traversal skill with a cooldown. The Spirit Step can move you from a much further distance and no longer requires a target.

28.description: The Spirit Step is removed, and Flay has increased attack speed.

29.description:
Flay's melee attack is removed. Flay becomes a spell that directly creates the Blood Eruption, and is now affected by cast speed instead of attack speed.

Any modifiers to Flay's attack speed in its skill tree instead apply to cast speed.
29.altText: Additional Blood Eruptions can still be created by killing enemies with Flay.

stats.statName: Attack Speed on Tree -> Cast Speed

30.description:
Flay's base damage is converted to cold and it now has a chance to freeze. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to frostbite chance.

This node has no effect if {Soul Ripper} is allocated.

31.description:
Flay's base damage is converted to necrotic. Consequently this damage scales with increases to necrotic damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to damned chance.

32.description:
Bleed chance from all sources is converted to poison chance.

This node has no effect if {Soul Ripper} or {Frostblight} are allocated.

33.description:
When you create a {Blood Eruption}, you gain a stack of {Blood Revelry}, up to 5. Direct uses of Harvest or Rip Blood can consume a stack of Blood Revelry to deal more damage and gain increased area of effect.

Blood Eruptions have a significantly reduced delay before erupting.
33.altText: Only one stack can be consumed at a time by each direct use of Harvest or Rip Blood.

stats.statName: Harvest or Rip Blood Damage on Stack Consumed
Harvest or Rip Blood Area on Stack Consumed

34.description:
Flay deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a lower mana cost.

Flay has less attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

1.description: Chaos Bolts has increased cast speed, and its projectiles travel faster.

2.description:
Chaos Bolts' base necrotic damage is converted to physical. Consequently this damage scales with increases to physical damage, but not increases to necrotic damage.

Damned chance from all sources are converted to bleed chance for Chaos Bolts.

Swaps Chaos Bolts' {Necrotic} tag for a {Physical} tag.

4.description: Chaos Bolts' hits now have a chance to fear enemies, but the projectiles target a wider area.

6.description: Chaos Bolts' hits have a chance to inflict enemies with damned.

7.description: Chaos Bolts costs less mana, but now consumes a portion of your current health and ward on cast.

8.description: Chaos Bolts deals more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers) equal to a portion of your missing health.

9.description:
Hitting your minions with Chaos Bolts grants them any damned, ignite, bleed or frostbite chance that Chaos Bolts gains from this tree.

This buff lasts 10 seconds, and does not stack.

stats.statName: Ailment Chances to Minions on Hit

10.description:
Directly casting Chaos Bolts extends the duration of your active {Cthonic Fissures} and {Infernal Shades}. 

This effect has a 3 second cooldown.

11.description: Chaos Bolts' hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to damned, ignited, bleeding and frostbitten.
11.altText: Hitting enemies inflicted with multiple of these ailments, will cause the damage modifier to stack.

12.description: Chaos Bolts' hits have a chance to ignite enemies.

13.description:
Chaos Bolts' base fire damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to fire damage. It now has a chance to freeze enemies.

Ignite chance from all sources are converted to frostbite chance for Chaos Bolts.

Swaps Chaos Bolts' {Fire} tag for a {Cold} tag.

14.description:
Chaos Bolts' hits have a chance to chill enemies. 

Additionally, Chaos Bolts' hits have a chance to deal double hit damage to chilled enemies.

stats.statName: Chance for Double Hit Damage against Chilled

15.description:
Chaos Bolts' hits have a higher chance to freeze enemies per 1% uncapped cold resistance.

Additionally, Chaos Bolts deals more physical damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers) per 4% uncapped cold resistance.

stats.statName: Freeze Rate Multiplier per 1% Cold Res
Physical Damage over Time per 4% Cold Res

16.description: Chaos Bolts explosions have a chance to deal damage in a much large area.

17.description: Chaos Bolts releases additional projectiles, but it has a higher mana cost.

18.description: Chaos Bolts' projectiles have a chance to consume additional mana causing it to deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

19.description:
Whenever mana is consumed by the {Mana Anarchy} node, your minions gain additional spell damage based on your maximum mana and they also gain increased cast speed.

This buff lasts 13 seconds.

20.description:
Chaos Bolts no longer shoots multiple projectiles, but now instead shoots one large projectile causing it to deal more damage (multiplicative with other multipliers) in a larger area. 

These effects scale with the amount of projectiles Chaos Bolts would have shot.

21.description: Chaos Bolts' hitting one of your {Volatile Zombies} causes it to instantly explode. Zombies exploding this way deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

22.description: {Volatile Zombies} exploding from the {Volatile Kindling} node deal even more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area and poisons enemies.

23.description:
Whenever you cast Chaos Bolts you gain a stack of {Destructive Intensity} up to a maximum.

Each stack reduces the target area and improves Chaos Bolts base critical strike chance.

If you go 2 seconds without gaining a stack, all stacks are lost.

24.description: Chaos Bolts deals more damage and its hits deal more damage to {Cursed} enemies (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

25.description:
Chaos Bolts' hits have a chance per Dexterity to cause you to attack with {Harvest} from the location of enemies hit, hitting them and enemies around them.

This effect can occur a maximum of 3 times per second.

26.description: Chaos Bolts' hits against {Cursed} enemies regain health and mana.

27.description:
Chaos Bolts' hits against {Cursed} enemies has a chance to cause you to recast Chaos Bolts from their location towards another nearby enemy, consuming a portion of its mana cost. 

The recast has a minimum range of 5 meters, and will not cast at enemies within that range.
27.altText: Recasts from Seed of Chaos can't trigger Seed of Chaos.

28.description:
Chaos Bolts' hits have a chance per Intelligence to cast {Rip Blood} at target enemies.

This effect can occur a maximum of 2 times per second.

29.description: Chaos Bolts hits refreshes the duration of your {Curses} on them and grants you health per curse.

30.description:
Chaos Bolts' hits against {Cursed} enemies casts {Bone Curse} at their location.

This effect has a 6 second cooldown.

0.loreText: The primal strength of a bear is unmatched

2.description: Your bear deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

3.description: Your bear's basic attack releases a {Thorn Burst}, a spell that deals physical damage around the bear.

4.description: {Thorn Burst} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a chance to inflict bleed on hit.

5.description: Your bear also releases a {Thorn Burst} when hit, up to a limited number of times per 4 seconds.

6.description: {Thorn Burst} has a chance to shred armor on hit.

7.description:
Your bear has more health regeneration (multiplicative with other modifiers).

While you have an active bear companion, you have more health regeneration (multiplicative with other modifiers).

stats.statName: Health Regen for You with Active Bear

8.description: Your bear has increased attack speed.

9.description: Your bear has increased movement speed and cannot be stunned.

10.description: Your bear has a chance to cast a {Thorn Burst} from each enemy hit by its {Earthquake}. This chance is tripled against bosses and rare enemies.
10.altText: An enemy can be hit by both the Earthquake and all resulting Thorn Bursts.

stats.statName: Tripled Against Bosses And Rare Enemies

11.description:
Your bear can use {Swipe} with a 2 second cooldown. Your Bear's Swipe scales with its own stats, but is affected by your Swipe Tree.

Your bear deals additional melee physical damage per 3 points of your Strength.

12.description: Your bear's {Swipe} has a shorter cooldown.

13.description: Your bear deals more damage with Swipe (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has increased area with Swipe.

14.description: Your bear has more health and takes less damage at low health (both multiplicative with other modifiers).
14.altText:
Both of these effects are multiplicative with other modifiers.

Low health is defined as below 35% of maximum health.

15.description: Your bear can use {Earthquake}, with a 6 second cooldown. When cast this way, Earthquake uses your bear's stats but your Earthquake tree. Earthquakes cast by your bear deal less damage.

16.description: Your bear has additional critical strike chance.

17.description: Your bear takes less damage from critical strikes and its own critical strikes deal more damage.
17.altText: Both of these effects are multiplicative with other modifiers

18.description: Your bear has additional armor based on your strength.

19.description: {Thorn Burst} has a chance to poison enemies on hit. Additionally, your bear deals more poison damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

21.description: Your bear's {Roar} has increased area and healing effectiveness.

22.description: Your bear has increased movement speed and deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of bleed on the target (up to 30).

23.description: Your bear's abilities have increased area of effect.

24.description: Your bear gains an additional charge for Earthquake. When you directly cast {Warcry} or enter {Werebear Form}, your bear restores a charge for Earthquake.
24.altText:
Werebear Form's {Roar} counts as a Warcry.
If your bear had 0 remaining charges for Earthquake and 50% cooldown remaining, after casting Warcry it will have 1 remaining charge and 50% cooldown remaining.

stats.statName: Bear Earthquake Charge Restore on Warcry or Werebear

25.description:
The base physical damage of your bear's melee attack is converted to lightning, and it has a {Lightning} tag instead of {Physical}.

Your bear shocks enemies on hit.

Your bear gains the ability to teleport towards enemies, on an 8 second cooldown.

26.description: Your bear's {Roar} also grants itself and your minions less damage taken for 6 seconds.

27.description: Your bear's {Roar} inflicts Frailty on enemies.

28.description: Your bear's {Roar} also grants you a percentage of damage taken redirected to your highest health minion for 6 seconds.

stats.statName: Roar Grants Damage Taken Redirected to Highest Health Minion

0.description:
Combo skill. Seals your health at your current amount of health, draining your ward to 0 and preventing you from gaining health or ward for up to 5 seconds. For that duration you gain more damage equal to your percent missing health.

Reactivate to release a wave of death dealing damage based on how long the seal has been active, and percent missing health.

2.description: When you kill an enemy while sealed, a percentage of all of your delayed damage is cleared.

3.description: The Wave of Death has a chance to shred necrotic resistance.
3.altText: This effect's ailment can be converted by damage conversions within the tree.

stats.statName: Wave of Death Necrotic Resistance Shred Chance

4.description: If {Wandering Spirits} is active when you activate Death Seal it is granted additional duration.
4.altText: This affects the duration for which new spirits are revealed not the duration of individual spirits.

5.description: When Death Seal ends, a percentage of all of your delayed damage is cleared.

6.description: You release a Wave of Death each second while sealed and upon activation, in addition to when you release Death Seal, but your waves of death deal less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

stats.statName: Death Wave Cast Every Second While Sealed

7.description:
You release a Wave of Death when you cast {Reap} or {Evade}.

Death Seal must be on your action bar for this effect to work.
7.altText: Death Seal does not need to be active for this effect to occur.

stats.statName: Wave of Death on Reap or Evade

8.description: For the duration of Death Seal, you gain armor and stun avoidance for each 10 health you were missing when Death Seal was activated.

9.description: If you drop below 10% health while you are sealed, Death Seal is released automatically.
9.altText: This node does nothing when cast on a minion.

11.description: If your health is above 33% of your maximum when you activate Death Seal, it is reduced to 33% of your maximum health.

12.description: While sealed, you take less poison damage per 10% missing health, up to 50% missing health.

stats.statName: Less Poison Damage Taken per 10% Missing Health

13.description: Wave of Death hits deal more damage against poisoned targets (multiplicative with other modifiers).

stats.statName: Death Wave Hit Damage To Poisoned Enemies

14.description: Wave of Death hits deal more damage per stack of poison up to a maximum (multiplicative with other modifiers).
14.altText: This effect is multiplicative with other modifiers

stats.statName: Death Wave Hit Damage Per Poison

15.description: The Wave of Death has increased area of effect and additional critical strike chance.

16.description: Wave of Death deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

17.description: Wave of Death hits now leech a portion of the damage they deal as health.

18.description:
Wave of Death's base damage is converted to physical. Consequently this damage scales with increases to physical damage, but not increases to necrotic damage.

All of its effects related to necrotic resistance and necrotic resistance shred are converted to physical resistance and physical resistance shred.

stats.statName: Necrotic Resistance Shred Chance -> Physical Resistance Shred Chance

19.description: When you release Death Seal, you are granted {Bone Armor}, which grants less damage taken for the duration that Death Seal was active.

20.description: Death Seal's waves of death instantly kill enemies that are below a health threshold.

21.description: Minions hit by a Wave of Death deal more damage for 4 seconds (multiplicative with other modifiers).

22.description: Death Seal prevents health loss from effects that continously drain a percentage of your current health.
22.altText: This does not affect health drain effects from abilities like Reaper Form.

23.description: When you release Death Seal, you are granted {Haste} for 4 seconds.

24.description: When you release Death Seal, you recover a percentage of your missing health.

25.description:
You gain a stack of {Damned} for each second you remain sealed. Waves of Death hits now deal more damage per stack of Damned on you (multiplicative with other modifiers), up to a maximum benefit. 

You are cleansed of all Damned stacks when you release Death Seal.
25.altText: This damage modifier for Wave of Death if multiplicative with other modifiers.

stats.statName: Death Wave Damage Per Damned Stack

26.description: Death Seal's maximum duration is increased.

27.description: Death Seal now targets only minions.

28.description: When used on a minion, Death Seal also grants it more damage and critical strike chance (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

29.description: Minions targeted by Death Seal are rooted in place for its duration. When Death Seal is released, the minion explodes in addition to releasing the wave of death at its location.

30.description: You now repeatedly cast {Hungering Souls} while you are sealed. Hungering Souls cast this way has a 70% chance to have only 1 projectile.

31.description:
You release {Hungering Souls} more frequently.

Additionally, whenever you cast Reap or Evade, you gain this effect for a percentage of Death Seal's maximum duration. Death Seal must be on your action bar for this effect to occur.
31.altText: For example, if you have 2 points invested in this node then using Reap or Evade will cause you to release Hungering Souls for an amount of time equal to 50% of Death Seal's maximum duration.

stats.statName: Percent Effect Duration on Reap or Evade

32.description:
The Wave of Death's base damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to necrotic damage.

All of its effects related to necrotic resistance and necrotic resistance shred are converted to cold resistance and cold resistance shred.
32.altText: This node has no effect if {Corporeal Cascade} is allocated.

stats.statName: Necrotic Resistance Shred -> Cold Resistance Shred

1.description: Earthquake and its {Aftershocks} have a chance to slow enemies in their area of effect.

2.description: Earthquake and its Aftershocks have a larger area of effect.

3.description: Earthquake and its Aftershocks deal more hit damage to chilled or frozen enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

stats.statName: Hit Damage Against Chilled Or Frozen Enemies

4.description: Earthquake can cast more maximum possible Aftershocks.

5.description: Aftershocks have a chance when they hit to cast another Aftershock. Maximum of one additional Aftershock.

6.description:
Aftershock hits have a chance to have an {Avalanche Boulder} cast on their location, and when this effect triggers it consumes mana.

The {Boulder} is affected by your {Avalanche} Skill Tree.

stats.statName: Chance To Cast Boulder On Aftershock Hit

7.description: Aftershocks appear around your totems instead if they are nearby.

8.description: Slows caused by Earthquake and its Aftershocks last longer.

9.description: Earthquake and its Aftershocks have an increased chance to stun enemies, and Earthquake costs less mana.

10.description: Casting Earthquake grants you {Haste} and {Frenzy} for a duration.

11.description: Aftershocks are now damage over time, dealing their normal hit damage each second. Aftershocks last 3 seconds.

12.description: Aftershocks deal more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers) and last longer.

13.description: Aftershocks blind enemies within their area of effect.

14.description: Aftershocks deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and have an increased chance to stun enemies.

15.description: Earthquake can cast more minimum possible Aftershocks. Each enemy can only be targeted by one Aftershock.

16.description: Aftershocks have a larger area of effect.

17.description: Earthquake's initial slam deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

18.description: Earthquake's initial slam deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but in a smaller area.

19.description: Using Earthquake directly it now deals damage in a cone which has increased range. Aftershocks also favour targets in the direction Earthquake is cast.

20.description: Modifiers to Aftershock damage on this tree apply to the initial slam, but Earthquake can no longer create Aftershocks.

21.description:
Earthquake's initial slam occurs three times. First with 30% reduced radius and damage, then with 5% reduced radius and damage, then with 30% increased radius and damage.

Earthquake now has a cooldown, and each initial hit consumes mana.

22.description: Earthquake's initial slam reduces enemy armor.

23.description: Earthquake's initial slam deals more hit damage against rare and boss enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

stats.statName: Initial Slam Hit Damage Against Rares And Bosses

24.description:
Earthquake's base damage is converted to fire damage. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Additionally, armor shred chance from all sources is converted to ignite chance.

25.description: Earthquake's initial slam deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has an increased chance to stun enemies.

26.description:
Earthquake is converted into a spell, and no longer scales with melee damage. Earthquake now deals substantial additional base damage on the initial slam and its base damage is converted to Lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increased lightning damage, but not with increased physical damage.

Aftershocks also deal substantial additional spell damage.

27.description: Earthquake's initial slam deals additional lightning damage, and Earthquake deals more lightning damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

28.description:
Casting Earthquake expends Storm Stacks over 0.5 seconds.

{Storm Bolts} triggered this way deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
28.altText: Storm Stacks are gained from using {Gathering Storm}. You can not expend Storm Stacks you do not have.

30.description: Earthquake's initial slam deals more damage and has increased stun chance and stun duration, but Earthquake has a 6 second cooldown.

31.description: Stuns caused by Earthquake and its Aftershocks last longer, but Earthquake has a longer cooldown.

32.description: Earthquake's initial slam can't be dodged.

2.description: Acid Flask deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

3.description: Acid Flask has a chance to grant {Haste} on use for a short duration.

4.description:
When you directly use Acid Flask, you now throw 3 Acid Flasks in a line, but Acid Flask costs more mana.

Enemies can only be hit by one flask per throw.

5.description: When you directly use Acid Flask, you now throw Acid Flasks in a fan in front of you instead of a line. Flasks travel faster.

6.description: Acid Flask has a chance to shred enemy armor.

7.description:
Acid Flask leaves behind a {Poison Pool} for 4 seconds that poison enemies that stand in it and adds a 2 second cooldown per flask thrown.

You can have a maximum of 4 {Poison Pools} active at once.
7.altText:
{Poison Pool} applies a stack of poison to enemies standing in it each second.
This effect can be converted to Frostbite if Acid Flask is converted to cold.

8.description: You have a chance to poison enemies while standing in your {Poison Pools}.

9.description: {Poison Pools} last longer.
9.altText: {Poison Pool} applies a stack of poison to enemies standing in it each second.

10.description:
Acid Flask's base damage is converted to fire damage and its hits deal significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Acid Flask can no longer apply poison or create poison pools.

stats.statName: No Poison Chance or Poison Pools

11.description: Converts Armor Shred from all sources that Acid Flask would apply to Fire Resistance Shred.

12.description: When Acid Flask is thrown directly it causes 3 smaller explosions around the impact location dealing fire damage on hit, but it costs more mana.

13.description: Acid Flask has a chance to blind enemies hit for 4 seconds.

14.description: Acid Flask has a chance to shred enemy poison resistance on hit.
14.altText: This effect can be converted to cold resistance shred chance if Acid Flask is converted to cold.

15.description: Acid Flask has additional chance to poison enemies on hit.
15.altText: This effect can be converted to frostbite chance if Acid Flask is converted to cold.

16.description: Acid Flask has a chance to apply {Frailty} to enemies hit, causing them to deal less damage.

17.description: Acid Flask has increased poison duration.
17.altText: This effect can be converted to Frostbite duration if Acid Flask is converted to cold.

18.description: Acid Flask has increased throwing speed.

19.description:
You have a chance to drop an Acid Flask at your feet when an enemy hits you. 

This effect has a 5 second cooldown.

stats.statName: Chance to Drop Flask When Hit

20.description: Acid Flask costs less mana and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

21.description: Acid Flask has a chance to slow enemies on hit. Slow caused by Acid Flask lasts longer.

22.description: Acid Flask deals additional throwing fire damage.

23.description: Acid Flask has a chance to ignite enemies.

24.description: Acid Flask has increased citical strike chance and critical strikes deal more damage.

25.description: Acid Flask deals damage in a larger area.
25.altText: This does not affect {Cluster Bomb}.

26.description: Acid Flask travels faster.

28.description: Acid Flask penetrates poison resistance based on your own uncapped Poison Resistance
28.altText:
This scales off of uncapped poison resistance, so gaining more poison resistance above the normal 75% cap will continue to increase its effect.

Effects which convert Acid Flask's base damage also convert this penetration.

stats.statName: Poison Penetration per 5% Uncapped Poison Resistance

29.description: {Poison Pools} have a chance to inflict enemies with {Efficacious Toxin} each second, causing them to take increased damage over time.

30.description:
Acid Flask is now thrown as a trap that starts arming and explodes when enemies walk over it.

You can have a maximum of 6 Acid Flask Traps active at once.

2.description: Frenzy Totem has more health (multiplicative with other modifiers) and lasts longer.

3.description: Frenzy Totem affects allies or enemies in a larger area.

4.description: While in range of your Frenzy Totem, you have a chance to cast {Eterra's Blessing} on a random ally each second.

stats.statName: Chance To Cast Eterra's Blessing While In Range

5.description: Frenzy Totem stores a portion of the damage it receives, releasing it as damage dealt to enemies after taking a percent of its maximum health in damage.
5.altText: The damage is scaled by your increased minion damage.

stats.statName: Percentage Of Max Health Taken Before Releasing

6.description: Frenzy Totem also stores a percentage of the damage taken by you.

stats.statName: Percent Of Player Damage Taken Stored By Totem

7.description: Frenzy Totem has a chance to cast {Ice Thorns} when hit by enemies.

8.description:
Frenzy Totem is now {Sloth Totem,} which will now slow and reduce the armor of enemies instead of granting Frenzy.

Increased effect of frenzy is converted to increased effect of armor shred.

9.description:
Frenzy Totem is no longer summoned at your cursor; instead it is always placed 1 meter in the direction you're facing.

Frenzy Totem costs less mana and grants additional melee damage.

stats.statName: Frenzy Totem Summoned 1m In Front Of Player

10.description: You are tethered to the totem while you remain within 5 meters of it, and while tethered you deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
10.altText: The range of the tether is not affected by Increased Area for Area Skills stats.

11.description: Frenzy Totem's tether has a higher range.

13.description: You have additional critical strike multiplier while tethered.
