14.description: Allies affected by Frenzy Totem are granted increased health regeneration.

15.description: When you summon Frenzy Totem, you and your companions are granted {Haste} for a duration (doubled for companions).

16.description: Frenzy Totem's buffs are more effective, but Frenzy Totem now affects only companions.

17.description: Companions affected by Frenzy Totem have higher physical and elemental resistance.

18.description: While affected by Frenzy Totem, you revive downed companions faster.

19.description: Whenever you revive a downed companion, Frenzy Totem casts {Healing Nova.}
19.altText: The area of the Healing Nova is affected by Increased Area for Area Skills stats.

stats.statName: Healing Nova Cast When Companion Is Revived

20.description: Allies affected by Frenzy Totem are granted a chance to poison enemies.

22.description: Frenzy Totem's Frenzy buff is more effective.

23.description: When you summon Frenzy Totem you gain a temporary buff that grants you more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and increased melee attack speed, but also increases the damage you take.

24.description: When you summon Frenzy Totem, your companions are granted additional melee physical damage for 4 seconds.

25.description: Summoning Frenzy Totem refreshes companion ability cooldowns.

26.description: While Frenzy Totem is active, your Sabertooth's {Flurry Swipes} casts an additional time when used.

28.description: While Frenzy Totem is active, your Wolves' howls also grant increased critical strike chance to you and your allies.

stats.statName: Increased Critical Strike Chance Granted By Wolf Howl

29.description: While Frenzy Totem is active, your Scorpion's {Venom Nova} hits in a larger area.

0.loreText: Now you see me...

2.description: Teleport knocks enemies back from your destination once you arrive.

3.description: You have have a higher chance to freeze enemies if you have cast Teleport recently (past 4 seconds).

4.description: After casting Teleport your next direct spell cast refunds its mana cost, but Teleport has a longer cooldown.

5.description: Teleport has a shorter cooldown.

6.description: You have higher cold resistance and armor if you have cast Teleport recently (past 4 seconds).

7.description: Stat buffs granted by having cast Teleport recently (past 4 seconds) last longer.

8.description: Teleport creates a {Mirror Image} where you depart. Mirror Images count as minions and will taunt nearby enemies for 10 seconds, then disappear. Teleport costs more mana.
8.altText: {Mirror Image} health scales with intelligence and level.

9.description: Teleport creates a {Mirror Image} where you arrive. Mirror Images count as minions and will taunt nearby enemies for 10 seconds, then disappear. Teleport costs more mana.
9.altText: {Mirror Image} health scales with intelligence and level.

10.description: Teleport creates additional {Mirror Images} on arrival. Mirror images have a shorter duration.
10.altText: {Mirror Image} health scales with intelligence and level.

11.description: {Mirror Images} last longer.
11.altText: {Mirror Image} health scales with intelligence and level.

12.description: Teleport grants ward on cast.

13.description: When you use Teleport, you are granted ward equal to your intelligence stat.

stats.statName: Ward Gained Per Point Of Intelligence

14.description: You have increased ward retention if you have cast Teleport recently (past 4 seconds).
14.altText: Recently refers to the past 4 seconds

15.description: You have higher lightning resistance, fire resistance, and stun avoidance if you have cast Teleport recently (past 4 seconds).

16.description: Teleport knocks enemies further back.

17.description: Teleport costs less mana.

18.description: Your other skills recover more quickly if you have cast Teleport recently (past 4 seconds).
18.altText: Recently refers to the past 4 seconds

19.description: You deal increased elemental damage if you have cast Teleport recently (past 4 seconds).
19.altText: Recently refers to the past 4 seconds

20.description:
Teleport casts Elemental Nova where you arrive.

This node does not work if Elemental Nova has a cooldown.

21.description:
Teleport casts Elemental Nova where you depart.

This node does not work if Elemental Nova has a cooldown.

22.description:
Teleport casts Elemental Nova halfway between your arrival and departure points.

This node does not work if Elemental Nova has a cooldown.

23.description: Casting Teleport converts a percentage of your current health into twice as much ward.
23.altText: For example if you have three points in this node, and 100 current health, you will lose 9 health and gain 18 ward.

24.description: You cannot be stunned if you have cast Teleport recently (past 4 seconds).

26.description: Teleport has a shorter cooldown and if you have {Haste} when you cast Teleport its duration is reset.
26.altText: This cannot reduce the duration of Haste on you, only increase it or leave it unchanged.

2.description: Shurikens has a chance to poison enemies.

3.description: Shurikens penetrates enemy physical resistance.

4.description: Shurikens has a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

6.description: You have a chance to throw many additional Shurikens with each throw.
6.altText: For calculating the damage bonus of the {Keen Throw} node this effect counts as if it always added 2 shurikens.

7.description: Shurikens hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of bleed or poison on the target up to a maximum.

8.description: Shurikens are now be thrown at enemies all around you rather than in a cone in front of you.

9.description: Shurikens deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), and costs less mana.

10.description: {Chakram} hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for each projectile you would release with Shurikens.

11.description: Shurikens has a chance to {Blind} enemies.

12.description: You backflip away from target direction when you use Shurikens, but it now has a cooldown.

13.description: Shurikens has a shorter cooldown and you gain {Haste} for a short duration if it hits at least one enemy.

14.description: Shurikens {Immobilizes} enemies on hit, causing them to be unable to move for a short duration.

15.description: Shurikens has increased attack speed.

16.description:
Shurikens deals additional lightning damage and a percentage of its base physical damage is converted to Lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Shurikens gains a {Lightning} tag. If all its base damage is converted it loses its {Physical} tag.

17.description: Shurikens shocks enemies on hit.

18.description: Shurikens has a chance to shred enemy physical and poison resistance.

19.description:
Shurikens ricochets to different targets up to a maximum number of times, but costs more mana.

Pierce chance is converted to additional critical strike multiplier.
19.altText: This does not enable Chakrams to ricochet.

20.description: You throw additional Shurikens with each throw.

21.description: You now summon your Shurikens in a shield around you for 3 seconds. All Shurikens cast this way can hit the same target.
21.altText: Granting Shurikens pierce, such as from {Ethereal Blades}, will not allow each Shuriken to hit an individual enemy more than once.

22.description: When you directly cast Shurikens you gain a stack of {Bladed Armor}, which grants increased armor per stack. Maximum of 3 stacks.
22.altText: {Floating Blades} also affects the duration of Bladed Armor.

23.description: {Blade Shield} lasts longer.

24.description:
Shurikens travel faster and farther.

This does not affect {Chakram.}

25.description:
Shurikens are now thrown in a straight line and they can hit the same target, but you throw half as many (rounded up).

This has no effect if you have the {Blade Shield} node.

27.description: Shurikens has a chance to pierce enemies (continue through targets they hit).

28.description: Improves Shurikens' base critical strike chance and Shurikens deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

29.description: Shurikens' critical strikes deal more damage.

30.description:
You now throw a single returning {Chakram} instead of multiple Shurikens. 

The Chakram has increased size and deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). This damage modifier is doubled if Chakram is directly used.

2.description: Eterra's Blessing grants elemental and poison resistance.

3.description: Your next spell after casting Eterra's Blessing deals increased damage.

stats.statName: Increased Spell Damage On Next Cast

4.description: After casting Eterra's Blessing, your spells leech a portion of the damage they deal as health for 4 seconds.

5.description: When cast on a minion, Eterra's Blessing grants stun immunity for 4 seconds.

6.description: When Eterra's Blessing is cast on your {Scorpion} companion, you are both granted a chance to poison enemies with attacks and spells for 4 seconds.

7.description: When Eterra's Blessing is cast on your {Sabertooth} or {Raptor} companions, you are both granted a chance to cause enemies to bleed with attacks and spells for 4 seconds.

8.description: When cast on a minion, Eterra's Blessing also grants increased movement, attack, and cast speed for 4 seconds.

9.description: When Eterra's Blessing heals one of your companions it has a chance to refresh its activated ability cooldown, but Eterra's Blessing costs more mana.

10.description: When Eterra's Blessing targets a downed companion, it heals them for a portion of their maximum downed duration.

11.description: When you directly cast Eterra's Blessing on a companion it taunts nearby enemies for 4 seconds. However Eterra's Blessing now has a long cooldown.

12.description: When Eterra's Blessing is cast on one of your companions, you also heal yourself for a portion of its base heal amount.

13.description: Eterra's Blessing automatically targets the lowest health ally in range, but Eterra's Blessing costs more mana.

14.description: When Eterra's Blessing is cast on your {Spriggan} companion, you are both granted increased spell damage for 4 seconds.

15.description: Eterra's Blessing has a chance to heal all allies nearby its target for 50 health.
15.altText: The area in which allies are healed is affect by Increased Area for Area Skills stats.

stats.statName: Chance To Heal Allies Nearby Target

16.description: Eterra's Blessing costs less mana.

18.description: Eterra's Blessing knocks back enemies a given distance from its target.
18.altText: Increased Area for Area Skills stats affect the area in which enemies are pushed back, but not how far they are pushed back.

20.description:
Whenever you directly cast Thorn Shield, you also cast Eterra's Blessing on the same target.

Consumes Eterra's Blessing's mana cost as rage.

21.description: When Eterra's Blessing is cast on your Storm Crow companions, they are granted {Haste} and Frenzy for 5 seconds.

23.description: Eterra's Blessing has increased healing effectiveness.

24.description: Eterra's Blessing cleanses all ailments on its target.

26.description: Eterra's Blessing heals half of its value immediately, and half of its value over 4 seconds.

27.description: When {Efflorescence's} heal over time expires, heal again for half of Eterra's Blessing's value.

28.description: When you are out of mana Eterra's Blessing is free, but Eterra's Blessing can no longer provide additional buffs.

29.description: When you heal a target that is already at high health, you have a chance to summon a {Healing Totem} at its location which heals nearby allies.
29.altText: Targets above 65% max health are considered to be at high health.

stats.statName: Chance To Summon Healing Totem On High Health Heal

30.description: Eterra's Blessing heals for more if you have transformed recently (last 4 seconds).

32.description: When Eterra's Blessing is cast on your {Wolf} or {Bear} companions, you are both granted increased physical damage for 4 seconds.

1.description: Improves Forge Strike's base critical chance, and critical strikes deal more damage.

2.description: Forge Strike has increased cooldown recovery speed and attack speed. The attack speed bonus also applies to your Forged Weapons.

3.description: You are granted ward when Forge Strike summons a {Forged Weapon}.
3.altText: {Forged Weapons} are melee minions who seek out enemies and attack them.

4.description: {Forged Weapons} no longer move or attack, but generate ward when you are near them.
4.altText: {Forged Weapons} are melee minions who seek out enemies and attack them.

5.description: Improves Forge Strike's base critical chance and its hits inflict bleeding on hit, but your maximum number of {Forged Weapons} is halved.
5.altText: If you have an odd number of maximum forged weapons the number is rounded up.

6.description:
Converts Forge Strike into a sword that falls from the sky instead. Forge Strike has more attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers), cannot crit, and critical strike multiplier from the tree is converted to additional Physical Penetration for Bleed.

Converts to a polearm if you also have the {Spear Forge} node.

stats.statName: Crit Multiplier -> Physical Penetration for Bleed

7.description:
Converts Forge Strike into a spear that falls from the sky instead. Forge Strike critical strikes deal significantly more damage, but it hits in a smaller area.

Converts to a polearm if you also have the {Put To The Sword} node.

8.description: Forge Strike and {Forged Weapons} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and have an increased chance to stun enemies.
8.altText: The bonuses from this node apply to Forged Weapons from all sources, not just from Forge Strike.

9.description: Forge Strike hits reduce enemy armor, and armor shred applied by it last longer with increased effect.

10.description: Forge Strike can now be cast at your target instead of in front of you.

11.description: You deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) if you have used Forge Strike recently (last 4 seconds).

12.description: You have increased armor if you have used Forge Strike recently (last 4 seconds).

14.description: Forge Strike hits deal more damage against rare and boss enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

stats.statName: More Hit Damage Against Rares And Bosses

15.description: Forge Strike and {Forged Weapons'} hits deal damage in a larger area

16.description:
Converts Forge Strike into an anvil that falls from the sky instead. Forge Strike has an increased chance to stun enemies, and stuns it inflicts lasts longer, but it has less attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

Additionally, when you directly use Forge Strike it deals more physical damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
16.altText: The visual effect of this node will not apply if you have any other visual alterations in this tree. You will still gain the increased stun chance.

17.description: Forge Strike deals additional melee fire damage and more fire damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

18.description: Forge Strike causes {Detonating Ground}, sending out cracks which erupt after 1.5 seconds, dealing melee fire damage and igniting enemies.

19.description: {Detonating Ground} hits deal more damage.

20.description: {Detonating Ground} has a chance to ignite enemies on hit.

21.description:
{Forged Weapons} deal additional melee fire damage.

{Forged Weapons} gain the {fire} tag.
21.altText: The bonuses from this node apply to Forged Weapons from all sources, not just from Forge Strike.

22.description: {Forged Weapons} last longer and you can control more forged weapons at once.
22.altText: The bonuses from this node apply to Forged Weapons from all sources, not just from Forge Strike.

23.description: {Forged Weapons} now have a chance to become a {Great Axe} on summon, which deal more damage in a larger area, but attack slower.
23.altText: The bonuses from this node apply to Forged Weapons from all sources, not just from Forge Strike.

stats.statName: Chance To Convert To Great Axe

24.description: Forge Strike has a higher chance to summon {Forged Weapons}. This added chance is much higher against bosses and rare enemies.
24.altText: With 3 points invested in this node Forge Strike always summons a Forged Weapon on hit against bosses and rare enemies.

25.description: {Forged Weapons} have a much shorter duration, but deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), and explode when they expire, dealing fire and physical damage to nearby enemies.
25.altText: {Forged Weapons} are melee minions who seek out enemies and attack them.

26.description: Bleed inflicted by Forge Strike has additional Physical Penetration and lasts longer.

28.description: Forge Strike has no cooldown, but costs additional mana.

29.description: Ailments inflicted by Forge Strike deal increased damage over time equal to your increased stun chance.
29.altText: Includes increased stun chance from this tree

30.description: You have additional global Fire Penetration if you have used Forge Strike recently (last 4 seconds).

0.description: A series of fast dash attacks.

2.description: Dancing Strikes penetrates enemy physical resistance.

3.description: Dancing Strikes inflicts enemies with {Shadow Dagger}.

4.description: Dancing Strikes has a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

5.description: You deal more global damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers) for each time you have used Dancing Strikes recently.
5.altText: Recently refers to the past 4 seconds.

6.description: All bleed chance is converted to poison chance with Dancing Strikes. Physical penetration from this tree converted to poison penetration.

7.description: Dancing Strikes deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per poison stacks on the target up to a maximum.

8.description: Dancing Strikes has a chance to poison enemies, but deals less physical damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

9.description: Dancing Strikes hits deal more damage to bleeding and poisoned enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

10.description: Dancing Strikes grants you additional dodge rating for a short duration on use.

11.description: Dancing Strikes grants you additional dodge rating per point of Dexterity for a short duration on use.

12.description: Dancing Strikes deals more damage to rare enemies and bosses (multiplicative with other modifiers).

13.description:
Dancing Strikes' third attack creates a {Fighting Arena} for 4 seconds.

While fighting inside the arena, you and your allies deal more damage and take less damage (both multiplicative with other modifiers). The less damage taken is doubled for you.
13.altText: Only one Fighting Arena can be active at a time.

stats.statName: Damage Taken Bonus Doubled For You

14.description: You and allies fighting inside the arena have a high chance to cause enemies to bleed.

15.description: Dancing Strikes deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) but you travel less far between each attack.

16.description: You take less damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers) for a short duration after using Dancing Strikes.

17.description: {Lethal Mirage} and {Synchronized Strikes} deal increased damage for each time you have used Dancing Strikes recently.
17.altText: Recently refers to the past 4 seconds.

18.description: Dancing Strikes' third attack heals you if it hits at least one enemy.
18.altText: This is affected by increased healing effectiveness.

19.description: Dancing Strikes has a chance to grant you {Haste} for 2 seconds on use.

20.description: Dancing Strikes' second and fourth attack have a chance to throw {Shurikens} in target direction.

21.description: Dancing Strikes deals damage in a larger area.

22.description: Dancing Strikes has a chance to shred enemy armor.

23.description: When you use Dancing Strikes and hit at least one enemy, you gain a stack of {Rhythm} for a short duration and refresh all existing stacks, granting you global more damage per stack (multiplicative with other modifiers).

24.description: You have increased dodge rating per stack of {Rhythm}.

25.description: You have a global chance to cause enemies to bleed per stack of {Rhythm}.

26.description: Your critical strikes deal more damage per stack of {Rhythm}.

27.description: Each stack of {Rhythm} also grants 5% global more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but Dancing Strikes cost more mana.
27.altText: This is additive with Rhythm's baseline global more damage, but multiplicative with all other modifiers.

28.description: Dancing Strikes' first attack shreds enemy armor.

29.description: Dancing Strikes' second attack creates a {Shadow}, but Dancing Strikes costs more mana.
29.altText:
Shadows will repeat one skill you use before vanishing. Shadows can repeat Acid Flask, Shurikens or Shadow Cascade, and their damage scales with your damage stats. 

You can have 3 Shadows at once, and they will disappear after 5 seconds.

30.description: Dancing Strikes shreds enemy physical resistance.

31.description: Your next {Puncture} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) after using Dancing Strikes.

32.description: Dancing Strikes' first attack has a chance to also attack with {Shadow Cascade}.

0.loreText: Fanning the flames of fury.

2.description: Snap Freeze has increased cast speed.

3.description: Snap Freeze has a shorter cooldown, but Freeze inflicted by Snap Freeze has reduced duration.

4.description: Snap Freeze knocks enemies back.

5.description: Snap Freeze has a chance to chill enemies.

6.description: Chill caused by Snap Freeze has increased duration. If you have taken the {Snap Shock} node, this increases Shock duration instead.
6.altText: If you have taken the Snap Shock node then this increases shock duration instead.

7.description: Snap Freeze hits and deals spell cold damage and can apply on-hit effects, but costs more mana.
7.altText: This damage has an added damage scaling of 100%, and is increased by your increases to cold damage and spell damage.

8.description: Snap Freeze hits deal additional spell cold damage.

9.description:
Snap Freeze no longer freezes and its base cold damage is converted to lightning damage. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to cold damage.

Adds 4 lighting damage for each second of freeze duration. 

All chill chance is converted to shock chance, and all nodes which rely on targets being frozen or chilled now work on shocked enemies instead.
9.altText: Shock reduces lightning resistance by 5%, increases chance to be stunned by 10%, lasts 4 seconds, and can stack up to 20 times. It has 60% reduced effect against bosses and players.

stats.statName: Lightning Damage Per Second Of Freeze

10.description: Improves Snap Freeze’s base critical strike chance.

11.description: Snap Freeze critical strikes deal more damage.

12.description: Snap Freeze hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of {Shock} on the target.

13.description: Snap Freeze costs less mana and has a shorter cooldown.

14.description: Snap Freeze inflicts {Frostbite} on all enemies within its area of effect.

15.description: {Frostbite} inflicted by Snap Freeze has additional Cold Penetration.

16.description: Snap Freeze leaves a patch of {Frozen Ground} for 5 seconds, which chills all enemies who walk on it. Frostbite inflicted by Snap Freeze last longer.

17.description: Snap Freeze costs less mana, but has a narrower area of effect.

18.description: Snap Freeze’s area of effect extends further away from you.

19.description: Freeze inflicted by Snap Freeze has a longer duration, but has a narrower area of effect.

20.description: You have additional armor and cold resistance while Snap Freeze is on cooldown.

21.description: Freeze inflicted by Snap Freeze last longer.

22.description: You steal cold resistance from enemies hit by Snap Freeze, causing you to gain cold resistance for 4 seconds and the enemies hit to lose it.
22.altText: This still works on enemies with 0% elemental resistance; it causes their elemental resistance to become negative causing them to take more damage.

23.description: You can store an additional charge of Snap Freeze, but Snap Freeze has a longer cooldown.

24.description: Snap Freeze also freezes yourself for 2 seconds. You cannot take damage while frozen this way.

2.description: Maelstrom deals damage in a larger area.

3.description: You can choose to cast Maelstrom on your minions instead of yourself.

4.description: Maelstrom deals more damage when cast on a totem (multiplicative with other modifiers).

5.description: When you directly cast Maelstrom, you have a chance to also cast Tornado. This consumes a percentage of Tornado's mana cost.

stats.statName: Chance for Tornado on Direct Cast
Percent of Tornado Mana Cost Consumed

6.description: Maelstrom has a chance to chill enemies each second.

7.description: After every fifth Maelstrom stack gained, you release a {Tsunami}, a cold spell that deals damage in an area around you.

8.description: {Tsunami} deals more damage and has increased area for each stack of Maelstrom on you.

9.description: Maelstrom also heals allies in its area of effect each second.

10.description: Maelstrom deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), has significantly increased healing effectiveness and lasts significantly longer, but you can have only one maximum stack of Maelstrom.

11.description: Maelstrom deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but in a smaller area.

12.description: Maelstrom has an increased chance to freeze enemies each second.

13.description: If you go one second without directly casting Maelstrom you gain a stack of {Lagon's Slumber}. When you next cast Maelstrom directly, all stacks of {Lagon's Slumber} are consumed to cast Maelstrom an additional time per stack.

stats.statName: Extra Casts per Stack of Lagon's Slumber

14.description: Maelstrom costs less mana.

15.description: Each stack of Maelstrom grants you increased dodge chance.

stats.statName: Increased Dodge Rating Per Maelstrom Stack

16.description:
Maelstrom's base cold damage is converted to physical. Consequently this damage scales with increases to physical damage, but not increases to cold damage.

Chill chance from this tree is converted to slow chance.

Maelstrom can no longer freeze, but each stack of Maelstrom grants global more physical damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

stats.statName: Global More Physical Damage Per Maelstrom Stack

17.description: Maelstrom stacks have a longer duration.

18.description: While you have 6 or more stacks, you cast {Storm Bolt} at a nearby enemy each second.
18.altText: Storm Bolt scales with increased spell damage and lightning damage, but not with other nodes on this tree.

stats.statName: Storm Bolt Cast Each Second At 6 Or More Stacks

19.description: {Power of The Storm's} stack requirement is reduced.

20.description: {Storm Bolt} from the {Power of the Storm} node is cast at additional targets.
20.altText: Storm Bolt scales with increased spell damage and lightning damage, but not with other nodes on this tree.

21.description: Maelstrom deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). This bonus is doubled if you have at least 60 Attunement.

22.description:
You have a chance on killing an enemy or hitting a boss or rare enemy to cast Maelstrom. 

This effect has a 2 second cooldown.

stats.statName: Chance On Kill To Cast Maelstrom
Chance On Hitting Boss Or Rare

23.description: If you have 6 stacks of Maelstrom or more, you gain {Haste.}

24.description: If you have 6 stacks of Maelstrom or more, you gain {Frenzy.}

26.description: Each stack of Maelstrom grants you an increased chance to stun enemies.
26.altText: Maelstrom itself cannot stun, as it is a Damage Over Time Spell.

stats.statName: Global Increased Stun Chance Per Stack

28.description: Maelstrom deals more damage to chilled or frozen enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).
28.altText: If an enemy is chilled and frozen, both modifiers apply multiplicatively.

1.description: Healing Hands now hits enemies within its area of effect, dealing spell fire damage. Added spell damage applies to it at 200% effectiveness.

2.description: Healing hands deals additional spell damage based on your Increased Healing Effectiveness and on Increased Healing Effectiveness from this tree.

stats.statName: Spell Damage per 20% increased Healing Effectiveness

3.description:
Healing Hands {Immobilizes} void enemies for 1 second on hit and deals more damage to them (multiplicative with other modifiers).

Healing Hands grants allies 10% less void damage taken (multiplicative with other modifiers) for 10 seconds when cast on them. This buff does not stack.
3.altText:
You count as an ally so casting Healing Hands on yourself will grant you the buff.

Void Enemies include cultists, husks, pure voidforms, and voidfused enemies. They are encountered frequently in the Ruined Era.

4.description:
Healing Hands fears Undead Enemies for 2 to 3 seconds on hit and deals more damage to them (multiplicative with other modifiers).

Healing Hands grants allies 10% less necrotic damage taken (multiplicative with other modifiers) for 10 seconds when cast on them. This buff does not stack.
4.altText:
Fear causes enemies to flee from you and your allies. Enemies can only be affected by Fear once.

You count as an ally so casting Healing Hands on yourself will grant you the buff.

Undead enemies include skeletons, wraiths, zombies, and most other enemies encountered in the Imperial Era.

5.description: Healing hands deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) based on the combined levels of your specialised Buff skills.
5.altText: Only Skills with the Buff tag are counted.

stats.statName: Damage per Level of Specialised Buff Skills

6.description: Healing hands has a chance to {Electrify} on hit.

7.description: Healing Hands deals more lightning damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers) and when you hit an electrified enemy with Healing Hands it spreads all stacks of your stacks of electrify from that enemy to a number of other enemies within 5 metres.

8.description:
Healing Hands is converted into a melee attack that hits in a wide arc in front of you. It now scales with melee damage instead of spell damage and effects on this tree that granted spell damage now grant melee damage instead.

Healing Hands still heals you, as well as allies within its area of affect.

9.description: Healing Hands has increased healing effectiveness. This bonus is doubled if there is a dead player within 30 meters.

10.description: Healing Hands has an increased area of effect and a lower mana cost.

11.description: Healing Hands has a lower mana cost.

12.description:
You cast {Divine Bolt} at nearby enemies when you directly cast healing hands and heal yourself or an ally.

Divine Bolt is affected by specific passives from the Paladin tree and if you take this node then Divine Bolt from all sources scales with nodes on this tree.

13.description:
Healing Hands also grants ward to allies based on your Attunement.

If the ally has an effect that causes them to gain ward per second based on their missing health, then it will not heal them, but will provide a percentage of its healing as ward.
13.altText: You count as your own ally and are affected by this node when you cast Healing Hands on yourself.

14.description:
If Healing Hands would not affect any allied players at the chosen target location, it is cast centered on you instead.

Healing Hands has increased healing effectiveness.

stats.statName: Cast at self if not targeting ally

15.description: Healing Hands also grants ward to allies based on your Increased Healing Effectiveness and on Increased Healing Effectiveness from this tree.
15.altText: You count as your own ally and are affected by this node when you cast Healing Hands on yourself.

16.description: Healing Hands becomes a channeled ability, casting 4 times per second regardless of cast speed, and draining your mana.
16.altText:
If you have the {Seraph Blade} node, then the melee attacks occur in random directions while you channel.

If you have the {Rahyeh's Chariot} node then this node has no effect.

17.description:
Healing Hands also grants ward per second for three seconds after being cast on an ally.

The ward per second is equal to a proportion of the ward granted up front by the other nodes on this tree and by items that cause you to grant ward with Healing Hands.

This effect cannot stack multiple times, casting again on the same ally just refreshes the duration.
17.altText: You count as your own ally an are affected by this node when you cast Healing Hands on yourself.

stats.statName: Upfront Ward gained as Ward per Second

18.description: Healing Hands restores additional health up front.

19.description: Healing Hands restores additional health over time. This lasts for three seconds just like Healing Hands' inherent healing over time effect.

20.description:
When you directly use a melee attack and hit at least one enemy, you have a chance to cast Healing Hands around the target. This consumes mana based on Healing Hands's mana cost.

Healing Hands restores less up front health when cast indirectly.

stats.statName: Healing Hands Chance on Melee Hit
Less Up Front Healing For Indirect Casts

21.description: When you directly cast Smite, you have a chance to cast Healing Hands around the target location. This consumes 70% of its mana cost.

stats.statName: Healing Hands Chance on Smite Cast

22.description:
When you directly use Healing Hands you dash to the target location first. However, Healing Hands now has a cooldown and counts a {Traversal} skill.

This does not affect indirect casts of Healing Hands.
22.altText: Using a Traversal skill puts all other traversal skills on cooldown and traversal skills' cooldowns do not recover while you are using a traversal skill.

23.description: A portion of Healing Hands' remaining cooldown is recovered if you use it to heal an ally other than yourself. This effect can occur once per direct cast of Healing Hands.

24.description: When you cast Healing Hands, there is a chance it spawns a {Health Globe} at a random point inside the area of effect. When an ally walks over the globe, it is consumed, healing them for 70 health.

26.description: You are immune to damage while moving with Healing Hands.

28.description: Healing Hands takes longer to cast, but deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has increased healing effectiveness and a larger area of effect.
28.altText: The cast speed modifier is also multiplicative with other modifiers and affects attack speed instead if Healing Hands is converted to a melee attack.

30.description:
If you heal an allied player other than yourself that was below half prior to healing, Healing Hands restores them to full health and grants them ward equal to 80% of their max health.

This has no effect on you, nor on minions, nor players that have an effect that causes them to gain ward per second based on their missing health.

stats.statName: Health Gained as Ward when Healing to Full

32.description:
While channelling Healing Hands you also call down a beam from the sky that deals fire damage over time to enemies around the target area and heals allies within its area of effect.

Healing Hands costs additional mana per second while channelling.

1.description: {Active:} You have increased melee attack speed.

2.description:
{Passive:} You have a chance to shock enemies with melee attacks.

{Active:} This effect is doubled.

3.description: {Active:} You deal additional lightning damage with melee attacks, and deal increased lightning damage with melee attacks.

4.description:
{Passive:} You have a chance to cast {Zap} when you use a melee attack and hit at least one enemy. This effect has a 1 second cooldown.

{Active:} Zap's cooldown is reduced.
4.altText:
{Zap} scales with spell damage and lightning damage, but not other nodes on this skill tree.

Activating Enchant Weapon also resets this cooldown.

stats.statName: Chance to Zap on Melee Hit

5.description: {Zap} from {Conduit} has a chance to be replaced with {Lightning Blast}.

6.description: {Active:} You leech a portion of the fire and lightning damage you deal with melee attacks as health.

7.description: {Active:} You deal additional fire damage with melee attacks, and deal increased fire damage with melee attacks.

8.description:
{Passive:} You have a chance to ignite enemies with melee attacks.

{Active:} This effect is doubled.

9.description: {Passive:} Ignites you inflict last longer (doubled while active).

10.description: Activating Enchant Weapon consumes all ignite stacks on nearby enemies, causing their damage to be dealt instantly.

11.description: Ignites consumed by {Conflagrate} deal significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

12.description:
{Passive:} Cast {Fire Burst} when hitting an ignited enemy, up to a limited number of times per 2 seconds.

{Active:} Fire Burst's limit is doubled.
12.altText:
{Fire Burst} deals fire damage on hit and scales with increases to spell damage and fire damage but not other nodes on this tree, unless stated otherwise.

Activating Enchant Weapon also resets this cooldown.

13.description:
{Passive:} {Fire Burst} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

{Active:} Fire Burst also has increased area of effect.
13.altText: {Fire Burst} deals fire damage on hit and scales with increases to spell damage and fire damage but not other nodes on this tree, unless stated otherwise.

14.description: Enchant Weapon is active for longer.

15.description: {Active:} You deal increased elemental damage with melee attacks proportional to how much mana you are missing when Enchant Weapon is activated.

stats.statName: Melee Elemental Damage Per 2% Missing Mana

16.description:
{Passive:} Activating Enchant Weapon costs less mana.

{Active:} You deal increased elemental damage with melee attacks.

17.description: When you directly use a melee attack, Enchant Weapon will automatically activate if it is not on cooldown.
17.altText: Enchant Weapon will activate before the melee attack.

18.description: {Active:} You gain stacks of {Fire Aura} every second.

19.description: {Active:} You deal additional cold and lightning damage with melee attacks based on your weapon's melee damage.
19.altText: If you have 19 added damage on your weapon, you will receive +3 cold and +3 lightning melee damage. If you have less than 5 added damage on your weapon, this node does nothing.

stats.statName: Melee Lightning Damage Per 5 Melee Damage
Melee Cold Damage Per 5 Melee Damage

20.description:
{Passive:} You have a chance to chill enemies with melee attacks, and you gain a chance to inflict frostbite on enemies based on your chill chance.

{Active:} Both of these effects are doubled.

stats.statName: Percent of Chill Chance gained as Frostbite Chance

21.description:
{Passive:} Your melee attacks have a chance to cast piercing {Ice Shards} towards enemies they hit, up to a limited number of times per 2 seconds.

{Active:} The chance to cast Ice Shards is tripled.
21.altText:
{Icicles} deal cold damage on hit and scale with spell damage and cold damage, but not other nodes on this tree.

Activating Enchant Weapon also resets this cooldown.

22.description: {Active:} {Ice Shards} fires 2 additional projectiles.
22.altText: {Icicles} deal cold damage on hit and scale with spell damage and cold damage, but not other nodes of this tree.

23.description: {Active:} You deal additional cold damage with melee attacks, and deal increased cold damage with melee attacks.

24.description: Activating Enchant Weapon causes your next melee elemental attack to be free.

25.description: Activating Enchant Weapon cleanses negative ailments.

26.description:
Enchant Weapon has a reduced cooldown and duration.

{Active:} You cast {Elemental Nova} when you activate Enchant Weapon and when its active duration ends, consuming mana equal to Elemental Nova's mana cost.

stats.statName: Casts Elemental Nova on Active Start and End

2.description: You gain charges faster while moving.

3.description: Enemies that hit you are shocked while you have more than 80 charges.

4.description: You gain charges while moving much faster, but charges decay at your movement charge rate if you stop moving for more than 1 second.

5.description: You have a higher maximum amount of charges.

6.description: You gain {Haste} for 1 second per 50 charges when you discharge.

7.description: Discharge has a significantly higher range, but can only hit enemies within a 90 degree arc.

8.description: Discharge has a higher range the more charges you have.

9.description: Discharge’s critical strikes deal more damage if you have over 100 charges when you discharge.

10.description: You gain charges for each enemy you critically strike if you have discharged in the last 3 seconds.

11.description: Discharge deals additional spell lightning damage (doubled if you have at least 80 charges).

12.description: Improves Discharge’s base critical strike chance.

13.description: Discharge hits an additional enemy for every 50 charges you have when you discharge.

14.description: When you directly cast Static, Discharge deals additional lightning damage per charge, but Discharge costs more mana per charge.

15.description: You gain more charges when you are hit.

16.description: Discharge grants ward proportional to your charges, but has a longer cooldown.

17.description: Discharge hits more enemies.

18.description: Static's cooldown resets when you reach your maximum number of charges.

19.description: While over 80 charges, you expend 10 charges to cast {Lightning Blast} at an enemy within 8 meters every second. This effect consumes Lightning Blast's mana cost.

20.description: {Lightning Blast} critical hits have a chance to grant a charge.
20.altText: This affects all of your casts of Lightning Blast, not just from {Overload}.

21.description: Lightning Blasts from {Overload} have additional critical strike chance and a chance to chain additional times.

22.description: {Lightning Blasts} from {Overload} consume less of Lightning Blast's mana cost, but expends additional charges.

23.description: Discharge shocks enemies on hit. Each enemy is inflicted with 1 stack of shock for each 50 charges expended, up to a maximum.

24.description: After discharging, your next spell and melee attack deal additional lightning damage.

stats.statName: Additional Spell And Melee Lightning Damage

25.description: Discharge now has a chance to stun enemies, with a higher chance based the number of charges you have.

26.description: Nearby enemies are knocked back when you discharge.

27.description: Your next melee attack grants charges on hit. This effect has a 1 second cooldown.

1.description: Manifested Armor gains increased effect of stats from your body armor.

2.description: Your Manifest Armor gains melee physical damage equal to a proportion of the armour on your body armour.

stats.statName: Melee Physical Damage per 10 Armor On Chest

3.description: Manifested Armor has more health (multiplicative with other modifiers).

4.description: Manifested Armor gains a shield which scales with the stats of your equipped shield.

5.description: Manifested Armor gains additional health regeneration.

6.description: Manifested Armor gains increased effect for health regeneration from all items that affect Manifest Armor.

7.description: Manifested Armor reflects a percentage of damage to attackers.

8.description: Manifested Armor reflects damage back to attackers for an amount equal to your attunement.

stats.statName: Damage Reflected Per Point Of Attunement

9.description: Manifested Armor gains increased effect of stats from your helmet.

10.description: Manifested Armor deals additional melee and spell fire damage as well as more fire damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

11.description: Manifested Armor now also attacks with {Forgebreath}, a fire spell that deals 60 fire damage to all enemies in a cone in front of it. 3 second cooldown.

12.description: {Forgebreath} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.
12.altText: {Forgebreath} is a spell that deals 60 fire damage to all enemies hit.

13.description: {Forgebreath} has additional ignite chance and a shorter cooldown.

14.description: Manifested Armor's melee attacks have a chance to ignite enemies.

15.description:
Manifested Armor gains the ability to use {Whirlwind Strike}, a spinning attack which hits all nearby enemies multiple times and travels a short distance. 

This effect has a 4 second cooldown.

16.description: Manifested Armor gains increased effect of stats from your boots.

17.description: Manifested Armor has a chance to taunt nearby enemies each second.

18.description: Manifested Armor cannot be stunned.

19.description: Manifested Armor gains a charge ability, which deals physical damage and knocks back any enemy it passes through. 6 second cooldown.

20.description: Manifested Armor has a chance to slow attacking enemies when hit.

21.description: Manifested Armor gains increased effect of stats from your gloves.

22.description: Manifested Armor's melee physical attacks have a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

23.description: Manifested Armor deals more physical damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

24.description: Manifested Armor's melee attacks have a chance to reduce enemy armor.

25.description: Manifested Armor deals more damage, but has less armor (multiplicative with other modifiers).

26.description: Manifested Armor gains a sword which scales with your equipped weapon's stats.

0.loreText: Gone from reality in the blink of an eye and the fall of a blade

2.description: Erasing Strike and {Void Rifts} it creates deals damage in a larger area.

3.description: Erasing Strike hits have a chance to inflict enemies with {Time Rot}, an ailment that deals void damage over time, increases stun duration by 5%, lasts 3 seconds, and stacks up to 12 times.

4.description: When Erasing Strike hits a boss or rare enemy you have a chance to cast {Void Beam} at their location, a spell that continuously damages surrounding enemies for 3 seconds.
4.altText: {Void Beam} scales with increased void and spell damage.

5.description: Erasing Strike deals more damage over time.

6.description: Erasing Strike always creates a {Void Rift} at its impact location.

7.description: Erasing Strike hits shred enemy void resistance.

8.description: When Erasing Strike kills an enemy you have a chance to cast {Void Beam} at their location, a spell that continuously damages surrounding enemies for 3 seconds.
8.altText: {Void Beam} scales with increased void and spell damage.

9.description: Erasing Strike has increased cooldown recovery speed and deals more melee damage to enemies that are already damaged (multiplicative with other modifiers).

10.description: Erasing Strike deals more melee damage to enemies at full health (multiplicative with other modifiers).

stats.statName: Melee Damage Vs Full Health Enemies

11.description: Erasing Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and instantly kill enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health).
11.altText: If you have a similar effect from an item or passive node then the highest threshold is used.

12.description: All {Void Beams} created by Erasing Strike deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
12.altText: {Void Beam} scales with increased void and spell damage.

13.description: Erasing Strike consumes mana to cause additional echoes when used. Each echo will appear one second after the last. These additional echos cannot be created while you have negative mana.

14.description: Erasing Strike no longer has a cooldown, but it deals less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

15.description: Erasing Strike hits have a chance to slow and deals more melee damage to slowed enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

16.description:
Erasing Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). 

This bonus is doubled while wielding two handed weapon.

17.description:
Improves Erasing Strike's base critical strike chance.

Additionally, Erasing Strike's hits cannot be dodged.

18.description:
Erasing Strike critical strikes have a chance to grant you a {Void Essence}, which grants 3% more void damage, 3% more melee damage, and 15% reduced duration of stuns received.

You can have a maximum of 3 void essences at once.

19.description: Erasing Strike critical strikes deal more damage.

20.description: When Erasing Strike kills an enemy or hits a boss or rare enemy you regain health equal to a percentage of the target's maximum health.

stats.statName: Health Gained On Rare or Boss Hit

21.description: You gain the {Haste} buff for 1 second, granting 30% increased movement speed when Erasing Strike kills an enemy or hits a boss or rare enemy.

22.description: If you kill 5 or more enemies simultaneously with Erasing Strike, you create 4 {Void Beams} which travel at random, damaging surrounding enemies for 3 seconds.
22.altText: {Void Beams} scale with increased void and spell damage.

23.description: The kills required to summon {Void Beams} via the {Ravenous Void} node require less kills to trigger, but Erasing Strike costs more mana.

24.description:
Erasing Strike deals more void damage if you are using a two handed mace (multiplicative with other modifiers).

Erasing Strike has increased cooldown recovery speed if you are using a two handed sword.

Erasing Strike's melee hit and void rifts have a larger area of effect if you are using a two handed axe.

26.description:
Bleed chance from all sources is converted to {Time Rot} chance for Erasing Strike and effects related to bleed now depend on Time Rot instead. 

Erasing Strike deals more melee damage against targets with 12 stacks of Time Rot (multiplicative with other modifiers).

stats.statName: Melee Damage vs 12 stacks of Time Rot

27.description: You can store an additional charge of Erasing Strike.

28.description: Erasing Strike has increased cooldown recovery speed, but also has a higher mana cost.

0.loreText: Harness the storm

2.description: Storm Totem attacks have a chance to shock enemies.

3.description: Storm Totem hits deal more damage to shocked enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

4.description: Storm Totem has more critical strike chance against shocked enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

stats.statName: More Crit Chance Against Shocked Enemies

5.description: Storm Totem has additional Spell Lightning Damage based on your Shock Chance and your Chance to Shock Attackers.
5.altText: The totem's shock chance and your shock chance for minions are not taken into account, just your own shock chance. The same applies for the chance to shock attackers.

stats.statName: Spell Lightning Damage per 10% Shock Chance
Spell Lightning Damage per 10% Chance to Shock Attackers

6.description: Enemies hit by Storm Totem recently have reduced movement speed.

7.description: You have increased movement speed if Storm Totem has hit a shocked an enemy recently (last 4 seconds).

8.description: You deal increased lightning damage if a Storm Totem has hit a shocked an enemy recently.

9.description: Allies near your Storm Totem have additional lightning resistance.

10.description: Storm Totem has increased health.

11.description: Storm Totem hits have an increased chance to stun enemies and the stuns they inflict last longer.

12.description: Storm Totem costs less mana to summon.

13.description: Storm Totem has more cast speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

14.description: Improves Storm Totem's base critical strike chance.

15.description: Storm Totem critical strikes deal more damage.

16.description:
Storm Totem now creates a {Blizzard} around itself; enemies caught in the blizzard take cold damage over time and have a 25% chance to be chilled each second.

All shock chance is converted to chill chance. All effects which are conditional on shock are conditional on chill instead.

17.description: Storm Totem deals additional cold spell damage.

18.description: Storm Totem hits have a chance to chill enemies.

19.description: {Blizzard} has a chance to inflict enemies with {Frostbite} each second.

20.description: {Frostbite} inflicted by {Blizzard} has additional Cold Penetration.

21.description: Storm Totem's individual lightning strikes damage enemies in a larger area
21.altText: If you have the {Blizzard} node this affects the area of the blizzard.

22.description: Allies near your Storm Totem are granted additional melee lightning damage.

23.description: Storm Totem casts {Lightning Nova} when it dies.
23.altText: {Lightning Nova} scales with your minion's stats.

24.description: Storm Totem deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but cost more mana.

25.description:
If you have at least 3 other totems when you summon Storm Totem, up to 5 are consumed to instead summon a {Thunder Totem} which has more damage, duration, health and size per totem consumed this way (all multiplicative with other modifiers).

This effect does not consume other Storm Totems or Thunder Totems.

stats.statName: Thunder Totem Damage, Health, Duration And Size Per Totem

26.description: Your Storm Totem now casts {Storm Bolts} from your {Gathering Storm} instead of its own lightning strikes, but Storm Totem has significantly less cast speed and deals less damage (both multiplicative with other modifiers).
26.altText: The Storm Bolts benefit from your Storm Totem tree and your {Gathering Storm} tree.

stats.statName: Storm Bolts Instead Of Lightning Strikes

1.description: Frost Claw has a higher chance to freeze enemies and a higher chance to critically strike.

2.description: Frost Claw deals additional spell damage based on your added melee damage.
2.altText: The type of added melee damage determines the type of spell damage gained. For example if you have +30 Melee Void Damage, Frost Claw will gain +10 Spell Void Damage.

3.description: Frost Claw deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and its explosion deals damage in a larger area. These bonuses are doubled if you have at least 1200 ward.

4.description: Directly casting Frost Claw costs less mana and you have a chance to regain mana when you cast it.

stats.statName: Chance to gain 12 mana on Direct Cast

5.description:
Frost Claw's base cold damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to cold damage. 

Chill chance from all sources is converted to ignite chance.

Swaps Frost Claw's {Cold} tag for a {Fire} tag.

6.description:
Frost Claw's base cold damage is converted to lightning, unless it has already been converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to cold damage. 

Frostbite chance from all sources is converted to shock chance.

Swaps Frost Claw's {Cold} tag for a {Lightning} tag.

7.description: Frost Claw hits have a chance to {Slow} and {Chill}.

8.description: You have increased cast speed with Frost Claw.

9.description: Frost Claw deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), and its hits have a chance to inflict {Frostbite}.

10.description: Frostbite, chill, slow, ignite, and shock inflicted by Frost Claw last longer.

11.description:
You have a chance to cast {Elemental Nova} when Frost Claw's projectiles reach the target.

This consumes mana equal to Elemental Nova's mana cost and cannot trigger if you are out of mana.
11.altText: The chance is once per cast, not once per projectile.

12.description: Frost Claw has a higher chance to freeze based on its critical strike chance.

stats.statName: Freeze Rate Multiplier per 1% Crit Chance

13.description: If you have an active {Ice Barrage} when you hit an enemy with Frost Claw, that Ice Barrage fires faster for the rest of its duration, up to a maximum.
13.altText: This fire rate modifier is multiplicative with other modifiers.

stats.statName: Ice Barrage Rate of Fire on Hit

14.description:
You have a chance to cast {Ice Barrage} in the target direction when you cast Frost Claw.

This consumes mana equal to Ice Barrage's mana cost and cannot trigger if you are out of mana.

16.description:
When you are hit by an enemy you have a chance to retaliate with Frost Claw.

When you cast Frost Claw by any method you gain Ward.

17.description: When you cast Frost Claw you gain ward based on its Freeze Rate Multiplier.
17.altText: Addtional Freeze Rate Multiplier from this tree, including from Cold and Calculating, is taken into account for this node.

18.description:
When you use a melee attack and hit at least one enemy you have a chance to cast Frost Claw towards it, or at another nearby enemy if the hit killed the original target.

This effect consumes mana equal to a portion of Frost Claw's mana cost.

stats.statName: Chance To Cast On Melee Hit

20.description: Gain a stack of Frozen Sleeper every second up to a maximum. When you cast Frost Claw it consumes all stacks to gain cold penetration per stack and release an {Ice Spiral} for each stack.

stats.statName: Ice Spirals on Cast per Stack

21.description: When you cast {Ice Spirals} there is a chance that the number of projectiles will be doubled and they'll all deal double damage.
21.altText: The chance is calculated when Ice Spirals are cast and either applies to all of them or none of them with each cast.

22.description: For each active {Ice Spiral}, Glacier gains increased area and additional cold penetration, and Snap Freeze gains increased area and freeze duration.
22.altText: These bonuses apply based on the number of your Ice Spirals that exist when you begin casting Glacier or Snap Freeze.

stats.statName: Glacier Cold Penetration per Ice Spiral
Snap Freeze Area per Ice Spiral
Snap Freeze Freeze Duration per Ice Spiral

24.description:
Directly casting Frost Claw causes it to recast from the target location to a location 4 meters behind it. The second can hit the same enemies as the first cast.

Frost Claw costs additional mana.

25.description:
The second cast from {On Through The Snow} causes a third cast. The third cast can hit the same enemies as the first and second casts.

Frost Claw costs additional mana.
25.altText: The third cast is aimed at a location 4 meters behind the second cast.

26.description:
The second cast from {On Through The Snow} targets a random enemy that is 3 to 9 meters away from the original target location.

Frost Claw costs additional mana.

27.description:
When the second cast from {On Through The Snow} is released, Frost Claw is also cast back towards you.

Frost Claw's mana cost is increased.

28.description:
Frost Claw has 2 additional projectiles allowing it to hit enemies in a wider area on the way to the target.

Frost Claw costs additional mana.

29.description:
Frost Claw no longer creates a burst of damage at the target, but its projectiles are now staggered and they can all hit the same target.

Frost Claw's mana cost is increased, it no longer has the {Area} tag and it has a lowered base freeze rate.

30.description: Frost Claw has a lower mana cost and it deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to frozen enemies, but its projectiles are slower.

32.description: Frost Claw's projectiles are faster and it costs less mana.

0.loreText: Flesh unbound by space and time... for a price.

2.description:
When you use Transplant you are granted {Bone Armor} for 4 seconds, which causes you to take less damage.

This effect has a 10 second cooldown.

4.description: Transplant has increased cast speed and cooldown recovery speed.

5.description: {Bone Armor} lasts longer.

6.description: Transplant's health cost is regenerated over 4 seconds, but costs significantly more health (multiplicative with other modifiers).

7.description: Your minions deal additional melee damage for 4 seconds after you cast Transplant.

8.description: You leave behind a {Bone Minion}, which is a temporary melee minion, when you use Transplant, but your previous body no longer detonates. Other detonations still behave normally.
8.altText: {Bone Minions} last for 20 seconds.

9.description: You may Transplant to minions, which sacrifices the minion. Sacrifice cast this way uses your Sacrifice Tree and deals more damage than usual (multiplicative with other modifiers).

10.description: {Bone Minions} last until killed, but you may have only 1 active at a time.
10.altText: {Bone Minions} are additional Melee Skeletal Minions that are spawned when you Transplant.

11.description: You can summon more {Bone Minions}.
11.altText: {Bone Minions} are additional Melee Skeletal Minions that are spawned when you Transplant.

12.description: Transplant’s detonations deal damage in a larger area.

13.description: Transplant deals more hit damage to cursed enemies. Transplant hits against enemies afflicted with Bone Curse restore health. Transplant hits against enemies afflicted with Spirit Plague grant ward.

14.description: Transplant's base physical damage is converted to necrotic damage. Consequently this damage scales with increases to necrotic damage, but not increases to physical damage.

15.description: Transplant inflicts surrounding enemies with {Fear} on departure.

16.description: Transplant inflicts surrounding enemies with {Fear} on arrival.

17.description: Transplant creates an additional body that detonates on arrival.

18.description: Casting Transplant grants you {Haste} and {Frenzy} for a short duration.

19.description: You cast Bone Curse around the target location after you arrive.

20.description: Explosions cause enemies to bleed, but using Transplant also causes you to bleed.

21.description: Transplant detonations leave a {Pool of Blood} for 3 seconds that slows enemies.
21.altText: {Pools of Blood} are patches of blood left behind by certain skills which slow enemy movement.

22.description: Transplant costs less health (multiplicative with other modifiers).

23.description: {Pools of Blood} heal you for a percentage of your total health when you walk on them.
23.altText: {Pools of Blood} are patches of blood left behind by certain skills which slow enemy movement.

stats.statName: Pool of Blood Maximum Health Heal

24.description: You automatically cast {Rip Blood} at enemies nearby where you depart, but Transplant costs more health (multiplicative with other modifiers). An enemy cannot be hit by multiple instances of Rip Blood created this way.
24.altText: Your Rip Blood tree does affect Rip Blood cast by your Transplant skill.

25.description: When you hit an enemy with Transplant you regain mana, but lose a portion of your current health and ward.

26.description: Transplant restores mana, but has a longer cooldown.

27.description: Transplant detonation hits deal more damage, especially to bleeding enemies.
27.altText: These effects are multiplicative with each other and with other modifiers.

28.description: When you are out of mana, Transplant detonations deal more damage.

30.description:
Transplant explosions instantly kill enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health). 

If you have a similar effect from an item or passive node, then the highest threshold is used.

32.description: Transplant's base physical damage is converted to cold damage. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to physical damage.
32.altText: This node has no effect if {Ethereal Body} is allocated.

2.description: Arcane Ascendance grants you increased spell damage while active.

3.description: While Arcane Ascendance is active, each hit you take increases your spell damage and cast speed, but drains your mana.

4.description: You are granted increased spell damage each second while Arcane Ascendance is active.
4.altText: Expires at the end of Arcane Ascendance.

5.description: You are granted increased cast speed each second while Arcane Ascendance is active.

6.description: While Arcane Ascendance is active, spells and attacks have a chance to slow enemies over 5 meters away and you deal more damage to enemies per stack of slow on them.
6.altText: The more damage bonus is multiplicative with other modifiers

7.description: While Arcane Ascendance is active, you are granted mana whenever you kill an enemy that is over 5 meters away.

stats.statName: Mana Gained On Killing Distant Enemy

8.description: While Arcane Ascendance is active, whenever you kill a frozen enemy a nearby enemy is frozen for a duration.

9.description: You are granted {Haste} for a duration after leaving Arcane Ascendance. The duration is capped at 200% of the time you spent in Arcane Ascendance.

10.description: You regain mana while you enter Arcane Ascendance, but the mana is lost when you exit Arcane Ascendance.

11.description: Arcane Ascendance has a shorter cooldown.

12.description: You gain ward when you activate Arcane Ascendance.

14.description: While Arcane Ascendance is active, your spells and attacks that can freeze enemies have a higher chance to do so.

15.description: You knock back all nearby enemies when you enter Arcane Ascendance.

16.description: While Arcane Ascendance is active, you automatically cast {Lightning Blast} when you hit an enemy. Lightning Blast uses its skill tree and you lose mana equal to Lightning Blast's cost. This effect has a 2 second cooldown.

17.description: Lightning Blast cast by {Superconductor} triggers more frequently.

18.description: Arcane Ascendance drains less mana per second.

19.description: All of your spells cost less mana while Arcane Ascendance is active, but you cannot regenerate mana while Arcane Ascendance is active.

21.description: While Arcane Ascendance is active, spells and attacks have a chance to chill enemies over 5 meters away.

22.description: While Arcane Ascendance is active, spells and attacks have a chance to shock enemies over 5 meters away.

23.description: While Arcane Ascendance is active, you {Mark} enemies you hit that are over 5 meters away. When you exit Arcane Ascendance, you consume all marks, dealing lightning damage to affected enemies.
23.altText: Added spell damage applies to this damage at 135% effectiveness.

24.description: Arcane Ascendance now has a 2 second cooldown and no longer drains your mana. You can cast 4 spells before Arcane Ascendance ends automatically. Lasts 12 seconds.

25.description: You can cast more spells via {Acuity}, but Arcane Ascendance has a longer cooldown.

26.description: {Mark Of Thunder} deals more damage when it is consumed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

0.description:
Requires a bow.

Summons 7 {Black Arrows} which rain from the sky over 4 seconds, granting bonus damage to your next bow attack when retrieved.
0.altText: You cannot pick up a new {Black Arrow} until you've expended your current {Black Arrow}.

2.description: Using a {Black Arrow} grants increased damage over time to your next bow attack.

3.description: Picking up a {Black Arrow} grants you a stack of {Crimson Shroud} for a short duration, granting you bleed chance and less damage over time taken. This stacks up to 3 times for a short duration.

stats.statName: Damage Over Time Taken per Crimson Shroud

4.description: Using a {Black Arrow} grants a chance to shred enemy physical resistance to your next bow attack.

5.description: Picking up a {Black Arrow} restores health.

6.description: Picking up a {Black Arrow} grants you a stack of {Dusk Shroud} for 4 seconds, granting you glancing blow chance and dodge rating. This effect can stack.

7.description: Picking up a {Black Arrow} creates a {Shadow} at the arrow's location.
7.altText:
Shadows will repeat one skill you use before vanishing. Shadows can repeat Acid Flask, Shurikens or Shadow Cascade, and their damage scales with your damage stats. 

You can have 3 Shadows at once, and they will disappear after 5 seconds.

8.description: Picking up a {Black Arrow} grants you the Frenzy buff, granting you 20% increased attack and cast speed for a short duration.

9.description: Using a {Black Arrow} grants additional physical damage to your next bow attack.

10.description: Using a {Black Arrow} grants increased critical strike chance to your next bow attack.

11.description: Using a {Black Arrow} causes your next {Multishot} to pierce additional enemies (continue through targets they hit).

12.description: Using a {Black Arrow} improves your next {Flurry's} base critical strike chance.

13.description: Using a {Black Arrow} grants more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to your next bow attack, but consume additional mana.

14.description: Picking up a {Black Arrow} resets the combo of {Cinder Strike}.

15.description: Using a {Black Arrow} causes your next {Cinder Strike} to instantly kill enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health).
15.altText: If you have a similar effect from an item or passive node then the highest threshold is used.

16.description: Picking up a {Black Arrow} restores mana.

17.description:
Using a {Black Arrow} consumes all active {Shadows} to grant your next bow attack more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per {Shadow} consumed.

Consuming at least 3 {Shadows} grants significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

18.description: Using a {Black Arrow} grants {Puncture} additional physical penetration and bleed chance.

19.description: Using a {Black Arrow} grants additional poison penetration and poison chance to your next bow attack.

20.description: Additional {Black Arrows} are summoned, but the arrows are summoned at the same frequency causing {Dark Quiver} to have a longer duration.

21.description: Using a {Black Arrow} grants increased elemental damage to your next bow attack.

22.description: Using a {Black Arrow} grants a chance to freeze, shock or ignite enemies, depending on the element, to your next bow elemental attack.

23.description: Using a {Black Arrow} causes your next {Detonating Arrow} to deal damage in a significantly larger area.

24.description: Picking up a {Black Arrow} slows nearby enemies for a short duration.

25.description: Picking up a {Black Arrow} knocks nearby enemies back 4 meters.

26.description: {Black Arrows} are summoned more frequently. This does not cause more arrows to be summoned and also causes {Dark Quiver} to have a shorter duration.

27.description: You instantly summon a number of {Black Arrows} on use. The rest are spread out over the normal duration.
27.altText: This does not increase the total number of Black Arrows summoned.

28.description: Using a bow attack grants you a chance to summon a {Black Arrow} at a random nearby location. This effect has a 3 second cooldown.

stats.statName: Arrow On Bow Skill Use Chance

29.description: Using a {Black Arrow} causes your next {Hail of Arrows} to deal increased damage over time equal to twice your critical strike chance.

30.description:
Picking up a {Black Arrow} grants active {Ballistae} additional bow physical damage while they are alive.

This effect stacks up to 4 times.

31.description:
Picking up a {Black Arrow} grants active {Ballistae} increased attack speed while they are alive.

This effect stacks up to 4 times.

32.description: {Ballistae} that have been buffed by at least 4 {Black Arrows} always critically strike.

34.description: Using a Black Arrow grants your next {Heartseeker} additional {Recurve} chance.

0.description:
Requires a bow.

Fires an arrow that attatches itself in a target then explodes after 0.6 seconds. Added bow damage is converted to lightning damage.

2.description: Detonating Arrow has increased critical strike chance and it has reduced arming time.

3.description: Detonating Arrow critical strikes deal more damage and it has a chance to apply {Critical Vulnerability} to enemies, making them easier to critically strike.

4.description: Detonating Arrow now explodes on impact in a cone behind the target rather than a circle, but no longer has an arming time.

5.description:
The explosion base lightning damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to lightning damage.

Shock chance from all sources is converted to ignite chance and effects related to shock now depend on ignite instead.

Swaps Detonating Arrow's {Lightning} tag for a {Fire} tag.

6.description: The explosion deals damage in a larger area.

7.description: Detonating Arrow has a chance to shock enemies, but the explosion hit deals less hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

8.description: Detonating Arrow consumes a portion of your current mana to deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) based on the mana consumed, up to a maximum.
8.altText: As an example, if your current mana is 50 and you consume 10%, Detonating Arrow will deal 5% more damage.

9.description: The explosion deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

10.description: Detonating Arrow now has a cooldown, but when you directly use it, it deals more damage in a significantly larger area (both multiplicative with other modifiers), and has an increased chance to stun.

11.description: You can store an additional charge of Detonating Arrow.

12.description: If an enemy has an attached Detonating Arrow and gets hit again, it explodes the first arrow immediately.

13.description:
Detonating Arrow's base lightning damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to lightning damage. It also gains a base freeze rate.

Shock chance from all sources is converted to chill chance.

Swaps Detonating Arrow's {Lightning} tag for a {Cold} tag. 

This has no effect if Detonating Arrow is converted to fire with {Dragon Arrow}.

14.description: Detonating Arrow has a higher chance based on your uncapped Cold Resistance.

15.description: Detonating Arrow causes enemies to have less movement speed (multiplicative with other modifiers) for each arrow attached.

16.description: Detonating Arrow has a longer arming time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

17.description: Detonating Arrow deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a longer arming time. The explosion deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per second the arrow spent arming.

18.description: Detonating Arrow causes enemies to have less elemental resistance while they have at least 1 arrow attached.

19.description: The explosion hit deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per 5% health the enemy is missing.

stats.statName: Explosion Hit Damage per 5% Missing Health

20.description: The explosion deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but in a smaller area (multiplicative with other modifiers).

21.description: Detonating Arrow can now be charged up for up to 2 seconds, causing it to pierce a number of enemies (continue through targets it hits) per 0.5 seconds charged up.

22.description: Detonating Arrow deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per second charged up.

23.description: Detonating Arrow has a chance to shock enemies.

24.description: Detonating Arrow now slightly seeks out targets.

26.description:
When you hit an enemy with Detonating Arrow that already has an arrow attached to them, the explosion deals more damage in a larger area (multiplicative with other modifiers). 

{Suckerpunch Arrow} will not attach an additional Detonating Arrow.
26.altText: If Detonating Arrow's arming time is removed, this effect cannot occur.

27.description: Detonating Arrow has increased attack speed and shock applied by this skill last longer.

28.description:
The explosion causes {Lightning Tendrils} to chain out to other nearby targets. This can't hit enemies hit by the explosion.

This has no effect if Detonating Arrow's damage is converted.
28.altText: {Lightning Tendrils} scales with increases to lightning and bow damage.

29.description: {Lightning Tendrils} penetrate a portion of enemy lightning resistance and have a chance to shock enemies.

30.description:
The explosion now poisons enemies on hit, but its hits deal less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

Detonating Arrow's base damage is convered to Physical. Consequently this damage scales with increases to physical damage, but not increases to lightning damage.

Shock chance from all sources is converted to poison chance.

Swaps Detonating Arrow's {Lightning} tag for {Poison} and {Physical} tags.

This has no effect if Detonating Arrow is converted to fire or cold with {Dragon Arrow} or {Frostfang Arrow}.

32.description: Detonating arrow no longer costs mana and instead restores mana when you directly use it and hit at least one enemy. However it now only has a small chance of exploding.
32.altText: Have no effect on mana consumed by effects such as the {Infused Discharge} node on the this tree.

34.description: Ailments inflicted by Detonating Arrow deal more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

2.description: Explosive Trap deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and its hits shred enemy fire resistance.

3.description:
Whenever you hit an enemy with any melee attack, you attach an Explosive Trap to that enemy.

This effect has a 1.5 second cooldown and attached traps explode after 1 second ignoring arming time or when the enemy it's attached to dies. Enemies cannot have more than 1 trap attached.

4.description:
Attached traps deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

If the enemy that the Explosive Trap is attached to hits you, it now attaches to you instead (but will still only damage enemies). Hitting an enemy then attaches it back to them without changing the delay before exploding.

Additionally, when it explodes, the trap deals 30% more damage for each time it has been passed.

5.description:
When an Explosive Trap detonates, all other Explosive Traps now also detonate in quick succession and fire {Detonating Arrows} at the original target trap's location. The Detonating Arrows can occur a limited number of times per 2 seconds.

This effect consumes mana equal to a portion of your {Detonating Arrow's} mana cost.
5.altText: This effect only works while you have positive mana. Exceeding the limit only prevents Detonating Arrows, it does not prevent the chain detonations.

6.description: {Detonating Arrows} fired this way deal additional bow damage per 3 Dexterity.

7.description:
Explosive Trap's base fire damage is converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to fire damage.

Fire resistance shred chance from all sources is converted to lightning resistance shred.

Swaps Explosive Trap's {Fire} tag for a {Lightning} tag.

8.description: Explosive Trap's hits have a chance to shock enemies and inflict them with a {Spark Charge}.

9.description:
