When directly using Explosive Trap, an unconverted Explosive Trap and a trap corresponding to each conversion node you have taken are thrown at the same time. Traps thrown this way are thrown in a small area.

Additionally, Explosive Trap deals less damage in a smaller area (both multiplicative with other modifiers) and cost additional mana.

10.description:
Explosive Trap's base fire damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to fire damage.

Fire resistance shred chance from all sources is converted to cold resistance shred.

Swaps Explosive Trap's {Fire} tag for a {Cold} tag.
10.altText: This effect conversion takes priority if you have converted Explosive Trap to lightning.

11.description:
Explosive Trap's hits have a chance to chill enemies.

Additionally, Explosive Trap has additional freeze rate per Intelligence.

12.description:
When you directly throw Explosive Trap, its hits always freeze enemies, but it now has a cooldown.

Whenever you freeze an enemy with any skill, a portion of Explosive Trap's remaining cooldown is recovered.
12.altText: If Explosive Trap already has a cooldown, the highest cooldown is used.

13.description: Explosive Trap is now triggered from farther away and deals damage in a larger area.

14.description:
Particularly fast enemies (with a movement speed above 6 meters per second) trigger Explosive Traps instantly, even if they haven't armed.

Additionally, Explosive Trap's hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to moving enemies.
14.altText: Base player movement speed is 5.28 meters per second.

15.description: Explosive Trap deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area for each second it has existed before detonating up to a maximum.

16.description: Explosive Trap deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) if the arming time is not ignored, but it takes longer for it to arm before it can detonate.

17.description: When an Explosive Trap detonates, if it hit at least one enemy, it has a chance to grant you a stack of {Dusk Shroud}. This chance increases for each second it spends arming.
17.altText: The chance has no benefit when above 100%.

stats.statName: Dusk Shroud chance gained per second

18.description: Explosive Trap deals additional throwing damage per stack of {Dusk Shroud} you have.

19.description: Explosive Trap costs less mana and it has increased throwing attack speed.
19.loreText: Jelkhor taught a select few students how to build small intricate explosive contraptions.

20.description:
Whenever one of your Explosive Traps detonate, your {Falcon} gains physical and elemental penetration for a short duration.

This effect can trigger up to a maximum of 15 times within 3 seconds.

21.description: Whenever one of your Explosive Traps detonate, your {Falcon's} skills recover a portion of their remaining cooldowns.

22.description:
Whenever you directly throw Explosive Trap, you now throw traps, up to your maximum number of traps, in a wide area around the target location.

Explosive Trap deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per maximum traps, but it now has a cooldown and costs more mana per maximum trap.
22.altText:
"Per maximum trap" bonuses do take your base 5 maximum traps into account, as well as ones added by nodes and items.

If Explosive Trap already has a cooldown, the highest cooldown is used.

23.description: You can now have more active Explosive Traps.

24.description: When you directly use Explosive Trap you throw additional traps, but Explosive Trap costs more mana.

25.description: Explosive Trap costs less mana, but deals less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a smaller area.

26.description:
You now shoot arrows attached with Explosive Traps up into the air that then drop down around the target location.

Explosive Trap now scales with your bow damage instead of throwing damage and your bow attack speed instead of throwing attack speed.

This requires wielding a bow.

27.description:
Explosive Traps now instantly detonate when the arrows hit the ground via the {Blast Rain} node, ignoring the arming time.

Additionally, Explosive Trap has a higher chance to stun enemies.

28.description: Whenever an Explosive Trap detonates, it has a chance to drop a fresh Explosive Trap at its location as long as there is an enemy within 6 meters, but Explosive Trap costs more mana.

29.description:
Explosive Trap has an additional chance to drop a fresh Explosive Trap via the {Trap Sprinkler} node, but Explosive Trap costs more mana.

Traps dropped this way cannot drop more additional traps.

30.description:
Whenever an Explosive Trap detonates, it now has a chance to create a {Ballista} for you.

This consumes mana equal to a portion of {Ballista's} mana cost.

31.description:
Explosive Traps dropped by the {Trap Sprinkler} node are now flung at a nearby enemy within 12 meters instead of being dropped.

Explosive Traps dropped by the {Trap Sprinkler} node can now drop Explosive Traps when there's an enemy within 12 meters even if there is not an enemy within 6 meters.

32.description:
When an Explosive Trap drops a trap by the {Trap Sprinkler} node, it also flings an {Acid Flask} for you towards the target location.

This consumes mana equal to a portion of Acid Flask's mana cost.

2.description: Your Armblade Slash, Dive and {Locust} hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

3.description:
When you create a {Locust Swarm} with Swarm Strike you consume all stacks of bleed from enemies hit by it, causing the {Swarm} to deal increased damage in a larger area per stack of bleed consumed.

The increased area scales up to a maximum.

stats.statName: Locust Swarm Increased Damage Per Bleed

4.description: Yours and your {Locusts'} hits have a chance to poison enemies.

5.description: You can control additional {Locusts} and your Hives contain additional {Locusts}.

6.description: Hives release {Locusts} more frequently and if you have an active {Locust Swarm} it also releases Locusts every second.
6.altText: A Locust Swarm does not lose damage or otherwise change as it releases locusts, but cannot release more Locusts than were originally gathered to create it.

stats.statName: Locusts per 3 seconds from Locust Swarm

7.description:
After using Summon Hive, Human Form is now replaced with {Cleanse Hives}, which releases all {Locusts} from up to 2 Hives, replaces them with {Healing Totems} and transforms you to {Spriggan Form}.

This requires you to have Spriggan Form unlocked.

8.description: When a {Hive} releases a {Locust} you regain health and {Rage}.

9.description: Your Armblade Slash can now hit your own Hives which causes them to release {Locusts}.

10.description:
The base damage of Swarm Strike, {Locust Swarm}, and Dive is converted to cold, and {Locusts'} base melee damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to physical damage. These attack all also gain a chance to freeze enemies.

Poison chance from all sources is converted to {Frostbite} chance while in Swarmblade Form.

Your {Locusts'} Poison chance from all sources is converted to {Frostbite} chance.

11.description: You and your {Locusts} have a higher chance of freezing enemies per point of Attunement.

12.description: Your Hives now cast {Thorns} as if they were {Thorn Totems}, rather than releasing {Locusts}. They can cast thorns a limited number of times equal to the number of Locusts they would have released.
12.altText: If you have the {Release the Horde} node, hitting a Hive will release thorns.

13.description: You and your {Locusts} have a higher chance to dodge and additional armor while in Swarmblade Form.

14.description:
You cast {Maelstrom} a number of times when you Dive. 

This consumes a portion of Maelstrom's mana cost as {Rage}.

15.description: You gain {Rage} when you dodge.

16.description: All of your dodge rating is converted to armor while in Swarmblade Form.

17.description: Your Swarm Strike, {Locust Swarm} and your {Locusts'} melee attacks all deal damage in a larger area.

18.description: Your {Locust Swarm} leeches a portion of the damage it deals as health to you.

20.description: {Locust Swarm} has more duration and Swarm Strike hits deal more damage (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

21.description:
After using Swarm Strike, Human Form is now replaced with {Angered Swarm}, which adds 4 seconds to the duration of your {Locust Swarm} and transforms you to {Werebear Form}.

This requires you to have Werebear Form unlocked.

22.description: A random active companion uses its active ability after you directly use Swarm Strike.

stats.statName: Random Companion Ability After Swarm Strike

23.description: Your {Locust Swarm} deals more damage per {Locust} consumed (multiplicative with other modifiers) and while the Locust Swarm is active you have additional chance to poison on hit per {Locust} consumed.

stats.statName: Poison Chance Per Locust While Swarm Active

24.description: You and your {Locusts} deal additional melee physical damage while in Swarmblade Form and your {Locust Swarm} deals additional melee physical damage per active {Locust} consumed when you use Swarm Strike.

stats.statName: Swarm Melee Physical Damage Per Locust

25.description: You and your {Locusts} have improved base critical strike chance while in Swarmblade Form.

26.description: You can only control half as many {Locusts}, but they have significantly more health, deal significantly more damage in a larger area (all multiplicative with other modifiers) and are larger.
26.altText: The maximum number of locusts is rounded up.

27.description: You regain {Rage} when you or your {Locusts} critically hit.

stats.statName: Rage Gain When You Or Locusts Crit

28.description:
Your {Serpent Strike} tree now applies to Armblade Slashes, and it does not require a spear.

This effect does not include the base additional poison chance or increased poison duration from Serpent Strike.

stats.statName: Serpent Strike Tree Affects Armblade Slashes

29.description: You regain health and {Rage} when you or your {Locusts} kill an enemy or when you hit a rare enemy or boss.

stats.statName: Health And Rage Gain On Kill
Health And Rage Gain On Boss or Rare Hit

30.description:
You gain a stack of {Howling Cascade} when you use Armblade Slash and hit at least one enemy. Reaching 6 stacks consumes them to cast {Tornado}.

This consumes Tornado's mana cost.

stats.statName: Gain Howling Cascade Stacks On Hit With Slash

31.description: Reduce the maximum stacks of {Howling Cascade} required to cast {Tornado}, and tornadoes cast via Howling Cascade deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

stats.statName: Howling Cascade Stacks To Proc Tornado

32.description: When you use Armblade Slashes you now summon a {Locust} instead of doing a melee attack.

34.description: You have increased attack and cast speed while in Swarmblade form.

35.description: {Locust Swarm} now scales with your minion damage rather than your damage.

36.description: Swarm Strike and Dive deal more damage and you regain {Rage} on hit with both skills.

stats.statName: Rage On Hit With Swarm Strike And Dive

2.description: Hail of Arrows deals damage in a larger area

3.description: You have a chance to gain a stack of {Dusk Shroud} each second for 2 seconds while inside the area, granting you glancing blow chance and dodge rating. This effect can stack.

4.description: Hail of Arrows now also grants a stack of {Dusk Shroud} to allies each second for 2 seconds while inside the area.

5.description: Hail of Arrows now also shoots a {Barrage of Arrows} on use dealing bow physical damage, but costs more mana. This does not scale with damage over time.

6.description: Improves {Barrage of Arrows'} base critical strike chance.

7.description: {Barrage of Arrows} immobilizes enemies for a short duration. Rare enemies and bosses are slowed instead.

8.description: Hail of Arrows has a chance to apply {Frailty} to enemies each second.

9.description: Hail of Arrows has a chance to shred enemy armor each second.

10.description: Hail of Arrows has a chance to inflict enemies with {Crit Vulnerability} each second.

11.description: Hail of Arrows deals more bow damage to ignited enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

12.description:
Hail of Arrows' base physical damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to ignite chance and effects related to bleed now depend on ignite instead.

Swaps Hail of Arrows' {Physical} tag for a {Fire} tag.

This has no effect if Hail of Arrows is converted to cold with {Crystal Arrows} or to poison with {Acid Rain}.

13.description: Hail of Arrows deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but in a smaller area (multiplicative with other modifiers).

14.description: Hail of Arrows leeches a portion of the bow damage it deals as health.

16.description: Hail of Arrows deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

17.description: Hail of Arrows costs less mana, but has a shorter duration (multiplicative with other modifiers).

18.description: You can store additional charges of Hail of Arrows, but it has a shorter duration (multiplicative with other modifiers).

19.description: Hail of Arrows costs less mana and has a shorter cooldown, but has a longer delay before the arrows fall.

20.description: Hail of Arrows has a chance to cause enemies to bleed each second.

21.description: Hail of Arrows deals more bow damage per stack of bleed on the enemy, up to a maximum. This does not affect ailment damage.

22.description: Hail of Arrows now fall in a forward advancing rectangle area rather than a circle.

23.description: Hail of Arrows has a chance to slow enemies each second.

24.description:
Hail of Arrows' base physical damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to physical damage. It also has a chance to freeze enemies each second.

All slow chance from this tree is converted to chill chance and effects related to slow now depend on chill instead.

Swaps Hail of Arrows' {Physical} tag for a {Cold} tag.

This has no effect if Hail of Arrows is converted to poison with {Acid Rain}.

25.description: Hail of Arrows has increased chance to freeze enemies each second and has increased chill duration.

26.description: Hail of Arrows lasts longer.

27.description: Hail of Arrows deals more bow damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) over its duration scaling up to a maximum. This does not affect damaging ailments.

28.description:
Hail of Arrows lasts significantly longer (multiplicative with other modifiers), but you can only have one Hail of Arrows active at a time. 

Using Hail of Arrows again causes the old instance to stop.

29.description:
Hail of Arrows is now channeled and can be retargeted while you are channelling. It costs less initial mana, but rapidly drains your mana.

Channelled Hail of Arrows' delay is halved, and increases to its delay are halved.

30.description:
Hail of Arrows' base physical damage is converted to poison. Consequently this damage scales with increases to poison damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Swaps Hail of Arrows' {Physical} tag for a {Poison} tag.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to poison chance.
30.altText: {Barrage of Arrows} is not converted to poison.

31.description: Hail of Arrows has a chance to poison enemies each second.

32.description: Hail of Arrows deals more bow damage to stunned enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers). This does not affect ailment damage.

0.description: Rips blood out of a target enemy dealing physical damage to it. A {Blood Orb} is drawn back to you which restores 10 health when it reaches you.
0.loreText: The life blood of your foes need not be wasted

2.description: Rip Blood hits have a chance to create a {Blood Splatter} at the target, dealing damage to other enemies around it that were not hit by Rip Blood. This effect can occur a limited number of times per cast of Rip Blood.
2.altText:
An enemy cannot be hit by both Rip Blood and Blood Splatter, and cannot be hit by multiple Blood Splatters from a single cast.

Nodes on this tree do not apply to {Blood Splatter} unless stated otherwise.

Hitting or killing an enemy with {Blood Splatter} does not count as hitting or killing an enemy with Rip Blood.

3.description: When you directly cast Rip Blood and hit a boss or rare enemy it attaches a {Blood Tether}, dealing physical spell damage over time.
3.altText:
You can have an unlimited amount of Blood Tethers, but no more than 1 Blood Tether on a single enemy.

If converted to necrotic, Blood Tether's baseline more damage per stack of bleed will change to more damage per stack of damned.

stats.statName: Blood Tether on Boss or Rare

4.description: {Blood Splatter} deals damage in a larger area.

5.description: Rip Blood deals more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

6.description:
When a blood orb grants health, you gain a stack of {Coagulated Blood}. Upon reaching at least 6 stacks, your next cast of Rip Blood consumes 6 stacks to form a {Coagulated Blood Orb} that seeks out a nearby enemy, dealing spell physical damage in a small area.

Additionally, Blood Tethers such as from {Blood Bond} grant 3 stacks each second.
6.altText: This node has no effect if Rip Blood grants ward instead of health.

8.description: The {Coagulated Blood Orb} deals more damage in a larger area (multiplicative with other modifiers).

10.description: Rip Blood hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed..

12.description: {Blood Splatter} grants your minions {Blood Infusion} when it hits them. The {Blood Infusion} buff grants 15% more damage for 4 seconds (multiplicative with other modifiers).

13.description: Blood Splatter has increased area for each minion you currently control, up to a maximum benefit.

14.description: {Blood Infusion} grants increased attack and cast speed.
14.altText: {Blood Infusion} grants 15% more damage for 4 seconds (multiplicative with other modifiers).

15.description: {Blood Infusion} causes your minions to leech a portion of the physical damage they deal as health.
15.altText: {Blood Infusion} grants 15% more damage for 4 seconds (multiplicative with other modifiers).

16.description: Rip Blood has increased cast speed.

17.description: Rip Blood costs less mana and has increased cast speed.

18.description: When you are out of mana Rip Blood is free.

19.description: {Blood Orbs} grant additional health and the {Blood Orb} returns faster.

20.description: {Blood Orbs} restore more health based on your Intelligence stat.

21.description: {Blood Orbs} now also grant you mana when you directly cast Rip Blood. The amount of mana is tripled for orbs from bosses and rare enemies.

stats.statName: Tripled Against Bosses and Rare Enemies

22.description: Rip Blood can be cast on your minions, but no longer can be cast on enemies. {Blood Orbs} restore significantly more health.

23.description: Rip Blood has additional critical strike chance..

24.description: When you directly use Rip Blood and hit a boss or rare enemy or hit at least 3 enemies, you cast Marrow Shards in the same direction.

stats.statName: Marrow Shards on Boss, Rare, or Multi Hit

26.description: When you directly cast Rip Blood and hit at least one enemy you gain additional spell damage for 6 seconds. The amount of spell damage gained is doubled for Rip Blood. This effect can stack.

27.description: Rip Blood deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

28.description: Rip Blood deals more damage for each minion you currently control (multiplicative with other modifiers), up to a maximum benefit.

29.description:
When you directly cast Rip Blood and it kills at least one enemy, it will recast from that position towards another enemy, consuming Rip Blood's mana cost. These recasts can also trigger this effect.

Rip Blood no longer creates {Blood Orbs}.

stats.statName: Percent of Rip Blood Mana Cost Consumed

30.description:
Rip Blood and {Blood Splatter's} base physical damage are converted to necrotic damage. Consequently this damage scales with increases to necrotic damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to Damned chance.

31.description:
{Blood Orbs} now grant ward instead of health, equal to half of the health they would have restored.

Being at or close to full health does not affect the amount of the ward the {Blood Orbs} grant.
31.altText: This ward gain is not affected by healing effectiveness.

32.description: Rip Blood has increased cast speed leaves a stench on the target enemy that causes your minions to prioritise attacking it.

0.description: Apply a curse to enemies in an area that causes spell physical damage when hit.

1.description: Bone Curse deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

2.description:
Bone Curse deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and instantly kills enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health).

If you have a similar effect from an item or passive node then the highest threshold is used.

3.description: Enemies afflicted with Bone Curse have a chance to explode on death, dealing damage to nearby enemies, but Bone Curse costs more mana.

4.description: Killing an enemy with Bone Curse has a chance to summon a Skeleton Vanguard, a minion that deals melee physical damage using a spear. You are limited to 3 Skeleton Vanguards by default.

5.description: Shortly after casting Bone Curse, it causes a {Bone Eruption} beneath the target area, causing enemies to take spell physical damage, but Bone Curse Costs more mana.

6.description: Bone Curse deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but falls off after a few hits.

7.description:
Bone Curse becomes a toggled aura which surrounds you, but it has reduced area and drains your mana over time. You are also inflicted with Bone Curse.

This is not compatible with the {Oppressive Gaze} and {Illusion of Pain} nodes.
7.altText: Modifiers to Bone Curse's mana efficiency affect its mana drain.

8.description:
Bone Curse falls off after only 1 hit, but it always crits and deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). Bone Curse now has a cooldown.

This is not compatible with the {Signet of Agony} node.
The duration of {Cursed Limbs} and {Cursed Ground} are significantly reduced.

stats.statName: Cursed Limbs and Cursed Ground duration

9.description: Bone Curse has a chance to reduce enemy armor.

10.description: If you kill an enemy affected by Bone Curse you have a chance to gain {Bone Armor} for 4 seconds, which grants less damage taken (multiplicative with other modifiers).

11.description:
When {Marrow Thief} triggers you are also healed. 

The healing scales with healing effectiveness.

12.description: Bone Curse has a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

13.description: When Bone Curse times out, you cast {Rip Blood} on that enemy, a spell dealing physical damage. This effect can occur a limited number of times per second.
13.altText: Rip Blood cast this way cannot apply Bone Curse, even if you have the {Cursed Limbs} node.

stats.statName: Rip Blood On Bone Curse Time Out

14.description: When you cast Bone Curse, it now also leaves behind {Cursed Ground} for a short duration. Enemies that walk into the Cursed Ground are afflicted with Bone Curse.

15.description: Bone Curse affects a larger area.

16.description:
When you directly cast Bone Curse you summon a {Bone Prison} around the target area, trapping enemies inside. Bone Prison lasts a long time, but can be attacked and destroyed.

Bone Curse has a significantly longer cooldown.

17.description: Bone Curse has a significantly shorter cooldown, but {Bone Prison} now has gaps.

18.description: Your {Bone Prison} takes less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

19.description:
Bone Curse applies {Mark for Death} for 2 seconds, but costs more mana.

This effect overwrites {Mark for Death's} normal duration.
19.altText: If you have {Signet of Agony}, this mana cost is added to its mana drain.

20.description: {Mark for Death} lasts longer.

21.description: Bone Curse's base physical damage is converted to necrotic. Consequently this damage scales with increases to necrotic damage, but not increases to physical damage.

22.description:
Bone Curse deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but now only affects a single target. Bone Curse and Mark for Death have unlimited duration.

This is not compatible with the {Signet of Agony} node.

23.description: Bone Curse slows enemies within its area of effect

24.description: Bone Curse deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but lingers for a shorter duration on enemies if not reapplied. The duration reduction only applies to Bone Curse applied by the aura.
24.altText: Does not affect the duration of Bone Curse on minions.

25.description: Bone Curse costs less mana and has increased cast speed.

26.description: Bone Curse has a chance to apply chill when the enemy is hit.

27.description: Adds a freeze rate to Bone Curse, granting it a chance to freeze enemies.

28.description:
You may cast Bone Curse on your minions, which grants them more physical damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but also applies Bone Curse's negative effects. 

This effect lasts 4 seconds and does not stack.

29.description:
Casting Bone Curse on minions causes them to reflect a flat amount damage to attackers. 

This effect lasts 4 seconds and does not stack.

30.description: All minion buffs from Bone Curse have 200% increased effect on Bone Golems.

31.description:
After directly casting Bone Curse, you also cast Bone Curse on hit for the next few seconds, but Bone Curse costs more mana.
This cast on hit effect can't occur more than once per second.
31.altText: Bone Curse cast this way does not consume mana, but can not grant Cursed Limbs.

stats.statName: Bone Curse On Hit After Direct Cast

1.description: The {Glyph} explosion deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of slow on the target.

2.description: Glyph of Dominion deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and costs less mana.

3.description: You can now place down up to two Glyphs of Dominion, but Glyph of Dominion costs more mana. When the first {Glyph} explodes the second one does too. The second explosion deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) the further it is from the first one up to a maximum.

stats.statName: Second Glyph Damage Per 1 Meter Distance

4.description: Glyph of Dominion expands slower and lasts a longer (both multiplicative with other modifiers). This increases the time before it reaches its full size to detonate.

5.description: Glyph of Dominion expands faster and lasts a shorter duration (both multiplicative with other modifiers). This decreases the time before it reaches its full size to detonate.

6.description: Glyph of Dominion expands faster and lasts a shorter duration (both multiplicative with other modifiers) per amount of missing mana. This decreases the time before it reaches its full size to detonate.
6.altText: This effect also takes missing mana into account. For example if you are at -100 mana and have 200 maximum mana, you will gain 100% more expansion speed, which will cause it to fully expand and detonate in half the normal time.

stats.statName: More Expansion Speed Per 3 Missing Mana

7.description: After Glyph of Dominion its full size it now has a short delay before it detonates.

8.description: Glyph of Dominion now has a cooldown, which is refreshed whenever you directly cast {Runic Invocation}. It also deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per rune from {Runic Invocation}, without consuming them.

9.description:
Glyph of Dominion now consumes the {Runes} from {Runic Invocation} on cast to gain additional effects per {Rune} you have. 

{Rah Rune}: Glyph deals more damage in a larger area per {Rune} of this type.
{Gon Rune}: Glyph detonates additional times during the delay per {Rune} of this type.
{Heo Rune}: Glyph inflicts stacks of Frostbite per second per {Rune} of this type.

stats.statName: Frostbite Stacks Per Second Per Heo Rune

10.description: Glyph of Dominion has additional charges and all charges are refreshed whenever you directly cast {Runic Invocation}.

11.description: You cast {Elemental Nova} in the middle of the {Glyph} if you stand inside it when the delay from {Doom Scribe} starts and you gain stacks of {Fire Aura}.

stats.statName: Cast Elemental Nova When Delay Starts

12.description: Glyph of Dominion's damage over time part deals more damage for each second it is active (multiplicative with other modifiers).

13.description: While standing on your {Glyph} you and your allies deal more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of Armor Shred on the enemy, up to a maximum of 14 stacks.

stats.statName: Damage Over Time Per Armor Shred

14.description: Glyph of Dominion deals more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

15.description: {Disintegrate} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and grants you ward per second if you start channelling it while standing on your {Glyph}.

stats.statName: Disintegrate Grants Ward Gain Per Second

16.description: Glyph of Dominion deals damage in a larger area.

17.description: Glyph of Dominion is now cast at your current location and it grants you and your allies ward per second per your uncapped resistance while standing on your {Glyph}.

stats.statName: Ward Per Second Per 5% Uncapped Resistances

18.description: You and your allies gain additional resistances while standing on your {Glyph}.

19.description: After casting Glyph of Dominion you gain {Static Charges} at an accelerating rate while standing still, until your {Glyph} detonates.

20.description:
Whenever you or your allies enters your Glyph of Dominion it cleanses ailments and grants the {Haste} buff for a short duration.

Leaving and re-entering the same {Glyph} does not cause this effect to trigger again.

21.description: You and your allies gain additional Shock chance while standing on your {Glyph}.

22.description: Normal and Magic enemies have a chance to be stunned every half second while on your {Glyph}.

stats.statName: Stun Chance On Glyph Every 0.5 Seconds

23.description: Your {Lightning Blast} now chains while you are standing on your {Glyph}, but consumes mana when cast this way while you are at positive mana.
23.altText:
If {Lightning Blast} already chains, then this effect adds additional chains.

If {Lightning Blast} is channelled, then instead of adding mana consumption it is added to the channel cost.

stats.statName: Lightning Blast Additional Chains on Glyph

24.description: You and your allies gain increased area to spells and attacks while standing on your {Glyph}.

stats.statName: Spells and Attacks Area on Glyph

25.description:
{Glyph of Dominion's} base lightning damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to lightning damage.

Shock chance from all sources is converted to ignite for Glyph of Dominion and effects related to shock now depend on ignite instead.

Swaps {Glyph of Dominion's} {Lightning} tag for a {Fire} tag.

Ignite chance is halved for minions and other allies.

26.description: Glyph of Dominion ignites enemies on the {Glyph} every half second.

27.description: The ignite frequency from {Burning Symbol} is increased by your chance to ignite.

stats.statName: Increased Ignite Frequency Per Ignite Chance

0.loreText: Any bones, any marrow, can be your tools, even your own.

2.description: Marrow Shards deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but no longer pierces.

3.description: You leech a portion of physical damage as health if you have cast Marrow Shards recently (past 4 seconds).

4.description: Marrow Shards creates {Bone Splinters} in a cone behind the enemy when destroyed, damaging other enemies, but Marrow Shards no longer pierces and costs more health.
4.altText: {Bone Splinters} are a subskill of Marrow Shards and therefore are affected by all nodes in Marrow Shards's tree.

5.description: {Bone Splinters} deal more damage.

6.description: {Bone Splinters} travel faster and further.
6.altText: {Bone Splinters} scale with increases to physical damage and spell damage, but not with other nodes on this tree unless stated otherwise.

7.description: {Bone Splinters} have a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

8.description: {Bone Splinters} hits deal more hit damage against bleeding enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

9.description: {Bone Splinters} have additional critical strike chance.

10.description: {Bone Splinters} have additional critical strike multiplier.

11.description: Marrow Shards deals more damage, but its range is reduced.

12.description: Marrow Shards has additional critical strike chance and critical strike multiplier.

13.description: Marrow Shards has additional critical strike multiplier.

14.description: Marrow Shards has additional critical strike multiplier, but you lose health when you critically strike with Marrow Shards.

16.description: Marrow Shards creates {Bone Splinters} in a cone when destroyed, which damage enemies, but Marrow Shards travels less far and costs more health.
16.altText: {Bone Splinters} are a subskill of Marrow Shards and therefore are affected by all nodes in Marrow Shards's tree.

17.description:
Marrow Shards are now instantly destroyed, creating a {Splinter Nova} around you instead of {Bone Splinters}. Splinter Nova hits all enemies in an area around you.
Splinter Nova is affected by all modifiers to Marrow Shards and Bone Splinters. Modifiers to the projectile speed of Bone Splinters grant increased area for Splinter Nova.

18.description:
When you directly cast Marrow Shards, you have a chance to immediately cast a second instance of Marrow Shards.

Indirect casts of Marrow Shards, such as from this effect, do not cost health.

19.description: Marrow Shards hits have a chance to shred enemy armor.

20.description:
Marrow Shards deals more damage, but Marrow Shards can hit and damage your own minions. 

On hit effects, such as health gained on hit, do not proc when you hit your minions.

21.description: You gain health when you kill one of your own minions.

22.description: Grants you increased critical strike chance if you have killed with Marrow Shards recently (past 4 seconds).

23.description: You leech a portion of physical damage as life if you have killed with Marrow Shards recently (past 4 seconds).

24.description: Marrow Shards has a chance to cause enemies to bleed, but costs more health.

25.description: Marrow Shards deals significantly more damage, but consumes one of your minions when you cast it.
25.altText: The damage bonus is only gained if a minion is consumed.

26.description: Marrow Shards has a chance to create a {Marrow Orb} on hit that returns 15 health to you. This effect can occur a limited number of times per second.
26.altText: {Marrow Orbs} are a bloody projectile which restores health upon returning to you.

27.description: {Marrow Orbs} return more health.
27.altText: {Marrow Orbs} are a bloody projectile which restores health upon returning to you.

28.description: Marrow Shards hits have a higher chance to create a {Marrow Orb}.
28.altText: {Marrow Orbs} are a bloody projectile which restores health upon returning to you.

29.description: {Marrow Orbs} also replenish mana.
29.altText: {Marrow Orbs} are a bloody projectile which restores health upon returning to you.

30.description: Marrow Shards deals more hit damage against bleeding enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

32.description:
Marrow Shards's base physical damage is converted to cold damage. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not to physical damage. It also gains a base freeze rate.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to frostbite chance.

Swaps Marrow Shards's physical tag for a cold tag.

34.description: The second cast of Marrow Shards from {Ossumancy} will target a random enemy within 15 meters.

0.loreText: As they sow, so shall they reap.

2.description: You have increased health regeneration while channelling Rebuke.

3.description: Rebuke has a shorter cooldown, but costs more mana.

4.description: You take less elemental damage while channelling Rebuke (multiplicative with other modifiers).

5.description: You have more armor (multiplicative with other modifiers) while channelling Rebuke.

6.description: Rebuke's maximum duration is increased, allowing you to absorb more damage.

7.description: After you finish channelling Rebuke you gain the {Haste} buff, attack speed, and cast speed for a duration equal to half the duration you channelled Rebuke for.

8.description: You heal yourself and nearby allies each second while channelling Rebuke.

9.description: Buffs via the {Burst of Speed} and {Protective Legacy} nodes last longer after you finish channelling Rebuke.

10.description: You have increased mana regeneration while channelling Rebuke.

11.description: Rebuke hits deal more damage, and Rebuke hits in a larger area.

12.description: While channelling Rebuke, you have a chance to apply {Spreading Flames} to nearby enemies each second.
12.altText: This chance is rolled individually for each nearby enemy.

13.description: You have a chance to ignite nearby enemies each second while channelling Rebuke.

14.description: You have a chance to reduce nearby enemy armor each second while channelling Rebuke.

15.description: Ignite, armor shred, and spreading flames applied to enemies while channelling Rebuke last longer.

16.description: Rebuke hits deal additional base void damage.

17.description: Rebuke hits have a chance to grant you a {Void Essence}.

18.description: Rebuke has an increased maximum duration, allowing you to absorb more damage, but has a longer cooldown.

19.description: While channeling Rebuke the healing from the {Redemption} node increases each second.

20.description: Healing via the {Redemption} node now also scales with your attunement.

stats.statName: Increased Healing Per Point Of Attunement

21.description: The buffs you are granted via the {Augmented Plating} and {Brave the Elements} nodes now persist after you finish channelling Rebuke. Their duration is equal to half the duration you channelled Rebuke for.

22.description: Regenerate mana when you are hit while channelling Rebuke.

24.description:
You reduce a portion of Rebuke's remaining cooldown when you use a different melee attack and hit at least one enemy.

This effect can only occur a limited number of times per use of Rebuke, and the effect is doubled while wielding a two handed weapon.

25.description: Rebuke now has an additonal charge.

0.loreText: Swirling through the air, these hammers would be elegant were it not for the blood and broken bones they left behind them.

2.description: Hammer Throw has increased attack speed.

3.description: Hammer Throw deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but hammers travels slower.

4.description:
Hammer Throw can no longer spiral, chain, or orbit.

If your hammers would spiral, they instead deal significantly more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

If your hammers would chain, they instead deal more critical damage for each time they would chain.

If your hammers would orbit you, they instead have additional base critical strike chance.

Hammer Throw hits deal increased damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

5.description: When you are out of mana Hammer Throw is free.

6.description: Hammer Throw hits have a chance to reduce enemy armor.

7.description: Your hammers gain a {Disintegrating Aura}, causing enemies nearby them to take void damage over time, but Hammer Throw costs additional mana and has less attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).
7.altText:
{Disintegrating Aura} scales with your increases to void damage, damage over time, and throwing attack damage, but not with other nodes on this tree unless specifically stated otherwise. Its area scales with Increased Area for Area skill stats.

Added damage applies to Disintegrating Aura at 200% effectiveness per second.

8.description: {Disintegrating Aura} deals more damage, and Hammer Throw costs less mana.

9.description: Hammer Throw deals more damage, and has a higher chance to stun enemies.

10.description: Hammer Throw deals more damage, but Hammer Throw hits no longer pierce (travel through enemies hit). Its hits have a higher chance to stun enemies, and the stuns they inflict last longer.

11.description: Hammers chain to nearby enemies instead of returning to you. Hammer Throw can no longer throw extra projectiles, but it gains more damage and more attack speed (both multiplicative with other modifiers) for each extra projectile you would have thrown.
11.altText: This benefit is unaffected by modifiers which halve or double extra projectiles.

12.description: Hammers chain to additional enemies.

13.description: Hammer Throw deals more hit damage against stunned enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers) and the stuns they inflict last longer

14.description: Hammer Throw has a chance to grant you health on hit.

15.description: Hammer Throw rips a {Dark Orb} from enemies on hit, which travels back to you and grants 6 health and mana. Hammer Throw has a 5 second cooldown.

16.description: Hammers travel faster.

17.description: Hammer Throw hits have a chance to deal double damage, but hammers no longer return to you.

18.description:
Hammer Throw launches additional hammers, but Hammer Throw costs more mana.

Hammers from the same throw cannot hit the same enemy, unless they spiral.

19.description: Hammers are now thrown in a nova, with double the amount of additional hammers unless your hammers spiral. Hammer Throw hits deal additional throwing physical damage.

20.description: Hammers now travel in a spiral around you, but halves your amount of additional hammers and Hammer Throw costs more mana.
20.altText: Modifiers to projectile speed only affect the tangential velocity of spiralling hammers, not their radial velocity (i.e. they change the speed the hammers go around you, but not the speed at which they travel outwards).

21.description: Your spiralling hammers now orbit you, but Hammer Throw costs more mana.

22.description: Hammer Throw deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and costs less mana.

23.description: Hammer Throw hits have a higher chance to deal double damage.

24.description: Using Hammer Throw grants you a stack of {Zeal} for 4 seconds, which increases your damage and critical strike chance by 10% per stack.
24.altText: Buffs granted by {Zeal} are global. You can have a maximum of 3 stacks of {Zeal}.

stats.statName: Global Increased Damage Per Zeal Stack
Global Increased Crit Chance Per Zeal Stack

25.description: Each stack of {Zeal} also grants you added global ignite chance.

stats.statName: Global Ignite Chance Per Zeal Stack

2.description: {Vines} deal more damage and have more health (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

3.description: You now have a chance to summon a new Vine next to a nearby enemy when a {Vine} dies. Vines have increased attack and cast speed.

stats.statName: Summon Vine Chance On Vine Death

4.description:
After using Summon Vine, Human Form is now replaced with {Infestation}, which converts your 2 nearest {Vines} into {Hives} and transforms you to {Swarmblade Form}.

This requires you to have Swarmblade Form unlocked.

5.description:
Your {Vines} have a chance to grant you {Rage} on hit. Melee hits have a higher chance to grant Rage than spell hits.

If you have the {Great Vine} node the rage gained is 200% higher.

stats.statName: Chance to Gain Rage on Vine Melee Hit
Chance to Gain Rage on Vine Spell Hit

6.description:
You can now only summon 1 {Vine} at a time up to a maximum of 6, but they have significantly more health, size, threat generation and their melee attacks deal significantly more damage in a larger area (all multiplicative with other modifiers).

Indirect casts only create a vine on every third cast.

7.description: You now have a chance to also cast Thorn Shield on the nearest {Vine} when you cast Thorn Shield. Other allies with Thorn Shield deal global increased physical damage and have a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

stats.statName: Chance To Cast Thorn Shield On Nearest Vine

8.description: {Thorn Burst} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

9.description: {Thorn Burst} and Spirit Thorn hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

10.description: You now also have a chance to cast {Maelstrom} when you directly cast Thorn Shield.

stats.statName: Chance To Cast Maelstrom On Thorn Shield

11.description: You have additional armor and increased armor while in Spriggan Form.

12.description: Thorn Shield lasts longer.

13.description: Thorn Shield grants additional armor and increased armor.

14.description: Thorn Shield can now only target you and can no longer attach to other allies.
14.altText: This doesn't affect the Thorn Shield cast on other allies from the {Voice of the Thicket} node in the {Werebear} skill tree.

stats.statName: Thorn Shield Can Only Target You

15.description: Thorn Shield has a chance to recast itself on the same target when it expires.

16.description: Thorn Shield reflects additional flat damage to attackers.

17.description:
After directly casting Thorn Shield, Human Form is now replaced with {Bark Skin}, which adds 4 seconds to the duration of every Thorn Shield on you and transforms you to {Werebear Form}.

This requires you to have Werebear Form unlocked.

18.description: You gain ward equal to your armor when you enter Spriggan Form.

19.description:
You summon an additional {Spriggan} when you enter Spriggan Form which doesn't count towards your Spriggan limit, but does count towards your companion limit.

You will not summon an additional Spriggan if you are already at your maximum companion limit.
19.altText: Spriggan summoned this way disappears when you exit Spriggan Form.

20.description: Your {Healing Totems} have more health and duration (both multiplicative with other modifiers) and you have increased summoning speed while in Spriggan Form.

21.description: Healing Totems directly cast from this tree now also shoot thorns. {Thorn Totem's} skill tree, mana cost, cooldown and totem limit also apply to Healing Totems.

stats.statName: Thorn Totem Tree Benefits Healing Totems

22.description: You now always summon 3 Healing Totems and you can have additional maximum Healing Totems.

23.description: Healing Totems have increased healing effectiveness.

24.description: Healing Totems are converted to Fury Totems and now restore {Rage} instead of healing, but can only affect you.
24.altText: This effect is affected by increased healing effectiveness.

25.description: You now have a chance to cast Spirit Thorns from each of your Healing Totems when you directly cast Spirit Thorns.

26.description: Spirit Thorns and Thorn Shield deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

27.description: You gain {Rage} and ward when you directly cast Spirit Thorns and hit at least 1 enemy.

28.description: Spirit Thorns has a chance to pierce enemies (continue through targets they hit) and they penetrate enemy physical and cold resistance.

stats.statName: Spirit Thorns Physical And Cold Penetration

29.description: You now summon a {Vale Spirit} every 5 direct casts with Spirit Thorns, up to a maximum.

stats.statName: Vale Spirit Every 5 Spirit Thorn Casts

30.description: Your Healing Totems have a chance to summon a {Vale Spirit} when they die.

stats.statName: Vale Spirit Chance On Healing Totem Death

31.description:
When you directly cast Spirit Thorns while at maximum Vale Spirits, you consume them to cast {Entangling Roots} at the target area and you regain {Rage}, which deals more damage when cast this way (multiplicative with other modifiers).

This consumes Entangling Roots' mana cost.

stats.statName: Cast Entangling Roots With Spirit Thorns

32.description: You have a chance to cast {Maelstrom} on you when you directly cast Spirit Thorns.

33.description: Your hits have a chance to poison enemies while in Spriggan Form and your Vines have a chance to poison enemies.

34.description:
Spirit Thorns, Summon Vines and Thorn Shield's base physical damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to physical damage. They also have a chance to freeze enemies.

Poison chance from all sources, for all three skills, is converted to {Frostbite} and effects related to poison now depend on Frostbite instead.

35.description: Your {Vines} now cast thorns from range, instead of using a melee attack. This is affected by nodes on this tree that affects Spirit Thorns, but they only fire 1 projectile and {Great Vine} fires 3 projectiles.

stats.statName: Melee Attack -> Ranged Thorns For Vines

0.loreText: Searching for a new soul.

1.description: Skeletal Mages deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

2.description: Skeletal Mages can cast {Profane Oblation} on your melee Wraiths and Blood Spectres, sacrificing them to deal necrotic damage to surrounding enemies.
2.altText: Skeletal Mages will not sacrifice Putrid Wraiths or Flame Wraiths.

3.description: Skeletal Mages can cast {Profane Oblation} on your Skeleton Warriors, Skeleton Rogues, and Skeleton Vanguards, sacrificing them to deal necrotic damage to surrounding enemies.

4.description:
Adds {Cryomancers} to the pool of Skeletal Mages that can be summoned. Cryomancers deal cold damage and cast {Ice Shard}.

All poison chance gained from this tree is converted to chill chance for Cryomancers.
4.altText: Cyromancers count as Skeletal Mages and receive all of the bonuses they do.

5.description: Removes regular Skeletal Mages and Pyromancers from the pool of Skeletal Mages that can be summoned, and your Skeletal Mages deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

6.description: Skeletal Mages have an increased chance to stun enemies and an increased freeze rate.

7.description: Skeletal Mage hits have a chance to poison enemies.

8.description: Skeletal Mages have a chance to gain {Frenzy} for 3 seconds when they hit an enemy.

9.description:
Adds Pyromancers to the summon pool of Skeletal Mages that can be summoned. Pyromancers deal fire damage and cast {Fireball}.
 
All poison chance gained from this tree is converted to ignite chance for Pyromancers.
9.altText: Pyromancers count as Skeletal Mages and receive all of the bonuses they do.

10.description: Your Skeletal Mages have more health (multiplicative with other modifiers) and increased attack and cast speed, but regular Skeletal Mages are removed from the summon pool of Skeletal Mages.

11.description: Ignites and poisons inflicted by Skeletal Mages last longer and have additional Penetration.

12.description: Improves Skeletal Mages' base critical strike chance and they move faster.

13.description: Skeletal Mages' critical strikes deal more damage, and when they critically strike they are healed for a percentage of their maximum health.

14.description: You can summon more Skeletal Mages.

15.description: Skeletal Mages leech a portion of the damage they deal as health and have more maximum health (multiplicative with other modifiers).

16.description: Adds Death Knights to the summon pool of Skeletal Mages, which uses melee necrotic attacks, and removes all other types of Skeletal Mages from the pool.
16.altText:
Death Knights count as Skeletal Mages and receive all of the bonuses they do.

The area of the Death Knights' melee attacks is affected by Increased Area for Minion Area Skills stats.

17.description: Death Knight melee hits deal additional fire damage.

18.description: Death Knights cast {Hungering Souls}, using your Hungering Souls tree. Hungering Souls has a 6 second cooldown when cast by Death Knights.
18.altText: Effects within Hungering Souls's tree that are based on minion counts or mana still apply and are based on your minion counts or mana.

19.description: Skeletal Mages cast {Necrotic Mortar}, a ranged necrotic spell with a large area of effect. Necrotic Mortar has a 6 second cooldown.
19.altText: The area of the mortar is affected by Increased Area for Minion Area Skills stats.

20.description: Skeletal Mages are able to use their abilities more frequently.

21.description:
Skeletal Mages have a chance to fire 2 additional projectiles. 

Skeletal Mages have an increased area of effect with melee attacks.
21.altText: This can also affect {Hungering Souls} cast by Death Knights.

22.description: You can only summon one Skeletal Mage, an Archmage, that has significantly more maximum health and damage (both multiplicative with other modifiers), fires twice the number of extra projectiles, and is larger.
22.altText:
The Archmage can be any type of Skeletal Mage or Death Knight.

The modifiers to damage and health are multiplicative with other modifiers.

23.description: Skeletal Mages attack and cast faster (multiplicative with other modifiers).

24.description: Skeletal Mages' gain ward over time and have a chance to avoid critical strikes.

26.description: Skeletal Mages deal more damage based on your maximum mana.

27.description: When you directly cast Summon Skeletal Mage you are teleported to the target location. Summon Skeletal Mage now has a cooldown and counts as {Traversal} skill.
27.altText: Using a Traversal skill puts all other traversal skills on cooldown and traversal skills' cooldowns do not recover while you are using a traversal skill.

28.description: When you teleport using Summon Skeletal Mage some of your other minions are teleported with you.
28.altText: Immobile minions cannot be teleported.

0.loreText: Those who have seen past the darkness have been driven to madness or death.

2.description: Black Hole deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but Black Hole pulls enemies towards it slower.

3.description: Black Hole has a chance to chill enemies within its area of effect each second.

4.description:
Black Hole’s base cold damage is converted to fire damage. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to cold damage.

Black Hole lasts much longer, but no longer pulls enemies.

5.description: Black Hole’s damage over time penetrates enemy fire resistance.

6.description: Black Hole has a chance to ignite enemies within its area of effect each second based on your uncapped fire resistance.
6.altText: This scales off of uncapped fire resistance, so gaining more fire resistance above the normal 75% cap will continue to increase its effect. For example at 100% fire resistance, one point in this node grants 200% chance to ignite per second.

stats.statName: Ignite Chance Per Second Per 1% Uncapped Fire Res

7.description: Black Hole deals more fire damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

8.description: Black Hole grants you ward each second.

9.description:
Black Hole becomes two stars which orbit each other. One deals fire damage and the other deals cold damage. 

Black Hole deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

10.description: Black Hole deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

11.description: Black Hole deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but has reduced cast speed.

12.description: Black Hole will {Collapse} at the end of its duration, an explosion which deals cold hit damage and knocks enemies back.

13.description: Black Hole will {Collapse} each second while it exists, but it deals less damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

14.description: The explosions created by the {Collapse} and {Pulsar} nodes have an increased chance to freeze enemies.

15.description: Black Hole has increased duration and a chance to blind enemies within its area of effect each second.

16.description: Black Hole has a chance to create another Black Hole once it expires.
16.altText: The second Black Hole cannot create another.

17.description: Black Hole's cooldown is reduced and it costs less mana, but pulls enemies towards it slower and pulls enemies within a lesser area (both multiplicative with other modifiers).
17.altText: Modifiers to the pull area do not affect the damage area.

18.description: Black Hole pulls enemies toward it faster and from within an increased area.

20.description: Black Hole moves toward the nearest enemy that is not within its damaging area.

21.description: Black Hole moves faster toward the nearest enemy.

22.description: Black Hole’s center hits enemies, dealing spell physical damage.

23.description: Black Hole deals more damage to rare enemies and bosses (multiplicative with other modifiers), and it prioritises moving towards rare enemies and bosses.

24.description: Black Hole lasts longer.

25.description: Black Hole lasts longer, but has a longer cooldown.

26.description: A second Black Hole is created 10 meters away in a random direction from the first Black Hole.

27.description: Black Hole deals more damage to enemies within 1 meter of its center.
27.altText: This effect is multiplicative with other modifiers and does not affect ailments applied by Black Hole.

28.description: Black Hole deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but only 1 Black Hole can be created at a time.

29.description: Black Hole casts {Meteor} every second, but consumes Meteor's mana cost every second.
29.altText: Will only cast Meteor while above 0 mana.

30.description: You can store an additional charge of Black Hole.

0.loreText: The power of ice can be unexpectedly explosive

2.description: Each of Glacier’s explosions has a chance to chill enemies.

3.description: Glacier’s smallest explosion deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

4.description: Glacier’s middle-sized explosion deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

5.description: Glacier’s largest explosion deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

6.description: Glacier’s smallest explosion has a chance to chill enemies.

7.description: Glacier’s middle-sized explosion deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a chance to chill enemies.

8.description: Glacier’s largest explosion deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a chance to chill enemies.

9.description: Glacier’s smallest explosion has a chance to create an {Ice Vortex}, which lasts for 4 seconds and deals spell cold damage over time.
9.altText: {Ice Vortex} scales with increased to cold damage, damage over time, and spell damage, but not with other nodes on this tree.

10.description: Glacier’s middle-sized explosion has a greater chance to create an {Ice Vortex}, and the {Rime} buff has increased duration.
10.altText: {Ice Vortex} scales with increased to cold damage, damage over time, and spell damage, but not with other nodes on this tree.

11.description: Glacier’s largest explosion has a greater chance to create an {Ice Vortex}, and the {Rime} buff has increased effect.
11.altText: {Ice Vortex} scales with increased to cold damage, damage over time, and spell damage, but not with other nodes on this tree.

12.description: Each of Glacier’s explosions has a chance to create an {Ice Vortex}, which lasts for 4 seconds and deals spell cold damage over time.
12.altText: {Ice Vortex} scales with increased to cold damage, damage over time, and spell damage, but not with other nodes on this tree.

13.description: When you cast Glacier you gain the {Rime} buff which increases your damage over time and freeze rate multiplier.
13.altText:
Rime does not stack.

The Rime buff does affect the Glacier cast that grants it.

14.description: Glacier costs less mana, but the largest explosion is disabled.

15.description: Glacier’s middle-sized explosion deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but Glacier costs more mana.

16.description: Glacier has an increased chance to freeze and stun enemies.

17.description: Critical hits with Glacier grant mana equal to a percentage of your maximum mana, up to a limited number of times per second.

18.description: Glacier kills grant mana equal to a percentage of your maximum mana.

stats.statName: Percent Of Maximum Mana Gained On Kill

19.description: Glacier’s explosions occur in reverse order.

20.description: Greatly improves Glacier’s base critical strike chance, but reduces its critical strike multiplier.

21.description: All of Glacier’s explosions occur at a target location, but Glacier's critical hits no longer deal extra damage (compared to non-critical hits).

stats.statName: Crits No Longer Deal Extra Damage

22.description: Glacier has a higher chance to freeze enemies, but deals less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

24.description: Glacier costs less mana and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

25.description: {Ice Vortices} created by Glacier have a chance to instead become a {Greater Ice Vortex} that deals significantly more damage and has a larger radius.

26.description: Glacier deals more hit damage to rare and boss enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

stats.statName: Hit Damage Against Rares And Bosses

27.description: Chill chance granted by this tree is doubled. Glacier hits deal more damage to chilled enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

28.description: You gain ward on critical strikes with Glacier.

30.description:
When you directly cast Glacier you are teleported to the target location, as long as the location is accessible. This does not count as casting the Teleport skill and is not affected by Teleport's skill tree.

Glacier also gains a cooldown and now counts as a {Traversal} skill.
30.altText: Using a Traversal skill puts all other traversal skills on cooldown and traversal skills' cooldowns do not recover while you are using a traversal skill.

stats.statName: Does not use the Teleport Skill or Tree

0.description:
Requires a melee weapon.

Jump forward and strike in an area in front of you while shadows appear and simultaneously strike on either side of you.

1.description: Synchronized Strike deals damage in a larger area.

2.description:
{Shadows} created by Synchronized Strike deal increased damage. This effect also applies to shadows created from any source for 4 seconds after using Synchronized Strike.

This effect stacks.
2.altText: This benefit only applies to attacks performed by shadows, not to Synchronized Strike itself.

3.description: Synchronized Strike creates 2 additional {Shadows}, but costs significantly more mana. This can exceed your normal maximum number of {Shadows}.
3.altText: This effect is not cumulative with other sources of additional maximum {Shadows}.

4.description: Synchronized Strike has a chance to cause enemies to bleed and a chance to shred enemy physical resistance.

5.description: Using Synchronized Strike grants you {Crimson Shroud} for a short duration, granting you bleed chance and less damage over time taken. This stacks up to 3 times for a short duration.

stats.statName: Damage Over Time Taken per Crimson Shroud

6.description: Synchronized Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but {Shadows} from Synchronized Strike expire after attacking. They also do not cause existing {Shadows} to expire and do not trigger {on shadow creation} or {on shadow expiration} effects.

7.description: Synchronized Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

8.description: Synchronized Strike deals more damage to enemies on low health.
8.altText: Targets below 35% of max health are considered to be at low health.

9.description: Synchronized Strike leeches a portion of the damage it deals as health.

10.description: You gain {Haste} for a short duration when you kill an enemy with Synchronized Strike.

11.description:
Synchronized Strike instantly kills enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health).

If you have a similar effect from an item or passive node then the highest threshold is used.

12.description: You are granted increased critical strike chance for 4 seconds on kill with Synchronized Strike. This effect can stack.

13.description: Synchronized Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per equipped sword and has a chance to poison enemies per equipped dagger.

14.description: Improves Synchronized Strike's base critical strike chance.

15.description: Synchronized Strike deals more critical strike damage.

16.description: Synchronized Strike has a chance to inflict enemies with {Critical Vulnerability}.

17.description: Synchronized Strike has a chance to shred enemy armor. Armor shred applied by Synchronized Strike has increased effectiveness.

18.description: Synchronized Strike inflicts enemies with a {Shadow Dagger}.

19.description: Synchronized Strike consumes existing {Shadows} to deal damage in a larger area and grant you ward per {Shadow} consumed.

20.description:
Synchronized Strike causes existing {Shadows} to use {Shadow Cascade} on use, rather than being consumed immediately. 

This effect consumes a portion of mana per active Shadow.

21.description: Synchronized Strike costs less mana.

22.description: You are granted increased attack speed for 3 seconds if Synchronized Strike hits at least one enemy.

23.description: The {Shadows} now jump inward towards the target rather than outward, making it easier for them to hit the same target. Synchronized Strikes has additional mana cost.

24.description: Synchronized Strike deals more damage, but the {Shadows} now attack from where you teleport from, rather than where you arrive.

25.description: {Shadows} created within 4 seconds of using Synchronized Strike restore health on creation.

26.description:
You now disappear instead of teleporting to the target and a {Shadow} is created in your place, but Synchronized Strike has a longer cooldown. You are invulnerable for 1 second after using Synchronized Strike.

Synchronized Strike's mana cost is significantly lower.

27.description:
Directly using Synchronized Strike grants {Dark Passage} for 4 seconds, creating a shadow every second over its duration.

Synchronized Strike deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but only creates a single shadow from the initial attack.

stats.statName: Create a Shadow Every Second for 4 Seconds

28.description: Synchronized Strike always critically hits enemies on high health.
28.altText: Targets above 65% max health are considered to be at high health.

0.loreText: Adaptability is a power in and of itself

2.description: Enables {Ice Nova}, which has a freeze rate of 40. Elemental Nova hits deal more (multiplicative with other modifiers) damage.
2.loreText: Applies to all type of elemental nova

3.description: Elemental Nova has a chance to chill enemies and an increased chance to freeze enemies.
3.loreText: Applies to all types of elemental nova

4.description: Elemental Nova casts {Freezing Cascade} on hit, creating a cascade of freezing novas that chain between enemies.
4.loreText: Applies to all types of elemental nova

5.description: Elemental Nova deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but Elemental Nova costs more mana.
5.loreText: Applies to all types of elemental nova

6.description: Elemental Nova hits have a chance to grant ward.
6.loreText: Applies to all types of elemental nova

7.description: The {Protective Strikes} and {Survival of the Victor} nodes on this tree grant more ward.
7.loreText: Applies to all types of elemental nova

8.description: Enables {Lightning Nova}, which has +1% critical strike chance compared to other Elemental Nova types. Elemental Nova hits deal more (multiplicative with other modifiers) damage.

9.description: Elemental Nova hits have an increased critical strike chance.
9.loreText: Applies to all types of elemental nova

10.description: Elemental Nova kills have a chance to grant ward.
10.loreText: Applies to all types of elemental nova

11.description: You have more ward retention for 4 seconds after killing an enemy with Elemental Nova. You may have only one instance of this buff at once.
11.loreText: Applies to all types of elemental nova

12.description: Enables {Fire Nova}, which deals 8% more hit damage than other Elemental Nova types. All Elemental Nova hits deal more (multiplicative with other modifiers) damage.

13.description: Elemental Nova hits penetrate enemy elemental resistances.
13.loreText: Applies to all types of elemental nova

14.description: Elemental Nova hits deal more damage against enemies that are at high health (multiplicative with other modifiers). Elemental Nova has increased cast speed.
14.loreText: Applies to all types of elemental nova

stats.statName: Hit Damage To High Health Enemies

15.description: Elemental Nova is now cast at a target location instead of around you.
15.loreText: Applies to all types of elemental nova

16.description: Elemental Nova has a significantly larger area of effect when directly cast, and ignites caused by Elemental Nova have increased duration, but Elemental Nova has a 4 second cooldown. The area of effect increase is smaller if Elemental Nova is channeled.
16.loreText: Applies to all types of elemental nova

17.description: Elemental Nova has a shorter cooldown.
17.loreText: Applies to all types of elemental nova

18.description:
Elemental Nova hits have a chance to attach a {Spark Charge}, which deals lightning damage to nearby enemies after 1 second or when the enemy dies.

Additionally, Elemental Nova deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
18.loreText: Applies to all types of elemental nova

19.description: Elemental Nova hits have a chance to Ignite enemies.
19.altText: Applies to fire nova, ice nova, lightning nova, and elemental nova.
19.loreText: Applies to all types of elemental nova

20.description: You can store an additional charge of Elemental Nova.
20.loreText: Applies to all types of elemental nova

21.description: Elemental Nova has a larger area of effect.
21.loreText: Applies to all types of elemental nova

22.description: Elemental Novas have a chance to be {Overcharged}. Overcharged Novas shock enemies and have a larger area of effect.
22.loreText: Applies to all types of elemental nova

23.description: {Overcharged} Elemental Novas deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and have increased stun chance.
23.loreText: Applies to all types of elemental nova

24.description:
{Ice Nova} has a higher chance to Freeze enemies.

{Lightning Nova} has a chance to Shock enemies.

{Fire Nova} has a chance to Ignite enemies.

25.description: Elemental Nova costs less mana, but you take increased cold damage if you have cast Elemental Nova recently (past 4 seconds).
25.loreText: Applies to all types of elemental nova

26.description: Elemental Nova deals more elemental damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a slightly larger area of effect. These effects are doubled when it is directly cast.
26.loreText: Applies to all type of elemental nova

27.description: Elemental Nova has a chance to shred armour on hit and has increased critical strike chance.
27.altText: Armour Shred reduces armour by 100, lasts 4 seconds, and can stack.
27.loreText: Applies to all types of elemental nova

28.description: Elemental Nova becomes a channeled ability, unleashing 5 novas per second, and rapidly draining your mana. Elemental Nova has a smaller area of effect (multiplicative with other area modifiers).
28.altText: Cast speed only affects how quickly you start channelling.
28.loreText: Applies to all types of elemental nova

29.description: Elemental Nova costs less mana per second to channel
29.loreText: Applies to all types of elemental nova

30.description:
You have additional lightning resistance while channeling, but Lightning Nova is disabled.

If you have not taken the {Fire Nova} or {Ice Nova} nodes, then this node re-enables basic Elemental Nova.
30.loreText: Applies to all types of elemental nova

32.description: Elemental Nova hits deal more damage against chilled enemies, frozen enemies, shocked enemies, and ignited enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).
32.loreText: Applies to all types of elemental nova

34.description: Elemental Nova critical strikes deal more damage.
34.loreText: Applies to all types of elemental nova

2.description: Whenever you expend a {Storm Stack} you have a chance to cast {Storm Bolt} at an additional enemy.

3.description: Gathering Storm deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and you expend {Storm Stacks} more frequently, but {Storm Bolts} target enemies within a smaller area.

4.nodeName: In the Eye of the Storm
4.description: Whenever you expend a {Storm Stack} you have a chance to cast {Maelstrom}.

6.description: Whenever you expend a {Storm Stack} you have a chance to gain a stack instead of losing one.

7.description: Whenever you expend a {Storm Stack} you have a chance to gain {Haste}.

8.description:
Whenever you use a companion ability you expend {Storm Stacks} over the next 0.3 seconds.

Storm Bolts triggered this way deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

stats.statName: Expends Storm Stacks On Companion Use

9.description: Whenever you hit a boss or rare enemy with a {Storm Bolt} you have a chance to cast it again at the same enemy after 0.25 seconds.

10.description: While wielding a staff the melee attack of Gathering Storm is replaced by a direct ranged cast of {Storm Bolt}, but Gathering Storm costs additional mana.
10.altText: Gathering Storm cast this way is affected by effects which apply to Gathering Storm and to Storm Bolt, but it is no longer a melee attack.

11.description: {Storm Bolts} target enemies from farther away.

12.description: If you have from 1 to 15 {Storm Stacks}, your minions' lightning skill hits have a chance to grant you a {Storm Stack}.
12.altText: If Gathering Storm is converted to physical or cold then this requires a physical or cold hit instead.

13.description: Gathering Storm penetrates enemy lightning resistance.
13.altText: If Gathering Storm is converted to physical or cold then this grants physical or cold penetration.

14.description: {Storm Bolts} now consume a portion of your current mana to deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per 10 current mana, up to a maximum.
14.altText: The amount of mana consumed is also restricted by the max damage bonus, so having more than 1,000 current mana won't consume more than 10 mana.

15.description: Whenever you expend a {Storm Stack} while dual wielding you now cast {Storm Bolts} at two enemies instead of one.

stats.statName: Additional Storm Bolt While Dual Wielding

16.description: Gathering Storm has increased attack speed.

17.description: Whenever you directly use Gathering Storm you gain mana per active {Storm Stack} up to a maximum.

stats.statName: Mana Gain Per Storm Stack On Use

18.description: You have increased global stun chance and additional freeze rate multiplier per active {Storm Stack} up to a maximum.

stats.statName: Increased Stun Chance Per Storm Stack
Freeze Rate Multiplier Per Storm Stack

19.description: Gathering Storm's hits have a chance to consume mana to grant you additional {Storm Stacks}.
19.altText:
This has no effect if you have no current mana.

Mana consumption happens after the mana gain from the {Manafused Storm} node.

20.description: Gathering Storm's melee attack deals damage in a larger area and you have a chance to gain an additional {Storm Stack} if you hit at least 3 enemies with the same melee attack.

21.description:
Whenever you use Gathering Storm's and hit at least one enemy you gain a stack of {Wings of Lightning}.

Each time one of your {Storm Crows} attack they consume a stack of Wings of Lightning causing their basic attack to chain 2 additional times.

22.description:
{Storm Bolts'} hits have chance to shock enemies.

Gathering Storm deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to shocked enemies.
22.altText: If Gathering Storm is converted to cold or physical respectively this depends on frostbite or armor shred.

23.description:
Gathering Storm deals additional spell damage per 3 melee damage on your equipped axe or mace.

The added spell damage granted by this effect is significantly reduced when applied to a Storm Totem through its {Unmatched Storms}.

24.description:
Gathering Storm's and {Storm Bolt's} base lightning damage is converted to physical. Consequently this damage scales with increases to physical damage, but not increases to lightning damage.

Shock chance on hit from all sources is converted to armor shred chance for Gathering Storm.

Swaps Gathering Storm's {Lightning} tag for a {Physical} tag.

25.description: Gathering Storm deals additional melee damage per Strength while wielding a 2 handed weapon.

26.description:
Gathering Storm's and {Storm Bolt's} base lightning damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to lightning damage.

Shock chance on hit from all sources is converted to frostbite chance for Gathering Storm.

Swaps Gathering Storm's {Lightning} tag for a {Cold} tag.

27.description: Gathering Storm's hits have a chance to chill enemies and a higher chance to freeze enemies.

28.description: Gathering Storm has a higher chance to freeze enemies per 2 Attunement and it also has additional cold penetration for frostbite per 2 Attunement.

30.description: Gathering Storm has improved base critical strike chance per stack of {Maelstrom} on you from any source.

0.loreText: Call to the forest and it will call back to you in the howls of the wolves

2.description: Your Wolves have additional dodge chance, and have increased dodge rating for each point of strength you have.

3.description: Your Wolves gain a {Leap Attack} to close the gap on distant enemies. Leap Attack has a 10 second cooldown.

4.description: Wolves have a chance to {Howl} on kill. This does not expend Howl's mana cost or put it on cooldown.

5.description: Wolves have a chance to cause enemies to bleed with their melee attacks.

6.description: Wolves deal more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers) and bleed they inflict has additional Physical Penetration.

7.description:
When you kill an enemy one of your Wolves has a chance to {Howl}. This does not expend Howl's mana cost or put it on cooldown.

Howl also grants more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and increased melee attack speed to all affected allies.

8.description: Wolves have increased attack and move speed.

9.description: Wolves deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
