10.description: Your Wolves' melee hits deal more damage, have a greater chance to stun (both multiplicative with other modifiers) and it has improved base critical strike enemies, but has less attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

11.description: You have an additional wolf companion at all times. This wolf does not count towards your companion limit.

12.description: Wolves have additional armor, and their attacks leech a portion of the physical damage they deal as health.

13.description: Wolves have a chance to chill enemies on hit.

14.description: Wolves deal additional cold damage with attacks, and have an increased chance to stun enemies.

16.description: Wolves have additional base health regeneration and increased health regeneration.

17.description: You can summon Wolves up to your maximum number of companions.
17.altText: When you cast Summon Wolf, you will summon wolves up to your companion limit.

18.description: Your Wolves have a chance to retaliate with {Storm Bolt} when hit or when they hit an enemy.
18.altText: {Storm Bolts} cast by your Wolves are affected by your {Gathering Storm} tree and scale with minion damage.

19.description: Your Wolves have more health (multiplicative with other modifiers).

20.description: Your Wolves have a chance to retaliate with {Storm Bolt} when hit, and deal more spell damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
20.altText: {Storm Bolts} cast by your Wolves are affected by your {Gathering Storm} tree and scale with minion damage.

21.description: Your Wolves deal more lightning damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

22.description: Your Wolves' melee attacks deal additional lightning damage.

23.description: Your Wolves now deal increase damage and have increased health for each point of Attunement you have.
23.altText: This scales with your attunement, not the attunement of your wolves.

24.description: Wolves have more damage and dodge rating (multiplicative with other modifiers). This bonus is tripled for Wolves that have used {Howl} recently.
24.altText: Recently refers to the past 4 seconds

25.description: Your Wolves cannot be stunned.

26.description: The buffs granted by {Howl} last longer and wolves have a chance to Howl when they hit a rare or boss enemy. This does not expend Howl's mana cost or put it on cooldown.

27.description: Your Wolves' {Howl} also grant {Haste} for a short duration.

28.description: Bleed inflicted by Wolves lasts longer and wolves have a chance to slow on hit and when hit.

29.description:
Your Wolves gain the {Ice Bite} ability, which deals higher damage in a larger area, with a 6 second cooldown. 20% of the remaining cooldown is recovered every time the Wolf hits with an ability other than Ice Bite, including their basic attack.

Ice Bite deals melee cold damage. Consequently this damage scales with your wolves' increases to melee and cold damage, but not increases to their physical damage.
29.altText: Ice Bite has 100% increased radius relative to the wolves' basic attack.

30.description: While you have the additional wolf from {Permanent Bond} summoned, Summon Wolf is replaced with {Howl}, but you cannot have more than one wolf summoned at a time.

stats.statName: You can only have one active Wolf
Summon Wolf becomes Howl with only one active Wolf

0.altText: Added damage is applied at 1200% effectiveness
0.loreText: A cunning mage can use the power of gravity in more ways than one

2.description: Meteor deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but Meteor has reduced cast speed.

3.description: Meteor has increased cast speed, but costs more mana. Meteors fall faster.

4.description: Meteor deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and even more against enemies at full health.

5.description: Meteor has a chance to break into {Shrapnel} on impact, hitting nearby enemies.
5.altText: {Shrapnel} scales with increases to spell damage and fire damage, but not with other nodes on this tree unless stated otherwise.

6.description: {Shrapnel} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
6.altText: {Shrapnel} scales with increases to spell damage and fire damage, but not with other nodes on this tree unless stated otherwise.

7.description: {Shrapnel} travels faster, causing it to travel further.
7.altText: {Shrapnel} scales with increases to spell damage and fire damage, but not with other nodes on this tree unless stated otherwise.

8.description: {Shrapnel} projectiles pierce (continue through targets they hit), but travel slower.
8.altText: {Shrapnel} scales with increases to spell damage and fire damage, but not with other nodes on this tree unless stated otherwise.

9.description: Meteor has a chance to stun enemies and stuns it inflict last longer.

10.description: Meteors deal more damage of all types except fire (multiplicative with other modifiers).
10.altText: Meteor deals only fire damage by default, so for this node to have an any effect you must first add non-fire damage from another source, such as an item.

11.description: Meteor falls faster.

12.description: When directly cast, an additional Meteor falls within a 4m radius of the first, but Meteor costs much more mana.
12.altText: Increased Area for Area Skills stats still only affect the area of effect of each individual meteor, not the size of the area in which they drop.

stats.statName: Number Of Meteors For Direct Casts

13.description: Meteor deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but meteors fall further apart.

14.description: When directly cast, more Meteors fall per cast, but individual Meteors deal damage in a smaller area.

stats.statName: Number Of Meteors For Direct Casts

15.description: Meteors fall more frequently. This does not affect the total number of Meteors that fall.

16.description: Meteors fall in a line towards where you aim, but Meteor costs more mana.

17.description: Meteor costs less mana.

18.description: Meteors deals damage in a larger area of effect.

19.description: Improves Meteor's base critical strike chance. Meteor has a chance to deal damage in a significantly increased area.

20.description: Meteor critical strikes deal more damage.

22.description: When directly cast, more Meteors fall per cast.

stats.statName: Number Of Meteors For Direct Casts

23.description: Meteor always crits if you have more than 400 mana before you cast it.

24.description:
After you cast Meteor you recover a portion of the mana spent over the next three seconds. 

You can only recover mana from one cast at once, so if you cast meteor again within three seconds you lose the remaining mana you would have recovered from the first cast.

25.description: Casting Meteor grants the {Craterborn} buff, granting additional fire penetration and increased cast speed for a short duration. Craterborn does not stack.

26.description: Directly casting Fireball while you have {Craterborn} grants ward and restores your mana.

0.loreText: One day all that will be left of us will be echoes in the abyss

2.description: Abyssal Echoes deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

3.description: Abyssal Echoes' initial burst shreds enemy armor.

4.description: Armor shred applied by Abyssal Decay has increased effect.

5.description: Abyssal Echoes no longer has a cooldown, but costs more mana.

6.description: Abyssal Echoes costs less mana.

7.description: Directly using Abyssal Echoes has a chance to cast a {Void Rift} from each nearby {Devouring Orb}.

8.description: Abyssal Echoes can now be cast at the target location.

9.description: Abyssal Decay has increased duration.

10.description: Abyssal Decay now blinds enemies.

11.description: Abyssal Decay causes enemies to have reduced physical resistance, but it is no longer consumed when the enemy is hit.

12.description: Abyssal Decay causes enemies to take increased damage over time.

13.description: Abyssal Decay now deals damage when the enemy is hit, rather than over time. Each hit deals a portion of the full damage Abyssal Decay would have dealt over its full duration. This damage still counts as damage over time.

stats.statName: DoT -> Damage To Enemy On Hit

14.description: Directly using Abyssal Echoes grants you {Nether Coating} for 5 seconds, granting you increased attack speed with your melee and throwing attacks and causing you to deal more damage to blinded enemies.

15.description: {Nether Coating} also grants you a chance to inflict {Time Rot} on hit.

16.description: Abyssal Echoes' initial burst consumes all stacks of bleed on the enemy, causing their damage to be dealt instantly.

17.description: Abyssal Echoes' initial burst slows enemies.

18.description: Abyssal Decay causes Enemies that would apply {Slow} to instead grant their target {Haste} for 1 second.

19.description: After casting Abyssal Echoes your next {Erasing Strike} and {Void Cleave} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to slowed enemies.

20.description: Abyssal Echoes affects a larger area.

21.description: Abyssal Echoes' initial burst has a chance to ignite enemies.

22.description: Abyssal Echoes' initial burst now hits and deals spell void damage, but no longer inflicts Abyssal Decay.

23.description:
Spell void damage from {Potent Corruption}, {Vorpal Reverberation} and attribute scaling is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to void damage.

Abyssal Echoes' initial burst now also heals you and your allies and nodes on this tree that grant more damage also grant more healing.

24.description: Abyssal Echoes' damage now scales with attunement rather than vitality, and its healing effectiveness is also increased by attunement.

25.description: Abyssal Echoes deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but no longer chains.

26.description: Abyssal Decay now spreads to several nearby enemies after 1 second.

27.description: Abyssal Decay spreads to enemies further away and can spread to more enemies when it spreads.

28.description: {Abyssal Rifts} cast additional Abyssal Echoes.

29.description: Abyssal Echoes now creates an {Abyssal Rift} at the target location that casts Abyssal Echoes for you 3 times at its location before expiring.

31.description:
Abyssal Echoes can chain additional times. 

This effect is tripled for echoed casts.

32.description: Echoed casts deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

0.loreText: Mana is a mage's most vital tool and his ability to produce it is his most vital ability

2.description: Mana Strike has increased attack speed.

3.description: Mana Strike has a chance to shred enemy physical resistance and a chance to shock enemies.

4.description: Mana Strike hits grant you increased spell damage for 4 seconds. This effect can stack, and is doubled when hitting a boss or rare enemy.

stats.statName: Global Spell Damage Per Enemy Hit

5.description: Mana Strike hits enemies near the target location, rather than in front of you, but grants significantly less mana (multiplicative with other modifiers) from mana orbs and instant restoration.

6.description: Mana Strike instantly restores mana when it kills an enemy, or when it hits a boss or rare enemy.

stats.statName: Mana Instantly Restored on Boss or Rare Hit

7.description: Mana Strike instantly restores mana when it critically strikes an enemy.

8.description: Mana Strike has significant additional critical strike chance, but Mana Strike's critical strikes no longer deal extra damage.
8.altText: Mana Strike will no longer receive critical strike multiplier from any source.

9.description: Mana Strike grants more mana gained (multiplicative with other modifiers) from its mana orbs and instant restoration.

10.description: Mana Strike now has a cooldown. It grants more mana gained from mana orbs and instant restoration, and it has more area of effect (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

11.description:
Mana Strike has a chance to knock enemies back on hit.

This effect has a 2 second cooldown.

12.description: Mana Strike hits have a chance to attach a {Spark Charge}.

13.description: Mana Strike gains additional critical strike chance equal to a percentage of your current mana, but its base critical strike chance is removed.

14.description: Mana Strike has additional melee lightning damage equal to a percentage of your current mana.

stats.statName: Current Mana -> Added Melee Lightning Damage

15.description: Mana Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) while you are not on full mana.

16.description: Mana Strike leeches a percentage of damage dealt as health while you are not on full mana.

17.description: Mana Strike additionally strikes enemies it hits with {Mana Arc} while you are not out of mana. {Mana Arc} consumes 10 mana.
17.altText: {Mana Arc} scales with increases to spell damage and lightning damage, and can benefit from other nodes on this tree.

stats.statName: Casts Mana Arc At Positive Mana

18.description: Mana Strike has increased attack speed. {Mana Arc}'s mana consumption is reduced.

19.description: Mana Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but {Mana Arc}'s mana consumption is increased.

20.description: Mana Strike has an increased area of effect.

21.description: Mana Strike's mana orbs restore additional mana while you are out of mana.

stats.statName: Mana from Mana Orbs while Out Of Mana

22.description: Mana Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a chance to shock enemies.

23.description: Mana Strike's mana orbs restore additional mana.

24.description: A portion of the mana gained from Mana Strike's mana orbs is instead gained as twice as much ward.

stats.statName: Mana Gain -> Twice as Much Ward Gain

25.description: {Transfusion} grants more ward (multiplicative with other modifiers).

26.description:
When you directly use Mana Strike and hit at least one enemy, you have a chance to cast {Static Orb}. This chance is doubled while you are above 80% mana. This effect can occur up to 3 times per 2 seconds, and consumes 120% of Static Orb's mana cost.

If Mana Strike has a cooldown, this effect is guaranteed.

28.description:
Mana Strike's base lightning damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to lightning damage. It now has a chance to freeze enemies.

Shock chance on hit from all sources is converted to frostbite chance for Mana Strike.

Swaps Mana Strike's {Lightning} tag for a {Cold} tag.

0.loreText: Unleash the echoes of the dead

2.description: {Wraiths} appear at the target location, but Summon Wraith costs more mana.

3.description: {Wraiths} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and have increased melee attack speed, but are unable to move.

4.description: {Wraiths} have more melee attack speed (multiplicative with other modifers).

5.description: Summon Wraith summons additional {Wraiths} with each cast, but Summon Wraith also costs more mana and now has a cooldown.

6.description: Summon Wraith has a shorter cooldown, and there is a shorter delay between each {Wraith} being summoned.

7.description: Summon Wraith summons additional {Wraiths} per cast, but costs more mana.

8.description: Removes the delay between each {Wraith} being summoned, but fewer Wraiths are summoned per cast (rounded up).

9.description: {Wraiths} have more maximum health (multiplicative with other modifiers).

10.description: {Wraiths'} health no longer decays, but you are limited to only 2 wraiths.
10.altText: Effects which increase your maximum wraiths do not apply if you have this node.

11.description: Bleed inflicted by {Wraiths} has increased effect and duration.
11.altText: Increased bleed effect increases the damage of bleed multiplicatively with other modifiers, but additively with other sources of increased bleed effect.

12.description: {Wraiths} are larger, deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), and hit a larger area with their melee attacks.

13.description: You can control more {Wraiths} at once.
13.altText: This node has no effect if you have the Twin Spirits node.

14.description: {Wraiths} deal additional necrotic damage with attacks and spells.

15.description: Summon Wraith has increased cast speed and costs less mana.

16.description: {Wraiths} move faster.

17.description: You have a chance to instead summon a {Flame Wraith}, which casts fireballs. Additionally all {Wraiths} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

18.description: {Wraiths} have improved base critical strike chance, and when you cast Summon Wraith you gain increased critical strike chance equal to its mana cost for 4 seconds.

19.description: {Wraiths} have additional critical strike chance and leech a portion of the damage they deal with crits as health

20.description: {Wraiths'} critical strikes deal more damage.

21.description: {Wraiths} deal more necrotic damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), and leech a portion of the necrotic damage they deal as health.

22.description: {Wraiths} have more maximum health (multiplicative with other modifiers), but Summon Wraith costs more mana and has reduced cast speed.
22.altText: The health bonus is multiplicative with other modifiers.

23.description: {Wraiths}' have additional posion penetration and their melee attacks have a chance to poison enemies on hit.

24.description: You have a chance to instead summon a {Putrid Wraith}, which Poisons enemies from a distance. Additionally all {Wraiths} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

25.description: {Wraiths}' health decays more slowly.

26.description: Your critical strikes restore health to your {Wraiths}.

28.description: {Wraiths} have a chance to cause enemies to bleed on hit.

29.description: {Wraiths} have a chance to apply {Damned} to nearby enemies on death.
29.altText: Damned is a stacking ailment that lasts for 3 seconds, deals 25 base Necrotic damage and reduces targets health regeneration by 20% per stack.

30.description: Gain ward for each {Wraith} summoned, but their health decays more quickly.

0.loreText: Lead the charge

2.description: Shield Rush deals more damage.

3.description: Shield Rush hits deal more hit damage to enemies at full health (multiplicative with other modifiers).

stats.statName: Hit Damage Vs Full Health Enemies

4.description: When you cast Shield Rush you create a {Void Beam} that travels with you, which is a spell that deals void damage over time in a small area. Shield Rush costs more mana.

5.description: When Shield Rush ends it creates a {Void Beam} that travels back in the direction you came from, but Shield Rush costs more mana.
5.altText: {Void Beam} is a spell which deals void damage over time in its area of effect.

6.description: Shield Rush no longer requires a shield and hits deal additional base void damage, but Shield Rush costs more mana.

7.description: Shield Rush's final impact deals additional melee void damage.

8.description: Shield Rush hits deal additional void damage, but this damage is reduced by your increased attack speed.

stats.statName: Damage Reduced By Increased Attack Speed %

9.description: Shield Rush costs less mana.

10.description: You take less damage while using Shield Rush (multiplicative with other modifiers).

11.description: Shield Rush hits have an increased chance to stun enemies.

12.description:
When Shield Rush ends, you return to the position you used it from.

This removes Shield Rush's {Traversal} tag.

13.description: When Shield Rush ends, your mana is restored to the amount you had when it started, but Shield Rush now has a 10 second cooldown.

stats.statName: Mana Restored When Shield Rush Ends

14.description: Shield Rush gains additional charges, but you take more damage while using Shield Rush (multiplicative with other modifiers).

15.description: Shield Rush no longer has a cooldown, but costs health in addition to mana to use.

16.description: Shield Rush's final impact deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

17.description: Shield Rush's final impact deals more damage.

18.description: Improves the base critical strike chance of Shield Rush's final impact.

19.description: Critical strikes from Shield Rush's final impact deal more damage.

20.description: Shield Rush's final impact strikes a second time after a 0.5s delay, but Shield Rush hits deal less damage.

21.description: Shield Rush's final impact echo deals significantly more hit damage, but the delay between the final impacts is longer.

22.description: Improves the base critical strike chance of Shield Rush's final impact echo.

stats.statName: Final Impact Echo Base Crit Chance

23.description: Critical strikes from Shield Rush's final impact echo deal more damage.

2.description: Armament stacks last longer and grant you additional melee physical damage per stack.

3.description: You have additional armor and block effectiveness per stack of Armament.

4.description: When you drop below 0 mana, you consume all stacks of Armament to restore mana per stack.

5.description: When you have 0 stacks of Armament you have an additional sword when using Multistrike, as if you had 1 stack.

6.description:
Each additional sword is replaced with {Smite}.

Smite cast this way costs its full mana cost per cast.

7.description:
You have a chance to retaliate with Multistrike swords on block. 

This effect has a 1 second cooldown and doesn't include the initial strike.

8.description: Multistrike attacks repeated by your {Echoes} have additional swords.
8.altText:
This only affects the echoed Multistrike, not the original use.

Echoing is a Void Knight mastery bonus. It grants you a chance for your attacks to repeat after a second. This node's echo bonus has no effect unless become a Void Knight.

9.description: The initial strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

10.description: Multistrike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per 30 armor, up to a maximum.

11.description: Directly using {Forge Strike} consumes all stacks of Armament to summon additional {Forged Weapons} per stack.

12.description: Multistrike has a chance to consume a stack of Armament while at maximum stacks to summon a {Forged Weapon}.

13.description: You now strike twice with Multistrike, but the full attack takes significantly longer. Each additional sword is now replaced with an axe that strikes its target twice.
13.altText: This effect still counts as using Multistrike once.

14.description: Improves Multistrike's base critical strike chance.

15.description: When you create more additional swords than there are nearby enemies, each remaining sword can consume mana to strike the nearest enemy, even if it was hit by the initial attack.
15.altText: This effect only works while you are on positive mana.

16.description: Multistrike has increased attack speed.

17.description: Multistrike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) while you are at maximum stacks of Armament.

18.description: Multistrike penetrates enemy physical resistance.

19.description: Multistrike hits have a chance to inflict bleed on enemies per stack of Armament.

20.description: Multistrike deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of bleed up to a maximum.

21.description:
Each additional sword is replaced with a spear, which stabs in an elongated area rather than a slash. This has no effect if swords are already converted to axes.

Additionally, Multistrike's critical strikes deal more damage while wielding a spear.

22.description: Multistrike deals damage in a larger area and its created swords can strike enemies further away.

23.description:
If a sword kills an enemy it will create an additional sword to strike another enemy.

This effect cannot be triggered from additional swords created this way.

24.description: You can have an additional maximum stack of Armament.

25.description: You can have an additional maximum stack of Armament, but Multistrike has less attack speed per stack (multipicative with other modifiers).

26.description: While at maximum stacks of Armament and positive mana, attacking with Multistrike will consume all stacks and 40 mana to use {Forge Strike}.

27.description: Multistrike has an additional sword while you are at maximum stacks of Armament and wielding a two-handed weapon.

stats.statName: Additional Sword At Max Stacks With 2h

28.description: {Void Cleave} consumes all stacks of Armament to gain more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and increased area per stack consumed.

2.description: Applies slow to enemies within the smoke cloud each second.

4.description: Applies armor shred to enemies within the smoke cloud each second.

5.description: Armor shred applied by Smoke Bomb is converted to poison resistance shred.

6.description: You have a chance to poison enemies with bow attacks while inside the smoke cloud.

7.description: While using a bow you now shoot an arrow that detonates the Smoke Bomb at the target location.

8.description: Smoke Bomb has a chance to shred enemy armor each second within the smoke cloud.

9.description: Smoke Bomb has a chance to inflict a stack of {Shadow Dagger} whenever it applies slow.

10.description: The smoke cloud lasts longer.

11.description: Your bow attacks have improved base critcal strike chance and blind enemies while you are inside the smoke cloud.

12.description: You and allies are granted {Smoke Blades} each second for 4 seconds while inside the smoke cloud, granting you additional melee and throwing damage. This effect can stack.

13.description: {Smoke Blades} now also causes melee and throwing attacks to leech a portion of the damage you deal as health.

14.description: The smoke cloud has a chance to create a {Shadow} each second at a random location inside the smoke cloud.

15.description: You are granted a stack of {Crimson Shroud} on kill while inside the smoke cloud, granting you bleed chance and less damage over time taken for 4 seconds. This stacks up to 3 times.

stats.statName: Damage Over Time Taken per Crimson Shroud

16.description:
You leap to the target location when you use Smoke Bomb, instead of backflipping away.

Smoke Bomb now has a much shorter cooldown, but counts as a {Traversal} skill.
16.altText: Using a Traversal skill puts all other traversal skills on cooldown and traversal skills' cooldowns do not recover while you are using a traversal skill.

17.description: The smoke cloud covers a larger area.
17.altText: This affects starting area and maximum area, but not how long it takes to reach maximum area.

18.description:
You backflip away from target direction when you use Smoke Bomb. Smoke Bomb now counts as movement skill.

During Smoke Bomb's movement you are immune to Damage.

19.description: The initial burst applies {Frailty} to enemies, causing them to deal less damage.

20.description: The initial burst grants you a stack of {Silver Shroud}, causing you to dodge the next hit and gain ward per stack.

21.description: The initial burst cleanses negative ailments on you.

22.description: The initial burst also cleanses negative ailments on allies.

23.description: The initial burst consumes all {Shadows} inside the smoke to grant you and allies health per {Shadow} consumed this way.

24.description: The initial burst consumes all {Shadows} inside the smoke to grant you and allies mana per {Shadow} consumed this way.

25.description: The smoke cloud catches fire at the end of its duration, igniting enemies inside the cloud.

26.description: Leaving the smoke cloud early causes it to immediately catch fire and end.

27.description: You use {Shadow Cascade} when the smoke cloud ends.

28.description: Your {Decoys} inside the smoke cloud automatically explode when the smoke cloud ends.

29.description: You are granted a stack of {Dusk Shroud} each second for 2 seconds while you are in the smoke cloud, granting you glancing blow chance and dodge rating. This effect can stack.

30.description: The smoke cloud grants stacks of {Dusk Shroud} more frequently.

31.description: The smoke cloud now also grants {Dusk Shroud} to allies for 2 seconds while inside the smoke cloud.

32.description: The smoke cloud has a larger area and grows faster.
32.altText: This affects starting area and maximum area, and reduces how long it takes to reach maximum area.

34.description: {Puncture} and {Shurikens} have a chance cause enemies to bleed if used inside the smoke cloud.

0.description: A bow or melee skill that performs 3 rapid attacks.

2.description: Flurry has increased attack speed.

3.description: You have increased attack speed for each hit you dealt with your previous flurry, up to a maximum.
3.altText: Multiple stacks can be gained with each strike if you hit multiple enemies.

4.description: Enemies killed by Flurry have a chance to release a {Kinetic Burst} around the target, dealing physical damage.

stats.statName: Chance for Kinetic Burst on Kill

5.description: Flurry deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifers).

6.description: Flurry leeches a portion of the damage it deals as health.

7.description: Flurry strikes have a chance to grant you {Adrenaline Rush}, granting Flurry 5% more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and 5% increased attack speed. This lasts for 4 seconds, can stack up to 4 times.

8.description: Each stack of {Adrenaline Rush} grants a chance to inflict bleed on hit.

9.description: Eack stack of {Adrenaline Rush} grants Flurry more hit damage against bosses and rare enemies.

stats.statName: More Damage to Bosses per Stack

10.description: {Adrenaline Rush} lasts longer.

11.description: {Adrenaline Rush} can have multiple stacks.

12.description: Damaging ailments inflicted by Flurry deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

13.description: Flurry is now a channelled ability that costs mana per second to maintain.

14.description: Flurry deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for each second channelled up to a maximum.

15.description: You have additional physical and elemental resistances while channelling Flurry.

16.description: If you are using a bow you fire arrows faster, but they are less accurate.

17.description:
Flurry's first strike has a chance to inflict poison.
Flurry's second strike has a chance to cause bleed.
Flurry's third strike has a chance to shred physical and poison resistance.
17.altText: These chances are not reduced by Flurry's penalty to ailment chances.

stats.statName: Third Strike Poison Res Shred Chance
Third Strike Physical Res Shred Chance

18.description: Bleed inflicted by Flurry has additional Physical Penetration.

19.description: Poison inflicted by Flurry has additional Poison Penetration.

20.description: If you are using a melee weapon Flurry now causes {Force Waves} to blast forward with each strike, dealing melee physical damage.

21.description: The {Force Waves} travel further.

22.description: Improves Flurry's base critical strike chance.

23.description: Flurry critical strikes deal more damage.

24.description: Critical strikes restore health. The amount of health gained is increased by Dexterity.

25.description: Flurry grants health when hitting at least one enemy.

26.description: Flurry grants mana when hitting at least one enemy.

27.description: Flurry's third strike Slows enemies hit.

28.description: Flurry's first and second strike deal less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but the third strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

29.description: If you are using a bow, every 6th arrow is replaced with {Multishot}.
29.altText:
For nodes that affect the 1st, 2nd, and 3rd arrow separately, this means that the 3rd arrow of every second rotation is replaced with Multishot.

Multishot cast this way benefits from Multishot's skill tree, but not from Flurry's skill tree.

0.description: Curses a target with a powerful necrotic damage over time effect. Spreads to a single nearby target on target death.

2.description: Enemies afflicted by Spirit Plague are now also slowed.

3.description: You have a chance to spread Spirit Plague when you hit an afflicted enemy.

stats.statName: Chance To Spread On Hitting Afflicted Enemy

4.description: You gain ward when hitting an enemy afflicted by Spirit Plague, up to a limited number of times per second.

5.description: Spirit Plague spreads when you critically strike an afflicted target.

stats.statName: Plague Spreads On Crit Against Afflicted Target

6.description: Enemies you inflict with Spirit Plague are also inflicted with Frailty.

7.description: Spirit Plague is now cast in an area around the target, but costs more mana.

8.description: Spirit Plague is cast in a larger area.

9.description: Spirit Plague deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but no longer spreads.

10.description: Spirit Plague has additional spell necrotic damage for each point of Intelligence

11.description: Enemies you inflict with Spirit Plague are also inflicted with poison for the same duration.

12.description: Spirit Plague has a chance to summon a {Poison Wisp} when it kills an enemy, a minion which lasts for 15 seconds and poisons nearby enemies.

13.description: Spirit Plague costs less mana and lasts longer.

14.description: Spirit Plague spreads after a duration. (This does not affect the maximum number of spreads.)

15.description: Spirit Plague has increased cast speed and lasts longer.

16.description: Enemies afflicted by Spirit Plague are also feared.

17.description: Spirit Plague is now a combo skill. Directly recasting Spirit Plague within 2 seconds will cause up to 3 inflicted enemies to spread Spirit Plague to other enemies around them.

18.description: You gain increased global damage over time when you afflict an enemy with Spirit Plague. This effect lasts 4 seconds and can stack up to 13 times.

19.description: Enemies you inflict with Spirit Plague are also inflicted by {Plague} for the same duration. {Plague} is an ailment that deals poison damage over time, spreads between enemies, and does not stack.

20.description: {Plague} inflicted by Spirit Plague has additional Poison Penetration.

21.description: You gain increased poison damage when you afflict an enemy with Spirit Plague. This effect lasts 4 seconds and can stack up to 13 times.

22.description: Spirit Plague deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

23.description: Spirit Plague deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but spreads in a smaller area.

24.description: Spirit Plague spreads to additional targets, but costs more mana.

25.description: Enemies you inflict with Spirit Plague are also inflicted with bleeding for the same duration.

26.description: Bleed inflicted by Spirit Plague has additional Bleed Penetration, but you are now also inflicted with bleeding.

27.description: You gain mana when Spirit Plague kills an enemy.

28.description: You have a chance to apply bleed when you hit an enemy afflicted by Spirit Plague.

stats.statName: Chance To Inflict Bleed On Afflicted Enemies On Hit

0.description:
Requires dual wielding.

A circular attack that's also used by your  {Shadows}.

2.description: Shadow Cascade deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per active {Shadow}.

3.description: You have more dodge rating while directly using Shadow Cascade (multiplicative with other modifiers).

4.description: Shadow Cascade has a chance to apply {Frailty} to enemies hit, causing them to deal less damage.

5.description:
If you hit at least 4 enemies with Shadow Cascade, you deal increased physical damage for a short duration.

This effect can be triggered by daggers from {Dagger Dance} as well.

6.description: Shadow Cascade slows enemies for a short duration.

7.description: Shadow Cascade has a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

8.description: Bleed chance from all sources is converted to poison when using Shadow Cascade.

9.description: Shadow Cascade deals damage in a larger area.

10.description: Shadow Cascade deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per 1% of increased melee attack speed you have.
10.altText: This effect ignores the less attack speed from {Crushing Darkness}.

11.description: Shadow Cascade has more melee critical strike chance (multiplicative with other modifiers) against bleeding and poisoned enemies.

stats.statName: More Melee Crit Chance vs Bleeding
More Melee Crit Chance vs Poisoned

12.description: Improves Shadow Cascade's base critical strike chance.

13.description: Shadow Cascade's critical strikes deal more damage.

14.description: Shadow Cascade has a chance to create a {Shadow} on kill.

15.description: You gain mana on use with Shadow Cascade per active {Shadow}.

16.description: A portion of Shadow Cascade's mana cost is refunded if used when you have at least one {Shadow}

17.description: Shadow Cascade has a chance to shred enemy armor.

18.description: Shadow Cascade deals more melee damage to enemies on low health (multiplicative with other modifiers).
18.altText: Targets below 35% max health are considered to be at low health.

19.description: Shadow Cascade deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) if you have at least a certain number of {Shadows}.

20.description: When you directly use Shadow Cascade it deals more damage, but it has less attack speed (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

21.description: Shadow Cascade now also throws piercing daggers at nearby targets, dealing throwing physical damage.

22.description: Daggers from {Dagger Dance} last longer causing them to travel further.

23.description: Daggers from {Dagger Dance} have a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

24.description: {Dagger Dance} throws more daggers which deal significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but Shadow Cascade no longer includes a melee attack.

25.description: Shadow Cascade is now channeled and throws daggers 3 times a second. It rapidly drains your mana.

26.description: Daggers from {Dagger Dance} inflict enemies with {Shadow Dagger}. This chance is much lower when {Dagger Dance} is used by a {Shadow}.

stats.statName: Shadow Dagger Chance from Shadow Casts
Shadow Dagger Chance from Other Casts

27.description: Shadow Cascade deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per sword or dagger you are wielding.

28.description:
When you directly use Shadow Cascade while targeting a {Shadow} you swap places with the Shadow.

This effect consumes mana based on how many times you have swapped places with a Shadow in the past 5 seconds.
28.altText:
This effect does not occur if the target shadow is in an inaccessible location.

If you have not swapped place with a Shadow in the past 5 seconds, this effect consumes no mana.

0.loreText: The best defense...

2.description: Shield Throw deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but Shield Throw has a longer cooldown.

3.description: Shield Throw can target and ricochet to allies other than yourself, and when it hits allies they are granted {Steel Defense} for a duration, granting them additional armor.

4.description:
If your {Manifest Armor} is hit by the shield, it performs a sweeping melee attack.

This attack cannot be triggered when the shield has no ricochets remaining.
4.altText: The attack scales with the Manifest Armor's stats.

stats.statName: Manifest Armor Casts Sweeping Melee Attack When Hit

5.description: {Steel Defense} also grants allies stun avoidance when Shield Throw hits them.
5.altText: The amount of elemental and poison protection granted is the same as the amount of armour granted.

6.description: The benefits granted by {Steel Defense} scale with your Attunement.

7.description: Whenever Shield Throw ricochets on an enemy it casts {Lava Burst,} a spell dealing fire damage to all enemies near the impact.

8.description: {Lava Burst} deals damage in a larger area and has an increased chance to stun enemies.

9.description: {Lava Burst} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

10.description: Shield Throw deals additional throwing fire damage and penetrate enemy fire resistance.

11.description:
Shield Throw's base physical damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to ignite chance for Shield Throw. 
Physical resistance shred chance from all sources is converted to fire resistance shred chance for Shield Throw.

stats.statName: Phys Shred -> Fire Res Shred Chance

12.description: Shield Throw deals more fire damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

13.description: Shield Throw and {Lava Burst} hits have a chance to ignite enemies and ignites it inflicts last longer.

14.description: Shield Throw has increased attack speed and projectile speed.

15.description: Shield Throw ricochets to additional targets, but it costs additional mana.

16.description: Shield Throw costs less mana.

17.description:
Shield Throw's hits grant you a stack of {Colossus} for 4 seconds. This can stack up to 20 times.

Each stack grants you increased armor and additional physical penetration.
17.altText: {Lava Burst} hits do not trigger this effect.

18.description:
Shield Throw leeches a portion of its damage to you.

Additionally you steal armor from enemies you hit for 4 seconds, meaning you reduce their armor and gain additional armor yourself.

19.description: Shield Throw's hits shred enemy armor.

20.description: Shield Throw ricochets to additional targets and you regain health whenever Shield Throw Ricochets, scaling with your Dexterity.

21.description: Shield Throw deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and its hits deal additional throwing damage.

22.description: Improves Shield Throw's base critical strike chance.

23.description: Shield Throw deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) equal to a portion of your block chance.

24.description: Shield Throw deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) equal to 100% of your block chance, but you have reduced all resistances while Shield Throw is released.
24.altText: This stacks with {Spiked Plates} for a total of 150% of your block chance as more hit damage.

25.description: Shield Throw has a chance to slow and increased chance to stun enemies.

26.description: Shield Throw's hits have a chance to inflict bleed and shred enemy physical resistance.

27.description: When you use Shield Throw, you are granted {Haste} for a duration.

28.description: Shield Throw's hits grants you the {Frenzy} buff for a short duration.

29.description: Shield Throw has additional critical strike multiplier scaling with your block effectiveness.

30.description: Shield Throw's hits have a chance to apply {Frailty}.

31.description: Shield Throw can ricochet between additional targets, including you if there are no other targets.

33.description:
Shield Throw can be thrown while you have a shield out, but shields are smaller and deal less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

This node has no effect if {Siege Breaker} is allocated.

0.description: Volcanic Orb fires additional {Shrapnel} from its final explosion.

2.loreText: The might of a volcano swirling in the palm of your hand

3.description:
Volcanic Orb is converted into Frozen Orb. Base fire damage is converted to cold for Frozen Orb and the skill effects it creates. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not with increases to fire damage.

Ignite chance from all sources is converted to frostbite chance for Volcanic Orb.
3.altText: The orb itself has a freeze rate of 40, the shrapnel has a freeze rate of 32, and explosions created at the start or end have a freeze rate of 100.

4.description: {Shrapnel}, {Explosive Orb} and {Fire Glyph} have a chance to chill enemies and a chance to inflict frostbite on hit.

5.description: {Shrapnels} hits deal more damage against chilled enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

6.description: {Shrapnel} travels faster, causing it to also travel further. Shrapnel is created more frequently.

7.description:
Volcanic Orb core and {Shrapnel} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but Volcanic Orb's duration is reduced. 

If you have taken the {Explosive Ground} node, Volcanic Orb leaves Explosive Ground more frequently.
7.altText: If you have taken the {Explosive Ground} node, Volcanic Orb leaves Explosive Ground more frequently.

8.description: You have increased cast Speed with Volcanic Orb, and Volcanic Orb travels faster, causing it to also travel further.

9.description: {Shrapnel} has an increased chance to stun enemies and a chance to ignite on hit.

10.description: {Shrapnel} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

11.description: {Shrapnel} pierces enemies (continues through enemies it hits).

12.description: Volcanic Orb leaves {Explosive Ground} as it travels, which explode after 3 seconds, dealing fire damage to enemies within its area of effect. Volcanic Orb costs significantly more mana.
12.altText:
{Explosive Ground} scales with increases to fire damage and spell damage, but not with other nodes on this tree.

Modifiers to the damage of Volcanic Orb's core also apply to Explosive Ground.

13.description: Volcanic Orb leaves {Explosive Ground} more frequently, but costs more mana.
13.altText: {Explosive Ground} scales with increases to fire damage and spell damage, but not with other nodes on this tree.

14.description: Volcanic Orb costs less mana, but moves slower and has a reduced duration.
14.altText: If you have taken the {Explosive Ground} node, Volcanic Orb leaves Explosive Ground more frequently.

15.description: Volcanic Orb creates a large explosion at the end of its duration, dealing fire damage.
15.altText: The explosive scales with increases to fire damage and spell damage, but not with other nodes on this tree.

16.description: Casting Volcanic Orb creates a {Fire Glyph} at your feet which explodes after 1.3 seconds, creating a {Fire Nova}.
16.altText: The explosion scales with increases to fire damage and spell damage, but not with other nodes on this tree.

17.description: Explosions from {Explosive Orb} and {Glyph of Fire} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

18.description: Explosions from {Explosive Orb} and {Glyph of Fire} have a chance to ignite enemies.

19.description: Volcanic Orb's core deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

20.description: Volcanic Orb's core, {Shrapnel} and {Explosive Orb} hits deal more damage, but Volcanic Orb costs more mana and has less cast speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

21.description: Volcanic Orb's core and {Shrapnel} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but Shrapnel is created less frequently.

22.description: Frozen Orb has an increased chance to freeze enemies.

23.description: Volcanic Orb moves slower for each second it exists.

24.description: Volcanic Orb's core deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), and it accelerates, moving faster for each second it exists.

25.description: Volcanic Orb has a shorter cooldown.

26.description: Volcanic Orb's core hits deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but Volcanic Orb no longer creates {Shrapnel} when it ends.

27.description: Volcanic Orb costs less mana.

0.loreText: The fury of nature crushes all

2.description: Fury Leap's critical strikes deal more damage.

3.description:
You have a chance to reset Fury Leap's cooldown whenever you kill an enemy with any other skill.

Fury Leap's cooldown can only be reset once every 5 seconds.

stats.statName: Chance To Reset Fury Leap Cooldown On Kill

4.description: Fury Leap creates {Storm Bolts} while you are leaping.
4.altText: {Storm Bolt} is affected by your Gathering Storm tree.

5.description: {Storm Bolts} occur with increased frequency.

6.description:
You have additional spell damage per 2 Attunement while leaping, and kills with {Storm Bolt} have a chance to reset Fury Leap's cooldown.

Fury Leap's cooldown can only be reset once every 5 seconds.

stats.statName: Spell Damage Per 2 Attunement While Leaping
Chance For Storm Bolt To Reset Fury Leap's Cooldown

7.description: When you land, you and your minions gain additional melee damage and spell damage for 3 seconds. This buff can stack.

8.description: When you land, you and your minions gain {Frenzy} for 3 seconds, which increases attack and cast speed. Frenzy cannot stack.

9.description: Your Wolf, Sabertooth, and Raptor companions leap with you.

10.description: Fury Leap has an increased chance to stun enemies and stuns it inflicts last longer.

11.description: Fury Leap pulls enemies when you land.

12.description: Fury Leap has a chance to cast {Summon Vines} where you leap from.
12.altText:
{Summon Vines} is an active skill in Spriggan Form and can be scaled via the Spriggan Form tree.

The vines are stationary melee minions whose attacks poison on hit.

The vines scale with your bonuses to minions, but not with other nodes on this tree.

stats.statName: Chance To Cast Summon Vines At Departure

13.description: Fury Leap has a chance to cast {Summon Vines} where you land.
13.altText:
{Summon Vines} is an active skill in Spriggan Form and can be scaled via the Spriggan Form tree.

The vines are stationary melee minions whose attacks poison on hit.

The vines scale with your bonuses to minions, but not with other nodes on this tree.

stats.statName: Chance To Cast Summon Vines At Arrival

14.description: Fury Leap's deals damage in a larger area and costs less mana.

15.description: Fury Leap hits deal more damage against enemies at full health (multiplicative with other modifiers).

stats.statName: Hit Damage Against Enemies At Full Health

16.description: Fury Leap deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and you leech a portion of the damage it deals as health.

17.description:
Fury Leap's cooldown is reset when you kill an enemy with a short leap.

Fury Leap's cooldown can only be reset once every 5 seconds.
17.altText: A short leap is less than 10 meters.

stats.statName: Reset Fury Leap Cooldown On Short Leap Kill

18.description: While you are below half health, Fury Leap always critically strikes.

20.description: Fury Leap deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a shorter cooldown.

22.description: When you land with Fury Leap you cast Upheaval. This consumes Upheaval's mana cost and requires positive mana.

24.description: You are immune to damage while leaping.

25.description: Fury Leap deals more damage based on how far you leap.

26.description: When you land, you and your minions are healed.
26.altText: This is affected by your Increased Healing Effectiveness stat.

27.description: When you land you cleanse all ailments on you and your minions.

0.loreText: Don't fear the Reaper.

2.description: While in Reaper Form, you deal increased damage but have reduced healing effectiveness.

3.description: You move faster for 4 seconds after using {Reap} while below half health.

4.description: {Reap} deals damage in a larger area and you leech a portion of the damage its hits deal as health.

5.description: While in Reaper Form you gain health from kills. This bonus is doubled for kills using {Reap}.

6.description: While in Reaper Form, you deal increased damage and have increased critical strike chance, but lose health when you kill an enemy.

7.description: {Reap} deal more damage for each percent of health you are missing (multiplicative with other modifiers). You deal increased damage at low health while in Reaper Form.
7.altText: You are at low health when your current health is below 35% of your maximum health.

stats.statName: Reap Damage Per Missing Health Percent

8.description: {Reap} hits instantly kill enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health).
8.altText: If you have a similar effect from an item or passive node then the highest threshold is used.

9.description:
All of {Reap}'s base damage and its added melee damage from intelligence are converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to necrotic damage.

Poison chance from all sources is converted to {Frostbite} for Reap, and Reap gains a freeze rate equal to four times your intelligence.

Reap loses its {Necrotic} and {Poison} tags and gains a {Cold} tag instead.

stats.statName: Reap Necrotic Damage per Intelligence -> Cold

10.description: While in Reaper Form, you deal additional necrotic damage. This bonus is doubled for {Reap}.

11.description: While in Reaper Form, your critical strikes deal more damage. This bonus is doubled for {Reap}.

12.description:
All of {Reap}'s base damage and its added melee damage from intelligence are converted to physical. Consequently this damage scales with increases to physical damage, but not increases to necrotic damage. You have additional physical penetration while in Reaper Form.

All poison related effects from this tree now affect bleed for Reap.

Reap loses its {Necrotic} tag and gains a {Physical} tag instead.
12.altText: This node has no effect if you have taken the {Gravechill} node.

13.description: {Reap} moves you further.

14.description: Reap poisons enemies. It also gains the {Poison} tag.
14.altText: Effects in the tree such as this, which modify poison chance or duration, can be converted to frostbite or bleed if you have taken the {Gravechill} or {Bloodmoon Reaver} nodes.

15.description: {Reap} has a chance to poison enemies, and poisons you inflict while in Reaper Form last longer.

16.description: Entering Reaper Form poisons all nearby enemies. While in Reaper Form, you have a chance to poison enemies that you hit.

stats.statName: Poison Stacks To Nearby Enemies On Transform

17.description: While in Reaper Form, you have a chance apply {Mark For Death} to enemies on hit. This chance is doubled for {Reap}.

18.description: You have increased attack, cast speed and movement speed while in Reaper Form.

19.description: Gain a stack of {Reaper’s Ascendance} every 5 seconds you spend in Reaper Form, which grants you increased spell damage. You can have up to 25 stacks of Reaper’s Ascendance at a time.

20.description: You gain stacks of Reaper’s Ascendence more frequently.

21.description: While in Reaper Form, your health decays more slowly and you deal increased damage over time.

22.description: While in Reaper Form, you gain additional armor proportional to your intelligence.

23.description: While in Reaper Form, potions grant twice as much health as normal.

24.description: While in Reaper Form, you gain additional necrotic and poison resistance per point of intelligence.

stats.statName: Necrotic Resistance Per Point Of Intelligence
Poison Resistance Per Point Of Intelligence

25.description: While in Reaper Form, you have more ward retention. {Reap} grants ward on hit.

26.description: {Reaper’s Blessing} also grants ward when you transform back to your human form.

27.description: Entering Reaper Form summons {Skeletons}, unless you are already at your maximum number of Skeletons.
27.altText: The skeletons summoned are the same as those summoned with the Summon Skeleton skill, and all of its nodes still apply.

28.description: You gain ward when entering Reaper Form.

29.description: Hitting minions with {Reap} heals them for the same amount that Reap would heal you if an enemy was hit.

30.description: You have a chance to cast {Hungering Souls} whenever you kill an enemy with {Reap}.

31.description: While in Reaper Form you have increased healing effectiveness and leech more of the damage you deal. You gain additional health on hit with {Reap}.

32.description: {Reap} has a much longer cooldown, but no longer shares a cooldown with other traversal skills.

34.description: While in Reaper Form, you have a chance to retaliate with {Blood Tether} when you are hit.

stats.statName: Chance To Cast Blood Tether When Hit

0.description: Quick fixed distance dash which hits all enemies in the path with a lightning melee attack.

1.description: Surge shocks enemies and has an increased chance to stun.

2.description: Surge deals damage in a larger area.

3.description: Surge {Immobilizes} enemies hit for a short duration.

4.description: Surge has a chance to apply a {Spark Charge} on enemies.

5.description:
Shock applied by Surge has increased duration per equipped sword.

{Spark Charges} applied by Surge deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per equipped sword.
5.altText: If you have the {Glacial Assault} node then this increases frostbite duration instead of shock duration, and if you have the {Flaming Surge} node it increases ignite duration instead of shock duration. However, regardless of these nodes, this node always increases spark charge damage.

6.description: Surge deals additional melee lightning damage.

7.description: Surge deals more damage per 1% of movement speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

8.description: You are invulnerable while Surging.

9.description: Surge has increased duration, causing you to move slower.
9.altText: This does not affect the total distance travelled.

10.description: Surge deals more lightning damage per 4 {Static Charges} you have when you use Surge (multiplicative with other modifiers).

11.description: Gain {Static Charges} when you use Surge.

12.description: You gain {Static Charges} on hit with Surge.

13.description: You cast {Static} on arrival with Surge.

14.description: Improves Surge's base critical strike chance and you gain ward on crit with Surge.

15.description: You travel further with Surge.

16.description: You gain ward if Surge hits at least one enemy.

17.description: You gain ward on hit with Surge.

18.description:
Surge's base lightning damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to lightning damage. It also has a chance to freeze enemies.

Shock chance from all sources is converted to {Frostbite} chance and effects related to shock now depend on Frostbite instead.

Swaps Surge's {Lightning} tag for a {Cold} tag.

19.description: Surge causes a {Tidal Wave} to continue past the arrival point, dealing spell cold damage and chills enemies.

20.description: Surge has a higher chance to freeze enemies and deals more cold damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

21.description: You now cast {Lightning Blast} on arrival with Surge. This uses Lightning Blast's mana cost.

22.description: You now cast {Lightning Blasts} while travelling with Surge. This uses Lightning Blast's mana cost.

23.description: Surge now moves you in a zig zag motion rather than a straight line and deals more spell lightning damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

24.description: While Surge is on cooldown, using a melee attack and hitting at least one enemy grants you a stack of {Dormant Energy} up to a maximum. Using Surge again consumes all stacks to deal more damage per stack (multiplicative with other modifiers).

25.description: Consuming stacks of {Dormant Energy} grants you ward per stack consumed.

26.description: You have a chance to cast {Fire Aura} when you consume a stack of {Dormant Energy}.

27.description:
Surge's base lightning damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to lightning damage. 

Shock chance from all sources is converted to ignite chance and effects related to shock now depend on ignite instead.

Swaps Surge's {Lightning} tag for a {Fire} tag.

Has no effect if you have the {Glacial Assault} node.

28.description: Surge causes a {Flame Reave} to continue past the arrival point, a melee attack dealing fire damage in a cone in front of you. This effect costs Flame Reave's mana cost as well.

30.description: Surge deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) but you travel a shorter distance.

0.loreText: A primalist should wield his weapon like the claws of a bear, like the talons of an eagle.

2.description: Swipe deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and slows enemies, but has a cooldown.
2.loreText: A bear need only strike once to claim its prey

3.description: While you have {Aspect of the Panther} you have additional critical strike multiplier per Stack. This bonus is doubled if you are dual wielding.

4.description: Swipe hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

5.description: Swipe has a chance to shred physical resistance on hit.

6.description: When you attack with Swipe and hit at least one enemy you gain health if you are transformed, or mana if you are not transformed.
6.altText: This effect cannot be triggered by Claw Totems or other minions using Swipe.

7.description:
Swipe hits instantly kill enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health). 

If you have a similar effect from an item or passive node then the highest threshold is used.

8.description:
Each stack of {Aspect of the Panther} lasts longer and grants increased health regen.

Aspect of the Panther also applies to your {Sabertooth} if you have one.
8.altText: This effect does not apply to your Sabertooth if triggered by Claw Totem or other minion using Swipe.

stats.statName: Aspect of the Panther affects Sabertooth

9.description:
Swipe deals more lightning damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

Every 3 seconds, your next Swipe deals damage in a larger area and has its base damage converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not with increases to physical damage.

Swipe gains a {Lightning} tag.

10.description: The cooldown for the effect of the {Storm Claw} node is reset if you summon a Totem.

stats.statName: Storm Claw Cooldown Reset on Totem Summon

11.description:
Swipe has a chance to shock on hit and a portion of Swipe's base damage is converted to Lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not with increases to physical damage.

If you have 5 points in this node, Swipe loses its {Physical} tag.
11.loreText: Umjol the Shaman taught his followers how to draw the power of lightning from the sky, even while Lagon rested.

12.description: Swipe has additional lightning penetration based on your Attunement

13.description: Swipe deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and leeches a portion of damage dealt as health.

14.description: You have a chance to summon a {Claw Totem} when Swipe kills an enemy or hits a rare or boss enemy.

stats.statName: Chance To Summon Claw Totem On Kill
Chance to Summon Claw Totem On Rare or Boss hit

15.description: When you attack with Swipe and hit at least one enemy you gain a stack of Aspect of the Panther. Each stack lasts 4 seconds and grants you more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
15.altText: Stacks are not multiplicative with each other, i.e. 2 stacks gives 10% more damage, not 10.25%.

16.description: Aspect of the Panther can have more stacks and each stack grants you additional melee damage.

stats.statName: Maximum Aspect of the Panther Stacks

17.description: When you attack with Swipe and hit at least one enemy you have a chance to call forth a {Spirit Wolf} from each of your summoned wolves.
17.altText: This effect cannot be triggered by Claw Totems or other minions using Swipe.

18.description: When you attack with Swipe and hit at least one enemy you call forth a {Spirit Wolf} from each of your summoned wolves.
18.altText: This effect cannot be triggered by Claw Totems or other minions using Swipe.

19.description: While you have {Aspect of the Panther} you have increased attack and cast speed. This does not scale with the number of stacks.

20.description: Swipe deals more Lightning Damage per stack of Shock on the target and more Cold Damage per stack of Chill on the target.
20.altText: These effects are multiplicative with each other and with other modifiers.

21.description: Swipe deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

22.description: When you use Swipe and hit at least one enemy your nearest companion uses its companion ability and is restored to full health.
22.altText:
This does not require the companion's ability to be off cooldown and does not put it on cooldown or invoke its mana cost.

Downed companions are excluded.

This effect cannot be triggered by Claw Totems or other minions using Swipe.

stats.statName: Nearest Companion Health Restored on Hit

23.description: When you use Swipe and hit at least one enemy, all your totems gain +1 Melee Damage and +1 Spell Damage. This buff stacks and lasts until the totems expire.
23.altText: This effect cannot be triggered by Claw Totems or other minions using Swipe.

24.description: Swipe hits deal more damage against slowed enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers)

0.loreText: The forest will go to war to keep its inhabitants safe

2.description: You can have additional Thorn Totems active, but Summon Thorn Totem costs more mana.

3.description: You summon your maximum number of Thorn Totems at once in a ring around the target location, but your maximum number of Thorn Totems is reduced and Summon Thorn Totem costs additional mana per additional totem summoned.
3.altText: Thorn totems that would be created in innaccessible locations are not created at all, but still increase the mana cost.

stats.statName: Totems Summoned In Ring At Location
Mana Cost Per Additional Totem Summoned

4.description: You regain mana when a Thorn Totem dies or is unsummoned.
4.altText: You can only regain mana from Thorn Totems that were summoned directly.

5.description: Summon Thorn Totem costs less mana.

6.description: Thorn Totem hits have a chance to poison enemies.

7.description:
When Thorn Totems die or are unsummoned they release a {Poison Burst}, which deals a small amount of physical spell damage on hit and inflicts poison.

Thorn Totem gains a {Poison} tag, but this does not affect the damage type of Thorn Totems' other abilities.
7.altText: If you have the {Pillars of Heorot} node, 100% of Poison Burst's hit damage is converted to cold.

8.description: Poison and Frostbite inflicted by Thorn Totem last longer.

9.description:
Thorn Totem's thorns gain a chance to freeze and 100% of their base physical damage is converted to cold damage. Consequently its damage now scales with your totems' increases to cold damage instead of physical damage.

All poison chance is converted to frostbite chance for Thorn Totems.

Thorn Totems have additional cold resistance.
9.altText: Freeze rate grants a chance to freeze based on the enemy's health.

10.description: Thorn Totem has a higher chance to freeze enemies, and a greater chance to freeze enemies for each point of Attunement you have.
10.altText: This scales with your attunement, not the attunement of your totems.

stats.statName: Freeze Rate Multiplier Per Point Of Attunement

11.description: Thorn Totem deals additional spell cold damage, including its own thorns.

12.description: Thorn Totems deal more spell damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but their projectiles travel more slowly.

13.description: Thorn Totems have a chance to release twice as many thorns with each burst.

14.description: Thorn Totems fire only one thorn with each burst, but they have massively increased cast speed, are more accurate with their thorns, and their thorns' hits deal more damage to rare enemies and bosses (multiplicative with other modifiers).
14.altText: {Torrent of Thorns} can still double the number of thorns in each burst to 2.

stats.statName: Thorn Hit Damage vs Rares and Bosses

15.description: Thorn Totem's thorns can pierce enemies up to a maximum

16.description: Thorn Totem deals more damage, but has less cast speed (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

17.description: Thorn Totem's thorns have a chance to deal double damage on hit.

18.description: Thorn Totem hits have a chance to shred enemy armor.

19.description: Thorn Totem's thorns travel faster and farther.

20.description: You summon Thorn Totem faster and all Thorn Totems have increased cast speed.

21.description: Thorn Totems have more health (multiplicative with other modifiers) and additional physical resistance.

22.description: Thorn Totem's thorns now seek nearby targets, but Thorn Totem has less cast speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).
22.altText: This doesn't change the fact that multiple thorns cannot hit the same target

23.description: Thorn Totems last longer and have more health (multiplicative with other modifiers)

24.description: Thorn Totems have an increased critical strike chance and deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

25.description: Thorn Totem's thorn hits deal more damage per stack of poison on the target (multiplicative with other modifiers) up to a maximum.
25.altText:
At 20 or more stacks this grants 80% more hit damage.

If you have taken the {Pillars of Heorot} node, this node's effect depends on the number of Frostbite stacks on the target instead of the number of poison stacks.

0.loreText: The souls of the dead hunger for flesh.

2.description: Souls deal additional spell damage based on your maximum mana, but fewer Souls are created with each cast.

3.description: Souls are significantly larger and deal more hit damage, but only one is created with each cast.

4.description: Improves Hungering Souls' base critical strike chance.

5.description: Souls' critical strikes deal more damage.

6.description: Souls are larger and deal more hit damage, but Hungering Souls costs more mana.

7.description: Souls have a chance to grant you mana when they kill an enemy.

stats.statName: Chance To Grant Mana On Kill

8.description: Souls grant you more mana when they kill an enemy.

9.description: Hungering Souls fires projectiles in a narrower cone.

10.description: Souls have a chance to poison enemies.

11.description: Souls have an increased chance to poison enemies, and they cost less mana.

12.description: Directly casting Hungering Souls causes you to deal more damage over time against Possessed Enemies for 8 seconds. This effect does not stack.
12.altText: This grants more damage over time against enemies afflicted with Spreading Flames instead of Possessed Enemies if Hungering Souls is converted to Fire.

13.description: Hungering Souls has a chance to fire additional projectiles.

14.description: Hungering Souls fires additional projectiles, but costs more mana.

15.description: Hungering Souls costs less mana, and fires projectiles in a wider cone.

16.description: Hungering Souls has increased cast speed and its souls travel faster, causing them to go further before they expire.

17.description:
Souls hits instantly kill enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health). 

If you have a similar effect from an item or passive node then the highest threshold is used.

18.description: Souls deal additional necrotic damage on Hit.

19.description: You have a chance to cast Hungering Souls when hit, but Souls cast this way have a 70% chance to only have one projectile.

stats.statName: Chance To Cast Hungering Souls When Hit
Chance for Single Projectile When Hit

20.description: Hungering Souls cost less mana and has a chance to grant ward on kill.

21.description:
You have a higher chance to cast Hungering Souls when hit.

When you directly cast Hungering Souls you gain Ward.

stats.statName: Chance To Cast Hungering Souls When Hit

22.description:
You have a higher chance to cast Hungering Souls when hit.

When you directly cast Hungering Souls you have a chance to cast it twice in quick succession.

stats.statName: Chance To Cast Hungering Souls When Hit

23.description: Souls deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) if you have at least one minion.

24.description: Souls deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for each minion you have.

25.description: Souls deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) if you have exactly three minions.

27.description:
Hungering Souls' base damage is increased and converted to fire and its hits ignite instead of possessing. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to necrotic damage.

Souls deal more hit damage.

28.description: Ignites inflicted by Hungering Souls last longer and have additional Fire Penetration

29.description: Souls deal more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

0.loreText: Might through retribution

2.description: You can {Riposte} an additional time after Vengeance hits an enemy, but Riposte mitigates less damage.

3.description: You deal more global damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) while preparing to riposte.

4.description: You can {Riposte} an additional time after Vengeance hits an enemy.

5.description: Vengeance has increased attack speed.

6.description:
Vengeance deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

This effect is doubled if you have blocked or parried a hit recently.

stats.statName: Doubled With Recent Block Or Parry

7.description: Vengeance and Riposte hits have a chance to attack with {Iron Blade}.

8.description:
Vengeance' base physical damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to physical damage or other damage types.

Chance to shred physical resistance from all sources is converted to chance to shred fire resistance.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to ignite.

Swaps Vengeance' {Physical} tag for a {Fire} tag.
8.altText: This node has no effect if you have taken the {Blade of Darkness} node.

9.description: {Iron Blade} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

10.description: {Iron Blade} has a chance to reduce enemy armor.

11.description:
{Iron Blade} travels faster, causing it to also travel further.

Additionally, Vengeance and Riposte hits have a chance to attack with {Iron Blade} per point of Attunement up to a maximum.

12.description: Vengeance critical strikes deal more damage.

13.description:
{Iron Blades} and {Riposte} gains different benefits depending on your equipped weapons.

Mace: Riposte deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
Axe: Riposte instantly kill enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health).
Sword: Improves {Iron Blades'} base critical strike chance.
Spear: {Iron Blades} have increased bleed duration.

stats.statName: Iron Blades Critical Chance With Sword
Iron Blades Bleed Duration With Spear

14.description: {Iron Blades} now have a chance to be summoned as {Forged Weapons} instead.

15.description: You gain an additional chance to parry per {Forged Weapon} for 4 seconds after using Vengeance.

16.description:
Vengeance hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

This effect is doubled against enemies on low health (below 35% health).

17.description: Vengeance deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), and its hits have a chance to apply {Frailty} on enemies.

18.description:
Vengeance' base physical damage is converted to void. Consequently this damage scales with increases to void damage, but not increases to physical damage or other damage types.

Chance to shred physical resistance from all sources is converted to chance to shred void resistance.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to chance to inflict {Time Rot} for Vengeance.

Swaps Vengeance' {Physical} tag for a {Void} tag.

19.description: You take less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and have increased armor if you've hit an enemy with Vengeance in the past 2 seconds.

20.description: Vengeance and {Riposte} hits have a chance to grant a {Void Essence}.

stats.statName: Void Essence Chance On Vengeance Or Riposte

21.description: Your next {Void Cleave} or {Erasing Strike} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) after you use and hit with Vengeance.

stats.statName: Void Cleave Damage After Vengeance Use
Erasing Strike Damage After Vengeance Use

22.description: Vengeance hits have a chance to shred enemy armor and physical resistance.

23.description: Vengeance hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

24.description: Increases the effectiveness of all armor shred applied by Vengeance and {Riposte}.

26.description: Vengeance gains additional physical penetration with bleed per 1% overcapped physical resistance.

28.description: Riposte deals more fire damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and its hits have a chance to ignite enemies.

30.description:
Hits that you {Riposte} cannot critically strike you.

Additionally, improves Vengeance's base critical strike chance.
30.altText: Hits that you riposte that would have crit are downgraded to regular hits and do not deal additional damage.

32.description:
Vengeance hits have a chance to inflict {Time Rot}.

Additionally, Vengeance has additional chance to Echo if it can Echo.

33.description:
Vengeance deals more void damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and additional melee void damage.

Additionally, Echoed Vengeance cannot be dodged.

34.description:
Vengeance has a chance to grant you {Frenzy} for 2 seconds when hitting ignited enemies.

Additionally, Vengeance deals more fire hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per ignite on the enemy, up to a maximum.

0.loreText: Look into the orb, watch closely. It's looking back at you too.

2.description: Devouring Orb now orbits you, but has a much shorter duration (multiplicative with other duration modifiers).

3.description: Devouring Orb deals more damage and orbits you at a greater distance.

4.description:
While you are moving, you will automatically cast Devouring Orb if it is not on cooldown and you have enough mana.

This effect puts Devouring Orb on cooldown.

5.description: Devouring Orb now deals void damage to enemies it collides with.
5.altText: Added spell damage applies to the collision at 200% effectiveness.

6.description:
Devouring Orb deals more hit damage to enemies it collides with (multiplicative with other modifiers).

This ONLY affects the damage that devouring orb deals when the orb itself collides with an enemy, not the damage dealt by its void rifts or other sub skills.

7.description:
You deal more global void damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and have increased mana regen while a Devouring Orb is active.

These bonuses are doubled if you have at least 90 vitality.

8.description: Devouring Orb lasts longer, but a Devouring Orb's {Void Rifts} no longer increase in size or damage for each successive rift.
8.altText: This effect is multiplicative with other duration modifiers.

stats.statName: Successive Void Rifts Do Not Gain Damage
Successive Void Rifts Do Not Gain Area

9.description: Every 3 seconds Devouring Orb releases an {Abyssal Orb}, a spell which seeks enemies and detonates, dealing void damage in an area.
9.altText: The area of the rifts created by Abyssal Orbs scale with void rift area modifiers from this tree and with Increased Area for Area Skills stats.
